chapters.title: Chapter 451 Beast Blood Pond
paragraphs: In her room, Shang Xiaoyin, who had previously fallen unconscious due to Shang Xiaojuan's actions, finally opened her eyes. She then checked her surroundings before examining her body, and was relieved to find nothing serious about her. "That bastard! How dare he attack me for that damn slut!? I can't beat you, but I can still make you suffer!"

Shang Xiaoyin then took out a device from her storage ring, which was an interspatial communication device. She immediately contacted her parents to tell them about Shang Xiaojuan's actions against her, especially since she couldn't possibly contact Shang Huaqiang directly. A while later, she had already gotten an answer from them, and an evil smile immediately spread across her face.

"Haha! That madman will be taken home by force this morning, so no one can protect that bitch from me, and I can torture her to my heart's content." Shang Xiaoyin then sat on the side of the bed, directed her senses to Shang Yaolin's room, and discovered her peacefully sleeping. Even so, she was worried that Shang Xiaojuan was protecting her.

Using her senses, she searched their residence for him, and she was relieved when she found him nowhere. "Now that the madman is gone and only that fox kid is on that damn bitch's side, so I must act now, and I'll take her to that place."
Shang Xiaoyin immediately left her room and went to Shang Yaolin's, but Mei immediately warned Zhang Xiaolong [3] the moment she entered their room.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 17,200 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 172 green jewels sent to the inventory.]

The notification appeared at the same time that Mei informed him of Shang Xiaoyin's presence, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately unsealed his senses. However, he didn't immediately open his eyes and observe her first, especially since she could kill him easily, so he didn't want to take any risks.

[Master, Shang Xiaoyin's cultivation is at 5-Moon Divine Transcend, but the quality and quantity of her Yin Qi are poor when compared to Shang Yaolin's, likely because she is a body cultivator. Anyway, the system has detected a powerful sense monitoring you since you started sealing your senses, so I immediately tracked down its owner, who happens to be Tianguo.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was not surprised by that, especially since Tianguo was a divine beast, and his cultivation had also reached the seven divine realms, so he had already expected that he would notice his presence in the Wasteland Realm. 'Since he only intends to monitor me, I don't need to bother with him for the time being, and I will observe the situation first before going to see him.'

Shang Xiaoyin immediately approached the bed and sealed Shang Yaolin's cultivation, but she did not seal Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s cultivation because she regarded him as a weak prey, so she looked down on him greatly. Since he was curious about his plan, he didn't stop her from taking them away from the Shang Clan residence.
As she took them away, she called several women to immediately follow her to their secret hideout.

However, Shang Wuzi, who had just returned to their residence with three male members of the Shang Clan, caught Shang Xiaoyin in action. "You guys return to your places, don't discuss this matter with anyone, and I will follow her."

Sometime later, Shang Xiaoyin landed at the northernmost part of the northern island, and she observed the situation around her before channeling her qi into a rock. In an instant, the ground in that area shook quite violently, and the ground in front of her split to both sides, revealing a stone staircase leading underground.
'Oh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] was slightly surprised after seeing that. 'Can you check the underground, Mei?'
[Unfortunately, I can't do it, master. A strong concealment barrier surrounds this place; even powerful cultivators like Shang Chenguang and Shang Yingyue cannot detect it.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and attempted to use his senses to check inside, but the barrier immediately repelled them. As a result, he stopped his action and waited for Shang Xiaoyin to bring them inside.

Shang Wuzi, who was hiding in the distance, was also surprised to see the underground. 'This woman! What kind of place is this? How did she find it? Moreover, she used the mirage illusion array to hide it; even Senior Yingyue and the others seemed to be unaware of the existence of this place.'
A while later, three women arrived in that area, and Mei immediately told Zhang Xiaolong [3] the names of the three of Shang Xiaoyin's subordinates: Shang Jiali, Shang Yifen, and Shang Xinyu.
Since they belonged to the same clan, Shang Wuzi naturally recognized them, but he only paid attention to the petite woman with shoulder-length red hair, who was none other than Shang Xinyu.
"Let's go in now." Shang Xiaoyin immediately brought Shang Yaolin and Zhang Xiaolong [3] to the underground, followed by her three subordinates.
Shang Wuzi moved towards that spot, but he was stopped by the formation array, and the area immediately closed again, making him furious.

'Damn it! Only authorized people can pass through this formation, and Shang Xiaoyin is the key!' In the end, Shang Wuzi decided to hide in that area and wait for Shang Xiaoyin to come out of there. 'Should I report this to Senior Yingyue? Tch! I better not do that, or that brute woman will find out and report me to our patriarch, and I will be the one who suffers."

On the way to the underground, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see countless star crystals on the two walls flanking the stairs, and he could also see many other types of stones, such as soul pearlstone, phoenix quartz, dragonbone obsidian, and so on.

However, what caught his attention the most were those dark red stones, which were the bloodstones, especially since they contained a slightly stronger demon aura than the demon aura in the Netherworld Realm. As for the other stones, they were more useful for forging weapons or making formation arrays. 'Dang! The resources in this place are much richer and more varied!

If I can take this place from his hands, then I can utilize most of these resources to improve our cultivation. As for the stones for forging and formation arrays, I can sell them at a very high price.'

Soon after reaching the lowest point of the underground, Zhang Xiaolong [3] saw a blood pond, its contents constantly bubbling like boiling water. Around the pond, he saw various kinds of herbs, but the system could only recognize a few of them. 'What is this brute woman really planning to do to Shang Yaolin? Why did she bring us here?'
Shang Xiaoyin then handed Zhang Xiaolong [3] over to her three subordinates, who looked so eager to play with him; even their eyes were sparkling as they kept caressing his smooth black fur.
'Tch! Almost all women are the same! All of them always like cute things.' Zhang Xiaolong[3] grumbled in his heart, but he continued to pretend to be asleep.

Shang Xiaoyin swiftly undressed Shang Yaolin and prepared to submerge her in the blood pond when Shang Jiali abruptly intervened. "Are you really going to put her in there? She's not a body cultivator like us, so her body might not be strong enough to withstand the mixed effects of several beast bloods in the pond.
The effects could cause her cultivation veins to rupture, which would ultimately lead to her death."

"I know you hate Shang Yaolin so much, but I think you shouldn't put her there." Shang Xiaoyin immediately turned to them with a frown, but Shang Yifen hurriedly continued. "Even though our patriarch will protect you, you will still be in big trouble if he dies, especially since Aunt Qianying loves him so much.

If she finds out that she died by your hands, I'm sure she will ask her Murong Clan to hold our clan accountable, which will make the situation between the two clans heated, and he might sacrifice you to appease their anger."

Shang Xinyu also tried to persuade Shang Xiaoyin. "I agree with them, and you should reconsider your plans for Shang Yaolin, particularly given the power of the Murong Clan, which rivals our own Shang Clan. Although there is a marriage relationship between the two clans, we all know that they have never liked each other, and they decided to have such a relationship for the benefit of both parties.
If you cause her death, you will cause the relationship between the two clans to crack, and you yourself will bear the heavy consequences."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised by the words of the three women. 'Oh? What an interesting piece of information! Since the Murong Clan has such a relationship with the Shang Clan, I will try to get closer to them through Shang Yaolin and Shang Guangming, and their clan members will be perfect allies to destroy Shang Huaqiang and his clan.'

After thinking deeply about it, Shang Xiaoyin decided to follow the three women's words because she herself was fully aware of the consequences. Even so, she had no intention of letting go of Shang Yaolin. She tied her hands with chains before hanging her in the middle of the pond, where the hot steam from the pond quickly turned her naked body red.
She then picked one of the blackish purple herbs, formed it into a small ball, and forced her to swallow it.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] scowled in response to Shang Xiaoyin's actions, suspecting the herb might be poisonous. However, Mei immediately informed him that the herbs were actually nightmare vines, and while they wouldn't kill her, they would certainly cause her to have awful dreams.
Fortunately, he was still imprisoned in her subconscious with the dream imprisonment ability, so the herbs would not affect her, which relieved him.

Suddenly, Shang Xiaoyin took off her dress and entered the blood pond, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] could clearly see all her muscles, as well as her wound scars. 'How exactly does a body cultivator train? How could his body be covered in so many scars?'

Shang Xiaoyin immediately submerged her body into the blood pond, leaving only her head on the surface. "Aren't you three going to join me? The temperature outside continues to drop, and the cold is getting stronger. You guys should come here, and we can temper our bodies while waiting for the temperature outside to drop."

The three women immediately laid Zhang Xiaolong [3] on the side before taking off their dresses, and they right away joined Shang Xiaoyin in the blood pond. They quickly closed their eyes to cultivate their bodies by utilizing the mixture of beast blood inside.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes slightly and observed the four women cultivating their bodies. He noticed that the blood mixture in the pond was beginning to seep into their bodies, causing their expressions to appear slightly painful as they absorbed its effects. 'Hmm? Can you detect all types of blood in the pond, Mei?'

[Master, the mixture of blood in the blood pond comes from various types of poisonous beasts, such as the deathmist spider, the bloodbane viper, the blackthorn centipede, and several other types. However, there is blood from one kind of terrible beast, the abyssal venom wyrm.]
'Abyssal venom wyrm? Isn't that beast a giant worm or snake with similarities to a dragon?'

[Yes, Master. Anyway, the blood pond is very useful for tempering your body, and you won't feel the pain like them, especially since you have poison immunity. Unfortunately, there are no body cultivation techniques in the system, but I think you can ask Shang Guangming about it, and he might be willing to share his techniques with you.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly as a sign of agreement. 'I'll try talking to Shang Guangming later.'
As he kept looking at the four women, Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled slightly and released a bit of his demon pheromone, directing it at them.

The four women's expressions became restless as soon as they inhaled Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s demon pheromone; their mouths opened with soft moans, and their chests heaved up and down, aroused by their lust. Even so, they tried to fight back against its effects by using their Qi, especially since they could not stop cultivating their bodies all of a sudden, or they would suffer a backlash.

'I can't fight the four of you openly, but that doesn't mean I can't do something to all of you, and you guys can enjoy that.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then looked at Shang Yaolin and thought of a way to free her before bringing her back to the Shang Clan residence. 'I will wait until they are fully aroused before releasing her, and after that, I will immediately bring her to the Shang Clan's residence.'

Time flew quickly, and several hours had passed since Zhang Fei [4] started hunting demon beasts. Orith, who watched from the top of a boulder, became more and more impressed after witnessing him killing so many demon beasts, especially his ability to absorb their demon power, and he also obtained many demon beast cores of various grades.

'Unfortunately, his demon rank was still at the marquis rank, and his lust demon abilities were not yet comparable to Yhrer's. However, once he evolved into a lust demon lord and enhanced all his abilities, he would be able to match him.
I will discuss this with Ilsath later, and she will undoubtedly agree with my plan to strengthen him, allowing us to get rid of that idiot incubus lord as soon as possible.'
*Bam*
[Ding]
[Daily Quest: Killing 750 demons at Marquis rank or above.]
[Status: Done.
[Reward: 75,000 female essences are added to the balance.]

"Phew." Zhang Fei[4] immediately used his body modification to return his body to its original state, and he landed directly in front of Orith. "Forgive me for making you wait too long, My Lady. My training today is enough, but I will train the same way tomorrow."

"It's okay." Orith then floated down in front of Zhang Fei [4], shamelessly taking off his top and groping his chest to feel his muscles. "Your body is much better than Yhrer's, and your muscles are more defined. However, I'm curious how you can move that fast, especially since Ilsath is the only lust demon who has such a fast speed thanks to her super speed.
Additionally, I believe that your raw strength is comparable to or even greater than Thish's, yet her raw strength can be so potent due to her super strength."

Zhang Fei[4] smiled and grabbed Orith's hands. "My lady, it's actually not that difficult to increase our speed without having a super speed or anything like that. Since I don't have such an ability or adequate resources because I am a wild incubus, I decided to train by carrying a heavy demon beast on my shoulders, and I also used a lot of iron weights to make my body heavier.

However, we can't start with too heavy a load, but we can gradually increase the weight after our bodies get used to the previous weight. Regarding my raw strength, I don't have a specific method to enhance it, but it naturally increases as my demon rank rises, along with the impact of my training on increasing my speed."
"So you were able to achieve your current speed and raw strength just by relying on such heavy training?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] nodded to Orith. "Actually, you can also become faster and stronger than Lady Ilsath or Lady Thish if you do the same training as me, but such heavy training is not suitable for a noble woman like you, My Lady."
"Haha." That made Orith laugh softly. "I personally don't want to do that kind of training, and I'm more interested in doing other training. Do you want to accompany me to my training, Elion?"

paragraphs: *Thud... Thud...*
"What is this place, My Lady?" Zhang Fei [4] asked Orith directly as they arrived in front of a cave.

In response, Orith smiled and waved her hand, and the large round rock that sealed the cave entrance immediately rolled aside, revealing a sloping path in front of them. She immediately pulled Zhang Fei [4] into the cave, and the large round rock quickly returned to its position, sealing the cave's mouth once more.

"This place was the private quarters of one of the three previous succubus duchesses, but Ilsath and Thish didn't like it, so I decided to take it over. Actually, I've never brought other male demons here, including Yhrer, so you're the first male demon to come here."

"Oh." Zhang Fei [4] responded in a flat tone, even though he was curious about the end of the cave. "I heard from Xenaya that Yhrer frequently visits the succubi tower, and he has fun with the three of you."

"Are you jealous of that?" Zhang Fei [4] immediately shook his head at Orith, especially since she was no different from a slut in his eyes. "You're right, he does spend a lot of time with us, but he's not as strong as you imagine, and he'd actually be too weak if not for his abilities."

Zhang Fei [4] himself had read about Yhrer's abilities, so he was not surprised to hear Orith's answer. "I heard that the four of you are lust demon lords, so his abilities should be very extraordinary, and my abilities naturally can't compare to his, right?"

paragraphs: 'Tch! This woman! Her breasts are as large as Orith's! Zhang Xiaolong [3] murmured in his heart as he groped Hong Xinxin's breasts. She didn't mind because he was still too young in her eyes, but she would likely be furious if she discovered he was a fully grown man.

Hearing about the fox race, Hong Xinxin hurriedly pulled Shang Yaolin into the room and closed the door, and she sealed the room with her aura, so no one could eavesdrop on them.
"Actually, Long'er is a mix-breed of a heavenly fox and a demon fox, and they came to the realm to hunt him down."

"Oh?" Hong Xinxin immediately lifted Zhang Xiaolong [3] high and observed him for a brief moment. "If you didn't mention it, I definitely wouldn't have noticed, and I could indeed sense the heavenly fox aura from him even though it was faint."

After all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] mixed his two bloodlines to disguise himself with his current form, and he deliberately made his demon bloodline more dominant than his fox bloodline. "Have you met those evil foxes before, Aunty?"

"Haha." Hong Xinxin softly laughed before answering him. "Even though those foxes almost always stay in their realm, I have met some of them in the past. Actually, not all of them are bad, and many of them are kind. However, it's a different story if we talk about their two ancestors, especially Tian Baitian, and he was truly evil.

Unlike him, Tian Baixing is quite gentle, and she doesn't carelessly kill other living creatures. If my guess is correct, that old guy sent their members to hunt you down to the Netherworld Realm, specifically because you are a mixed breed."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately put on a pitiful face as he sulked at Hong Xinxin. "Aunty, big brother told me that they might have killed my parents, so I want to become strong to take revenge on them."

"Such a pitiful child; you are still this small, but you have already lost your parents." Hong Xinxin once again hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3] to her chest while rubbing the back of his head. "Actually, you are really talented, you know? You should only be around 10 years old now, but your cultivation has already reached the 6-Star Soul Realm.

Usually, children of your age are just starting to explore their path of cultivation, so their cultivation is usually still in the elementary realm. However, your parents probably taught you to cultivate earlier than other children because you are a mixed breed, and you need strength to protect yourself."
"Aunt Xinxin, you probably won't believe it, but Long'er is a dual cultivator." Hong Xinxin immediately turned to Shang Guangming, who had just opened his eyes. "Try observing him more closely."

Hong Xinxin immediately used her senses to inspect Zhang Xiaolong [3] in more detail, causing her expression to change to surprise after realizing it. "I thought you were the only kid who had Yin Qi from dozens of women inside your body, and I can feel some of them are very strong for the current you. Did your parents give you all of their Yin Qi?"

"Yes, Aunty. My parents are dual cultivators, and they told me that the dual cultivation path is the fastest to become strong, so they also taught it to me." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Shang Guangming. "Big brother, I want to learn about body cultivation, so I asked big sister to take me to see you."
Instead, Shang Guangming pointed at Hong Xinxin. "You can learn directly from her, especially since she was the one who taught me my body cultivation technique."
"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Hong Xinxin in surprise.

Hong Xinxin smiled and immediately sat on the side of the bed before placing Zhang Xiaolong [3] on her lap. "Are you really interested in body cultivation, Long'er? Unlike ordinary cultivation path or dual cultivation path, body cultivation path is really hard to improve, and you have to undergo a lot of harsh training to strengthen your body.

However, once you reach a certain level, your physical strength and raw strength will significantly increase. You will even be able to crush metal simply by squeezing it, without the need to use your cultivation."

In response, Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded his head repeatedly. "Aunty, I'm not only interested in the body cultivation path, but I'm also interested in the soul cultivation path. Unfortunately, my parents don't know much about those two cultivation paths, so they can't teach me about them. If you don't mind, I'd like to learn about the body cultivation path from you, so I can become even stronger."

"Are you able to endure the excruciating pain?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Hong Xinxin in confusion, but then she took out a bottle and explained it to him. "Unlike ordinary cultivation path, you can't just start the body cultivation path, and you have to undergo the body tempering process first, which will be extremely painful.

This potion is the key to undergoing the process, but its effects are akin to a deadly poison, as it not only tempers your outer body but also your inner body, including your bones. That's why not everyone can go through it, and only teenagers who have reached the age of maturity can start their body cultivation path, especially because the pain is extremely unbearable."

'A potion with effects similar to deadly poison, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered before putting on a determined look. "Aunty, I don't care what kind of pain I have to go through, as long as I can become extremely strong; even if the pain is extremely excruciating and unbearable, I will definitely be able to get through it."

"Little Guangming, Long'er's determination is much better than you." Shang Guangming turned his head away upon hearing Hong Xinxin, who was rubbing Zhang Xiaolong's head, say this. "Back then, you chose the body cultivation path, but you became fearful when you were about to undergo the initial process.
Even your father and Sister Qianying had to tie you up so that you could undergo the process, especially since you repeatedly ran away."

"Pft! Hahaha!" Shang Yaolin laughed out loud and glanced at Shang Guangming, whose face had turned extremely red from embarrassment. "Back then, he kept screaming in pain, and he also kept begging our parents to let him go."
"Stop it, Yaolin! Don't mention that again!"

The three of them laughed out loud at Shang Guangming's reaction, but Hong Xinxin suddenly carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] up before carrying him to the bathroom in the room, and the Shang siblings immediately followed.

After she filled the wooden tub with water, Hong Xinxin immediately poured the potion into the water and stirred it. "Long'er, you can take off your clothes now and get into this tub, so we can start the process straight away, especially since it takes so long. However, the process will be really painful, and you must maintain your consciousness while you go through the process.
Additionally, you cannot use your qi to protect your body, or my potion will not be able to penetrate into your body, and it will be wasted."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] hurriedly took off his clothes, especially since he couldn't wait to become a body cultivator, so his physique could become even stronger. paragraphs: 'Hmm?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] was slightly surprised when Hong Xinxin's qi flowed into his body, but it was different from what he usually did when treating or doing other things. Instead, her qi enveloped his bones, internal organs, veins, and other things. 'Is this the advantage of the body cultivation path?

I have my heavenly body tempering, but it only passively increases my body strength and raw strength, especially since it doesn't have a sub technique like this. If I manage to learn her body cultivation technique, both my body strength and raw strength will significantly increase.
"Can you feel it, Long'er?"

"Yes, Aunty." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "My father taught me about how to channel my Qi into other people's bodies, but he never taught me the method you are using now, and I can feel that my inner body is slowly strengthening."

"Haha." Hong Xinxin laughed at that. "Your father is a dual cultivator, so he naturally doesn't know such a method. We body cultivators can use our qi to strengthen all parts of our body, both inside and out, so we won't be easily injured when fighting our opponents.

Actually, the principle is the same as ordinary path cultivators use their Qi to protect their bodies, but such protection can still be destroyed by opponents who are stronger than us. Unlike them, our protection is not easily destroyed, especially since we protect our body from within.

Once you reach a high level in body cultivation, your skin will become extremely strong and resistant to damage from swords or other weapons. However, the body cultivation path is the harshest compared to other paths, especially since we have to keep forging our body even by using very extreme methods.
We cannot rely solely on our Qi to forge our bodies, but we also require many other resources to do so, and we must undergo hard training."
"What kind of training should we do to temper our bodies, Aunty?"

Before answering his question, Hong Xinxin first took off her nightgown, exposing her curvy body and massive breasts before Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s eyes. "I got all these scars when I started my path on the body cultivation path, and my father used all kinds of sticks, from wood to iron, to beat me.

At first, I was always in excruciating pain, and all my bones were broken many times because of it, so I fainted many times while I was going through it. However, I made the decision to become a body cultivator, and my stubborn nature led me to persist with the rigorous training.

Even though I had to suffer for so many years, my hard work paid off because I am now one of the best body cultivators in my clan, and my father doted on me very much because of my hard work and determination.

Since you have decided to learn the body cultivation path as well, you must prepare yourself from now on because I will give you the same harsh training as I did in the past, and I forbid you to close your sense of pain. Otherwise, your training will be useless, and you will never become a capable body cultivator."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded and asked again. "Does that mean you will accept me as your disciple, Aunty?"

"No." Zhang Xiaolong [3] put on a confused look immediately, so Hong Xinxin told him straight. "I never intended to take any disciples, particularly since I have to be responsible for them, and such a responsibility is truly a pain in my ass.

Although I come from a fairly large and renowned clan in my realm, I don't really like to rely on my clan to improve myself, and I mostly leave the clan to further temper my body. All cultivators, regardless of their path, will fail if they overly rely on others. Instead, we must rely on ourselves for the best results, which is why I often seek out danger, even if it poses a risk to my life.
Even though you are still small, I will not be merciful to you, and I will take you to dangerous places in this realm after you master the basics of the body cultivation path."
"Don't worry, Aunty. I will go through all of your rigorous training, and I am not afraid to go to those dangerous places."
"That's good." Hong Xinxin then stopped her qi before pulling her hand back, and she immediately put on her nightgown again. "You can try it now, and I will use my senses to inspect your body."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes and followed Hong Xinxin's previous method, and he felt that it was not too difficult to do. He immediately spread his qi throughout his entire inner body, and he began to envelop his internal organs, veins, and even his bones with it.

Hong Xinxin instantly fell dumbstruck after Zhang Xiaolong [3] did that. 'This kid! How could such a small kid have such extraordinary talent and comprehension? He only watched me once, but he was able to do it perfectly straight away. Moreover, he was truly unusual; his qi was really thick and dense for a child his age. Hey!
If Tian Baitian wanted to kill him, he was truly an idiot, and Yaolin would reap great benefits if she could establish a contract with him.'
After a few minutes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes, and he kept his qi enveloping his entire inner body. "Did I do it right, Aunty?"

Hong Xinxin immediately patted Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s head gently. "You just learned it, but you can already do it perfectly. Even I, as a novice body cultivator, need several days to master it, whereas Little Guangming requires a month.
Even so, you must not be complacent because this is only your first step in the body cultivation path, and you still have a very long way to go to become an experienced body cultivator."

"I understand, Aunty." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded his head repeatedly. "My father always emphasized to me never to be complacent, especially since the cultivation world is so vast. There are other skies above the sky, and there are countless powerful cultivators who are much stronger than me, so I must never be complacent and strive to improve my strength continuously."

"You had such a great father, you know? I really wanted to meet him, but unfortunately, he didn't live long, so I didn't have the chance to." Hong Xinxin directly touched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s forehead and imparted her body cultivation technique to him.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Heavenly Lightning Body Cultivation Technique. Grade: Divine.]

'Holy shit! It's a divine-grade body cultivation technique!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] exclaimed in shock after the notification appeared. "Aunty, I don't have the lightning element, so how am I supposed to learn that technique?"

"Long'er, you don't need the lightning element to learn it, but the results will be much better if you have it." Hong Xinxin then explained to him. "Even so, you still need the assistance of lightning to master it, and I can assist you with that since my lightning element has reached its peak stage.

However, it will be very painful since I have to attack you with my lightning, and I will not hold back in doing so. Additionally, you can use the lightning that appears in the sky during heavy rain to temper your body, and this realm is very suitable for that, especially since lightning storms often occur here."
"I see." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked again. "Are there different levels of lightning in each realm, Aunty?"

Hong Xinxin nodded in response. "The lightning element's strength in each realm is different, and the lightning that appears in the upper realms will be stronger. However, only two realms have very strong lightning elements, and one is in the middle realms, which are three weeks away from here."
"What's the name of that realm, Aunty?"

"The Nine Stars Realm." Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised to hear the name of the realm from Hong Xinxin's mouth, but he immediately suppressed his excitement. "In that realm, there is a mountain called Cyanwood Mountain, and the phenomenon of powerful lightning storms often occurs at its peak.

Actually, I have checked that place several times, but I can't get close to its peak even with my current cultivation and lightning element level, so I suspect there is something related to the lightning element there."

'Hey! That item is a lower-grade lightning elemental seed, so it's natural that powerful lightning storms often occur there.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally wouldn't say that to Hong Xinxin, especially since he himself really needed it to get the lightning element, even though the chance was very small.

[Master, Hong Xinxin's lightning element has reached the peak rank, and she should be able to help you obtain the lightning element. However, you have to take her heart first, and you also have to think of a way to take that lower-grade lightning elemental seed.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded slightly in response to Mei. "Then what is the name of the other realm, Aunty?"

"Raging Thunder Realm, one of the realms in the upper realms." Zhang Xiaolong [3] let out a soft sigh in his heart, especially since that realm was so far from his reach. "Anyway, I'll stay in this realm for a hundred years, so I might be able to take you to the Nine Stars Realm in the future.
However, you must first master the third stage of the heavenly lightning body cultivation technique, and I believe you will have no difficulty in doing so, considering your talent is so good."
After that, Hong Xinxin took Zhang Xiaolong [3] in her arms, guided him out of the Shang Clan residence, and led him to the summit of the mountain.

Upon arrival, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately sat cross-legged and listened to Hong Xinxin, who began explaining the technique. "As you have read yourself, the technique has five stages: initial, intermediate, advanced, half-perfection, and perfection. Each level requires different lightning powers, so you need stronger lightning to be able to proceed to the next stage.
However, you need a strong physique to be able to withstand the lightning attacks, so we will start by training your body first."
"Aunty, does that mean I can learn many body cultivation techniques to strengthen myself?"

"Every body cultivator can learn some body cultivation techniques, and it would be great if you could learn several techniques at once, especially elemental body techniques like mine. However, it is rare for us to learn more than one, especially since each technique has harsh requirements, and not everyone can get through them.

That's why we usually choose a technique that suits our elements, which will make it easier for us to master them." Hong Xinxin suddenly used a technique, causing her entire body to be enveloped in a purple aura. "Try throwing the rock beside you at me."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately carried out Hong Xinxin's order, but the stone shattered into dust before it touched her body, even though she did nothing. "Was the stone destroyed because of the lightning element that enveloped your body?"

"In the eyes of other cultivators, this is like ordinary Qi protection, but this is my lightning Qi protection. 'Her fist strength is truly terrifying, and my bones will definitely shatter if she punches me.

Shang Yaolin told me that they need a special method to mine these rocks, yet she can split them into two with just a light punch.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] muttered in his heart as his body shuddered slightly, especially since his fist strength was not as strong as Hong Xinxin's, even though his heavenly body tempering had reached level two.
'However, her technique really benefits me, especially since I can use both techniques to improve myself at the same time.'

*Smack*

"Didn't I tell you before that I wouldn't be merciful to you?" Hong Xinxin immediately hit Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s back again with the wooden stick, causing his face to continue to grimace in pain, especially since she forbade him from using his qi to protect his body. "Since you have decided to become a body cultivator, you must learn to endure the pain, or you will fail."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed heavily before nodding to Hong Xinxin, who immediately hit his back again with her wooden stick. Although his heavenly body tempering technique had reached level two, and he also had his demon body strengthening method, each of her blows was still extremely painful for him.

Not to mention, her lightning element also continuously electrocuted his body, causing his feet to tremble continuously, and his back to quickly turn red with his blood flowing from the impact marks. 'Damn it! This old woman really has no mercy!'

Since all his clones were connected to his real body, Zhang Fei and his other clones also felt the pain, which made all his wives and partners panic. They even had to stop dual-cultivating with them because the pain was unbearable, but they immediately explained to the women about the training that Zhang Xiaolong [3] was undergoing.

This time, he was forced to take all of Hong Xinxin's attacks, and he didn't even protect his body with Qi.

After that, Hong Xinxin brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] back to Shang Yaolin's room, and she cleaned the wounds on his back with a loving and admiring gaze. 'If I have a child with Little Guangming in the future, I want to have a son with a mentality similar to his, so I can brag about him in front of everyone.'

paragraphs: "Hmm?" Orith checked Zhang Fei [4]'s back in confusion, so she turned to her subordinate. "Are you sure he had an injury before, Risaela?"
Risaela herself was confused not to see any scars on Zhang Fei [4]'s back. "My Lady, he kept screaming in pain earlier, and his back suddenly bled on its own, so I immediately went to call you."

'Sigh! Fortunately, I have healing pills, my light element, and the regenerative healing factor that I mimicked from Ashreth. Otherwise, my wounds would take a long time to heal, especially since that old woman didn't hold back in beating Zhang Xiaolong [3].' Zhang Fei [4] then spoke to Orith.
"My lady, stop worrying about me; my old injuries from the beast attack have relapsed, but my recovery is fast, so my wounds have disappeared."
"Eh?" Orith and Risaela were truly shocked to hear that. "Do you have the ability to recover? Usually, we lust demons recover our injuries through sex, but our recovery won't be as fast as yours."

'Recovery through sex, huh? That's really strange, but it's also fantastic.' Zhang Fei [4] muttered in his heart as he remembered that ability in the status of the four lust demon lords. "I do have a healing ability, and it works automatically every time I get injured, so my recovery is faster than any lust demon."

After hearing that, Orith became lost in thought as she lightly tapped her chin, contemplating which demon possessed such a healing ability. "As far as I remember, there are some demons that have such a recovery ability, some of which are dark elves and salamander demon beasts, but this is the first time I heard of a lust demon having it."

'So there are also dark elves in this realm, huh?' Zhang Fei [4] then pulled Orith closer and briefly kissed her lips. "My lady, you must have known that I'm not an ordinary lust demon, right? I don't know how I got that ability, but I've had it since I was little.

That's why I always dare to go into the scary forest to face those fierce demon beasts by myself, especially since my healing ability is very good. Even so, if I cut my limbs, I won't be able to recover and will become disabled."

"I see." Orith nodded understandingly at that. "There is no perfect ability in this world, but your healing ability is already amazing. However, you still have to be careful, especially against Thish, and you have to immediately run away if he approaches you."
"My lady, I will definitely remember your advice to stay away from Lady Thish."

"Since you're fine, I'll get back to taking care of my duties." Orith then got out of bed and walked out. "Risaela, you don't need to think about other tasks, and your main task now is to serve Elion, so you have to do your best because he is not easily satisfied."

After that, Risaela immediately approached Zhang Fei [4] while removing her red dress, making him quite tempted by her naked body. Although her body is inferior to Orith, she is still quite sexy, and she is still sexier than Ilsath.

[Master, this succubus has sexual manipulation ability, and it can induce sexual arousal in others to make them lustful and crave sexual interaction, regardless of gender and age. Mu Lingshu's stone body prevents her from experiencing sexual arousal; even your demon touch and demon pheromone have no effect on her, so I think you can try using that ability to help her.]
'Let's give it a try.'
After Risaela took off Zhang Fei[4]'s clothes, she immediately mounted his lower body, and the two quickly engaged in sexual activity.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was lying in the middle of Zhang Yue and Zhang Lin, and all three of them were completely naked. "My wounds have disappeared, so you two don't have to worry about me anymore, okay?"
"Isn't that old woman going to beat up your third clone again tomorrow, Fei'er?" Zhang Yue asked with a worried look, especially since Zhang Fei's wounds looked quite severe earlier.

"Yes." Zhang Fei didn't want to hide it from his big sister. "Even though it's painful, it's the best way to strengthen my body even more, so I'll keep going until it's completely strong. Moreover, you've seen my recovery speed, so I'll definitely be fine."

Zhang Yue let out a heavy sigh because Zhang Fei was always stubborn once he'd decided on something. "Even though your recovery speed is very fast, you still have to be careful, lest you get seriously injured by that old woman."

"I know you're worried about me, but I'll definitely be fine, Big Sis." Zhang Fei then planted a soft kiss on Zhang Yue's lips before turning to Zhang Lin, who looked like she was in serious thought. "Are you thinking about learning that body cultivation technique?"

"Haha." Zhang Lin laughed and nodded at Zhang Fei. "Big Brother, I always felt that I was the weakest among all your women; even our Big Sis is much stronger than me now, after she awakened her ice phoenix bloodline and physique, so I thought of learning that body cultivation technique to strengthen my physique. Unfortunately, I am a water element possessor, and lightning element is my weakness.

Moreover, I don't have your healing speed, and I had to go through such torture to learn it, so I'm a little afraid to learn it. Even so, I've made up my mind, so I want you to teach me that technique, and I will endure the pain."

"Me too, Fei'er." Zhang Fei and Zhang Lin looked at their big sister in surprise, especially since Zhang Yue had always been afraid of pain, and she had even fainted when she lost her virginity. "Why are you two looking at me like that? Although I have awakened the ice phoenix bloodline and physique, I am still the weakest among you all in terms of cultivation, so I also want to improve myself.

If both you and Lin'er are willing to go through that process, then I am also eager to do so. Furthermore, with your healing pills and light elements, you can help me recover, so I think it's fine if I do it. Anyway, I'm sure it's not only us who want to learn it, but our other sisters will also want to learn it, so all of us will be very strong.
That way, we don't need to hide like before, and we can help you face the enemies that might come our way in the future."

"That's true, Big Brother." Zhang Lin then told Zhang Fei that Ye Lian and the others were frustrated because they couldn't participate in the fight against those heretics before, so they wanted to do whatever they could to increase their strength. "If you tell them about that technique, they will definitely be overjoyed and impatient to learn it like us."

After contemplating the situation, Zhang Fei swiftly lifted the two women off the bed and escorted them to meet his other wives once they had dressed. As Zhang Lin expected, Ye Lian and the others were really excited and impatient to learn the body cultivation technique, and they put on a determined look to go through the torture, especially since their husband also had to go through the torture.

Since they had all decided that way, Zhang Fei immediately taught them the Heavenly Lightning Body Cultivation Technique, and he asked them to first understand the technique before starting their rigorous training. He also taught it to his three slaves and Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s two partners: Mei Xiang, Qiao Fei, Qiao Ran, Ba Shuxiang, and Xie Jingxian.
Even though none of them have the lightning element, the effect of increasing body strength and raw strength is crucial for them.

Inside the portable mansion, Zhang Fei [1] was also discussing the technique with all his partners. After all, he had decided to take them all away to the middle realms in the future, especially since he wanted to keep them by his side.

Ning Xiang and the others were relieved by Zhang Fei's decision, particularly because they had grown too comfortable with him after spending so much time with him, and the constant fear that he would leave them when he no longer needed them haunted their hearts.

Yan Luan'er was the most enthusiastic among them, especially after learning about her elder sister's dire condition at the hands of Thish. She was determined to learn about it so she could exact revenge on the succubus duchess.

Zhang Fei [1] then taught them the Heavenly Lightning Body Cultivation Technique, and he taught them how to use their qi to strengthen their bodies both inside and out, based on Hong Xinxin's previous teachings.

Since the Amaris Twins and Nadea could not become demon cultivators because they were born without cultivation veins, Feltia [2] could not teach them the Heavenly Lightning Body Cultivation Technique. She only taught the technique to Ursula, Eve, Fyr, Leora, and Ashreth.

Unlike Ursula and Ashreth, who were enthusiastic about the technique, Eve, Fyr, and Leora appeared scared when Feltia [2] explained the difficult process of learning the Heavenly Lightning Body Cultivation Technique. Even so, they finally agreed to learn it, especially since they didn't want to be left behind by him.
Even so, Feltia [2] had no intention of teaching that technique to Oz the 1st, Oz the 2nd, and Morgana.
*Tap... Tap... Tap...*
"Yaolin, I want to talk to you."
Shang Yaolin, who was about to return to her room, immediately turned to the voice owner and asked. "What do you want to talk to me about, Senior Yingyue?"

"Let's talk in your room." Shang Yaolin nodded and immediately led Shang Yingyue into her room, and they saw Zhang Xiaolong [3] fast asleep, but Hong Xinxin was no longer there. "Do you remember what happened last night?"

"Hmm?" Shang Yaolin looked at Shang Yingyue in confusion, especially since her subconscious was imprisoned by Zhang Xiaolong [3], so she had no idea about Shang Xiaoyin's actions towards them. "Did something happen last night? As far as I can remember, I slept soundly with Long'er last night, so I don't understand what you mean."

Shang Yaoling's answer caused Shang Yingyue to raise her eyebrows, especially since she herself did find them in her room last night, but Shang Wuzi told her that Shang Xiaoyin kidnapped them both. "Did you two really sleep in your room last night?"
"Yes."

Shang Yingyue did not ask further and left the room, leaving Shang Yaolin confused by her attitude. She immediately disregarded this, undressed, and laid down beside Zhang Xiaolong [3], embracing him. "Aunt Xinxin must have tortured you really hard before, right? Although her training is really harsh, I believe you can get through it, and you will become a reliable body cultivator in the future."

After she left Shang Yaolin's room, Shang Yingyue went straight to Shang Xiaoyin's room to check on them, but she found that the four women had started acting strangely again. Once again, she knocked them unconscious before checking their bodies one by one, especially since she felt so strange about their behavior. "What actually happened to them?

That fragrance had previously affected me, and I also had difficulty dispelling its effects, but I was finally able to dispel it. These girls' cultivation is also in the seven divine realms, so they should also be able to do it themselves, yet they are still affected by it even now."

Shang Yingyue then made the four women sit cross-legged on the bed, and she helped them to dispel the effects by using her own qi. Unfortunately, she still didn't know the main cause of their strange behavior, so she wouldn't be able to restore them completely, even if she dispelled the fragrance of the lustrous moonflower plants from their bodies.
Shang Guangming let out a heavy sigh as soon as he entered his room, especially since Hong Xinxin was already waiting for him with a flirtatious smile. "What about Long'er?"

"Long'er is a genius." Shang Guangming was taken aback by that, especially since Hong Xinxin rarely praised others, and he always considered others beneath him. "I only showed him once how to use our qi to strengthen our bodies from outside and inside, and he was able to do it in just a few minutes."
"Are you serious about that?" Shang Guangming was really shocked because it took him a month to be able to do it himself.

"Haha." Using her aura, Hong Xinxin stretched her hand forward and pulled Shang Guangming closer. "I don't need to lie to you, right, Little Guangming? Moreover, Long'er didn't faint even once, even though I beat his back so hard for several hours straight.

Your accidental meeting with him was truly a blessing in disguise, and Little Yaolin could reap huge benefits if she manages to form a contract with him. If he grows up and becomes strong in the future, then his heavenly fox ability will be of great benefit to all of you, and Shang Huaqiang will definitely consider giving your family a higher status.
That way, your family's influence within the Shang Clan will be very significant, and other families will not dare to look down on you guys anymore like before."

Shang Guangmin smiled bitterly, because Hong Xinxin had always been impatient to marry him. "I won't marry you now, Aunt Xinxin. If you can help Long'er become strong, and my family has successfully risen in status in my clan, then I will marry you at that time."

paragraphs: After they had served their punishment, the two women from the Huang and Hao Clans went straight to the Shang Clan residence, but they stopped in their tracks when they saw Shang Wuzi, who looked confused all alone on the roof.
Huang Qinghua immediately cupped her two hands beside her mouth and asked in a loud tone. "Hey, Wuzi! Why are you daydreaming up there? Did Shang Xinyu reject your confession?"
"Pft! Haha." Hao Jianxiu laughed at that and teased Shang Wuzi. "Is it true that Shang Xinyu has rejected you?"
"Shut up, Lilies!" Shang Wuzi then jumped down, landing in front of them. "I don't know what happened to Shang Xinyu and the others, but Senior Yingyue is helping them recover."

Both women immediately exchanged confused glances, especially since they had not heard any commotion last night. Moreover, most of the other clans living on the island would not dare to attack members of the Shang Clan, and only a few of the other clans would dare to do so. "What happened to them? Could it be that someone attacked them?"

"I'm sure no one could have snuck in there, especially since the place was covered by a powerful formation. Even if someone managed to sneak in there, I'm sure that person wouldn't do anything strange to them and kill them straight away.

Anyway, they kept acting strangely as if they had been exposed to something, and their condition still hasn't improved, even though Senior Yingue has been helping them for some time now." Shang Wuzi then told them about last night's events after they parted ways, and both women were completely shocked to hear that Shang Xiaoyin had brought her three friends to kidnap Shang Yaolin and Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Moreover, they're both inside now, and they are sound asleep."
"Do you think Yaolin did something to Shang Xiaoyin and those three women?" Hao Jianxiu inquired as she peered into the residence.
"I'm not sure if Yaolin did it." Shang Wuzi shook his head in denial. "I'm sure Shang Xiaoyin used something on them before bringing them there, since I saw her and that fox kid unconscious."

"I agree with you! Although Shang Xiaoyin looks brute, she is not a stupid woman, so she would not have brought them there without doing something to them first." Huang Qinghua then peered into the residence, deep in thought.

"That fox kid's cultivation is at the 6-Star Soul Realm, so he wouldn't have been able to trick them, let alone do something like that to them, and they would have immediately noticed his actions if he tried to do something."
Shang Wuzi and Hao Jianxiu also couldn't believe that Zhang Xiaolong [3] could trick Shang Xiaoyin and the others with his low cultivation, so they didn't hold any suspicions about him.
"Anyway, what exactly is that place?" Shang Wuzi shrugged his shoulders at them, especially since he himself could not enter, causing the two women to be curious about the place.

They suddenly saw Shang Yingyue walking out from inside with a look full of confusion, and they could hear her talking to herself, but they couldn't hear her clearly. They immediately went up to her and asked her, but she disappeared from their sight right away. After that, the three of them rushed inside and went to Shang Xiaoyin's room, but they found the four women unconscious.

Hao Jianxiu immediately walked to the bedside, grabbed Shang Yaolin's right hand, and used his senses to inspect her internal body. She then checked the bodies of the other three women, but the results were still the same. "This is weird; I can't find any traces of substance in their bodies, so they shouldn't have been exposed to poison or anything."

"There are no new scars on their bodies, so no one should have attacked them." After observing the four women's external bodies, Huang Qinghua grabbed Shang Xiaoyin's hand from her lover and checked her pulse before raising her eyebrows. "Why is her pulse so chaotic? She's obviously unconscious, so her pulse should be calm, but it's so fast now.

It seems that they were indeed affected by something, but it was not caused by external factors, and it should have come from within their bodies. Perhaps they were exposed to something that dissolves easily, so we can't find traces of it in their bodies."

"If that's true, then the answer to their strange behavior lies within that place." Both women immediately turned to Shang Wuzi, who shook his head helplessly at them. "Shang Xiaoyin is your patriarch's beloved niece, and her mother also pampers her a lot, so I think they prepared that place especially for her."

"Yeah." Shang Wuzi nodded in agreement. "Since the four of them are body cultivators, I'm sure that place has a lot to do with the body cultivation path. Unfortunately, we can't do anything to check that place, but Senior Yingyue should be able to since she was able to bring them back."

"In addition to being a soul cultivator, Senior Yingyue is also a formation array master, so the formation is not much of an obstacle for her." Huang Qinghua then turned to his lover. "How about we go there now? I'm sure she's gone there, and we might be able to sneak in there."

"Do you think Senior Yingyue is a fool?" Hao Jianxiu asked while shaking her head. "She must be aware that place is reserved for Shang Xiaoyin, so she wouldn't let anyone else in there. She even asked Wuzi to come back before saving them, so we don't have to waste time going there."

Huang Qinghua puffed out her cheeks in response, especially since she was really curious about Shang Xiaoyin's secret place. She then hugged Hao Jianxiu's arm and pulled her out of the room. "Since Shang Yaolin is still sleeping, we'll wait for her to wake up first, and we'll ask her to introduce us to that fox kid."
"All right."

After the two women left, Shang Wuzi immediately swapped Shang Xiaoyin's position with Shang Xinyu, and he sat beside her while stroking her cheek. "What am I lacking? Your parents have even agreed for us to get married, but you have always refused to marry me, and you even chose to go to this realm to accompany this brute."

Shang Wuzi then leaned forward and wanted to kiss Shang Xinyu, but he suddenly stopped when their lips were only an inch apart, and he immediately canceled his intention before leaving the room. 'Xinyu, I will prove to you that I am worthy to be your husband, and I will make you willing to marry me at that time.'

Meanwhile, Shang Yingyue had returned to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, but she was no longer as reckless as before because she had already experienced the sensation given by the fragrance of the lustrous moonflower plants, and she didn't want to be affected by it a second time, so she enveloped her body with her qi to prevent it.

Shang Yingyue carefully checked the surrounding area, and she quickly found the source of the fragrance, so she approached one of the lustrous moonflower plants. "Has this plant been here for a long time? If that's true, the fragrance of this plant should have influenced Shang Xiaoyin and the others long ago, but it has only affected them since last night.

Moreover, who was the person who saved Shang Yaolin and that fox kid from their hands? Could it be that person who planted this plant in this place? How did that person break through the formation outside? Could it be that he is a formation array master like me?"

After she made sure the place was completely clean, Shang Yingyue immediately left, but many questions about the situation arose in her mind, and she continued to make conjectures about the actual situation.
After returning to her office, Shang Yingyue immediately contacted someone from her clan, and an old man walked out of the portal a few minutes later. "Do you know this plant, Old Shang Kuang?"

"Hmm?" Shang Kuang immediately observed the black plant that was still wrapped in Shang Yingyue's qi, but then he shook his head at her. "I've seen many kinds of black plants, but this is the first time I've seen this one. Where did you find it? Why did you call me just to check it out?"

Shang Yingyue immediately explained everything to Shang Kuang, including the situation of Shang Xiaoyin and the other three women, making the old man fall into deep thought. "Bring me to them, so I can check their conditions directly."
In a few minutes, they were already in Shang Xiaoyin's room, and Shang Kuang immediately checked their conditions, but he still couldn't find any other abnormalities in their bodies.
"How was the result?"

"I couldn't detect the abnormalities in them." Shang Kuang then sighed softly and took the black plant from Shang Yingyue's hand. "Leave them like this for the time being, and I will examine this plant to find a solution to reverse their condition.
Anyway, you better not say anything to Shang Ziyuan for now, or she will come here immediately and make a scene if she finds out her daughter is in this condition."

They immediately returned to the fortress, and Shang Kuang headed back to their realm to examine the black plant. Meanwhile, Shang Yingyue promptly returned to her private quarter, contemplating the strange situation.

Time passed quite fast, and night finally arrived. A middle-aged woman with long red hair and a golden ornament tying the back of her hair walked into the Shang Clan residence. Her arrival surprised the young cultivators living there, but some of them repeatedly stole glances at her, especially the male ones.

Her face exudes beauty and maturity, featuring glazed eyes with red pupils, a small nose, thick lips adorned with red lipstick, and light makeup on her chubby cheeks. Her figure, while not particularly tall and curvaceous, exudes a seductive and sensual aura in her loose red dress, exposing the cleavage of her F-Cup breasts to their gaze.

Every time she walked forward, her breasts jiggled up and down, her big buttocks protruding from her lower dress. A proud smile graced her face as she noticed their glances at her body. Instead of being embarrassed because of their gazes, she actually puffed out her chest, making her breasts stand out even more.
"Mother!"

"Hmm?" The woman immediately turned to the voice, but she immediately put on an angry expression. "Why are you so stupid, Guangming? Our patriarch gave you an easy task, but you failed to carry it out, and here you are now serving your hundred-year sentence."

Shang Guangming smiled bitterly at his mother's scolding, especially since she scolded him in front of so many people, and his peers were clearly holding back their mocking laughter. He immediately ignored them and walked over to Murong Qianying. "Do you want to see Yaolin right now? She should still be sleeping in her room with Long'er."
"Let's go; I can't wait to check out that fox kid."

When they reached the room, they discovered Shang Yaolin taking a bath, while Zhang Xiaolong [3] was deeply cultivating on the bed. However, Mei had already informed him of their arrival, particularly Murong Qianying's presence. He immediately unsealed his senses. 'Scan her.'
Name: Murong Qianying
Age: 5,000+ years old
Race: Human
Gender: Female
Cultivation: 4-Moon Divine Transformation
Element: Blood [Advanced stage]
Core: Upper-Rank Blood Core
Physique: Human physique
Special physique: None
Special bloodline: None
Partner: Shang Chongyun
Like: Shang Chongyun, Shang Guangming, Shang Yaolin, Hong Xinxin
Dislike: Shang Huaiqiang, Fei Qinyuan, Shang Xishun

'Blood elements?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] was taken aback upon reading this, as Mei had previously informed him that the blood element was a rare element, similar to metal and wood, and this was the first time he had encountered a cultivator who possessed such an element. '4-Star Divine Transformation, huh? I hope he doesn't see through my disguise, or I'm dead.'

Murong Qianying immediately sat in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3], pressed her index finger to his forehead, and closed her eyes to read his memories. 'Hmm? Xinxin didn't lie to me, huh? This brat's father must be a powerful heavenly fox, and his cultivation has probably reached the Divine Ascendant.

Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to place such a powerful restriction in his memories, preventing me from reading them even with my current cultivation. Although it will take all my strength, I may be able to break his restriction. Unfortunately, it will definitely destroy his mind, and he'll be useless if he becomes a mindless living being, so I'd better not do it.'

"Mother?" Shang Yaolin, who had just finished bathing, called out in surprise. She immediately jumped onto her mother, causing Murong Qianying to fall onto the bed, and she rubbed her face against her breasts like a spoiled girl. "When did you come to this realm? Why didn't you tell me before you came here?"

"I came here specifically to see this fox kid." Shang Yaolin immediately looked up at Murong Qianying with a frown. "Xinxin told me about his relationship with the heavenly fox race, so I immediately arranged my time to come to this realm."
Shang Yaolin immediately jumped down from her mother's body and complained. "I thought you came to this realm because you missed me, but it turns out you came for Long'er."

"Hey! You're my only daughter, so of course I missed you." Murong Qianying then sat down again and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I want to discuss something with you about this kid, but we should talk in your brother's room."
Shang Yaolin seemed confused by that, so he turned to Shang Guangming, who nodded at him. They then followed their mother there, where Hong Xinxin was already waiting for them.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally would not let them talk about him in his absence, so after making sure that no one was monitoring him, he immediately used his invisibility to sneak into Shang Guangming's room to eavesdrop on them.

Upon their arrival, Murong Qianying immediately conveyed Hong Xinxin's idea to her daughter, causing Shang Yaolin's jaw to drop. After all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still too young in her eyes, and she herself was already hundreds of years old, so she felt that the two women's idea of asking her to marry him in the future was completely insane.

'Heh!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly sneered after hearing their plan. 'Do you think I would be interested in Shang Yaolin? The Shang Clan is my enemy because you all have caused some of my closest people to suffer, so I will destroy you all in the future.'
"Mother, I don't agree with your idea!" Shang Yaolin immediately rejected them. "Long'er is indeed a heavenly fox, and he will be useful to us; however, I will not sacrifice myself for such a thing!"

"Foolish girl!" Murong Qianying immediately scolded her daughter. "He is not only a heavenly fox, but he is also a genius cultivator, so it doesn't matter if you marry him. Moreover, you can control him after you make a contract with him, so you can do whatever you want to him afterwards, even if you want to treat him as your slave.

The most important thing is that our family's status can rise, and we can gain an important role in the Shang Clan, so we can think of another plan to get rid of Shang Huaqiang and take over the clan completely."

After hearing that, Shang Yaolin's face darkened, ready to reject her mother once more. However, Hong Xinxin hurriedly spoke to her. "Little Yaolin, you yourself have experienced being oppressed by the main members of the Shang Clan, and Long'er is your main key to turning your situation around.

If you fail to form a contract with him, then we will never be able to get rid of Shang Huaqiang, and you will also be suppressed by them for the rest of your life. That's why we came up with an idea like that, and it is the best idea for all of us."

sentences.text: After they had served their punishment, the two women from the Huang and Hao Clans went straight to the Shang Clan residence, but they stopped in their tracks when they saw Shang Wuzi, who looked confused all alone on the roof.
Huang Qinghua immediately cupped her two hands beside her mouth and asked in a loud tone.
"Hey, Wuzi!
Why are you daydreaming up there?
Did Shang Xinyu reject your confession?"
"Pft!
Haha." Hao Jianxiu laughed at that and teased Shang Wuzi.
"Is it true that Shang Xinyu has rejected you?"
"Shut up, Lilies!" Shang Wuzi then jumped down, landing in front of them.
"I don't know what happened to Shang Xinyu and the others, but Senior Yingyue is helping them recover."
Both women immediately exchanged confused glances, especially since they had not heard any commotion last night.
Moreover, most of the other clans living on the island would not dare to attack members of the Shang Clan, and only a few of the other clans would dare to do so.
"What happened to them?
Could it be that someone attacked them?"
"I'm sure no one could have snuck in there, especially since the place was covered by a powerful formation.
Even if someone managed to sneak in there, I'm sure that person wouldn't do anything strange to them and kill them straight away.

Anyway, they kept acting strangely as if they had been exposed to something, and their condition still hasn't improved, even though Senior Yingue has been helping them for some time now." Shang Wuzi then told them about last night's events after they parted ways, and both women were completely shocked to hear that Shang Xiaoyin had brought her three friends to kidnap Shang Yaolin and Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Moreover, they're both inside now, and they are sound asleep."
"Do you think Yaolin did something to Shang Xiaoyin and those three women?" Hao Jianxiu inquired as she peered into the residence.
"I'm not sure if Yaolin did it." Shang Wuzi shook his head in denial.
"I'm sure Shang Xiaoyin used something on them before bringing them there, since I saw her and that fox kid unconscious."
"I agree with you!

Although Shang Xiaoyin looks brute, she is not a stupid woman, so she would not have brought them there without doing something to them first." Huang Qinghua then peered into the residence, deep in thought.

"That fox kid's cultivation is at the 6-Star Soul Realm, so he wouldn't have been able to trick them, let alone do something like that to them, and they would have immediately noticed his actions if he tried to do something."
Shang Wuzi and Hao Jianxiu also couldn't believe that Zhang Xiaolong [3] could trick Shang Xiaoyin and the others with his low cultivation, so they didn't hold any suspicions about him.
"Anyway, what exactly is that place?" Shang Wuzi shrugged his shoulders at them, especially since he himself could not enter, causing the two women to be curious about the place.
They suddenly saw Shang Yingyue walking out from inside with a look full of confusion, and they could hear her talking to herself, but they couldn't hear her clearly.
They immediately went up to her and asked her, but she disappeared from their sight right away.
After that, the three of them rushed inside and went to Shang Xiaoyin's room, but they found the four women unconscious.
Hao Jianxiu immediately walked to the bedside, grabbed Shang Yaolin's right hand, and used his senses to inspect her internal body.
She then checked the bodies of the other three women, but the results were still the same.
"This is weird; I can't find any traces of substance in their bodies, so they shouldn't have been exposed to poison or anything."

"There are no new scars on their bodies, so no one should have attacked them." After observing the four women's external bodies, Huang Qinghua grabbed Shang Xiaoyin's hand from her lover and checked her pulse before raising her eyebrows.
"Why is her pulse so chaotic?
She's obviously unconscious, so her pulse should be calm, but it's so fast now.
It seems that they were indeed affected by something, but it was not caused by external factors, and it should have come from within their bodies.
Perhaps they were exposed to something that dissolves easily, so we can't find traces of it in their bodies."
"If that's true, then the answer to their strange behavior lies within that place." Both women immediately turned to Shang Wuzi, who shook his head helplessly at them.
"Shang Xiaoyin is your patriarch's beloved niece, and her mother also pampers her a lot, so I think they prepared that place especially for her."
"Yeah." Shang Wuzi nodded in agreement.
"Since the four of them are body cultivators, I'm sure that place has a lot to do with the body cultivation path.
Unfortunately, we can't do anything to check that place, but Senior Yingyue should be able to since she was able to bring them back."
"In addition to being a soul cultivator, Senior Yingyue is also a formation array master, so the formation is not much of an obstacle for her." Huang Qinghua then turned to his lover.
"How about we go there now?
I'm sure she's gone there, and we might be able to sneak in there."
"Do you think Senior Yingyue is a fool?" Hao Jianxiu asked while shaking her head.
"She must be aware that place is reserved for Shang Xiaoyin, so she wouldn't let anyone else in there.
She even asked Wuzi to come back before saving them, so we don't have to waste time going there."
Huang Qinghua puffed out her cheeks in response, especially since she was really curious about Shang Xiaoyin's secret place.
She then hugged Hao Jianxiu's arm and pulled her out of the room.
"Since Shang Yaolin is still sleeping, we'll wait for her to wake up first, and we'll ask her to introduce us to that fox kid."
"All right."
After the two women left, Shang Wuzi immediately swapped Shang Xiaoyin's position with Shang Xinyu, and he sat beside her while stroking her cheek.
"What am I lacking?
Your parents have even agreed for us to get married, but you have always refused to marry me, and you even chose to go to this realm to accompany this brute."

Shang Wuzi then leaned forward and wanted to kiss Shang Xinyu, but he suddenly stopped when their lips were only an inch apart, and he immediately canceled his intention before leaving the room. 'Xinyu, I will prove to you that I am worthy to be your husband, and I will make you willing to marry me at that time.'

Meanwhile, Shang Yingyue had returned to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, but she was no longer as reckless as before because she had already experienced the sensation given by the fragrance of the lustrous moonflower plants, and she didn't want to be affected by it a second time, so she enveloped her body with her qi to prevent it.
Shang Yingyue carefully checked the surrounding area, and she quickly found the source of the fragrance, so she approached one of the lustrous moonflower plants.
"Has this plant been here for a long time?
If that's true, the fragrance of this plant should have influenced Shang Xiaoyin and the others long ago, but it has only affected them since last night.
Moreover, who was the person who saved Shang Yaolin and that fox kid from their hands?
Could it be that person who planted this plant in this place?
How did that person break through the formation outside?
Could it be that he is a formation array master like me?"

After she made sure the place was completely clean, Shang Yingyue immediately left, but many questions about the situation arose in her mind, and she continued to make conjectures about the actual situation.
After returning to her office, Shang Yingyue immediately contacted someone from her clan, and an old man walked out of the portal a few minutes later.
"Do you know this plant, Old Shang Kuang?"
"Hmm?" Shang Kuang immediately observed the black plant that was still wrapped in Shang Yingyue's qi, but then he shook his head at her.
"I've seen many kinds of black plants, but this is the first time I've seen this one.
Where did you find it?
Why did you call me just to check it out?"
Shang Yingyue immediately explained everything to Shang Kuang, including the situation of Shang Xiaoyin and the other three women, making the old man fall into deep thought.
"Bring me to them, so I can check their conditions directly."
In a few minutes, they were already in Shang Xiaoyin's room, and Shang Kuang immediately checked their conditions, but he still couldn't find any other abnormalities in their bodies.
"How was the result?"
"I couldn't detect the abnormalities in them." Shang Kuang then sighed softly and took the black plant from Shang Yingyue's hand.
"Leave them like this for the time being, and I will examine this plant to find a solution to reverse their condition.
Anyway, you better not say anything to Shang Ziyuan for now, or she will come here immediately and make a scene if she finds out her daughter is in this condition."
They immediately returned to the fortress, and Shang Kuang headed back to their realm to examine the black plant.
Meanwhile, Shang Yingyue promptly returned to her private quarter, contemplating the strange situation.
Time passed quite fast, and night finally arrived.
A middle-aged woman with long red hair and a golden ornament tying the back of her hair walked into the Shang Clan residence.
Her arrival surprised the young cultivators living there, but some of them repeatedly stole glances at her, especially the male ones.
Her face exudes beauty and maturity, featuring glazed eyes with red pupils, a small nose, thick lips adorned with red lipstick, and light makeup on her chubby cheeks.
Her figure, while not particularly tall and curvaceous, exudes a seductive and sensual aura in her loose red dress, exposing the cleavage of her F-Cup breasts to their gaze.
Every time she walked forward, her breasts jiggled up and down, her big buttocks protruding from her lower dress.
A proud smile graced her face as she noticed their glances at her body.
Instead of being embarrassed because of their gazes, she actually puffed out her chest, making her breasts stand out even more.
"Mother!"
"Hmm?" The woman immediately turned to the voice, but she immediately put on an angry expression.
"Why are you so stupid, Guangming?
Our patriarch gave you an easy task, but you failed to carry it out, and here you are now serving your hundred-year sentence."
Shang Guangming smiled bitterly at his mother's scolding, especially since she scolded him in front of so many people, and his peers were clearly holding back their mocking laughter.
He immediately ignored them and walked over to Murong Qianying.
"Do you want to see Yaolin right now?
She should still be sleeping in her room with Long'er."
"Let's go; I can't wait to check out that fox kid."
When they reached the room, they discovered Shang Yaolin taking a bath, while Zhang Xiaolong [3] was deeply cultivating on the bed.
However, Mei had already informed him of their arrival, particularly Murong Qianying's presence.
He immediately unsealed his senses. 'Scan her.'
