'Blood elements?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] was taken aback upon reading this, as Mei had previously informed him that the blood element was a rare element, similar to metal and wood, and this was the first time he had encountered a cultivator who possessed such an element. '4-Star Divine Transformation, huh?
I hope he doesn't see through my disguise, or I'm dead.'
Murong Qianying immediately sat in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3], pressed her index finger to his forehead, and closed her eyes to read his memories. 'Hmm?
Xinxin didn't lie to me, huh?
This brat's father must be a powerful heavenly fox, and his cultivation has probably reached the Divine Ascendant.
Otherwise, he wouldn't be able to place such a powerful restriction in his memories, preventing me from reading them even with my current cultivation.
Although it will take all my strength, I may be able to break his restriction.
Unfortunately, it will definitely destroy his mind, and he'll be useless if he becomes a mindless living being, so I'd better not do it.'
"Mother?" Shang Yaolin, who had just finished bathing, called out in surprise.
She immediately jumped onto her mother, causing Murong Qianying to fall onto the bed, and she rubbed her face against her breasts like a spoiled girl.
"When did you come to this realm?
Why didn't you tell me before you came here?"
"I came here specifically to see this fox kid." Shang Yaolin immediately looked up at Murong Qianying with a frown.
"Xinxin told me about his relationship with the heavenly fox race, so I immediately arranged my time to come to this realm."
Shang Yaolin immediately jumped down from her mother's body and complained.
"I thought you came to this realm because you missed me, but it turns out you came for Long'er."
"Hey!
You're my only daughter, so of course I missed you." Murong Qianying then sat down again and looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I want to discuss something with you about this kid, but we should talk in your brother's room."
Shang Yaolin seemed confused by that, so he turned to Shang Guangming, who nodded at him.
They then followed their mother there, where Hong Xinxin was already waiting for them.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] naturally would not let them talk about him in his absence, so after making sure that no one was monitoring him, he immediately used his invisibility to sneak into Shang Guangming's room to eavesdrop on them.
Upon their arrival, Murong Qianying immediately conveyed Hong Xinxin's idea to her daughter, causing Shang Yaolin's jaw to drop.

After all, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was still too young in her eyes, and she herself was already hundreds of years old, so she felt that the two women's idea of asking her to marry him in the future was completely insane.
'Heh!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] inwardly sneered after hearing their plan. 'Do you think I would be interested in Shang Yaolin?
The Shang Clan is my enemy because you all have caused some of my closest people to suffer, so I will destroy you all in the future.'
"Mother, I don't agree with your idea!" Shang Yaolin immediately rejected them.
"Long'er is indeed a heavenly fox, and he will be useful to us; however, I will not sacrifice myself for such a thing!"
"Foolish girl!" Murong Qianying immediately scolded her daughter.
"He is not only a heavenly fox, but he is also a genius cultivator, so it doesn't matter if you marry him.
Moreover, you can control him after you make a contract with him, so you can do whatever you want to him afterwards, even if you want to treat him as your slave.

The most important thing is that our family's status can rise, and we can gain an important role in the Shang Clan, so we can think of another plan to get rid of Shang Huaqiang and take over the clan completely."
After hearing that, Shang Yaolin's face darkened, ready to reject her mother once more.
However, Hong Xinxin hurriedly spoke to her.
"Little Yaolin, you yourself have experienced being oppressed by the main members of the Shang Clan, and Long'er is your main key to turning your situation around.
If you fail to form a contract with him, then we will never be able to get rid of Shang Huaqiang, and you will also be suppressed by them for the rest of your life.
That's why we came up with an idea like that, and it is the best idea for all of us."

paragraphs: "No! I still don't agree with your idea!" Shang Yaolin immediately refused again. "Aunt Xinxin, I certainly dislike being suppressed by them, but I don't want to be used as a tool to gain a higher status, and it doesn't matter to me if I can't make a contract with Long'er. Moreover, you and my mother have always liked young leaves, right?

You yourself are still a virgin now, so you should be the one to seduce and marry him in the future! As for me, I will only marry the man of my choice, but all the men I have known so far are not worthy of being my husband."

Shang Yaolin immediately ran out of her brother's room and returned to her own room, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] was forced to follow her back to their room. He was still curious about Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin's next plans after she rejected them, but he was afraid that she would be suspicious if he disappeared from there.
"As expected." Hong Xinxin spoke as she turned to face Murong Qiangyin. "What do you think about this? We both know Yaolin's character, and he will never agree to our idea."

Murong Qiangyin nodded slightly while thinking deeply. "If Yaolin still doesn't agree with our idea, then I have no choice but to send my eldest daughter to this realm, and I will ask her to take that fox child from her."

"Are you serious about that, Mother? Are you really going to send our big sister to this realm?" Shang Guangming inquired immediately, but his expression appeared strange as he thought about their big sister.

"Do I look like I'm joking?" Murong Qiangyin asked back with a raised eyebrow. "That kid is a heavenly fox, so everything will be too late once he grows up, and we won't be able to use him for our own interests if we can't control him.

Moreover, Yumei has long hated Shang Huaqiang, and she won't mind doing all the available options as long as we can improve our family status, so she is our best choice. I am confident that she can seduce and control that kid, and he will be completely submissive to our orders later."

Shang Guangming was rendered speechless by his mother's reply, especially since he was completely familiar with Shang Yumei's character, so he also knew that she was their best choice to control Zhang Xiaolong [3].

Hong Xinxin immediately spoke again. "You should contact Yumei now and have her come to this realm as soon as possible, Sister Qianying. She must act quickly, as it will be difficult for her to snatch Long'er away from Yaolin if he has already attached himself to her."

Murong Qianying herself was already aware of this, so she immediately took out her interspatial communication device and contacted her eldest daughter. "Yumei is on her way back to our realm, and she will go straight to this realm once she arrives there in three days."
Shang Guangming massaged his forehead after hearing that. 'Sigh! Yaolin and Big Sister are polar opposites, and Long'er will suffer if she truly falls into her hands.'
Unfortunately, all of them still don't know about the real Zhang Xiaolong [3], let alone his plans for them.

After Shang Yaolin entered their room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately inquired. "Where were you just now, Big Sis? When I woke up, I couldn't find you. I wanted to go look for you, but I didn't dare to do it."

"My mother came to this realm, and she is currently in my brother's room, so I came to see her." Shang Yaolin then approached Zhang Xiaolong [3] and carried him. "The weather in this realm seems to be calm tonight, so how about we go for a walk?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately agreed with Shang Yaolin's idea. "I'm tired of staying in this room, Big Sis, so I want to go out and explore the island."

Shang Yaolin immediately took Zhang Xiaolong [3] out of their room before leaving the Shang Clan residence, but she instantly frowned when they arrived at the exit gate, especially since two women were already waiting for them. "What are you two doing here, Huang Qinghua and Hao Jianxiu?"

"Hey! You don't have to be so cold to us, right?" Huang Qinghua was the first to answer as he approached them. "We didn't come here to find trouble with you; we came because we'd heard about this fox kid, so we wanted to see him with our own eyes."
*Slap*
Shang Yaolin immediately slapped Huang Qinghua's hand away as soon as she reached out to rub Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s head. "Stay away from us! Otherwise, I'll beat you up!"

Huang Qinghua looked furious at that, but Hao Jianxiu immediately patted her shoulder to stop her, especially since Murong Qiangyin was inside the residence, and she would punish them if she attacked Sang Yaolin. "Does this fox kid mean that much to you? You're not usually like this, Yaolin. Usually you act indifferent, but now you're acting like a mother hen protecting her chick."

"Yes! Long'er is mine, and I won't let anyone get close to him, especially the two of you." Shang Yaolin immediately took out her short spear and pointed at them. "You guys better leave now before I get really angry!"
"You-Mhmm."
Hao Jianxiu immediately covered Huang Qinghua's mouth with her hand and pulled her away from them. "All right, we don't want to look for trouble with you, so I will take Qinghua back right now."
"Humph!" Shang Yaolin snorted at them, stored his short spear, and took Zhang Xiaolong[3] away with him.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] continued to look at the two women as he realized about the relationship between them. These two women, unlike Yan Luan'er and Xi Zihua, are truly lilies. Moreover, their clans seem to be no less powerful than the Shang Clan, so I must find a way to get closer to them.'
Mei, who understood her master's thoughts, immediately displayed both women's status.

'They both don't like Shang Yaolin, huh?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then asked. "Who are they, Big Sis? Why do you dislike them so much?"

Instead, Shang Yaolin was irritated by Zhang Xiaolong's [3] question. "Tch! You better not ask about them! The short chubby one is Huang Qinghua, and the other is Hao Jianxiu, both of whom come from the Huang and Hao branch clans. If there's anyone I hate the most in this world, it's those two!

They are the most disgusting women because they are lilies, and their behavior is also very annoying, so you shouldn't think about getting closer to them. They never like men, and they will probably torture you."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed in his heart, especially since he always found the lily couple very interesting. "So how many clans from upper realms are here?"

"About 50 clans, but they live spread across this island. Besides my Shang Clan, there are five other clans living in this area: the Huang, Hao, Qiao, Murong, and Deng Clans." Shang Yaolin then pointed to a building that was more like a five-story tower. "Can you see that building?

That is the residence of the Qiao Clan, and the leader of their representatives is Senior Brother Qiao Liangren, whose strength is stronger than Senior Sister Yingyue, with his cultivation at the 1-Moon Divine Fusion Realm. Anyway, they are both soul cultivators, and they train under the guidance of Senior Hun Di."

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s eyes lit up when he heard that, especially since he didn't know the method to properly cultivate his soul, and he had relied more on dual soul cultivation so far. Unfortunately, the increase in his soul power is insignificant, even though he has done it repeatedly with all his wives and partners who have reached the soul realm or above. "Who is Senior Hun Di, Big Sis?"

"Oh! I remember you saying that you were also interested in soul cultivation." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Shang Yaolin. "Senior Hun Di is the best soul cultivator in the upper realms, and our seniors gave him the nickname the Soul Emperor; even our patriarchs respect him very much.
However, he is very strict and selective when choosing disciples, making it extremely difficult to become his disciple. Senior Sister Yingyue, for example, spent ten years to become his disciple."
"Ten years?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked by that.

"Yes." Shang Yaolin nodded before continuing. "Even though Senior Hun accepted her as his disciple, Senior Sister Yingyue couldn't immediately learn soul techniques from him, and she had to do a lot of housework for several years as a test of her determination.
Many of them failed to meet the test and gave up halfway, but she had a strong mentality and determination, and she patiently went through everything without ever complaining."
"What about Qiao Liangren?"

"Haha." Shang Yaolin giggled at that, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] could see the admiration in her eyes. "Senior Brother Liangren is a unique, handsome, and cool man. He prefers an atmosphere full of silence, and he rarely speaks, especially since he needs high concentration and quietness to cultivate his soul.

Even so, he is gentle and kind-hearted, and he never looks at other people based on their status, so many people admire him, both men and women, including me. Actually, we can meet him at the mountain peak, but he shares the time with Senior Yingyue to cultivate there. If my memory serves me correctly, tonight is his turn to cultivate, so I'll accompany you there later.
However, please refrain from making any noise, as he prefers peaceful cultivation."

"I know, Big Sis." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately thought of a way to approach Qiao Liangren, especially since he had long wanted to increase his soul power, and he was the only person who could help him now. Although Shang Yingyue could also help him, he felt that she was too cautious and suspicious of him, so he felt that it would be difficult to approach her. "Then what about the other clans?"

Shang Yaolin immediately pointed out the residences of the other four clans. "Senior Huang Shengyan, the representative of the Huang Clan, is the strictest among the other representatives. When you meet him, be careful in your speech and behavior, or he'll punish you.

Senior Hao Weizen and Senior Deng Zhichao, the representatives of the Hao and Deng Clans, are notorious for their lecherous behavior, frequently spying on women while they are bathing. The Murong Clan is my mother's family, and their representative is Senior Sister Murong Mengying. Unlike Senior Sister Yingyue, she is lazy and drunkard.
However, when faced with serious problems, she can be extremely serious and ruthless towards anything and anyone that poses a threat to her clan."

'Oh?' Shang Yaolin's description of Murong Mengying piqued Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s interest in meeting her, so he immediately searched for her location on his map, and he found her alone in the fortress. 'That woman seems very interesting; I might be able to form a good relationship with her.' "What about other clans living in other areas?"
As she took Zhang Xiaolong [3] to several places, Shang Yaolin told him many things about those clans, and Mei immediately recorded the data regarding them into the system.

Meanwhile, the two women had returned to their private quarters, but Huang Qinghua was still furious because of Shang Yaolin's previous threats, making Hao Jianxiu shake her head helplessly. "Forget about her, especially since you will never win against her, and you will suffer if Aunt Qianying punishes you severely."
"What do you think about that fox kid?"

Hao Jianxiu immediately sat down beside his lover. "I can indeed sense the demon aura from him, so Hao Shihai and Huang Fujian's reports about him are indeed accurate. Unfortunately, Shang Yaolin is very protective of him, so it is difficult for us to get more information about him, except our two seniors investigate him.
However, he is too weak to be a threat, so Senior Brother Weizen and Senior Brother Shengyan won't care about him."

"That's true." Huang Qinghua then pulled her lover down onto the bed. "How about we work together with the others to kidnap that kid? I don't know why, but somehow, I have a feeling that he is not an ordinary fox, so I want to snatch him from that bitch."

"No." Hao Jianxiu immediately rejected her idea. "Qiao Xuan has already refused to do that, and Murong Yi is still a cousin of Shang Yaolin, so he won't help us either. As for Deng Shicang, he is useless and won't be able to help us, so you better forget about that fox kid. Anyway, let's sleep now, especially since we still have to continue our duties tomorrow."

Huang Qinghua sighed softly and closed her eyes, but she continued to rack her brains for a way to snatch Zhang Xiaolong [3] from Shang Yaolin. 'Tch! Sooner or later, I will definitely snatch that fox kid from that bitch, and I will force him to make a contract with me.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 17,700 Qi.]
[Reward: 177 green jewels.]

The notification's appearance signified that the day had changed again, and Shang Yaolin immediately brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] back to the Shang Clan residence, especially since it was already midnight. However, he asked her to take him to the mountain peak, especially since he wanted to see Qiao Liangren cultivating there, so she took him there directly.

When they arrived there, Qiao Liangren was already sitting in the middle with his eyes closed, and his cultivation soul was already outside his body, so they did not approach him and watched him from a distance.

As Shang Yaolin had said before, Qiao Liangren was indeed very handsome, and his expression was filled with tranquility as he cultivated. However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could feel something different about him, especially his cultivation soul.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then used the nature awareness ability to check Qiao Liangren's cultivation soul, and he could see countless Qi threads flowing into it. Not only that, but he could also see that it was also absorbing nature energy from those colorful rocks.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a while before whispering to Shang Yaolin. 'Big Sis, I want to try doing the same as Senior Liang'er, so please protect me.'

Before Shang Yaolin could speak, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already closed his eyes and released his cultivation soul, leaving her stunned. 'Sigh! This kid! He's really impatient to learn new things, but I'm not sure he can do the same as Senior Brother Liangren, especially since he has never learned about soul cultivation before.'

Hong Xinxin immediately spoke again.
"You should contact Yumei now and have her come to this realm as soon as possible, Sister Qianying.
She must act quickly, as it will be difficult for her to snatch Long'er away from Yaolin if he has already attached himself to her."
Murong Qianying herself was already aware of this, so she immediately took out her interspatial communication device and contacted her eldest daughter.
"Yumei is on her way back to our realm, and she will go straight to this realm once she arrives there in three days."
Shang Guangming massaged his forehead after hearing that. 'Sigh!
Yaolin and Big Sister are polar opposites, and Long'er will suffer if she truly falls into her hands.'
Unfortunately, all of them still don't know about the real Zhang Xiaolong [3], let alone his plans for them.
After Shang Yaolin entered their room, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately inquired.
"Where were you just now, Big Sis?

Shang Yaolin immediately took Zhang Xiaolong [3] out of their room before leaving the Shang Clan residence, but she instantly frowned when they arrived at the exit gate, especially since two women were already waiting for them.

Besides my Shang Clan, there are five other clans living in this area: the Huang, Hao, Qiao, Murong, and Deng Clans." Shang Yaolin then pointed to a building that was more like a five-story tower.

Anyway, they are both soul cultivators, and they train under the guidance of Senior Hun Di."
Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s eyes lit up when he heard that, especially since he didn't know the method to properly cultivate his soul, and he had relied more on dual soul cultivation so far.
Unfortunately, the increase in his soul power is insignificant, even though he has done it repeatedly with all his wives and partners who have reached the soul realm or above.
"Who is Senior Hun Di, Big Sis?"
"Oh!
I remember you saying that you were also interested in soul cultivation." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded to Shang Yaolin.
"Senior Hun Di is the best soul cultivator in the upper realms, and our seniors gave him the nickname the Soul Emperor; even our patriarchs respect him very much.
However, he is very strict and selective when choosing disciples, making it extremely difficult to become his disciple.
Senior Sister Yingyue, for example, spent ten years to become his disciple."
"Ten years?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked by that.

If my memory serves me correctly, tonight is his turn to cultivate, so I'll accompany you there later.
However, please refrain from making any noise, as he prefers peaceful cultivation."

Although Shang Yingyue could also help him, he felt that she was too cautious and suspicious of him, so he felt that it would be difficult to approach her.
"Then what about the other clans?"
Shang Yaolin immediately pointed out the residences of the other four clans.
"Senior Huang Shengyan, the representative of the Huang Clan, is the strictest among the other representatives.
When you meet him, be careful in your speech and behavior, or he'll punish you.
Senior Hao Weizen and Senior Deng Zhichao, the representatives of the Hao and Deng Clans, are notorious for their lecherous behavior, frequently spying on women while they are bathing.
The Murong Clan is my mother's family, and their representative is Senior Sister Murong Mengying.
Unlike Senior Sister Yingyue, she is lazy and drunkard.
However, when faced with serious problems, she can be extremely serious and ruthless towards anything and anyone that poses a threat to her clan."

'Oh?' Shang Yaolin's description of Murong Mengying piqued Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s interest in meeting her, so he immediately searched for her location on his map, and he found her alone in the fortress. 'That woman seems very interesting; I might be able to form a good relationship with her.' "What about other clans living in other areas?"
As she took Zhang Xiaolong [3] to several places, Shang Yaolin told him many things about those clans, and Mei immediately recorded the data regarding them into the system.
Meanwhile, the two women had returned to their private quarters, but Huang Qinghua was still furious because of Shang Yaolin's previous threats, making Hao Jianxiu shake her head helplessly.
"Forget about her, especially since you will never win against her, and you will suffer if Aunt Qianying punishes you severely."
"What do you think about that fox kid?"
Hao Jianxiu immediately sat down beside his lover.
"I can indeed sense the demon aura from him, so Hao Shihai and Huang Fujian's reports about him are indeed accurate.
Unfortunately, Shang Yaolin is very protective of him, so it is difficult for us to get more information about him, except our two seniors investigate him.
However, he is too weak to be a threat, so Senior Brother Weizen and Senior Brother Shengyan won't care about him."
"That's true." Huang Qinghua then pulled her lover down onto the bed.
"How about we work together with the others to kidnap that kid?
I don't know why, but somehow, I have a feeling that he is not an ordinary fox, so I want to snatch him from that bitch."
"No." Hao Jianxiu immediately rejected her idea.
"Qiao Xuan has already refused to do that, and Murong Yi is still a cousin of Shang Yaolin, so he won't help us either.
As for Deng Shicang, he is useless and won't be able to help us, so you better forget about that fox kid.
Anyway, let's sleep now, especially since we still have to continue our duties tomorrow."
Huang Qinghua sighed softly and closed her eyes, but she continued to rack her brains for a way to snatch Zhang Xiaolong [3] from Shang Yaolin. 'Tch!

The notification's appearance signified that the day had changed again, and Shang Yaolin immediately brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] back to the Shang Clan residence, especially since it was already midnight.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] thought for a while before whispering to Shang Yaolin. 'Big Sis, I want to try doing the same as Senior Liang'er, so please protect me.'
Before Shang Yaolin could speak, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had already closed his eyes and released his cultivation soul, leaving her stunned. 'Sigh!
This kid!
He's really impatient to learn new things, but I'm not sure he can do the same as Senior Brother Liangren, especially since he has never learned about soul cultivation before.'

paragraphs: Sensing Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s action, Qiao Liangren immediately stopped his cultivation and put his soul back into his body. He then opened his eyes and observed him for a while before standing up, and he immediately moved in front of them, shocking Shang Yaolin.

Shang Yaolin wanted to say something to him, but Qiao Liangren put his index finger to his lips to signal her not to say anything, so she immediately swallowed her words and nodded at him. 'This is bad! I'm afraid Senior Brother Liangren will be angry with Long'er.'
Qiao Liangren immediately pressed his index finger against Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s forehead and channeled his qi into his body very slowly, which shocked him.

However, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately felt relieved, especially since Qiao Liangren did not do anything detrimental to him. Instead, he guided him to direct the Qi, which he absorbed from the air, into his soul. 'Kid, remember well: the body and soul are one, so you must cultivate both together.

You have indeed reached the soul realm and formed your cultivation soul, and your soul has also reached the early stage of the soul foundation level. However, you are not yet a soul cultivator, so you cannot cultivate your soul directly. For now, you need to channel the Qi you absorb from the air into your soul while simultaneously balancing the Qi in your body and soul.
Once you become a soul cultivator, you will be able to absorb Qi through your body and soul at the same time.'
Zhang Xiaolong[3] nodded slightly and followed his guidance, and Qiao Liangren immediately retracted his qi once he was able to understand his words, but he continued to monitor his progress.

Qiao Liangren nodded in satisfaction when he sensed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had successfully carried out his instructions; even the Qi within his body and soul was slowly coming to balance. 'This is really unexpected; he is a mix breed between a beast and a demon beast, but his talent and comprehension in cultivation make people jealous.

He is a dual cultivator, and I saw him training with Aunt Xinxin to become a body cultivator yesterday, yet he now wants to cultivate his soul to become a soul cultivator. Moreover, his soul is much stronger than other cultivators at his level, but it seems that he doesn't have a proper teacher to guide him in his soul cultivation path.
If my master sees him, he might be interested in taking him as his disciple. Unfortunately, his cultivation level is still too low, making it impossible for him to thrive in that environment.'
Seeing Qiao Liangren's expression, Shang Yaolin patted her chest as she felt relieved that he was not angry towards Zhang Xiaolong [3], and she could see that he was trying to help him.

Shang Yaolin's expression turned shocked when she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul starting to glow, so she checked his body and soul with his senses. 'Eh? Senior Brother Liangren had only taught him once, but he could already do the same thing as him, and his Qi absorption was getting faster and faster. Sigh!
He is indeed amazing, and he can help me have a better life in my realm, but I'm not that crazy to follow their idea of marrying him, so I have to think of another way to make him obedient to me.'
Slowly but surely, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul became brighter and stronger, causing Qiao Liangren to repeatedly nod his head.

'Hmm?' Qiao Liangren raised his eyebrows slightly as Zhang Xiaolong [3] began to absorb the nature energy contained within the colorful rocks around them. 'This kid! How did he know about nature energy? He even understood how to absorb it.'

Unfortunately, Qiao Liangren still didn't know anything about Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he would be in for a huge shock if he knew about his contract with Zefyr, which allowed him to gain knowledge of nature energy thanks to the nature awareness ability.
At dawn, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul were already completely bright, and his soul power was also several times stronger than before.

[Congratulations! The host cultivation broke through to 7 Star Soul Realm.]
[The host soul level increased to the half-perfection stage of the soul foundation level.]
*Swoosh.*

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s body unleashed a shockwave that surprised the two people, but Shang Yaolin only knew that his cultivation had broken through, unlike Qiao Liangren, who was a soul cultivator. 'His cultivation and soul broke through at the same time.'
Soon, Zhang Xiaolong [3] opened his eyes and smiled in satisfaction. "Senior Brother Qiao, thank you for your pointer; I can finally become a soul cultivator."

"You don't need to thank me. I helped you because I could see your talent, and the result did not disappoint me." Qiao Liangren then questioned Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Have you never studied the soul cultivation path before?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head before explaining. "Senior brother, I live in the demon realm, and my parents are not soul cultivators, so I've never studied it before. That's why I asked Big Sis Yaolin to bring me here after she informed me that you were a soul cultivator, so I could observe how you cultivate your soul.
Unfortunately, I couldn't do it before you guided me, so I'm grateful that you are willing to guide me."
"How did you know about the natural energy?"
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately made up a story. "I learned about it from my father, and I've absorbed it before, so I have no trouble doing it again."

"I see." Qiao Liangren nodded in understanding. "Beasts are born from nature, so they should be able to understand nature energy. Honestly, I want to give you my soul cultivation technique, but I can't do it without my master's permission, so I can only help you this much, and you have to think of a way to strengthen your soul further yourself."

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and stood up. "No problem, Senior Brother. Not everything can be obtained easily, so I'm already thankful to be able to become a soul cultivator now, and I will think of a way to cultivate my soul myself."

"I like your mindset, and you can come here again if you want to cultivate your soul, especially since this is the best place for it." Qiao Liangren then turned to Shang Yaolin. "You should take him back now, since it's already dawn, and I'll start cultivating my soul."
"Yes, Senior Brother."
After they disappeared, Qiao Liangren immediately returned to his previous spot and sat there, but he smiled faintly before closing his eyes and releasing his soul.

Upon arriving at their room, Shang Yaolin hurriedly took off her dress, leaving only a thin cloth covering her private parts. She then carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] to lie down beside her and hugged him. "You're really lucky, you know?

Senior Brother Liangren is not usually willing to teach others, but your talent has caught his interest, so you should not waste this opportunity and learn more about the soul cultivation path from him."
"You're right, Big Sis. I'm indeed lucky, and I won't waste the opportunity to learn from Senior Brother Qiao."
"That's good." Quickly, Shang Yaolin closed her eyes to rest, but the effects of the pill that Shang Xiaojuan gave her before started to kick in again as soon as she fell asleep.

Upon realizing this, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately imprisoned Shang Yaolin's subconscious once more, giving her a different dream. 'Do you think I will obey you and your family? Instead, I'll make you obedient to me first, and then your family will follow.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not waste any more time, and he immediately sealed his senses to cultivate, especially since he still had to train his physique again later. As usual, Mei helped him to monitor the people in the surrounding area, especially Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin, who were still plotting something against him.

In three different places, Zhang Fei and his two clones immediately gathered all his wives, partners, and slaves. They guided those who had reached the soul realm to start cultivating their souls. Additionally, he taught it to all of his family members who had also reached that stage, which delighted them, especially the senior cultivators like Liu Rong, Zhang Long, and others.

Zhang Fei [4] immediately rolled Risaela, who had fallen asleep exhausted, to the side. He then looked at Orith, who was walking towards them with a smile. "Are you satisfied with Risaela's service?"

"Risaela is not bad, but she is weaker than Xenya, let alone when compared to you." Zhang Fei [4] immediately pulled Orith down before laying on top of him. "Do you still have other matters, My Lady? How about we do it again now?"

"Hehe." Orith giggled and wrapped her arms around Zhang Fei [4]'s neck. "My business is done for now, so I came back here because I also wanted to do it with you again. Initially, I intended to invite Ilsath to watch us again, but she locked herself in her room and didn't answer my calls."

"It's okay, I'm not in a hurry with Lady Ilsath, and I will try to conquer her in my own way." Zhang Fei [4] immediately took out some sex tools, and Orith looked excited to see them. "You seem to be addicted to using these things, my lady."

Orith nodded to Zhang Fei [4]. "After you used them on me once, I became impatient to use them again, especially since they increased the sexual pleasure in my body, and I want to experience that pleasure again."

Zhang Fei [4] immediately put those sex tools on Orith's body, starting with her eyes, mouth, hands, and feet. Despite not having stripped her naked, he immediately began to stimulate her. After the succubus duchess started to get aroused, he started to take off her dresses one by one while teasing her, causing her to become more impatient to be fucked by him.
After some time, Zhang Fei [4] directly penetrated Orith's pussy, and the two quickly got carried away into their sexual activity.

Meanwhile, a middle-aged woman was lying in bed, and she repeatedly glanced at her husband, who was sleeping soundly beside her. 'What should I do? Should I end our marriage? If I did that, Luan'er would definitely be sad, but I feel guilty towards him because of my affair with Zhang Fei, and I have refused his requests to have sex with me for the past month.
Moreover, I keep missing that guy, but he still hasn't come to see me, and he's definitely still having fun with his other woman right now.'

Yi Na let out a heavy sigh and got out of bed, glancing at Wei Jiang for a moment before leaving their room. However, she was surprised to see that their daughter had returned to their clan, so she immediately went over to Wei Luan. "When did you get back, Luan'er? Why didn't you tell me earlier?"

"Hehe." Wei Luan turned to her mother with a chuckle, and she immediately pulled Yi Na to sit beside her. "I was bored in the sect because Chu Xing still hasn't returned there, so I decided to surprise you by coming back suddenly."
"Did you know that Chu Hong is dead?"

"Yes." Wei Luan answered with a nod. "I heard about it from Sect Master Hai Yuzhen, and it's also one of the reasons I came home. I was thinking of going to find Chu Xing to comfort her, especially since she must be devastated because of her father's death, but I was at a loss as to where to find her, especially since she was with Zhang Fei."

Yi Na's heart skipped a beat when her daughter mentioned Zhang Fei. In fact, she knew about his whereabouts, but she couldn't possibly tell Wei Luan about it. "He should be at the Yin-Yang Pavilion, right? After all, he is a core disciple of the sect, and he is also the son-in-law of the Shen Clan."

"Mother, I wouldn't be at a loss to find Zhang Fei if he was in the Yin-Yang Pavilion." Yi Na pretended to be surprised to hear that, so Wei Luan told her again. "I've seen him open a portal before, and he said that it was his private training place, so I thought he and Chu Xing should be there now, especially since Elder Hai Twins told me that she wanted to enter seclusion with him.
Anyway, Madam Shen or people from the Liu Clan might know their whereabouts, so I want you to accompany me to ask them later."

Naturally, Yi Na knew that those people would not know of their whereabouts, especially since she knew that Zhang Fei would only bring certain people into his training space. Even so, she still agreed to her daughter's request. "All right, I will accompany you to meet them, but I'm not sure if they know where they are now."
"I know."
Since they couldn't sleep anymore, and they also rarely saw each other because Wei Luan was always busy at the Hidden Sea Palace, so the two of them chatted until the sun started to rise.

However, Wei Luan was confused when she saw her father come out of the room, especially since Wei Jiang's expression looked angry. Furthermore, he didn't greet them and simply left, so she asked her mother directly. "Did something happen between you two? Why does my father look angry even though he just woke up?"

Wei Luan's question made Yi Na feel even more guilty in her heart, but she then turned to her daughter. "Luan'er, I'm at a loss for words, but my relationship with your father has been strained for the past month."
"Eh?" Wei Luan was shocked to hear that, as she had never witnessed her parents fight and believed their relationship had always been harmonious.
Yi Na let out a soft sigh and continued. "Actually, I was thinking about ending our marriage, but I was still thinking about your feelings, so I wanted to know your opinion on it."

"What exactly happened between you two? Why did you suddenly want to end your marriage?" Wei Luan asked with a dark face because Yi Na's decision was too sudden, and she hadn't explained the problem between them.

Instead, Yi Na shook her head. "I can't explain to you about the problems between us yet, but I feel uncomfortable being with him anymore. Actually, I haven't made a decision yet, and I'm still mulling it over. However, the situation between us is difficult to fix, and it makes both of us suffer, so I hope you can understand if I decide to end our marriage later."

Wei Lan looked at her mother with a confused look, especially since she still didn't know the situation between them, but she immediately ran away to find her father in another room. However, the butler informed her that Wei Jiang had hurriedly left their clan without saying anything, so she returned to her mother again. "Are you really sure you want to end your marriage with my father?

Honestly, I don't want to see you two separate, so I hope you can think things over again and tell me the real situation. Perhaps I can help you two mend things, and your relationship can be as harmonious as before."

"Luan'er, our relationship is beyond repair, so I thought about making that decision." Yi Na then hugged her daughter. "I promise, I will tell you the truth when I am truly ready, so I hope you will not force me to tell you now, and I hope you are willing to support my decision."

"I really find it difficult to support your decision, so let me think about it first, Mother." Yi Na could only nod to Wei Luan. "Let's take a bath. I want to go to the Yin-Yang Pavilion and the Liu Clan as soon as possible."

Qiao Liangren nodded in satisfaction when he sensed that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had successfully carried out his instructions; even the Qi within his body and soul was slowly coming to balance. Moreover, I keep missing that guy, but he still hasn't come to see me, and he's definitely still having fun with his other woman right now.'
Yi Na let out a heavy sigh and got out of bed, glancing at Wei Jiang for a moment before leaving their room.
However, she was surprised to see that their daughter had returned to their clan, so she immediately went over to Wei Luan.
"When did you get back, Luan'er?
Why didn't you tell me earlier?"
"Hehe." Wei Luan turned to her mother with a chuckle, and she immediately pulled Yi Na to sit beside her.
"I was bored in the sect because Chu Xing still hasn't returned there, so I decided to surprise you by coming back suddenly."
"Did you know that Chu Hong is dead?"
"Yes." Wei Luan answered with a nod.
"I heard about it from Sect Master Hai Yuzhen, and it's also one of the reasons I came home.

I was thinking of going to find Chu Xing to comfort her, especially since she must be devastated because of her father's death, but I was at a loss as to where to find her, especially since she was with Zhang Fei."
Yi Na's heart skipped a beat when her daughter mentioned Zhang Fei.
In fact, she knew about his whereabouts, but she couldn't possibly tell Wei Luan about it.
"He should be at the Yin-Yang Pavilion, right?
After all, he is a core disciple of the sect, and he is also the son-in-law of the Shen Clan."
"Mother, I wouldn't be at a loss to find Zhang Fei if he was in the Yin-Yang Pavilion." Yi Na pretended to be surprised to hear that, so Wei Luan told her again.

"I've seen him open a portal before, and he said that it was his private training place, so I thought he and Chu Xing should be there now, especially since Elder Hai Twins told me that she wanted to enter seclusion with him.
Anyway, Madam Shen or people from the Liu Clan might know their whereabouts, so I want you to accompany me to ask them later."
Naturally, Yi Na knew that those people would not know of their whereabouts, especially since she knew that Zhang Fei would only bring certain people into his training space.
Even so, she still agreed to her daughter's request.
"All right, I will accompany you to meet them, but I'm not sure if they know where they are now."
"I know."
Since they couldn't sleep anymore, and they also rarely saw each other because Wei Luan was always busy at the Hidden Sea Palace, so the two of them chatted until the sun started to rise.
However, Wei Luan was confused when she saw her father come out of the room, especially since Wei Jiang's expression looked angry.
Furthermore, he didn't greet them and simply left, so she asked her mother directly.
"Did something happen between you two?
Why does my father look angry even though he just woke up?"
Wei Luan's question made Yi Na feel even more guilty in her heart, but she then turned to her daughter.
"Luan'er, I'm at a loss for words, but my relationship with your father has been strained for the past month."
"Eh?" Wei Luan was shocked to hear that, as she had never witnessed her parents fight and believed their relationship had always been harmonious.
Yi Na let out a soft sigh and continued.
"Actually, I was thinking about ending our marriage, but I was still thinking about your feelings, so I wanted to know your opinion on it."
"What exactly happened between you two?
Why did you suddenly want to end your marriage?" Wei Luan asked with a dark face because Yi Na's decision was too sudden, and she hadn't explained the problem between them.

However, the butler informed her that Wei Jiang had hurriedly left their clan without saying anything, so she returned to her mother again.
"Are you really sure you want to end your marriage with my father?
Honestly, I don't want to see you two separate, so I hope you can think things over again and tell me the real situation.
Perhaps I can help you two mend things, and your relationship can be as harmonious as before."
"Luan'er, our relationship is beyond repair, so I thought about making that decision." Yi Na then hugged her daughter.
"I promise, I will tell you the truth when I am truly ready, so I hope you will not force me to tell you now, and I hope you are willing to support my decision."
"I really find it difficult to support your decision, so let me think about it first, Mother." Yi Na could only nod to Wei Luan.
"Let's take a bath.

paragraphs: The two women were already in the guest hall of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, but Shen Wanshan told them that Zhang Fei, along with Shen Yu and Shen Xueyi, had not returned to the sect after they destroyed the heretics.

Unlike Yi Na, who already knows about Zhang Fei's relationship with Shen Xueyi, Wei Luan is really shocked to hear about their relationship, especially since she is his mother-in-law. Moreover, Shen Wanshan was his father-in-law, but he didn't seem to care about their relationship.

Since they couldn't find Zhang Fei in the sect, the two women immediately went to the Liu Clan to ask Liu Rong and Liu Ming about their whereabouts, but Wei Luan was disappointed once again because the two also left with him to train, and the people from the clan didn't know when they would return.

Yi Na knew from the beginning that they would never be able to find Zhang Fei unless he came to them himself, so she took her daughter for a walk in the city to cheer her up while talking about light things, but Wei Luan kept putting on a disappointed look because she was so eager to meet Chu Xing to comfort her. "When do you think they'll be back, Mother?"

"I don't know." Yi Na responded with a slight shake of her head. "Since no one knows where Zhang Fei's private training is, we can't do anything to look for them, so you can only wait for Chu Xing to return by herself after she finishes her training. Additionally, you've heard a lot of stories about him, right?

Thanks to him, we were able to destroy the demon portal and the heretics, allowing the people in this realm to live in safety. I'm confident that he can assist her in becoming stronger more quickly, so rather than wasting your time searching for her, it would be more beneficial to concentrate on your cultivation and training within the sect.
Otherwise, you will be left behind by her when she returns to the sect, and you will not be able to compete with her anymore."

"Sigh! You are right, Mother." Wei Luan then turned toward the Yin-Yang Sect's location. "Since Zhang Fei can become formidable in such a short period of time, I'm sure he can help Xing'er become as powerful as him. I have to train harder, or she will leave me behind. I really don't want that to happen, especially since we joined the sect together, and we have always supported each other since then.
Even so, I will stay at home for a few days to keep you company, and I also want to talk to my father about your relationship, so I can help improve it between you two."

Yi Na chose not to comment on the matter, especially since the problem between her and her husband was her own fault. Although she still regrets her mistake, she does not deny that she herself enjoyed her relationship with Zhang Fei.

Unfortunately, Wei Luan's wish was in vain because their clan butler informed them that We Jiang decided to go to another region with the patriarchs of other clans, and he did not tell her when he would return.

Yue Lanxin and Ye Qianyu were busy teaching Polypus about cultivation and water elements in the deserted valley, especially since the two of them had promised to accompany him during Zhang Fei and Zhang Lingxue's absence. The young beast was always enthusiastic about listening to their teachings.

A little away from them, three mature women were looking for herbs they needed for their sect's juniors. One of them kept sighing because they could no longer freely enter and exit the deserted valley, especially since Zhang Fei's phrometeus domain enveloped the entire area, and they could only enter with Polypus's permission.
"Why do you keep sighing, Big Sis Yuzhen?"

"What else?" Hai Yuzhen then turned to the Hai Twins. "Back then, this valley belonged to our sect, and we were able to compete with the other sect thanks to all the herbs in it, but this place belongs to Zhang Fei now."

"We can't do anything about it, right?" Hai Dongxin spoke with a soft sigh. "For many years, we have controlled this valley for our sect's benefit because no one has come here, but we also cannot claim this place as ours because we ourselves have never set up a formation here."

"Unfortunately, the situation changed after Zhang Fei accidentally discovered this valley and swiftly created this formation, so this place now belongs to him." Hai Dongyin then looked at Polypus. "In fact, that young beast discovered this place before him, but he was too weak to stop him and Boitata. Fortunately, his nature was not evil, so he let him stay here and take care of this place.
Moreover, he also installed that small portal, especially since this place is a paradise for alchemists, so Zhang Lingxue can go back and forth between the central region and this place easily."

At that, Hua Yuzhen let out a heavy sigh. "Zhang Lingxue is one of the best alchemists in our realm, and she can utilize all the herbs in this place much better than us. However, I am curious about how Zhang Fei was able to create this barrier, especially since I heard from Di Xiong that he hasn't studied formation arrays for too long.
Moreover, his portal is not just any portal either since it can connect two regions that are so far apart, and it was clearly created not using a formation array but something else."

The Hai Twins smiled as they remembered their encounter with Zhang Fei, and they also remembered about his progress. "Everything about him is too mysterious, Big Sis Yuzhen. Back then, he managed to save us from Boitata with his cultivation still at the 1-Star Foundation Realm, but he had already reached the soul realm in just three months, and he had also saved our realm from the lurking enemies."
"Anyway, you haven't had the chance to meet Chu Xing because she had already entered into seclusion with him when you came back to our sect." Hua Yuzhen looked at Hai Dongxin curiously.

"At that time, we allowed her to go with Zhang Fei for two days, but her speed increased greatly after she trained with him for those two days; even Lanxin had difficulty keeping up with her speed without her cultivation. Perhaps her speed has become even faster now, especially since they have been in seclusion for about a month, and the three of us might not be able to catch up with her speed."

Talking about them made Hai Yuzhen suddenly remember someone. "Speaking of Zhang Fei, I haven't met his little sister either, and I'm really curious about that little girl, especially after you two told me that she could reach the core realm in just two months. I know that dual cultivators can cultivate faster than us, but he can do it because his women and partners are simply too many.
His little sister only relies on manual cultivation and his yang qi, yet her cultivation can progress that fast, which means her talent far exceeds all the cultivators I know."

"I don't know how much Zhang Lin will improve after she comes out of seclusion, but I think she must have reached the soul realm by then. Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's ambitions do not lie in this realm, and he has even sent two of his clones to the middle realms, so he will probably bring his little sister and the others there in the near future." Hai Dongyin then looked around them.
"If that happens, he probably won't need this valley anymore, and we might be able to ask him to give us access to his barrier, so we can make use of these herbs specifically for our sect."

"Don't you two have any interest in going to the middle realms?" The Hai Twins looked at Hai Yuzhen in surprise, especially since their cultivation was still far from the heaven realm, so they had not thought that far. "Zhang Fei seems to appreciate you both, and he even entrusted Zhang Lin to you.

Therefore, I believe he might offer you the opportunity when the time comes for him to take them there. If the opportunity comes to you two, you guys should not waste it and accept his offer right away, so you guys will be able to improve faster by going there."
"Then what about you, Big Sis?"

"Naturally, I also have a dream of going to the middle realms, especially since becoming strong is the dream of all cultivators. However, I have no relationship with Zhang Fei, and everything I know about him is based on my conversations with Liu Rong and the others." Hai Yuzhen then fell silent for a while, but the Hai Twins could see a hint of hatred in her eyes.

"I must admit that he has made a tremendous contribution to this realm by helping us get rid of those evildoers, but he is still a demon. You two should still remember that I have a deep hatred for demons, so I don't want to know him or have any relationship with him, regardless of his merit. Even if it takes hundreds or thousands of years, I will try to go there with my own abilities."
After hearing that, Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin exchanged glances with each other, but they immediately sighed in their hearts because they were fully aware of Hai Yuzhen's hatred for the demons.

Despite coming from the same Hai Clan, the three of them had different lineages and were much luckier than Hai Yuzhen, especially since the demons had slaughtered all her families during their first invasion.

The Hai twins immediately hugged Hai Yuzhen. "Big Sis, I know you have our best interests in mind, but we will never leave you alone, so we will refuse if Zhang Fei really offers us the opportunity, and we will accompany you in this realm."
"You-"
Hai Dongxin immediately covered Hai Yuzhen's mouth. "Big Sis, we decided this a long time ago, so we will never change our decision, and we will go to the middle realms together in the future."

Hai Yuzhen immediately pulled Hai Dongxin's hand down and hugged them both. "You two are truly foolish sisters, you know? I personally feel heavy if I have to part with you two, but you are much younger than me, and your future is wide open in front of you. That's why you two don't need to think about an old woman like me, and you should think more about your future."
"No!" The Hai Twins immediately refused. "You raised us and taught us many things, so we will never leave you; you don't need to persuade us because our decision is final."

In a different area of the Sky Jade Realm, three men and four women lay on the ground, their bodies drenched in a mixture of blood and sweat. However, it was not their blood; it was the blood of the beasts they had killed earlier.

Not far from them, a woman sat leisurely on a large boulder, watching them with an amused smile. Her appearance was still neat, and there was no blood or sweat covering her body. "Quan Xun, you had a difficult time at first, but you gradually adapted, and your progress in the past few days has been quite good.
However, your ability is still far cry compared to your cousin's, so you have to work harder."

"Hahaha!" When Quan Xun heard that, he laughed bitterly. "Senior Lingshan, you are unfair if you compare me to Cousin Fei! He has cultivated much longer than me, and he has also faced too many dangers, so he is already several steps ahead of me. Even so, I will not stop here, and I will continue to improve myself for the sake of myself, Susu, and my mother."

"Well, that's true." Fu Lingshan replied with a nod of agreement. "Even though you are still weak now, you already have a good mentality, and you should continue to maintain it. Otherwise, it will be difficult for you to grow to keep up with your cousin, and you will also be unable to protect your loved ones."

As he caught his breath, Lian Chengyu spoke to Fu Lingshan. "Senior sister, we have been fighting with those beasts since yesterday, and my body is completely exhausted now, so we should take a rest for now. Otherwise, we won't become strong, and we will die from exhaustion instead."

"Your cultivation is far above Quan Xun, but you are far weaker than him in mentality." Instead, Fu Lingshan scolded her partner. "Your mind is too full of sex, but your stamina is very weak, so you have to improve it even more, or I will never satisfied with you."

"Pft! Hahahaha!" Nanxuan Luoyue, Lin Dong'er, and Mu Lingshu laughed at that. "Senior Sister, Chengyu is a man with a small heart as small as a chicken, and he will be depressed for quite some time if you say that."
"Hey! I'm not like that!" Lian Chengyu argued as he stood up, but his legs shook violently, causing him to fall backwards. "Damn it! I am a strong man! I will definitely prove it to you!"

"Yeah... yeah... we believe that you are a strong man, Chengyu!" Xia Bing said so in a sarcastic tone, which irritated Lian Chengyu. "Senior sister, have you found any water sources nearby? The blood of thosse beasts made my whole body sticky, so I want to wash it off quickly before resting."
"Me too!" The four women said in unison because they also felt uncomfortable with blood on their bodies.
"There is a river about 100 miles west."
"Huh?" Fu Lingshan and the others were shocked to hear the voice, and they all hurriedly looked at the voice's owner before exclaiming in unison.
"Zhang Fei!"
"Cousin Fei!"

Zhang Fei [5] immediately landed beside them and distributed qi recovery pills, which they immediately swallowed. At first, he was on Earth, but after Zhang Fei [4] mimicked the sexual manipulation from Risaela, he decided to go to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since his real body and the other clones were still occupied with their own affairs.
However, he did not meet them directly, and he continued to watch them train from a distance.
Zhang Fei [5] then carried Mu Lingshu like a princess, making her face turn red with embarrassment, especially since he did it in front of so many people.
Nanxuan Luoyue and the others didn't care about his action, but Lin Dong'er looked at Zhang Fei [5] with jealousy and resentment in her eyes, especially since he cared more about Mu Lingshu than him.

"Lingshu, I came here specifically to see you because I have obtained something that might be able to cure the abnormality in your body, and you can live like other normal women if it is really useful." Mu Lingshu fell into a daze and stared at Zhang Fei [5] in shock, especially since she had long hoped to be able to live as a normal woman.
He just smiled and enveloped everyone with her aura, and he immediately brought them to the nearby river.

"What else?" Hai Yuzhen then turned to the Hai Twins.
"Back then, this valley belonged to our sect, and we were able to compete with the other sect thanks to all the herbs in it, but this place belongs to Zhang Fei now."
"We can't do anything about it, right?" Hai Dongxin spoke with a soft sigh.

"For many years, we have controlled this valley for our sect's benefit because no one has come here, but we also cannot claim this place as ours because we ourselves have never set up a formation here."
"Unfortunately, the situation changed after Zhang Fei accidentally discovered this valley and swiftly created this formation, so this place now belongs to him." Hai Dongyin then looked at Polypus.
"In fact, that young beast discovered this place before him, but he was too weak to stop him and Boitata.
Fortunately, his nature was not evil, so he let him stay here and take care of this place.
Moreover, he also installed that small portal, especially since this place is a paradise for alchemists, so Zhang Lingxue can go back and forth between the central region and this place easily."
At that, Hua Yuzhen let out a heavy sigh.
"Zhang Lingxue is one of the best alchemists in our realm, and she can utilize all the herbs in this place much better than us.
However, I am curious about how Zhang Fei was able to create this barrier, especially since I heard from Di Xiong that he hasn't studied formation arrays for too long.
Moreover, his portal is not just any portal either since it can connect two regions that are so far apart, and it was clearly created not using a formation array but something else."
The Hai Twins smiled as they remembered their encounter with Zhang Fei, and they also remembered about his progress.
"Everything about him is too mysterious, Big Sis Yuzhen.

Back then, he managed to save us from Boitata with his cultivation still at the 1-Star Foundation Realm, but he had already reached the soul realm in just three months, and he had also saved our realm from the lurking enemies."
"Anyway, you haven't had the chance to meet Chu Xing because she had already entered into seclusion with him when you came back to our sect." Hua Yuzhen looked at Hai Dongxin curiously.

"At that time, we allowed her to go with Zhang Fei for two days, but her speed increased greatly after she trained with him for those two days; even Lanxin had difficulty keeping up with her speed without her cultivation.
Perhaps her speed has become even faster now, especially since they have been in seclusion for about a month, and the three of us might not be able to catch up with her speed."
Talking about them made Hai Yuzhen suddenly remember someone.
"Speaking of Zhang Fei, I haven't met his little sister either, and I'm really curious about that little girl, especially after you two told me that she could reach the core realm in just two months.
I know that dual cultivators can cultivate faster than us, but he can do it because his women and partners are simply too many.
His little sister only relies on manual cultivation and his yang qi, yet her cultivation can progress that fast, which means her talent far exceeds all the cultivators I know."
"I don't know how much Zhang Lin will improve after she comes out of seclusion, but I think she must have reached the soul realm by then.

Unfortunately, Zhang Fei's ambitions do not lie in this realm, and he has even sent two of his clones to the middle realms, so he will probably bring his little sister and the others there in the near future." Hai Dongyin then looked around them.
"If that happens, he probably won't need this valley anymore, and we might be able to ask him to give us access to his barrier, so we can make use of these herbs specifically for our sect."

"Don't you two have any interest in going to the middle realms?" The Hai Twins looked at Hai Yuzhen in surprise, especially since their cultivation was still far from the heaven realm, so they had not thought that far.
"Zhang Fei seems to appreciate you both, and he even entrusted Zhang Lin to you.
Therefore, I believe he might offer you the opportunity when the time comes for him to take them there.
If the opportunity comes to you two, you guys should not waste it and accept his offer right away, so you guys will be able to improve faster by going there."
"Then what about you, Big Sis?"
"Naturally, I also have a dream of going to the middle realms, especially since becoming strong is the dream of all cultivators.

However, I have no relationship with Zhang Fei, and everything I know about him is based on my conversations with Liu Rong and the others." Hai Yuzhen then fell silent for a while, but the Hai Twins could see a hint of hatred in her eyes.
"I must admit that he has made a tremendous contribution to this realm by helping us get rid of those evildoers, but he is still a demon.
You two should still remember that I have a deep hatred for demons, so I don't want to know him or have any relationship with him, regardless of his merit.
Even if it takes hundreds or thousands of years, I will try to go there with my own abilities."
After hearing that, Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin exchanged glances with each other, but they immediately sighed in their hearts because they were fully aware of Hai Yuzhen's hatred for the demons.

Despite coming from the same Hai Clan, the three of them had different lineages and were much luckier than Hai Yuzhen, especially since the demons had slaughtered all her families during their first invasion.
The Hai twins immediately hugged Hai Yuzhen.
"Big Sis, I know you have our best interests in mind, but we will never leave you alone, so we will refuse if Zhang Fei really offers us the opportunity, and we will accompany you in this realm."
"You-"
Hai Dongxin immediately covered Hai Yuzhen's mouth.
"Big Sis, we decided this a long time ago, so we will never change our decision, and we will go to the middle realms together in the future."
Hai Yuzhen immediately pulled Hai Dongxin's hand down and hugged them both.
"You two are truly foolish sisters, you know?
I personally feel heavy if I have to part with you two, but you are much younger than me, and your future is wide open in front of you.
That's why you two don't need to think about an old woman like me, and you should think more about your future."
"No!" The Hai Twins immediately refused.
"You raised us and taught us many things, so we will never leave you; you don't need to persuade us because our decision is final."
In a different area of the Sky Jade Realm, three men and four women lay on the ground, their bodies drenched in a mixture of blood and sweat.
However, it was not their blood; it was the blood of the beasts they had killed earlier.
Not far from them, a woman sat leisurely on a large boulder, watching them with an amused smile.
Her appearance was still neat, and there was no blood or sweat covering her body.
"Quan Xun, you had a difficult time at first, but you gradually adapted, and your progress in the past few days has been quite good.
However, your ability is still far cry compared to your cousin's, so you have to work harder."
"Hahaha!" When Quan Xun heard that, he laughed bitterly.
"Senior Lingshan, you are unfair if you compare me to Cousin Fei!
He has cultivated much longer than me, and he has also faced too many dangers, so he is already several steps ahead of me.
Even so, I will not stop here, and I will continue to improve myself for the sake of myself, Susu, and my mother."
"Well, that's true." Fu Lingshan replied with a nod of agreement.
"Even though you are still weak now, you already have a good mentality, and you should continue to maintain it.
Otherwise, it will be difficult for you to grow to keep up with your cousin, and you will also be unable to protect your loved ones."
As he caught his breath, Lian Chengyu spoke to Fu Lingshan.
"Senior sister, we have been fighting with those beasts since yesterday, and my body is completely exhausted now, so we should take a rest for now.
Otherwise, we won't become strong, and we will die from exhaustion instead."
"Your cultivation is far above Quan Xun, but you are far weaker than him in mentality." Instead, Fu Lingshan scolded her partner.
"Your mind is too full of sex, but your stamina is very weak, so you have to improve it even more, or I will never satisfied with you."
"Pft!
Hahahaha!" Nanxuan Luoyue, Lin Dong'er, and Mu Lingshu laughed at that.
"Senior Sister, Chengyu is a man with a small heart as small as a chicken, and he will be depressed for quite some time if you say that."
"Hey!
I'm not like that!" Lian Chengyu argued as he stood up, but his legs shook violently, causing him to fall backwards.
"Damn it!
I am a strong man!
I will definitely prove it to you!"
"Yeah... yeah... we believe that you are a strong man, Chengyu!" Xia Bing said so in a sarcastic tone, which irritated Lian Chengyu.
"Senior sister, have you found any water sources nearby?
The blood of thosse beasts made my whole body sticky, so I want to wash it off quickly before resting."
"Me too!" The four women said in unison because they also felt uncomfortable with blood on their bodies.
"There is a river about 100 miles west."
"Huh?" Fu Lingshan and the others were shocked to hear the voice, and they all hurriedly looked at the voice's owner before exclaiming in unison.
"Zhang Fei!"
"Cousin Fei!"
Zhang Fei [5] immediately landed beside them and distributed qi recovery pills, which they immediately swallowed.

At first, he was on Earth, but after Zhang Fei [4] mimicked the sexual manipulation from Risaela, he decided to go to the Sky Jade Realm, especially since his real body and the other clones were still occupied with their own affairs.
However, he did not meet them directly, and he continued to watch them train from a distance.
Zhang Fei [5] then carried Mu Lingshu like a princess, making her face turn red with embarrassment, especially since he did it in front of so many people.
Nanxuan Luoyue and the others didn't care about his action, but Lin Dong'er looked at Zhang Fei [5] with jealousy and resentment in her eyes, especially since he cared more about Mu Lingshu than him.

"Lingshu, I came here specifically to see you because I have obtained something that might be able to cure the abnormality in your body, and you can live like other normal women if it is really useful." Mu Lingshu fell into a daze and stared at Zhang Fei [5] in shock, especially since she had long hoped to be able to live as a normal woman.
He just smiled and enveloped everyone with her aura, and he immediately brought them to the nearby river.
