paragraphs: As they waited for the others to clean up their bodies, Fu Lingshan and Zhang Fei [5] sat side by side on an old log. "Have you been watching us for a long time?"

"Yeah, I've been in this area since midnight, but I wanted to see their progress first, so I just came out now." Zhang Fei [5] then turned to Fu Lingshan. "Anyway, thank you for your help in guiding Quan Xun, especially since I still don't have time to train him myself."

"Quan Xun is part of this team, so I have to guide him, right? Although he is still a novice cultivator, he has a great spirit to keep moving forward, so that is a good sign, and he might be able to become a strong cultivator like you in the future." Fu Lingshan then lifted both of her legs up, hugged them, and laid her head on her knees while looking at Zhang Fei [5].

"Do you know that your growth and abilities have made many people admire and envy you? You joined our sect about two and a half months ago with a cultivation in the foundation realm, but now you are already a core disciple with a cultivation in the soul realm. Unfortunately, you spent most of your time outside the sect on missions, so not many disciples knew you before, except for your partners.

However, everything changed after your marriage with Shen Yu, coupled with your actions in helping Madam Xueyi get rid of Shen Haoran and the others. From then on, the other disciples, especially the female disciples, started to set their sights on you. Moreover, the news about you helping our seniors to stop the demons and heretics has spread far and wide, including in our sect.
Those male disciples are eager to challenge you, and those female disciples look forward to meeting you."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [5] laughed when he heard that. "I have never been interested in being a hero, and I only do everything for the sake of those closest to me. It doesn't matter if those male disciples want to challenge me; I will accept all of their challenges after I return, especially since I still need sparring partners to improve myself."
"Do you still need sparring partners with your current strength? You can even defeat cultivators who are stronger than you, so they are not your opponents, right?"

"You think too highly of me." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer confused Fu Lingshan. "Everyone only knows that I helped them, but only we know the process, and I can accomplish everything because of the help of many people. In fact, I barely did anything other than giving them some information, especially since those demons and heretics can easily kill me, and they are the ones who take care of them all.
That's why I still have to improve myself, or I will continue to rely on the help of others."

Fu Lingshan nodded in response. "Even if you say that you only gave them some information, you have to remember that our enemies have existed for a long time, and they have never been able to get rid of them before, so all the information you give them is crucial in their victory."

"Perhaps you're right, but that's in the past, and I don't want to think about it." Zhang Fei [5] then looked up at the sky. "Our lives will not go backwards, but we must continue to move forward. If we are complacent with our past, we will never be able to face the long road ahead."

"Haha." Fu Lingshan let out a soft laugh accompanied by a nod of agreement. "You are right; our road is indeed still long ahead of us. Moreover, the cultivation world is never calm, and troubles will always come to us one after another. Not to mention, there are so many cultivators with cultivation far above ours, so we must continue to strive hard to improve our cultivation and strength.
Then, what will you do with those female disciples? Will you accept those who come to you to offer themselves?"

"Do you think I will accept all women who come to me?" Fu Lingshan replied with a shrug as she did not personally know Zhang Fei [5]. "My wives and partners are women of my choice, and I choose them because they are the best in my eyes. I enjoy having many women and dual cultivation, but I won't accept every woman who offers herself to me.
Even if I accept them now, I will leave them behind later, and they themselves will suffer because of it. So it's better if I don't accept them."
"Does that mean you will keep your current partners with you?"

"That shouldn't be a question, right?" Fu Lingshan nodded to Zhang Fei [5]. "Honestly, I initially only wanted to obtain their Yin Qi, and I planned to leave them once I was truly strong. However, all the time we spent together made me change my mind, so I will always keep them by my side and bring them to the middle realms in the future."

"Middle realms, huh?" Fu Lingshan muttered softly as she continued to look admiringly at Zhang Fei [5]. "Perhaps you are the only cultivator at our level who has considered the middle realms; even I have never thought that far, especially since I am not confident in my own ability to cultivate."

"Such thoughts are actually the basic mistake of the majority of cultivators, especially since they will only weigh us down on our path of cultivation, and we will never progress if we have such thoughts." Zhang Fei [5] raised both hands high and clenched his fists. "The world of cultivation has many unsolved mysteries, and a cultivator's potential is limitless.

That's why I don't want to be limited by my weaknesses, and I will continue to dream as high as possible to give myself a clear goal, so I will always have a purpose to strengthen myself. For now, my mission is to bring them to the middle realms, and I will take them to the upper realms after I succeed there.
If I have succeeded in the upper realms, then I will go to explore this universe more deeply."

Listening to all of Zhang Fei [5]'s words caused Fu Lingshan to sigh in her heart, and she massaged her dizzy head, especially since his dreams were simply too high and not many people had the ability to achieve such lofty dreams. Moreover, many people used to set their goals as high as his, but only a few of them were able to succeed in the end, and those who failed were far more numerous.

"Cousin Fei!" Zhang Fei [5] immediately raised his eyebrows at Quan Xun, who was running towards him, followed by Tang Susu shyly walking behind him. "You've seen Susu before, right? She has accepted me now, but I still have to go to her parents to propose to her, so please tell my mother about this matter."

"All right, I will tell Aunt Tan later, so she can help you propose to Tang Susu as soon as possible." Quan Xun looked excited after hearing that, and he immediately hugged Tang Susu, whose face was already completely red.

Zhang Fei [5] shook his head slightly at his cousin's behavior, but he immediately floated towards Mu Lingshu, who was walking together with Lin Dong'er, Nanxuan Luoyue, and two other men. "Give me your hand, and I hope this will really work."

Mu Lingshu immediately stretched out her hand before it was grabbed by Zhang Fei [5], and her heartbeat was beating much faster than usual. She was like that—not because of him, but because she was nervous about her chances of becoming a normal woman.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately applied the sexual manipulation to Mu Lingshu, and he used his demon touch afterwards, but he frowned because he didn't see any changes in her expression or body movements. "Do you feel anything different in your body?"
"No." Mu Lingshu answered with a slight head shake, and her expression turned disappointed because of that.

Zhang Fei [5] immediately grabbed Mu Lingshu's shoulders. "I thought it would work, but it turned out that the result was not as I expected. Even so, you don't have to be disappointed, okay? I promised you that I would cure the abnormality in your body, so I will continue to look for a way to cure you, and I will definitely find a cure one day."

"Brother, how exactly do you want to cure Mu Lingshu? Why didn't we see you take anything out?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately turned to Lian Chengyu, gesturing him to come closer to him. After he arrived beside them, he immediately grabbed her hand and used the sexual manipulation on him, which caused him to become horny, and his dick quickly protruded from his pants. "Holy fuck! What did you do to me?
Why am I suddenly so eager to fuck Senior Sister Lingshan?"
"Pftt! Hahaha!" Mu Lingshu was the first to laugh after hearing that, and her heart felt relieved that Zhang Fei [5] had not lied to her, especially since Lian Chengyu was affected by his ability.

"Why don't you just pounce on Senior Sister Lingshan right now? That way, you can prove to her that you are a strong man." After Nanxuan Luoyue said that, Fu Lingshan hurriedly left the place, but Lian Chengyu immediately chased after her, making all of them burst into laughter. "Zhang Fei, I want to try the ability you used on him just now."

"Are you sure about that? If I use that, your sexual desire will be even higher, and Xia Bing might be overwhelmed to handle you." Nanxuan Luoyue ran towards her partner before bringing him in front of Zhang Fei [5], and she asked him to use it on the two of them. "All right."
In an instant, Xia Bing and Nanxuan Luoyue also felt that their sexual desire became higher than usual, and both of them hurried to other areas to satisfy their lust.

Zhang Fei [5] smiled amusingly when he saw them like that, but then he turned to Lin Dong'er with a mischievous smile, causing her to shudder. Just like on their first meeting, she immediately turned around and ran away like a frightened rabbit, especially since his smile gave her a bad feeling.

"Haha! You always scare Dong'er." Mu Lingshu said this as she looked at Lin Dong'er, who had already hidden behind a tree a little away from them, but her head was sticking out from behind it as she glared at Zhang Fei [5]. "What exactly is the effect of your ability? Why did the three of them become like that?"

"Unlike my touch technique, which will make other people controlled by their lust directly, my technique just now can strengthen or weaken other people's sex drive, so I increase their sex drive." Zhang Fei [5]'s answer left Quan Xun and the three women dumbfounded. "That's why I thought it could treat you, but it failed."

"It's okay; you don't have to blame yourself. Moreover, I've been living with this disorder for so long, so it's okay for me to wait a little longer." Mu Lingshu then asked Zhang Fei [5]. "Are you leaving now? Or do you want to join us?"

"There is danger lurking in my home realm, so I have to go back there to monitor the situation, and I will come to see you again after my real body comes out of seclusion." Mu Lingshu looked disappointed to hear that, but Zhang Fei [5] immediately hugged her and kissed her forehead. "Do you want to join training with my real body?"
"No." Mu Lingshu immediately rejected his offer. "We've taken a lot of missions, so I'll stay here and train with them, and we can meet again after you come out of seclusion."

"It's no problem if you want it that way, and I can help you later when I get out of seclusion." Zhang Fei [5] then asked Mei to buy three sets of basic pills and gave them to Mu Lingshu directly, and he also gave her a few bottles of his yang qi. "In that case, I'll go now, and we'll meet again soon."

After he disappeared, Mu Lingshu immediately distributed those basic pills to Tang Susu and Lin Dong'er, and she then spoke to her best friend. "Why are you always afraid of him? You've been in love with him since that day, right? I can see your jealousy towards me, so you should dare yourself to get close to him, or you two will continue to be strangers."
Instead, Lin Dong'er pouted her lips and looked for a safe place to swallow those pills, making Mu Lingshu shake her head helplessly.

"Senior sister, does that mean you've also fallen in love with my cousin?" Mu Linshu was momentarily stunned by Quan Xun's question, but she had no intention of answering him and hurriedly left him. "My guess was correct, right, Susu?"
Tang Susu nodded slightly. "Senior Sister Lingshu has indeed fallen in love with Brother Fei, and it's probably because of his gentle treatment of her."

"Haha." That made Quan Xun laugh. "Cousin Fei was always that way, even before he became a cultivator, and his gentleness made many people like him. Unfortunately, his character has changed a lot, and he can be very cruel now; even so many people have died at his hands. Anyway, you can swallow those pills now, and you will get great benefits from them."

Three women were standing on the side of the bed while paying attention to the four young women's condition, but Shang Yingyue did not explain the truth to Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin, especially since the two would be furious if they knew that Shang Xiaoyin had kidnapped Shang Yaolin before. "Can any of you cure them?"
Hong Xinxin was the first to answer her. "Yingyue, I'm a body cultivator, remember? I never studied medical techniques and the like, so I can't do anything to help them."

"Since you've contacted Shang Kuang, you can wait for his answer, especially since he's the best healer in the Shang Clan." After she said that, Murong Qianying immediately took Hong Xinxin away, and they hurried to Shang Yaolin's room to check on Zhang Xiaolong [3].
Shang Yingyue looked at the four women before letting out a soft sigh, and she hurried off to the mountain peak to cultivate.

As soon as they arrived at Shang Yaolin's room, Hong Xinxin immediately sat down in front of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was still immersed in his cultivation. Despite his awareness of their presence, he feigned ignorance, primarily driven by his curiosity about their plans for him. "Hey, Sister Qianying, do you think Yumei can snatch him from Little Yaolin?"
'Yumei? Shang Yumei? Who's she?' Zhang Xiaolong [3] wondered in his heart.

Murong Qianying responded with a confident node. "Even if Yumei can't snatch him from Yaolin with normal means, she can still use her technique to control him. Since he's still a child, his mental strength is still too weak, so he will succumb to her technique and be completely obedient to him."

Hearing that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] sighed inwardly. 'I don't understand why people from the upper realms act like they are the most powerful and always want to control other people, but that's none of my business. Since they have planned such things for me, I have to do something about them first, and I'll start with Hong Xinxin.'

However, we shouldn't tell Thish about it, or she will use any means to keep him for herself."

Ilsath immediately looked at Zhang Fei [4] again, and she was actually tempted to have sex with him after seeing him having sex with Orith for so long yesterday, but she herself was still horrified at the thought of his dick penetrating her body.
"Forget it.
I won't do it with him now, and you can use him for yourself for the time being, so I can watch your progress toward your next evolution while I think about it."
Orith could only shake her head at Ilsath's decision, but she didn't force her to do it immediately with Zhang Fei [4], and the two of them hurriedly left the room.
The three main members of the Chang Clan stood together in front of a prison while staring at Cai Qiu, who had completely lost her mind.
Unlike his mother and daughter, Chang Wentian looked devastated to see the woman, who had accompanied him for so long and given him two children, become like that.
*Clang*
"What are you going to do, Mother?" Chang Wentian promptly inquired as soon as Chang Wuhen entered Cai Qiu's prison.
"What else?" Chang Wuhen then pointed at her daughter-in-law.
"The Liu and Shen Clans have killed her entire family, and she's now a living corpse, so it would be better if I killed her."
"But-"
"I agree with my grandmother, Father." Chang Wentian immediately frowned at Chang Wenjie.
"She is indeed my mother, but she and her clan are traitors, and many people have died because of them.
Since her family is dead, she can follow them to the afterlife, and she can be more at ease than if she continues to live like this.

Moreover, there are still many women outside who are interested in you, so you don't need to keep thinking about her, and you can take one of them to be your new wife to give you another son for this clan."
"Your daughter is often smarter than you, Wentian.
Wenhao has died, and our clan has no male successor.

Rather than thinking about Cai Qiu, it would be better if you thought about our clan's successor, or else our clan will end with you." Chang Wuhen then approached his daughter-in-law and grabbed her head.
"Honestly, I love you very much, but your condition is like this now, and your betrayal is also unforgivable.
Since you are my daughter, I will give you an easy death, and I hope you will get another happiness after you are reincarnated later."

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei was standing in front of some of his wives and family members, who were cultivating their souls.

Zefyr suddenly sat on Zhang Fei's shoulders.
"Hey, can you take me to that realm again?
I want to absorb the nature energy from those colorful rocks again."
"Sorry, I can't take you there now." Zefyr wore a disappointed expression upon hearing that, but Zhang Fei immediately stroked her little head in explanation.
"Currently, there are two powerful and influential women from the upper realms there, and they are always monitoring Zhang Xiaolong [3], so he can't move around freely right now.
You don't need to be disappointed like this, and I will immediately take you there if the opportunity arises, okay?"
"All right then, I will patiently wait for that opportunity."
"Fei!" Chu Qing called out softly as she hugged Zhang Fei's arm.
"You previously used something to help Sister Yue increase her cultivation, right?
Otherwise, her cultivation wouldn't be able to reach the 1 Star Core level that quickly, so I want you to use it on me, and I can join the others to cultivate my soul."
Upon hearing that, Ru Xue, Zhong Yan, Tang Zhiyu, and Qing Yi immediately turned to their husband, their expressions filled with anticipation.

After all, their cultivation was still in the core realm, and they had to reach the soul realm first to be able to cultivate their souls, so they also hoped that Zhang Fei could help them reach that stage soon.
Zhang Fei looked at them one by one with a smile before explaining to them, causing their eyes to sparkle like stars.
Without thinking twice, all of them immediately dragged Zhang Fei back into the Cloud Mansion, so he could directly help them using that. (A/N: Chapter 400.)

paragraphs: Meanwhile, Feltia [2] is flying in one of the other demon rulers' sub-realms with her female demon partners, and they soon arrive in the vast desert.
"Is the demon beast really hiding here, Fel?" Eve inquired as she surveyed the entire desert area.
"Yes." Feltia [2] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword out of his body and pointed it at the center of the desert. "The black scaled earth dragon demon is hiding down there."
"As far as I remember, the black scaled earth dragon demon rank should be at the marquis rank, and it has very strong scales that are almost impenetrable by all weapons."

"Ashreth, other weapons may not be able to penetrate its scales, but my sword was created specifically for killing demons." Feltia [2] immediately channeled his fire and light elements. "Moreover, the earth demon type is weak against light and fire, so it's not a big deal for me."

Feltia [2] then raised her sword, gripped the hilt with both hands, and extended both elements to form a red and white blade. After he was ready, he immediately swung it down with force, and his attack swiftly split the desert into two.
*Roar*

A loud dragon roar immediately rang in their ears, and they could see the black scaled earth dragon demon furiously glaring at them from below, especially since Feltia [2]'s attack just now had injured its back to the point where several of its black scales had broken.
Unlike western dragons, which generally have two wings, the black scaled earth demon dragon is wingless, and its body is also not as big as other dragons.
*Swoosh... Swoosh...*

Dozens of rocks quickly flew towards them, but Feltia [2] stretched his hand forward, and dozens of fireballs immediately flew towards them before colliding with each other, causing several large explosions in the air.

After that, Feltia [2] dove down towards the black scaled earth dragon demon, and the demon extermination sword in her hand continued to glow red and white. She didn't want to waste her time with the demon beast, so she also activated her heavenly fox bloodline to suppress it, causing it to press down and crack the area beneath it.

Unlike other demon beasts who were always unable to move under the pressure of Feltia [2]'s bloodline, the black scaled earth dragon demon used his willpower to fight back against the pressure as he let out a loud roar.
*Roar*

Once again, dozens of rocks came flying towards Feltia [2], but he swiftly avoided them as he continued to dive down. As soon as the demon beast opened its mouth to swallow him, he immediately used teleportation to move behind its head. He slashed the demon extermination sword at its neck, but the hardness of the scales behind it prevented it from instantly cleaving through.

The black scaled earth dragon demon tried to counterattack Feltia [2] using its tail, but he immediately teleported away before slashing its tail. Unlike the scales on its neck, the scales on its tail are not too hard or thick, and his attack cuts straight through its tail.
*Roar*

As the black scaled earth dragon demon was in pain from having its tail cut off, Feltia [2] immediately moved to the front of its chest after he realized that its scales there were just as thin as those on its tail, and he immediately thrust his sword to its chest. As he expected, his sword managed to penetrate its chest, and he immediately strengthened both elements, engulfing the demon beast.
*Roar*

The black scaled earth dragon demon didn't want to die just like that, and it immediately opened its mouth wide to pounce on Feltia [2]. However, he immediately took out his hellfire chains and threw them towards it, which right away coiled and strangled its neck with great force.
Additionally, the flames coming out of them caused the demon beast even more pain, especially since the flames were hotter and stronger than his fire element.

Feltia [2] swiftly pulled her sword out of the black scaled earth dragon demon's chest and moved to the back of its neck, and he once again attacked the area he previously attacked with two consecutive attacks. His first attack directly shattered its scale, and his second attack immediately cut its neck, causing a gush of black blood to erupt from the cut.
[Ding]
[Quest: Defeat the black scaled earth dragon demon.]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: Hard Gift Pack x 1 sent to the inventory.]

'Hmm? Why doesn't the system give me a new quest? Could it be that the quests in this realm are finished?' Feltia [2] then grabbed the demon core that emerged from the black scaled earth dragon demon's head and immediately stored it, along with the hellfire chains. He also returned the extermination demon sword to his body. 'Mei, open those two hard gift packs.'
[Yes, master.]
[You obtained 1 Bloodthirsty Fang Blade. Grade: Earth]
[You obtained 1 Abyssal Mirror. Grade: Earth]
'Hmm?' Feltia [2] was a little surprised by the names of the two items.
[Bloodthirsty Fang Blade: A sword forged from the fang of an ancient demon, imbued with a thirst for blood and souls.]
[Abyssal Mirror: A mirror that reflects the darkest fears of anyone who gazes into it, trapping their soul within the mirror's depths.]

Even though he liked the effects of both items, Feltia [2] still felt strange about them, especially since not only were the quests he always received related to demons, but all the rewards he had gotten so far were also related to demons, souls, or the like.
"Can we go back now, Fel?" Leora, the cat demon, inquired as she floated down to Feltia [2]'s side.
"Wait a minute." Feltia [2] then looked up at the sky. "Don't you two want to come down here? I've noticed that you guys have been following us since we left our sub-realm."
Soon, Oz the first and Morgana appeared in front of them, and the witch demon immediately said to Feltia [2]. "Honestly, I was curious about your fighting ability, and it's actually not bad.

However, your fighting ability is still like a newbie when compared to the cultivators from the upper realms, and you rely too much on your beast bloodline to suppress those demon beasts, so it would be better if you started learning not to use it and rely more on your own strength.
After all, your enemies will not always be beasts or demon beasts, but you will also continue to face many human and demon enemies in the future."

"Yeah, you're right about that." Feltia [2] nodded in agreement with that. "Actually, I use my bloodline to fight those beasts and demon beasts because I don't want to waste my time, and I also keep honing my fighting abilities to face non-beast enemies."

Morgana suddenly stretched her hand forward to attack Feltia [2] at a high speed, but to her surprise, her attack only penetrated his illusion. "Oh? You have such excellent speed, huh? I didn't even realize that you had moved away from your spot and created this illusion at the same time."

"Not only is it good, but it's also really fast, and it's not my full speed yet." Feltia[2] replied as he reappeared in his original spot, surprising Morgana. "I can still increase my speed further in the future, but my current body is still unable to withstand the burden of the training, so I am more focused on my cultivation and my body's strength for now."

"I see." Morgana nodded understandingly at that. "I think your decision is sound, particularly considering that the more advanced techniques you use, the more cultivation and physical strength you will require. Anyway, if you have the chance, you can go to the Nine Hells Darkland, which is approximately two months' journey from the Wasteland Realm.

Even though it is only in the middle realms, it has a special place, particularly for forging your body. My demon emperor discovered it by accident, and since then, he has repeatedly sent many demons from my realm to increase their physical strength."
"Is the Nine Hells Darkland also a demon realm? What kind of place are you referring to?"

"No, that realm isn't a demon realm." Morgana immediately shared her memories of the Nine Hells Darkland with Feltia [2], which shocked him, especially since the situation in that realm was truly terrifying. "As you can see for yourself, that realm is the worst realm in the middle realm, and you can see corpses of all races wherever you go, so people call it the nine hells.

Anyway, the place I'm talking about is the Fiendish Pond, which is located in the southernmost part of the realm. Nobody knows the origins of the pond's creation or the source of its demon blood and essence, but both are beneficial for forging the body, particularly for demons like us.

However, you must exercise caution if you visit that place in the future, as the demon souls roaming there harbor intensely negative emotions. If you are influenced by them, then you will become a crazy demon, or you will become a bloodthirsty demon."
Feltia [2] shuddered at the thought of himself turning into something like that. "Damn! That realm really does seem to be the worst realm!"

"Haha." Morgana laughed in response. "That's why my demon emperor only sends high-ranking demons to that realm, especially since low-ranking or middle-ranking demons will definitely be affected by those wandering demon souls, so you have to prepare yourself well before going to that realm."

"Yeah, you're right. Moreover, I can't move freely in the Wasteland Realm yet, so I won't be going to the Nine Hells Darkland anytime soon, and I will prepare myself first." Feltia [2] suddenly remembered something and promptly took the black key out of the inventory.
As soon as Feltia [2] did that, a black smoke immediately came out of Oz the first's body and turned into a male demon with his body bound by black chains, plus there was a keyhole in the middle.

Morgana immediately grabbed the black key from her hand and looked at it, as well as the keyhole in the middle of the man's figure. "Husband, I'm sure this is the key to unlocking these chains, but I can't be sure what will happen to you if I release him. After all, we don't have any information about him, especially since you still haven't regained your past memories."

Oz the first continued to gaze at the black key, and he was intrigued by the male figure. However, he didn't dare make a decision, especially since he was afraid that he would change if he released him from the chains.

Feltia [2] immediately told them. "Actually, I got this black key from Tharnon, and he told me that you were the one who gave it to him. Unfortunately, you did not explain to him the purpose of this key, and I even ordered the demons in the tower to search all over this realm to find a place with a keyhole, but it turns out that the keyhole was in your body."
"How about we go see Tharnon now?"
Oz the first immediately pulled the male figure back into his body. "Let's go; we have to see him now."

After saying goodbye, they immediately disappeared from that location, and Feltia [2] swiftly brought his female demon partners back to their tower. Even so, she had many questions about the male figure, especially since she could feel a sense of danger from him. 'I hope my guess is wrong; otherwise, I'll have to fight them, and I won't be able to defeat them unless I ask for Feng Yao's help.'
A while later, Oz the first and Morgana had arrived at the Endless Death, and they immediately met Tharnon at the bottom. "Hey, did my husband really never tell you anything about this key?"

"No." Tharnon shook his head before explaining. "Back then, my master handed it to me, but he didn't elaborate on it. However, I remember clearly that his expression was really serious at that time, and I've never seen him that serious except when he fought the Throne. Do you have any clue about the key?"

Morgana immediately touched Oz the first's back and forced the man's figure out of his body. "See? This key is exactly the same as this keyhole, so it should be used to open it, but we are still hesitant to open it."

Tharnon did not immediately respond to Morgana, instead observing the man's figure with a serious expression. He felt as though he had seen the man before, but he struggled to recognize him. "Since this man is inside my master's body, I'm sure he's the one who chained him.
That's why it would be best if we don't release this man before he regains his past memories, or we might unleash a danger beyond our imagination."
"I agree with him, wife." Oz the first immediately pulled the man's figure into his body again. "Anyway, Tharnon won't be able to face the current me, so you better keep this black key now."

"All right." Morgana then made a gesture with her hand, and a black cube immediately enclosed the black key. "This way, this key will be safe, and we will decide whether to release the man or not after you regain your past memories."
"So are you pregnant now?"

"Did you think I'd get pregnant that quickly?" Morgana turned the question around and shook her head. "We are both demon cultivators, and our cultivation has also surpassed the ten mortal realms, so it is not easy for me to conceive his child. Even so, we will continue to work hard so that I can get pregnant as soon as possible, especially since I can't wait to have his child."
"In that case, you two can return to the floating castle now."
"Why are you more impatient than us?"
"Hahaha!" Tharnon laughed at that. "I have been with my master for tens of thousands of years, so it is natural that I can't wait to see his descendants, right?"
Morgana nodded to Tharnon. "All right then, we'll be back right now."

After they disappeared, Tharnon curled up on the ground again, but his mouth was muttering something. 'Could that man be the person I thought? If that was really true, it would be better if they never released him, or these four realms would be completely in chaos.'
After she finished her task, Shang Yaolin immediately went back to her room to clean herself up. After that, she laid down beside Zhang Xiaolong [3] and rubbed his cheeks.

'What happened to me? Why did I dream of him last night? Furthermore, I had the impression that my dream had lasted for an extended period, during which time I witnessed his transformation into a handsome man.' Shang Yaolin moved her face closer to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face and wanted to kiss him, but he suddenly opened his eyes, causing her face to turn bright red with embarrassment.
She immediately laid down beside him and covered her red face with a blanket. 'Ugh! I must be crazy! He's still a child, but I want to kiss him!'
Zhang Xialong [3] smiled faintly but did not say anything about it. "Big Sis, I want to go to the top of the mountain to cultivate my soul."
"Eh?" Shang Yaolin immediately opened the blanket. "Tonight is Senior Sister Yingyue's turn to use the place, and she probably won't like it if you disturb her."
"Senior Sister Yingyue witnessed Aunt Xinxin beating me up for a few hours, so I believe she may not mind if I cultivate there, and you can just take me back if my presence bothers her, Big Sis."
Shang Yaolin let out a sigh and carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly, and she brought him to the top of the mountain peak afterward.
Shang Yingyue, who was cultivating, immediately opened her eyes. "Why did you bring him here? Don't you know that I don't like being disturbed when I'm cultivating?"

"Since this man is inside my master's body, I'm sure he's the one who chained him.
That's why it would be best if we don't release this man before he regains his past memories, or we might unleash a danger beyond our imagination."
"I agree with him, wife." Oz the first immediately pulled the man's figure into his body again.
"Anyway, Tharnon won't be able to face the current me, so you better keep this black key now."
"All right." Morgana then made a gesture with her hand, and a black cube immediately enclosed the black key.
"This way, this key will be safe, and we will decide whether to release the man or not after you regain your past memories."
"So are you pregnant now?"
"Did you think I'd get pregnant that quickly?" Morgana turned the question around and shook her head.
"We are both demon cultivators, and our cultivation has also surpassed the ten mortal realms, so it is not easy for me to conceive his child.
Even so, we will continue to work hard so that I can get pregnant as soon as possible, especially since I can't wait to have his child."
"In that case, you two can return to the floating castle now."
"Why are you more impatient than us?"
"Hahaha!" Tharnon laughed at that.
"I have been with my master for tens of thousands of years, so it is natural that I can't wait to see his descendants, right?"
Morgana nodded to Tharnon.
"All right then, we'll be back right now."
After they disappeared, Tharnon curled up on the ground again, but his mouth was muttering something. 'Could that man be the person I thought?
If that was really true, it would be better if they never released him, or these four realms would be completely in chaos.'
After she finished her task, Shang Yaolin immediately went back to her room to clean herself up.
After that, she laid down beside Zhang Xiaolong [3] and rubbed his cheeks.
'What happened to me?
Why did I dream of him last night?

Furthermore, I had the impression that my dream had lasted for an extended period, during which time I witnessed his transformation into a handsome man.' Shang Yaolin moved her face closer to Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face and wanted to kiss him, but he suddenly opened his eyes, causing her face to turn bright red with embarrassment.
She immediately laid down beside him and covered her red face with a blanket. 'Ugh!
I must be crazy!
He's still a child, but I want to kiss him!'
Zhang Xialong [3] smiled faintly but did not say anything about it.
"Big Sis, I want to go to the top of the mountain to cultivate my soul."
"Eh?" Shang Yaolin immediately opened the blanket.
"Tonight is Senior Sister Yingyue's turn to use the place, and she probably won't like it if you disturb her."
"Senior Sister Yingyue witnessed Aunt Xinxin beating me up for a few hours, so I believe she may not mind if I cultivate there, and you can just take me back if my presence bothers her, Big Sis."
Shang Yaolin let out a sigh and carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] directly, and she brought him to the top of the mountain peak afterward.
Shang Yingyue, who was cultivating, immediately opened her eyes.
"Why did you bring him here?
Don't you know that I don't like being disturbed when I'm cultivating?"

chapters.title: Chapter 466 True Dual Soul Cultivation
paragraphs: "Senior Sister Yingyue, he asked me to bring him here because he wants to cultivate his soul."

Shang Yingyue's expression was filled with disbelief upon hearing Shang Yaolin's statement, particularly considering that Zhang Xiaolong [3] originated from the demon realm and was still too young to comprehend the concept of soul cultivation. After all, it took her decades to cultivate her soul, so she found it difficult to believe that he could cultivate his soul so early.

Seeing Shang Yingyue's disbelief towards him, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately jumped down from Shang Yaolin's embrace. He immediately sat cross-legged on the ground, released his cultivation soul, and began to absorb Qi from the air.

"Hmm?" Shang Yingyue was surprised when Zhang Xiaolong [3] began to channel the Qi absorbed by his body into his soul, but she looked around the area after she sensed the movement of nature energy from those colorful rocks flowing into her body. "How... how is this possible?
In addition to absorbing Qi from the air, he is also absorbing the energy of nature, and his absorption rate is gradually increasing."

"Senior Sister Yingyue, Long'er is interested in becoming a soul cultivator, so I brought him here last night. At first, he still didn't know how, and he only tried to imitate Senior Brother Liangren. However, he failed to do so, so he guided him to absorb and channel his Qi into his soul."

Shang Yaolin's explanation left Shang Yingyue stunned for a while, especially since she knew Qiao Liangren's character very well, and it was unusual for him to guide others in cultivation, let alone Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s cultivation was still in the ten mortal realms.

However, Shang Yingyue immediately closed her eyes, released her cultivation soul once more, and brought it to the front of Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul. Her soul immediately grabbed both of his soul's hands, interlocking their fingers together.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was a little surprised by Shang Yingyue's action, but he became excited when she channeled her Yin Qi into his soul. She did it because she remembered that he was a dual cultivator, so she wanted to try it out. 'I never thought that this kind of thing could be done while cultivating the soul.'

If they were to dual-cultivate, then Zhang Xiaolong [3] would definitely not be able to absorb Shang Yingyue's Yin Qi, especially since the difference in their cultivation was like heaven and earth. However, soul cultivation was different from dual cultivation, and he did not need to absorb her Yin Qi into his body, so he only needed to circulate it throughout his soul to strengthen it.

Shang Yaolin's jaw dropped watching it because Shang Yingyue had never been willing to be touched by any man before except for her husband, but she took the initiative to do such a thing with Zhang Xiaolong [3]. Although their bodies were not in direct contact, souls were still part of the body, so they should be able to feel each other's touch.

Shang Yingyue was startled when she sensed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s Yang Qi flow into her soul, and her expression was slightly uncomfortable because of it. Even so, she couldn't stop him all of a sudden, or they would suffer a backlash if she suddenly stopped him. Instead, she poured more of her Yin Qi into his soul, to which he responded by pouring more of his Yang Qi into her soul.
Furthermore, their bodies continued to absorb Qi and nature energy, and their absorption speed increased with each passing moment.

Even though she was not a soul cultivator, Shang Yaolin could still feel the movement of Qi within their bodies, and she felt jealous watching Shang Yingyue and Zhang Xiaolong [3] in such a state. 'Tch! Don't tell me that Senior Sister Yingyue is interested in Long'er! I won't let that happen! He is mine, and I won't let anyone take him from me!'
*Thud*

Shang Yaolin immediately turned to Qiao Liangren, who had just landed beside her, but she didn't disturb him because he looked so serious in observing Shang Yingyue and Zhang Xiaolong [3], and he repeatedly nodded his head as a sign of understanding their actions.

'This kid possesses a remarkable talent in soul cultivation, allowing him to effortlessly follow Yingyue's guidance without any conscious thought. Perhaps he is the only cultivator who can thread his cultivation path with three different cultivation paths at the same time, and his future will definitely be bright if he can continue like this.

Unfortunately, his talent will arouse the envy and jealousy of others, so he must be more careful in all his actions. Otherwise, those powerful and ambitious cultivators will try to kill him before he can fully develop, especially since his existence will be a threat to them.' Qiao Liangren then turned to Shang Yaolin and spoke to her through voice transmission.
'Little Yaolin, you must not talk about their activities to anyone else, or you will put this kid in danger. Do you understand?'

'Yes, I understand, Senior Brother.' Shang Yaolin then looked at Zhang Xiaolong [3]. 'You are truly lucky to have met them, Long'er. Senior Brother Liangren and Senior Sister Yingyue are not usually like this, but they both seem to be fond of you.'

"Hmm?" Shang Yaolin and Qiao Liangren suddenly raised their eyebrows as they saw the yin-yang diagram appear above Shang Yingyue and Zhang Xiaolong [3], which was the effect of their Yang Qi and Yin Qi rotating faster into each other's souls as if they were dual cultivating their souls.
'Senior Brother, what happened to them? Are they doing dual soul cultivation?'

'Yes and no.' Shang Yaolin was confused by Qiao Liangren's reply. 'The way to dual cultivate the soul is no different from the way to dual cultivate the body, so they are not really dual cultivating their souls, but they are doing it indirectly.

Since you are not soul cultivators like us, you must not have noticed it, but the rotation of their Yin Qi and Yang Qi has achieved harmony, and the Yin-Yang diagram is the proof. Moreover, not all couples are able to achieve this kind of harmony, especially if it's their first time.'
'Does that mean Senior Sister Yingyue is the perfect match for Long'er in dual soul cultivation?'

Qiao Lianger nodded in agreement before speaking. 'Shang Yingyue is the perfect dual soul cultivation partner for Long'er, and vice versa. If they continued doing it every night, then his soul power would increase rapidly, and he might be able to reach the earthly or heavenly soul level in a few months, especially since her soul power was already too high to help him.
Furthermore, given his strong and pure Yang Qi, their situation would be mutually beneficial.'
Qiao Liangren's answer actually increased Shang Yaolin's jealousy, and a seed of fear that Shang Yingyue would snatch Zhang Xiaolong [3] began to form in her heart. 'Sigh!

If I had known the situation between them would be like this, I would definitely not have brought Long'er to see Senior Sister Yingyue, and she would certainly snatch him away from me if she had experienced the benefits of doing this kind of thing with him.'

'You're worrying too much, don't you?' Shang Yaolin immediately looked up at Qiao Liangren. 'Shang Yingyue is a loyal wife, and she is completely loyal to Wu Xueming. Moreover, she is different from Aunt Xinxin, who is interested in young leaves, so you don't have to worry that she will snatch him away from you.
Instead, you should continue to bring him to see her, especially since she can help him become very strong, and he will be more useful to you in the future.'
Shang Yaolin nodded to Qiao Liangren, but she still couldn't get rid of the worry in her heart, and her eyes repeatedly glanced towards Shang Yingyue with a glimmer of jealousy in both of them.

Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin were lying side by side in a bedroom, and they were still thinking about the pleasurable sensation that Zhang Xiaolong [3] gave them when he touched their chests. "Do you have an answer about that yet, Sister Qianying?"

"No." Murong Qianying shook her head slightly. "I've thought about it seriously, and I'm absolutely certain he didn't use any techniques on us, especially since his Qi is really calm, so I'm really confused about where that sensation comes from."

Hong Xinxin immediately turned to Murong Qianying. "Is it possibly due to the influence of his demon fox bloodline? As far as I can remember, those heavenly foxes don't have such abilities, and we don't know anything about his mother, so that's all I can think about for now."

"That possibility does exist." Murong Qianying then fell silent for a while. "Forget it; we'll bring that kid with us again later, so we can be more certain whether he used something against us or not."
"All right."
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 18,200 Qi.]
[Reward: 182 green jewels.]

Time continued to pass, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Shang Yingyue did not seem to want to stop doing that, and both of them actually enjoyed the circulation of their Yang Qi and Yin Qi in their souls even more. Moreover, their bodies also didn't stop absorbing the Qi and the nature energy, so he could complete the quest at the same time.

Since nothing bad happened to them, and their progress was actually getting better, Qiao Liangren decided to descend from the mountaintop, leaving Shang Yaolin waiting for the two in boredom. 'Sigh! How long will they continue like this? I'm tired and bored of continuing to wait for them.'
Without them realizing it, the time quickly passed, and the sounds of several beasts began to reach their ears, indicating that it was already dawn.
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 18,200 Qi.]
[Status: Done.]
[Reward: 182 green jewels sent to the inventory.]
[Ding]
[The host soul level increased to the perfection stage of the soul foundation level.]

Zhang Xiaolong[3] was delighted with the last notification, but he suddenly felt Shang Yingyue pulling her Yin Qi and soul back, so he also pulled his Yang Qi and soul back, causing the Yin-Yang diagram above them to instantly disappear.

Soon, both of them opened their eyes, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately cupped his hands to Shang Yingyue. "Senior Sister, I am truly grateful for your help. This way, I can better understand the meaning of dual soul cultivation, and my soul has finally reached the perfection stage of the soul foundation level."

"I didn't expect you to follow my actions, and you were careful when pouring Yang Qi into my soul as well. No wonder Senior Brother Liangren is willing to guide you to cultivate your soul; it turns out that you are indeed talented on the soul cultivation path." Shang Yingyue then turned to Shang Yaolin. "She's tired of waiting for us, so you two should go back now.
However, you must come here again tomorrow night, and I will help you to cultivate your soul again, so your soul power can increase to the soul core level faster."
"Yes, I will see you again tomorrow night, Senior Sister." Zhang Xiaolong [3] stood up and approached Shang Yaolin, who immediately carried him in her arms.

"Yaolin, you don't have to work today, and you can take him to see other places if you want." Shang Yaolin just nodded and carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] down from the mountain peak. "Sigh! What was I thinking when I did that? This is the first time I've done dual soul cultivation with a man other than my husband, let alone he was just a ten-year-old kid.
However, his Yang Qi is remarkably strong and pure for a boy his age, and I can sense that it enhances my Yin Qi, so I will do it with him again until I experience its true benefits."
Shang Yingyue did not immediately come down from the top of the mountain, but instead, she released her cultivation soul again to continue cultivating her soul manually.
Inside the room, Shang Yaolin was already lying on the bed with Zhang Xaiolong [3] in her arms, but she didn't say a word because the jealousy in her heart still hadn't disappeared.

'Apparently, the dream I gave her has begun to bear fruit, and she is jealous of Shang Yingyue because we are doing dual soul cultivation.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then rubbed Shang Yaolin's cheek. "Why don't you try learning soul cultivation, Big Sis? Cultivating our souls may seem difficult, but it's actually not that hard to learn.
Moreover, you are an experienced cultivator who has cultivated for hundreds of years, so I think you can do it."
"Why do you want me to study soul cultivation?"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed at that. "Big Sis, cultivators need soul power to achieve true power. Many cultivators possess high soul power, which can easily suppress our souls if we don't cultivate them. Moreover, you yourself want to do dual soul cultivation with me like I did with Senior Sister Yingyue just now, right?"

Upon hearing that, Shang Yaolin immediately released Zhang Xiaolong [3] from her embrace and turned her back on him, and her heart pounded at the thought of them doing so. "You are right, my soul power is still weak even though my cultivation is at the 1 Moon Divine Expansion, especially since I have never learned to cultivate my soul.

All right, I will start studying the soul cultivation path, and you must teach me how to do it. However, I'm exhausted from waiting for you for so long, so I'd like to go to bed now. You can start teaching me later, when we wake up."

"All right, I will teach you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then hugged Shang Yaolin from behind, and he waited for her to sleep first to make sure whether the effects of the pill that Shang Xiaojuan gave her had disappeared or not.

Sometime later, Zhang Xiaolong [3] could hear soft snoring, but he could also hear Shang Yaolin calling Shang Xiaojuan's name, indicating that the effects of the pill were still lingering in her body. He immediately used the dream imprisonment ability to imprison her subconscious, and he also gave her more pleasant dreams about him.
'Sooner or later, you will surely fall for me, and I will make you suffer as much as those who have suffered because of you and your clan.'

As soon as the sun rose, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately released Shang Yaolin's subconscious and woke her up. "Did you have a sweet dream, Big Sis? I heard you laughing and giggling to yourself while you were sleeping."
"En." Shang Yaolin nodded to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I did have a sweet dream that made me sleep really well, but I won't tell you about it."
"Cheapskate!" Zhang Xialong [3] exclaimed softly while pouting his lips, causing Shang Yaolin to laugh out loud at his antics.

Shang Yaolin hurriedly got out of bed while carrying Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Since Senior Sister Yingyue gave me a day off today, I'll take you to see other areas on this northern island. There's a beautiful place on the east side, so I'll take you there after we wash up."
"All right."

When they came out of their room, Murong Qianying and Hong Xinxin were already standing at the door, but the two women immediately led the them to the bathhouse, making Shang Yaolin confused by their behavior. On the other hand, Zhang Xiaolong [3] already understood their intentions, but he pretended not to notice anything, and a faint evil smile appeared on his face without them realizing.

The senior cultivators immediately looked at the top of Zhang Fei and the others, especially since a huge transparent Yin-Yang diagram began to form there, indicating that his plan for his eight women was beginning to bear fruit.
'I think only that kid can do something like that in this universe.'

Liu Rong nodded slightly at Zhang Long, who whispered to her. 'His talent for cultivation is indeed remarkable! He has only studied soul cultivation for three days, but he can already help his eight women improve their souls at once, and his own soul power has also increased by two levels in three days.'

'After all, his third clone lives in the Wasteland Realm now, and he also told us there were two strong cultivators who assisted him to increase his soul power, so it is natural that his soul power can increase by two levels in a short time.' A glimmer of envy flashed in Liu Ming's eyes, but he hurriedly suppressed his feelings, especially since Zhang Fei was both his brother-in-law and nephew-in-law.

'You're wrong about that.' Zi'er expressed her disagreement with Liu Ming's remarks. 'Whether you want to admit it or not, Zhang Fei's talent in cultivation has indeed surpassed us. It is true that two powerful cultivators assist him, and their assistance has been a boon to him.
However, it's important to keep in mind the number of young people we have assisted in the past, and the proportion of those who failed to meet our expectations compared to those who succeeded.

If I were in his shoes and had the same help, I still have no confidence that I would be able to do it, especially since helping eight people at once requires extraordinary control and concentration, and his actions are enough to prove his quality as a cultivator.'

Zi'er's words left Liu Ming speechless with no way to reply to her, especially since the number of their younger generation who failed was far greater than those who succeeded, even though they had helped them with various means and resources.

Yang Yudie's head nodded repeatedly, and a proud smile adorned her old face. 'Our talents as old cultivators cannot compare to Zhang Fei's. He started his cultivation path through a dual cultivation path, which made his cultivation increase tremendously in three months.

However, he was still not satisfied with that because his ambition was so great, so he decided to explore a new path as a body cultivator, and his efforts to become a soul cultivator could also be considered successful. If it weren't for him, we wouldn't have been able to learn those two ways, and watching him keep pushing himself made my old blood boil, so I wanted to try to do the same thing.'
'Haha.' Zhang Long laughed softly and took his wife's hand. 'Shall we do it now? They won't finish in a short time, so there's no point for us to keep watching them, and we can try to do it.'
'Yeah, let's do it now.' Zhang Long and Yang Yudie went straight to another area, wanting to try doing the same thing Zhang Fei did.
'Let's go! We will try to do that too.' Liu Ming was startled by his mother's words, but he immediately followed Liu Rong, especially since he didn't want to lose to Zhang Fei.

Zi'er could only sigh in her heart looking at them, especially since Zhang Wuji is living in the Netherworld Realm now, and he is trying to increase his demon power there. In the end, she decided to join Zhang Xiaoling and the others, particularly since she still hasn't managed to adapt to level two of gravity features.

Inside the portable mansion, Zhang Fei [1] also helped some of his partners to cultivate their souls, such as Yan Luan'er, Xi Zihua, Ning Xiang, Du Yuan, and Han Xuenai. Unlike his real body and first clone, Feltia [2] and Zhang Fei [4] continued to have fun with their partners in the Diyu Realm and the Netherworld Realm, respectively.

Three hours passed quickly, and Shang Yaolin finally managed to channel her Yin Qi into her soul, which made her completely relieved. She was slightly surprised when Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s Yang Qi began to enter her soul, but she quickly calmed herself down and circulated it throughout her soul, fearing a backlash if she became panicked.

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s Yang Qi slowly filled Shang Yaolin's soul more and more, and her Yin Qi also filled his soul more and more. Both continued to flow and revolve within each other's souls, and the Yin-Yang diagram above them became increasingly clear as time passed even more.

After he was sure of their situation, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did something that Shang Yaolin did not expect by embracing her soul using his, and his action caused her concentration to waver slightly, so she hurriedly stabilized it again.
One hour.
Three hours.

After five hours, the cave's temperature abruptly dropped, and a loud storm began to rumble outside. Because of that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to start pulling his Yang Qi back from Shang Yaolin's soul, especially since they had been at it for too long, and the temperature would also disturb their concentration.
Shang Yaolin followed Zhang Xiaolong [3] by pulling her Yin Qi back, and they returned their souls into their bodies after they no longer felt their Yang Qi and Yin Qi in their souls.

Both of them opened their eyes immediately, and Shang Yaolin gazed tenderly at Zhang Xiaolong [3], reaching out to caress his cheek. "Thank you, Long'er. If it weren't for you, I would never have thought of studying the soul cultivation path, and I definitely wouldn't have succeeded if you hadn't guided me with care."

"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] giggled and pressed Shang Yaolin's hand against his cheek. "Why are you thanking me, Big Sis? If you guys hadn't brought me to this realm, I wouldn't have been able to meet Aunt Xinxin, Senior Brother Liangren, and Senior Sister Yingyue. Without their help, I won't be able to learn those two cultivation paths, so it is only natural for me to help you, right?"

"Yeah." Shang Yaolin then looked outside, and the scenery outside was already covered by a heavy snowstorm. "Sigh! We were too absorbed in our cultivation, so we were late to notice the climate change, and we can't possibly return to our residence now."

"It's okay, big sis." Although he could easily bring Shang Yaolin back to the Shang Clan residence, Zhang Xiaolong [3] had no intention of doing so. Instead, he took out some firewood from his inventory and used his fire element to make a bonfire to warm their bodies.

"Moreover, you said yourself that you wanted to spend time with me, and no one can disturb us here, so we can relax while waiting for the climate to change again. However, Aunt Xinxin might be angry at me for being absent from her training, and she might beat me up even harder tomorrow."

"Haha." When she heard that, Shang Yaoling laughed, and she immediately pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] onto her lap while hugging him from behind. "I will help you explain it to Aunt Xinxin, and I believe that she will let it slide this time, so you don't have to worry about it."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] rubbed Shang Yaolin's hands, leaned on his chest, and looked up at her. "Have you ever liked a man, Big Sis?"
"Eh?" Shang Yaolin was taken aback by that. "Why do you ask that?"
"I'm just curious about that, especially since you're quite pretty. So I think there are many men who would want you as their wife."
"Hmm?" Shang Yaolin narrowed her eyes at him. "Quite pretty? Does that mean I'm not pretty in your eyes?"
"No... No..." Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head vigorously before stroking Shang Yaolin's cheeks. "You're pretty, but you're still less pretty than my mother, so I said it like that."

"Humph!" Shang Yaolin snorted softly and pinched his cheeks. "She's your mother, so you'll definitely think she's the prettiest woman in the universe! Even so, I still believe that I'm pretty, and many men yearn for me to be their wife, but I've never been interested in them because they only approach me to get my mother's favor.

However, there is one man I like, and that man is Senior Brother Liangren. Unfortunately, my feelings are one-sided because he has no interest in love matters, and cultivation is much more important to him than feelings, so I bury my feelings for him deep in my heart because I don't want to experience disappointment if he rejects me."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded his head in response. "Senior Brother Liangren is indeed handsome and kind, so it is natural that many women admire and dream of him as their husband. You don't need to be disappointed, and I am sure that you will find a man worthy of being your husband in the future."

"Hahaha." Shang Yaolin laughed out loud after hearing that. "You're still this small, but you act like a grown man who understands feelings. However, you're right; I may find a man who is suitable for me in the future. Moreover, my lifespan is still very long, so I don't want to think too much about it for now, and I will wait for my right man to come to me."

Shang Yaolin suddenly took out a thin mattress and had Zhang Xiaolong [3] lie down on it, especially since the temperature in the cave continued to drop, and she was afraid that he would catch a cold. "Where did you get a mattress like this, Big Sis?"

"There is a realm in the upper realms with an advanced civilization compared to other realms, and they have a lot of strange equipment in their realm, so other cultivators often go there to buy various things that can't be found in their realm." Shang Yaolin's answer made Zhang Xiaolong [3] curious about that realm.
"Its name is the Xianjin Realm, and it is the largest trading realm in the upper realms. However, the security in that realm is really tight, and we can't use our cultivation once we get there.

They set up a lot of equipment to seal our cultivation in every corner of their realm, and they also dispatched countless guardian puppets, which can kill cultivators even with their cultivation at the Divine Ascendant."

"Huh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was completely shocked to hear about the Xianjin Realm. "Puppets that can kill cultivators at the Divine Ascendant? Doesn't that mean the people in that realm are so powerful that they can create such strong puppets?"
Shang Yaolin smiled at seeing Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s expression. "I expected that you would be shocked after hearing that, especially since I myself was shocked when I first learned about that realm.

Anyway, the people in that realm are indeed powerful, and their leader also acts as the leader of the cultivators in the upper realms, especially since he is the strongest cultivator with his cultivation being at 2-Moon Divine Ascendant. However, no one knows his name, and we always refer to him as the nameless one."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was no longer surprised to hear the name, especially since Feng Yao had told him before. However, he was really curious about the Xianjin Realm. "Do you think I can go to that realm in the future, Big Sis?"

"Naturally, you can also go to that realm, but you don't need to think about it for now, especially since that place is still beyond your reach. For now, you only need to think about the road in front of you, and you can go there once you're really strong." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding, and Shang Yaolin then spoke again.

"In fact, I myself am lazy to go to that realm because there are too many powerful cultivators there, and I always feel pressured by their presence when I'm there, so I usually ask Uncle Chenguang or my mother to go there if I need something. Anyway, you haven't told me much about yourself, so I want to know more about you."

"There's nothing interesting in my life, Big Sis. We've always lived on the run to avoid being chased by those evil foxes, so we spent a lot of our time in hiding, and we were forced to move from one planet to another in the lower realms." Shang Yaolin felt sorry to hear that Zhang Xiaolong [3] had to live in such a situation.
"Even though I lived in misery before, I am quite happy now, and I will strive hard to take revenge on those evil foxes."

"Yeah, those heavenly foxes are indeed evil, especially Tian Baitian. Even though your father has humiliated his race by marrying a fox demon, he shouldn't have ordered people to kill your parents, and he should have let them live in peace in the lower realms, so you can live happily with them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed in his heart because Shang Yaolin bought his lies so easily.

"Anyway, I originally wanted to give you my Yin Qi, but I just remembered that your body can't absorb it yet, so I gave up on my intention. However, you don't need to worry, as my mother and Aunt Xinxin have already ordered the younger generation of the Murong and Hong Clans to collect their Yin Qi into bottles, and someone will send them here tomorrow, so you can use them to cultivate."

"It's okay, Big Sis." Zhang Xiaolong [3] replied with a nod. "Although I want to become strong as soon as possible, I am aware that our cultivation cannot be forced to increase that quickly. We must continue to stabilize our foundation before breaking through to the next stage, so I don't want to rush into it.

Moreover, I haven't fully succeeded in becoming a body cultivator, so I will focus on that for now. As for my soul cultivation, I have you and Senior Sister Yingyue to help me, so I'm not too worried about that."

"Since Senior Sister Yingyue has promised you, she will definitely continue to help you, and I will also certainly not stop helping you." Shang Yaolin suddenly fell silent, but her gaze continued to watch Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face.
"If I look at your face, I'm sure that you will be a handsome man when you grow up, and many women will go crazy for you, especially if they know about your talent in cultivation."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately cupped Shang Yaolin's cheeks, looked into her eyes, and asked her a question. "Does that mean you'll be crazy about me too, Big Sis?"

chapters.title: Chapter 469 Opportunity
paragraphs: Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question made Shang Yaolin feel confused about answering him, especially after she remembered the dreams she had in the past two nights, which were related to him.
"Did you never like me, Big Sis?"

"Eh?" Shang Yaolin immediately came back to her senses and shook her head in denial. "You're wrong, Long'er. I like you, so I brought you to this realm to keep me company. I don't know if I'll be crazy about you when you grow up, especially since I still can't picture your grown-up face, so we'll know the answer to your question in a few years."
"Hehe." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then curled up in Shang Yaolin's embrace. "I can't wait to grow up, Big Sis."

"Hmm? Why do you want to grow up so much? I actually hope that you never grow up, because you were cuter when you were little like this." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked up slightly and whispered into Shang Yaolin's ear, but his words left him dumbfounded for a while. She then hugged him as she ruffled his hair. "You little kid!
You're only ten, but you're already thinking about finding a wife and dual-cultivating with her!"

"Ugh! Stop it, Big Sis! You're messing up my hair!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] complained as he held Shang Yaolin's hand. "My dad said that dual-cultivating was very fun, and he always looked satisfied after he did it with my mom, so I was curious about it. Unfortunately, I can only do that after I grow up, right?
That's why I can't wait to grow up, so I can find a woman who accepts me for who I am, and I can dual-cultivate with her."
Shang Yaolin helplessly shook her head at Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer. "Your father is truly a bad teacher! He shouldn't have taught you about dual cultivation so early!"

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed out loud in response to her. "Big Sis, have you ever been curious about dual cultivation? After all, you are already hundreds of years old, and my father often said that the older we get, the higher our sex drive will be, so I thought that you—Ouch... Ouch... Big Sis... Spare me!
Don't pinch my cheek this hard!"

"You little shit! How dare you say I'm old!? Even though I'm hundreds of years old, I'm still as young as a teenage girl!" With a furious expression, Shang Yaolin pinched Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s cheek, causing him to instantly adopt a pitiful face and puppy eyes.
'Tch! This woman is too sensitive to the word old!'

"Humph! I'll have Aunt Xinxin beat you harder if you dare call me old one more time." Shang Yaolin immediately stopped her actions and rubbed his cheek. "Honestly, I feel that my sexual drive is increasing as I get older, but I don't want to think about such things, so I always focus on my training.

Anyway, I am interested in the dual cultivation path, but I won't do it with a random man, let alone with many men, like those female dual cultivators in the Sun and Moon Sect. Actually, I already have the dual cultivation technique that my aunt gave me in the past, and I have mastered it quite a bit.

However, I will only use it after I find a husband of my choice, so my husband and I will be like your parents, who are loyal to each other. What about you? Will you also be loyal to your wife, just as your father was loyal to your mother?"

"My father is indeed loyal to my mother, but he stated that a dual cultivator would be better if we had many wives, especially since that is what dual cultivation is all about. That's why he gave me the Yin Qi from many women in the past, especially since I need the power to protect myself." Shang Yaolin's face instantly darkened upon hearing Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s words.

Shang Yaolin let out a helpless sigh and laid down again. "Long'er, I hope you grow up to be a loyal man like your father, and whoever becomes your wife in the future will surely be delighted to have such a loyal husband."

'Heh! If you knew about the number of my wives and partners, you would probably die of shock!' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then inquired. "Is the Sun and Moon Sect specifically designed for dual cultivators, Big Sis?"

"Yeah." Shang Yaolin then told Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the sect's outline. "Even though Aunt Murong Fuyin is my maternal aunt and always treats me well, I always feel disgusted and hateful towards her, especially since she always acts like a prostitute. She is one of the elders in the sect, and she has two male partners."

"That's disgusting!" Zhang Xiaolong [3] screamed after hearing that. "If I had a wife or partner, I would never let any man touch them, and I would kill anyone who dared to think of doing such a thing with them."

"I like that, Long'er." Shang Yaolin replied with a slight nod. "You are a man, so you should protect your wife or partner from other men. If a man cannot protect his wife or partner, then he should castrate himself, and it would be even better if he just committed suicide."

Shang Yaolin's words made Zhang Xiaolong [3] laugh. "Haha! Big Sis, there's no way they would dare to castrate themselves, let alone commit suicide. Only a few, according to my father, would fight back when another man took their partner, while the majority would give up and find other women."

"Well, that's true." Shang Yaolin gave a nod of approval to that. "There are many such incidents in my realm, and most of them just give up without any intention of taking revenge on the men who stole their women. That's why I find it difficult to choose a suitable man to be my husband, especially since most of them are cowards.
Anyway, your father taught you to be a dual cultivator, so he already gave you the dual cultivation technique, right? Can you show it to me?"
"Sure." Zhang Xiaolong [3] promptly shared a dual cultivation technique with Shang Yaolin, but it was merely a random technique found in the system shop.

Shang Yaolin immediately read the technique, but he looked disappointed because it was only a spirit-grade dual cultivation technique. After giving it some thought, she touched Zhang Xiaolong's forehead and decided to give him the dual cultivation technique that Murong Fuyin had taught her.
[Ding]
[You obtained the Sun-Moon Harmony Sutra. Grade: Celestial.]
"Your dual cultivation technique is too low in grade, so I gave it to you so that you can become a better dual cultivator, and I got it from Aunt Fuyin."

"I'll read it now, Big Sis." Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately closed his eyes to read the technique, but he felt disappointed after reading it. 'This Sun-Moon Harmony Sutra can't compare to the Flawless Yin-Yang Art, especially since we still have to cultivate the Yin and Yang Qi we absorb, and the effects aren't anything special either.
Even so, it's much better than the technique I taught Quan Xun back then, especially since that technique was only at earth grade.'

Actually, only the sect master and elders of the Sun and Moon Sect can learn that technique, and its grade is much higher than the technique your father taught you."
"You're wrong, Big Sis." Zhang Xiaolong [3] denied with a shake of his head. "Actually, the technique is very good, but I can't learn or use it alone, and I need a partner to use it."
"Ahh!" Shang Yaolin let out a soft cry after remembering it. "That's right! That technique can only be used when you and your partner dual-cultivate, and you don't have a partner yet."

"I'm not tired or sleepy, and I want to know more about your realm, so you can tell me more about it, Big Sis."
"All right."

"How do you all feel?"
"Great!" The eight women answered in unison.

"That's good."
After Hong Xinxin left, Shang Yaolin immediately asked in an annoyed tone. "Why do you have to force yourself? What if you suffer a serious injury from your training?"

"Big Sis, no pain, no gain, remember? Moreover, it's the fastest way for me to temper my body, and my body isn't as weak as you think, so you don't have to worry about me, okay?" Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer actually made Shang Yaolin even more annoyed, and she immediately turned her back to him before closing her eyes.
[Master, I know her clan is your enemy, but Shang Yaolin is actually not bad, and she clearly cares about you very much.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not deny Mei's opinion; instead, he admitted it. 'Shang Yaolin is indeed a good woman, but her family and clan are too evil. They even planned to control me and contract me by force, remember?

Furthermore, she consented to their plan, so there's no need for me to show her kindness, correct?' Mei herself was aware of this, but she felt sorry for her if Zhang Xiaolong [3] were to lead her into a life of misery. 'Anyway, do you think the pill's effects on her body have worn off?'
[I think the effects are still in her body, master. Unfortunately, I can't detect any residue of the pill in her body, and strangely enough, its effects only work when she's asleep.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into deep thought and thought about what kind of pill it actually was, especially since it caused Shang Yaolin to keep dreaming about Shang Xiaojuan for days. Before long, he heard her start to mention the man's name again, indicating that the effects were still lingering in her body, so he was forced to lock up her subconscious again.
[What are your plans now, master? Are you going to meet Qiao Liangren at the top of the mountain now?]

'No.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map to search for Huang Qinghua and Hao Jianxiu's location, and he found that they were in a garden not far from their residence. However, several men were with them, including Shang Wuzi, so he immediately gave up his intention to meet them. He then checked on Hong Xinxin and found that she was sleeping with Shang Guangming.
'Is anyone monitoring me, Mei?'
[The system didn't detect anything, so there's no one watching you right now, master. Are you planning to go to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place?]

'Yeah, I want to use that beast blood pond to temper my body before I train with Hong Xinxin tomorrow, and I also want to dig up those stones.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately got out of bed, used his invisibility, and opened a portal to that place. 'Fortunately, the formation doesn't limit the space, so I can freely go in and out of that place.'
