chapters.title: Chapter 470 Bring Them To Cultivate
paragraphs: Upon arriving at Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not immediately use the beast blood pond. He wanted to mine the precious stones on the walls first, especially the bloodstones. When he saw the colorful rocks that were rich in nature energy, he remembered Zefyr, so he immediately asked Mei to open the portal to the training space.

Zefyr excitedly flew out of it, but she didn't come out alone because all of Zhang Fei's women plus Zhang Chen followed behind her. Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not forget to summon Boitata and the other contracted beasts to come out of the beast space, especially since their time to use the place was very limited, so he wanted them to make the most of their opportunities.

"Husband, the Qi in this realm is much different from that in the Sky Jade Realm, and my cultivation will definitely improve rapidly if I cultivate here often." Liu Hua and the others agreed with Boitata.
Unlike Zefyr, who immediately flew to the front of the largest colorful rock in that place, Liu Qingyu worriedly asked. "Is it okay if you bring us here?"

"The owner of this place is still unconscious, and I'm also keeping an eye on those strong cultivators, so you guys don't need to worry about them." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then pointed to the many reddish pink stones attached to the wall before speaking to Zhang Lingxue.
"Those stones are phoenix quartz, and the fire element inside them is really dense and strong, so I want you to absorb it together with Ying'er, Qing'er, and Boitata."
"Then what about me, Big Brother?" Zhang Lin asked.

"Did you see those stones? The icy blue stones are Frost Snow Stones, and the clear blue stones are Azure Sea Stones." Shen Xueyi, Shen Yu, Zhang Yue, and Zhang Lin immediately looked towards the stones that Zhang Xiaolong [3] pointed at. He then pointed to several other stones: the lightning spirit stones, the radiance stones, the earthen core stones, and the tempest stone.

"Those stones are suitable for those of you who have lightning, light, earth, and wind stones. That's why all of you can cultivate in this place while absorbing every element in those stones, so your cultivation and elements can increase together."

All of them excitedly took positions near the wall with stones according to their respective elements, and they began to cultivate there. Even the contract beasts, such as Jie Yuan, You Bai, Lan Zhen, and others, were excited about it.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then spoke to Liu Hua. "Since your element is poison, you can use the beast blood pond to cultivate and increase your element, especially since it is surrounded by several types of poisonous plants, and the pond itself also contains several types of poison."

"All right." Liu Hua proceeded directly to the side of the beast blood pond, removed her dress, and entered without delay. She then sat cross-legged in the center and began to absorb the Qi and poison elements present, but as she did so, her expression became slightly painful. Even so, she steadied her resolve and continued to do so, enduring the pain that coursed through her body.

After that, Zhang Xiaolong [3] began to dig the bloodstones from the wall, and Mei was in charge of monitoring the movements of powerful cultivators such as Shang Yingyue, Qiao Liangren, and the others.
[Master, I think it's time you wake up Shang Xiaoyin and the others, or Shang Yingyue will grow suspicious if they remain unconscious for too long.]
'Yeah, I'll remove the demon pheromone effect from them after we finish cultivating in this place, but I have to do something about them first, especially Shang Xinyu.'
[Does that mean you've decided to have Shang Xinyu as your partner?]
'Don't you already know the answer? Unfortunately, Shang Xinyu's cultivation is already in the seven divine realms, so I can't rush things with her, and I will slowly draw her to my side.'
[Ding.]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 18,700 Qi.]
[Reward: 187 green jewels.]

paragraphs: Above the flying artifact, Shang Xiaojuan, who was just waking up, looked gloomy. He immediately complained to Ai Weiren. "Master, why are you taking me away again? I want to go to the Wasteland Realm to accompany Yaolin."

"Foolish kid! You don't need to waste your time accompanying Shang Yaolin in that realm, and you only need to patiently wait for a month because she will be yours at that time." Ai Weiren then took out a leather parchment and gave it to Shang Xiaojuan, surprising him. "As you've guessed, this is the map to that place, and that place is a paradise for alchemists like us.
Once we arrive at that place, I will make another pill for you, so she will be completely obedient to you for the rest of her life, and you can do whatever you want with her later."
"Master, how did you get this map? What did you give that old woman to make her willing to hand it over to you?
"Haha." Ai Weiren laughed softly. "You'll find out when we arrive in that realm, especially since she will be waiting for us there."
Shang Xiaojuan raised his eyebrows in response, but Ai Weiren immediately left him alone, making him sigh helplessly.
"What about our son? Has his condition returned to normal?"

"Our son is awake now, and his condition has returned to normal, but Ai Weiren took him away with her." Ran Keqing immediately sat down in front of her husband and explained the information she had gotten from Ai Weiren about the Xingfu Pill, causing Shang Tinglong's face to darken. "What should we do?
If the pill's effects continue to affect Yaolin, she will eventually fall for our son, and Brother Chongyun will be furious if they have that kind of relationship."

Shang Tinglong became dizzy after his wife mentioned his brother, but he was familiar with Ai Weiren's character, and he was sure that she would not be willing to give him the antidote. "Anyway, I just came back from meeting my brother and sister-in-law, and Sister Qianying previously went to the Wasteland Realm for three days, but she didn't mention anything about Yaolin's condition."

"That's weird." Ran Keqing replied with a confused look. "Do you think the pill's effects aren't working? Sister Qianying loves Yaolin so much, and they must have slept together while she was in that realm, so she should know something if the pill affected her."

Shang Tinglong fell into deep thought and thought of other possibilities, especially since he was sure that Ai Weiren's pill's effects should work on Shang Yaolin. "Wife, I have to go see our patriarch this afternoon, and I can't go into that realm today, so I want you to go there to talk to Yaolin and check on his condition.
I hope the pill has no effect on her, or else our relationship with my brother will turn sour because of this matter."
"All right, I'll go to the Wasteland Realm right now." After his wife left, Shang Tinglong also hurriedly left their clan to meet Shang Huaqiang.

A young woman, whose long brown hair fell to her thighs, gracefully entered the residence of the Shang Clan's branch clan. Her elliptical face exuded beauty and seduction, yet her expression looked cold, and her clear brown eyes showed disgust as she gazed at the clan men. Her nose was neither slender nor big, and her thick lips were beautifully wrapped in red lipstick.

Her appearance in a turquoise and white dress was so sensual, especially since the top of her dress openly showed off her wide chest and shoulders, making her cleavage clearly visible. Even though she was disgusted by the men's gazes, she deliberately showed off her slim but curvy body.
Her F-Cup breasts kept jumping around every time she stepped forward, and her protruding buttocks also kept swaying from side to side, making the men have to swallow their saliva repeatedly.
"You've finally arrived, Yumei." Murong Qianying immediately greeted her eldest daughter as soon as Shang Yumei walked into the main hall.

"Show me a picture of that kid, Mother." Murong Qianying immediately touched Shang Yumei's forehead, surprising her when Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s image appeared in her mind. "Is he truly a heavenly fox? paragraphs: "Elion!" Zhang Fei [4] turned to Orith, who had quickly run in. "The three of us received a summons from the Kings and Queens of the demons, so we have to leave for the demon emperor city right now. Honestly, I don't want to leave you and keep you company, but I can't go against their orders, so I'm forced to leave you for a few days."
"I think that's fine." Zhang Fei [4] then pulled Orith and kissed her lips. "Moreover, I won't go anywhere, and I will continue to stay here, so we can be together again after you come back."

"Hehe." Orith kissed Zhang Fei [4] a few times before turning to leave. "I'll definitely be back soon, and I'd like to meet you once I do. Anyway, you can ask Risaela or the other succubi you like to accompany you, and you can call Xenaya to come here too."

Zhang Fei [4] didn't think much about the matter, especially since he kept thinking about Yan Zhixiu's condition. He immediately opened his map to check Thish's room, and he found the sect master of the Yin-Yang pavilion left in her room, which relieved him. 'This is my best chance to save her, but that brute succubus will definitely be suspicious if she disappears, so I have to think of something.'

[Isn't that a simple matter, master? You just need to find another female demon from the same race as her, and you can transform her into Yan Zhixiu using the science capsule. I'm sure Thish won't notice or be suspicious of you, and you can save her sooner than expected.'

'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei [4] immediately got out of bed and got dressed, but he waited for the three succubi duchesses to leave their tower first. After he made sure that they were far enough away, he immediately used his invisibility and went to Thish's room.

As Zhang Fei [4] expected, Thish was too arrogant to put up a barrier on her room, so he didn't have to go through the trouble of entering it. However, his expression was completely furious after he saw Yan Zhixiu hanging upside down on the crossbeam. She was in an unconscious state, so he rushed over to her and released her.
Since he needed her, he immediately took her away from the tower and brought her to the ghostveil forest.

Zhang Wuji, who was absorbing demon energy there, was surprised by Zhang Fei [4]'s arrival. However, his expression turned painful after he recognized Yan Zixiu in his arms, especially since his condition was really bad.

Even Arbeola let out a heavy sigh after he saw Yan Zhixiu's condition. "Thish's attitude is indeed excessive! Ever since she reached the duke rank and evolved into a lust demon lord, she has tortured so many female demons to death. Anyway, what are your plans for this woman, Kid? You can't just take her away like this, or she'll suspect you."

"I know that; that's why I brought her here, and I'll do something for her, so she won't be suspicious of me." Zhang Fei [4] then laid Yan Zhixiu on the ground and stuffed two flawless healing pills into her mouth, especially since he couldn't use his light element to heal her because she had turned into a demon.
"Old demon, do you know where a female demon of the same race as her can be found in this realm? I want to replace her with that female demon, so help me find the evil one."

"Wait a minute." Arbeola immediately contacted all the tree demons around the eastern region and asked them to look for an evil female demon of the same type as Yan Zhixiu. "Kid, you can go to the southeast citadel ruin, and you will find a female dream demon there. The other trees told me that she has killed many other demons, especially wandering demons, so you can use her to replace this woman."

After he found the location of the citadel ruin on his map, Zhang Fei [4] immediately used his Nine Cloud Steps to go there. Zhang Wuji immediately checked on Yan Zixiu's condition, and he was relieved that her condition was quickly improving, but he was sure that her mental condition was not good after being tortured by Thish for days.
"I hope my brother-in-law can cure her, or she will live like a living corpse for the rest of her life."

Sometime later, Zhang Fei [4] had arrived at the citadel ruin, and he could see a big red dot on his map, which was continuously circling him. Even so, he couldn't see the figure of the female dream demon, but it wasn't difficult for a cultivator like him. Moreover, her demon rank was far below his, so he immediately spread his senses along with his light element.

The female dream demon was shocked and panicked because of Zhang Fei [4]'s light element, and she tried to escape from that place. As soon as he summoned it, the demon extermination sword immediately shot towards her, and it directly pierced her shoulder before embedding itself into the ruins of the wall, exposing her true form. "Who... who are you? Why... why are you bothering me?
We... we don't have any problems with each other, so please let me go now."

"We don't have any problems with each other, but you've killed a lot of other demons." Zhang Fei [4] immediately flew in front of the female dream demon and grabbed her head. "Anyway, I won't kill you, and I will use you to save someone."
Before the female dream demon could complain to him, Zhang Fei [4] had already used his memory manipulation ability, and he changed quite a lot of her memories.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately pulled his sword out of the wall and returned it to his body, and he brought the female dream demon to the ghostveil forest directly.

Upon arriving there, Zhang Fei [4] immediately took out the science capsule and laid the female dream demon inside, making Zhang Wuji and Arbeola curious about it. He then took some things from Yan Zhixiu's body, such as hair, nails, skin, and blood.

After he put all the materials into the capsule's holes, Zhang Fei [4] immediately asked Mei to start the process, causing the capsule to glow quite brightly. Fortunately, the forest was quite dense, and the trees could cover the light so that it wouldn't attract the attention of other demons.
Zhang Fei [4] immediately turned to Zhang Wuji and Arbeola, and he explained to them his plans for the female dream demon, which shocked and amazed them at the same time.

"This way, Thish won't realize that the Yan Zhixiu in her hands is fake, and I can take her to her little sister, so she won't be sad anymore." Zhang Fei [4] then took out some bloodstones and gave them to them. "I found these stones in the Wasteland Realm, and the demon energy within them is much stronger than the demon energy in this realm, so you two can use them directly."

Arbeola was an old demon, so he could tell the truth from Zhang Fei [4]'s words, and he immediately absorbed the demon energy from those bloodstones. "The demon energy is really strong, kid. If I absorb enough of them, my demon rank might be able to rise to the king rank."

"Don't worry, Old Demon. I always repay kindness with kindness, and you've helped me a lot since I arrived in this realm, so I'll help you raise your demon rank to the king rank." Zhang Fei [4] then turned to Zhang Wuji. "Do you want to meet Zi'er and Xiaoling? They miss you, so they'll be pleased to see you, and you can absorb qi there.
Moreover, I've taught them about soul cultivation, so they can teach you later."
"I miss them too, so please send me there."
After he sent Zhang Wuji to his training space, Zhang Fei [4] immediately sat by Yan Zhixiu's side and thought of ways to recover her broken mentality. 'What can we do to help her recover, Mei?'
[The science capsule can do that easily, master. You just need to wait for the process to finish, and you can put Yan Zhixiu inside after that, so I can help her recover her mentality.]

Zhang Fei [4] sighed in relief as he examined the capsule. 'Every item in the system, be it from the modern shop or the cultivation shop, is completely overpowered. I really hope that I can meet that young girl in the future, so I can ask her directly about the reason she changed me and gave me the system.'
[Honestly, Master, I am also curious about the creator, and I want to know her purpose in creating me.]

'If I think about it, you really aren't an ordinary AI, Mei. Sometimes I feel that you have feelings, especially since you can understand my feelings, and you also have your own desires.' Mei didn't respond to Zhang Fei [4]'s words because she felt confused about herself. 'Hey! Do you think that young girl came from the Xianjin Realm?

Shang Yaolin stated that the Xianjin Realm boasts the most advanced civilization among the upper realms, and their technology surpasses that of Earth, leading me to believe that she indeed resides there. If that's true, we might be able to meet her in the future, and I want to ask her to create a body for you, so we can interact with each other more normally.'
Instead, Mei teased Zhang Fei [4]. [Do you want to interact normally with me, or do you want to bang me, master?]

'Fuck! For god's sake! You know my thoughts, so you should know that I don't think that way about you.' Mei laughed out loud inside Zhang Fei [4]'s mind. 'Tch! How dare you laugh at me!? If my wish comes true and you get a real body, I'll spank your ass really hard!'
Once again, Mei did not respond to Zhang Fei [4], but she felt that having a real body would be very exciting, and she hoped that it could come true.

After three hours, the light in the capsule had disappeared, so Zhang Fei [4] immediately checked the female dream demon, who had turned into Yan Zhixiu. He then took her out and placed the real Yan Zhixiu inside, so Mei could recover her mentality before he took her to Yan Luan'er.

The process itself didn't take too long, and Mei had finished it in an hour, and Zhang Fei [4] immediately took Yan Zhixiu out before storing the science capsule in his inventory again. After that, he sent her into the training space and brought the fake Yan Zhixiu back to the incubus tower, and he put her in Thish's room.

Inside the portable mansion, Yan Luan'er was already sitting on the sofa with Yan Zhixiu's head in her lap, and her tears continued to wet her big sister's face. "Fei, thank you; you have succeeded in bringing my big sister back to me."

"Hey, you are my partner, so you don't have to thank me." Zhang Fei [1] replied with a shake of his head. "Previously, her mental state was completely broken, but I have already restored it and given her healing pills, so she will definitely wake up soon."
"Yeah."

Du Yuan and the others also looked happy because Zhang Fei [1] had managed to save Yan Zhixiu, but Xi Zihua then hugged his arm. "Is it okay if you bring him back now? Won't the succubi duchess be suspicious of your fourth clone?"

Zhang Fei [1] hugged Xi Zihua's waist. "Did you forget about Lan Zhe? I have already turned another female dream demon into Yan Zhixiu, and I used her to replace her, so they won't suspect anything. Moreover, they are going to the demon emperor city now, and they won't be back for a few days."
"That's good." This relieved Xi Zihua, especially since Zhang Fei [1] would also suffer if something happened to his fourth clone.

"Mhmm." They suddenly heard a weak groan from Yan Zhixiu's mouth, and she slowly opened her eyes. However, she was immediately stunned when she saw Yan Luan'er, who was still crying. She then reached out both hands and rubbed her little sister's cheeks. "Is it really you, Luan' er? Am I not dreaming?"

"Big Sis! Sob..." Instead of answering her question, Yan Luan'er immediately hugged Yan Zhixiu tightly as she cried even harder, making the other women touched by their reunion. "Sob... Big Sis! It's me! You're safe now!
Sob... We will never be apart again, and we will always be together forever."
"Luan'er." Yan Zhixiu called softly as she also hugged her little sister, and the two of them continued to cry together, so Zhang Fei [1] and the others did not disturb them.
After they cried for quite a while, the two of them gradually calmed down again, and Yan Luan'er immediately explained everything to Yan Zhixiu.

Yan Zhixiu was not surprised to hear that Zhang Fei [1] could go to the Netherworld Realm because she already knew that, but she was surprised to hear that he was able to find and save her so quickly, so she then turned to him. "Thank you, I-"

"No need." Zhang Fei [1] interrupted Yan Zhixiu with a shake of his head. "You being stranded in the Netherworld Realm and falling into the hands of that vile succubus was partly my fault, and it wouldn't have happened if I had more preparation before I destroyed the demon portal. Furthermore, Luan'er is my partner, and since you are her elder sister, you are also considered my sister.
Anyway, you don't need to think about anything for now, and you will be completely safe here."
"En." Yan Zhixiu nodded a little before turning to the two women in the group. "I'm glad to see you two again, Xi Zihua and Shi Yue."
"We are also happy to see you again, Sect Master."
Xi Zihua then spoke to Yan Zhixiu. "Luan'er has been devastated and sad for the past few days, so we won't bother you guys for now, and we can talk again later."

"All right." Zhang Fei [1] then led them all back to the room to resume dual cultivation, while Yan Zhixiu once again looked at Yan Luan'er. "I'm back now, so you don't have to be sad anymore. However, I'm a demon now, and I can't return to our sect anymore, so you have to be the next sect master to replace me."

"Big Sis, I don't want to talk about this matter for now, and I just want to accompany you." Yan Luan'er immediately helped Yan Zhixiu sit down beside her. "As you have heard, Zhang Fei [1] is my partner now, and he already has many plans for us, including taking us to the middle realms in the future. Naturally, I won't leave you behind, and you must accompany us there in the future.

That's why I don't think too much about our sect anymore, and I want to focus on the opportunity before me. Moreover, there are many members of the Shen Clan who are more worthy than me to be our sect master, so let them take care of it."
Yan Zhixiu let out a soft sigh and laid her head on Yan Luan'er's shoulder. "I didn't expect that you and Zihua would decide to become Zhang Fei [1]'s partners, so I wanted to hear everything."
"All right." Yan Luan'er then told Yan Zhixiu about the beginning of her relationship with Zhang Fei [1], which started with her curiosity toward him.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei [4] was already standing in front of the mansion in the northern area, and he intended to meet the owner. "Sir Cain, I know you are inside, and I hope you will spare some time to talk to me because I have a good offer for you."

chapters.title: Chapter 473 Meeting Cain
paragraphs: Two of the several female demons who were cleaning the mansion were shocked to hear Zhang Fei [4]'s voice. Although they had not heard his voice for a long time, they could still recognize it, particularly since he had sent them to the Netherworld Realm until they both became demons.
"Lu Xin, isn't that his voice?"
Lu Xin nodded to Yu Xixuan, who was shaking with fear. "There's no mistaking that it's Zhang Fei's voice. He can send us here, so he can definitely come here too."
"Do you two know that man?" The male voice from behind surprised the two women, and they immediately turned to Cain before nodding to him. "Is he the one who sent you to this realm?"
"Yes, Lord Cain. His name is Zhang Fei, and he was indeed the one who sent us to this realm, but we don't know his purpose in coming to see you."

Cain himself has a gentle and handsome face, and his figure is also very tall, around 6'8". Unlike the other demons who always radiate an aura of ferocity, the aura that radiates from him actually shows gentleness. Uniquely, there is a transparent red female figure floating behind him, and her body is similar to a fire, but no demon can see it except for him.

"Follow me; let's find out the reason he came to my mansion." Cain then led the two women to meet Zhang Fei [4], but they were very afraid to meet him. Despite this, they followed him while suppressing their fear, believing that their master would protect them as usual.
Zhang Fei [4] raised his eyebrows slightly as the mansion door opened by itself, but he hurried inside, especially since he could see Cain and the two women walking from inside via his map.

"Oh? Aren't you the incubus that Orith brought to their tower?" Once they were face-to-face, Cain immediately questioned Zhang Fei [4], but the two women immediately hid behind their master upon catching his glance. "Moreover, my two maids told me that you sent them to this realm; that means you are a human like them, right?
How do you think the three succubi duchesses will react when they find out your true identity?"

Zhang Fei [4] smiled faintly hearing that. "Lord Cain, you are a marquis rank demon like me, so you should be able to see that I am a pure demon, right? Moreover, I'm sure you won't reveal my identity to the three succubi duchesses, especially since you don't have any solid evidence about it except for the testimony of low-ranking demons like them."

"Well, that's true." Cain replied with a nod of agreement, gesturing towards the sofa. He immediately sat down, with the two women standing behind him. "So what business do you have with me, Zhang Fei? Or should I address you as Elion?"

"Since these two female women have already informed you of my identity, you can call me whatever you like." After that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately sat down in front of them before taking out a bloodstone, which he placed on the table, surprising Cain.

"I don't want to talk nonsense with you, and I came here to offer you cooperation, especially since I've heard quite a lot about you from Old Arbeola, so I know that you are the best person for that."
"Lord Arbeola, huh?" Cain muttered to himself while looking at Zhang Fei [4] in disbelief.

"Old Arbeola has helped me a lot since I came to this realm, and our relationship is very good. If you don't believe me, then you can ask him directly." Zhang Fei [4] then pointed at the bloodstone. "As you can feel for yourself, the demon power inside this stone is stronger than the demon power in this realm."

"I know Lord Arbeola very well, and he wouldn't have told you about me if he wasn't interested in you, so I won't doubt you." Cain immediately took the bloodstone and looked at it more carefully, and he could feel the strength of demon power in it. "Did you get this stone from other demon realms?"

"You're right, I got it from other demon realms, and the demons there are much stronger than the demons in this realm." Zhang Fei [4] didn't hide it, because Cain already knew about his ability to move between realms from the two female demons. "If you cooperate with me and become my ally, I can give you more of this stone, and you can reach the duke rank faster if you absorb it."

Naturally, Cain was very tempted by Zhang Fei [4]'s offer to reach the duke rank faster, but he couldn't possibly believe him so easily. "Why do you want to cooperate with me and make me your ally? Hasn't Lady Orith already placed her trust in you? Her status is much higher than mine, and she can help you do more in this realm."

"You're not wrong with that." Zhang Fei [4] then pointed towards the incubus tower. "Orith and the others' status is indeed high, but that incubus lord is a hassle, especially since he wants to have the three of them for himself. Moreover, my current strength isn't yet comparable to his, so I don't want to get into trouble with him.
Besides, Old Arbeola told me that your status is actually higher than theirs, or else you couldn't possibly live so comfortably in this mansion; even Yhrer wouldn't dare to disturb you."
Cain responded with just a smile. "So what kind of cooperation do you want from me?"
"It's not difficult." Zhang Fei [4] then explained his wishes to Cain. "Old Arbeola told me that you have many demons under you, so it should be an easy matter for you, right?"

"That's correct." However, Cain seemed confused by Zhang Fei [4]'s wishes. "Since you can go to other demon realms with stronger resources, I find it strange that you want to search for resources in this realm, and you should cooperate with the demons in that realm instead."

"I don't have any connections in that realm yet, and the demons there could kill me very easily, so I don't want to take the risk." Cain nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei [4], who immediately continued.

"There are so many demons on my side, but their ranks are still low right now, and there is great danger lurking in their realm, so I need a lot of resources to strengthen them as soon as possible. The best option I have now is to utilize the resources available in this realm to strengthen them, especially since their effects are still significant to them."

After hearing that, Cain fell silent and pondered the pros and cons of accepting Zhang Fei [4]'s offer. He himself had long wanted to upgrade his demon rank to the duke rank, and the bloodstone was a shortcut for him to achieve it faster.

Zhang Fei [4] himself was not in a hurry about the matter, so he let Cain think about his offer first. However, he repeatedly looked at Lu Xin and Yu Xixuan, causing their bodies to continue trembling in fear. 'Hey! I'm already very satisfied seeing you two become demons like me, so you guys don't need to be afraid of me because I won't do anything to you anymore.'
Lu Xin and Yu Xixuan fell into a daze as soon as they heard Zhang Fei [4]'s voice in their heads, especially since Cain had never spoken to them in such a way.

After he had thought things through, Cain spoke directly to Zhang Fei [4]. "Your offer is very tempting, but I will not accept it just like that, and I have one condition for you if you want me to be your ally."
"Tell me."

"Sorry to say this, but you can't go to that realm, even if you reach King Rank later. Cain folded his forehead as he perceived that Zhang Fei [4] was looking down on him. "I'm not looking down on you, but I'm telling the truth.
Do you know the humans who control this realm?"
"Yes."

chapters.title: Chapter 474 Balena's Origin
paragraphs: "Oh? You could guess that I came from the upper realms?"

"Isn't that an easy matter?" Zhang Fei [4] asked back. "This Netherworld Realm is a demon realm in the middle realms, and I can feel that your demon aura is stronger than the other Oriths, even though your demon rank is below them.
That's why I guessed that you came from the upper realms, but your current situation confuses me, especially since you are stronger than them, yet you are confined in this place."

"I see." Balena replied with a nod. "You're right; I came from the upper realms, and my planet's name is the Blue Water Realm. Actually, I don't have any purposes in this realm, and I was stranded in this realm by accident after I entered a teleportation portal. While I was confused about my situation, a group of perverted male demons intercepted me and tried to capture me for their own purposes.

In response, I fought them and managed to kill several of them. However, one of them eventually called their leader, and it was those three succubi duchesses who answered their call. At that time, I sustained heavy injuries, and the three of them ganged up on me. In the end, I fell into their hands, and it happened because of this bracelet in my hand, which sealed my demon power."
'Is she telling the truth, Mei?'

[According to the data in the system, the Blue Water Realm does exist, Master. The realm is filled with ocean, and there is only 1% land, so all the demon in that realm lives underwater.] Mei then explained to Zhang Fei many other things about the Blue Water Realm.

Zhang Fei [4] nodded slightly. "Anyway, what's your name? Do you have a way to return to your realm? I might be able to help you get out of this place, but I can't do it now, and I have to wait for the right time for that."
"Why do you want to help me? What do you want from me? Anyway, my name is Balena, and I'm a demon whale."

"I want to help you because I believe that you are not an evil demon, and I don't want anything difficult from you." Balena put on a suspicious look after Zhang Fei [4] said that. "Honestly, I have a desire to go to a demon realm in the upper realms, but I have no way to go there.
I think the only way is to free you from this place, and you might be able to take me with you if you have a way back to your realm."

"Unfortunately, I don't have a way to get back to my realm, especially since the portal that took me to this realm disappeared right after I arrived." Zhang Fei [4] expressed disappointment upon hearing this, and Balena proceeded further. "Before I met those perverted demons, I had tried to find another way to return to my realm, and I had also tried to contact my family.
Unfortunately, all my efforts were in vain, and I am trapped here now."

"I see." Zhang Fei [4] then spoke to Balena once more. "Orith has great trust in me, so I will try to talk to her later. Unfortunately, she and the other two have gone to the Demon Emperor City and will not return soon, so please be patient. Anyway, I think you can already guess my identity, right?"
"Yes."

"I had to put this blindfold and ball back over your eyes and mouth, or they'll be suspicious of me." Balena nodded in understanding, and Zhang Fei [4] immediately put both of them back on her before leaving the underground.

Balena then turned to look in the direction Zhang Fei [4] was leaving. 'Isn't he a lust demon? Why don't I see lust in his eyes, even though I'm naked in front of him? Moreover, he himself is not a demon from this realm, and I can sense something else about him, but I don't know what it is.'
After he left the dungeon, Zhang Fei [4] immediately contacted Xenaya and Risaela, and he asked them to meet him in Orith's room.
"Why did you come here, Aunt Keqing?" Shang Yaolin, who had just finished her task, asked in surprise.

Ran Keqing immediately explained the reason for her visit to her niece, but Shang Yaolin's expression turned annoyed as soon as she mentioned the pill that Shang Xiaojuan had given her. "Did you feel the effects? Did you dream about your cousin while you were sleeping?"

"So the pill was meant to make me dream about him?" Ran Keqing answered with a nod, but Shang Yaolin was confused by it, especially since she had never dreamed of Shang Xiaojuan in the past four days, and he had been dreaming about Zhang Xiaolong [3] instead. "It seems like the pill's effects aren't working for me, Aunt.
I haven't dreamed of him at all, and I've been sleeping soundly for the last few days."

This time, it was Ran Keqing who was surprised by Shang Yaolin's answer because she knew the quality of Ai Weiren's pill, and she thought that her niece would be affected by it. "Did you really not feel anything?"
"No." Shang Yaolin shook his head at his aunt. "Anyway, I hope you won't tell that bastard about this, or he will force me to take another pill."

Ran Keqing immediately agreed to Shang Yaolin's request. "You don't have to worry about that, especially since I don't want to ruin your father's and uncle's relationships because of this matter, so I won't say anything to my son. Since nothing has happened to you, I will return to our realm and discuss this matter with your uncle."

"Yes." After Ran Keqing left, Shang Yaolin immediately put the cleaning tools back in their place and returned to her room. She frowned when she saw Shang Xiaoyin standing in the distance, staring at her with an expression full of hatred, but she ignored her and returned directly to her room.

Shang Yaolin was furious in her heart as soon as she saw Zhang Xiaolong [3] in her big sister's arms, plus Shang Yumei was also naked. However, her expression turned jealous of her big sister's body, especially since they were blood sisters, but their bodies were as different as heaven and earth. 'Damn it! Looking at her body makes me feel like I'm an adopted child!
She inherited our mother's sexiness, but I didn't inherit any of her sexiness.'
"Hmm?" Shang Yumei immediately looked at her little sister, but a mocking smile appeared on her cold face, and she also hugged Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s head tighter to her chest.
Shang Yaolin's blood and anger boiled seeing her big sister's behavior, but she didn't dare to say anything to her, especially since Shang Yumei could always control her using her techniques.

"Ugh! Big Sis Yumei, let go of me; your boobs are suffocating me!" Shang Yumei let go of Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately sat up on the bed and looked at Shang Yaolin. "When did you come back, Big Sis?"

"Just now." Shang Yaolin answered briefly and turned to go to the bathroom, but Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately stood up before jumping onto his back, surprising him. "Aren't you happier with my big sister? You should be with her and ignore me."

'Hahaha! This woman is jealous of Shang Yumei.' Zhang Xiaolong [3] then hugged Shang Yaolin's neck from behind and spoke telepathically. 'Big Sis, your big sister is hot, but I think you are better than her. Moreover, you brought me here and treated me well, so I can't possibly ignore you.
Anyway, I've already rejected her request to live with her, but she's very stubborn, so she wants to stay with us here.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s answer provided quite a relief to Shang Yaolin's feelings because she was afraid that Shang Yumei would snatch him away from her, but she was also confused about how he could escape from her big sister's techniques, especially with his low cultivation and soul strength.

"Can you track that place, Big Brother?" Zhang Lin inquired as she peered down at the city below them, but all she saw was an ordinary city.

[Master, you can go to the stone monument in front of the snowy village; the system detected a high concentration of ice element there, so I think that is the entrance to that place.]

Zhang Fei [5] frowned after hearing that, especially since he had yet to find any information about the reason behind Qi's disappearance from Earth. "So, you decided to choose my big sister as your successor?"

"She is my big sister and wife, so I will definitely help her as best I can. However, I was really surprised when she awakened both of them, but they are beneficial to her and me." Zhang Fei [5] then asked the remnant soul of the ice phoenix once again. "Can't you reform your body?
As far as I know, cultivators with high cultivation, whether human or beast, can reform their bodies as long as their cultivator's soul is still alive, and your soul is in front of us now."

"The Frozen Lotus Basin, huh?" Zhang Fei [5] muttered to himself as he thought about Feng Yao. Perhaps she might be willing to help her go to the phoenix realm faster, so she can improve herself in that place."

After all, the bloodline and physique of mythical beasts like us are too precious, and those greedy cultivators will try to capture her if they know that she has my bloodline and physique.}

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to the ice phoenix's remnant soul. "I will always protect my big sister, and I will slaughter all those who have evil intentions towards her, so you can rest in peace and leave everything to me."
After that, the remnant soul of the ice phoenix didn't say anything else, and it immediately began the process of merging its soul with Zhang Yue's soul.
Zhang Fei [5] let out a sigh of relief and turned to the other two women. "Big Sis is truly fortunate to have met the ice phoenix's soul, but she might change a little after their souls merge."
"Does that imply that Yu'er will become cold like the ice phoenix, Fei'er?" Qing Yi inquired as she continued to watch her elder daughter, who appeared to be asleep.

Zhang Fei [5] nodded to his mother. "That possibility is there, but you don't have to worry too much about it. Big Sis is still Big Sis, and I'm confident that she will remain the same after their souls merge completely."
"I hope so."

"Big brother, I can't imagine our big sister becoming a cold woman, so I hope she will never change." Zhang Lin then hugged Zhang Fei [5]'s arm. "Do you think I can get a strong bloodline like her in the future? If I get such a strong bloodline, I can definitely help you more, and I can also fight beside you to fight against enemies that might come our way in the future."

Zhang Fei [5] smiled and caressed his little sister's head. "Even if you don't have a strong bloodline, I'm sure you will become a powerful female cultivator in the future, especially since your talent in cultivation surpasses all of us.

Even so, this universe is vast, and there are still countless realms that we don't know about, so the possibility of obtaining a strong bloodline is still wide open. However, to obtain such a strong bloodline also depends on our luck, so you don't need to be jealous and be patient."

"I'm not jealous of you and big sis." Zhang Lin denied with a shake of her head. "I do want to have a strong bloodline, but I don't think too much about it, and I just need to continue to work harder in my cultivation and training. Moreover, I have you, and you will continue to help me in my cultivation, so I'm quite satisfied."
Qing Yi smiled listening to her youngest daughter's words, especially since Zhang Lin was already mature compared to women her age, and she never felt jealous of her brothers and sisters.

After they waited for some time, the process was finally completed, and Zhang Yue landed directly in front of them before opening her eyes. However, her expression was even colder than before, and the coldness emanating from her body was chilling to the bones. "Fei'er-"

"There's no need for that, right?" Zhang Fei [5] immediately interrupted Zhang Yue. "You are my big sister and wife, so it's my duty to help you. Anyway, you should have acquired some new techniques, right? Since there's nothing else in this place, I'll send you guys back to the training space, so you can start training them by utilizing the comprehension feature."
Zhang Yu nodded to him. "There are some techniques that appeared in my mind after the remnant soul of the ice phoenix merged with mine, so I want to learn them immediately."
"All right, let's go back."

chapters.title: Chapter 481 A Concealment Ring
paragraphs: Zhang Fei [5] decided to check on the women in the Yin-Yang space; he had locked them up for quite some time, and the amount of Yin Qi they had produced was quite a lot. He didn't wake them up right away, but he first went to see Xing Mei.

"Are you used to this place?" Xing Mei immediately turned her face to the side, saying nothing to Zhang Fei [5]. "I came here to tell you some news about your husband, and you will be shocked after hearing it."
Since Zhang Fei [5] mentioned her husband, Xing Mei immediately turned to him, but her expression was filled with fear. "Did... did you kill my husband?"

"Why should I kill him? Gu Tong has no problem with me, and he doesn't know about you and your son either." Zhang Fei [5] then crouched down in front of Xing Mei and shared some of his memories of the incident in the demon cave. "Ba Jiawen and Chu Hong are dead, and I don't know where Meng Qi is. So far, I have saved my brother-in-law and Yan Zhixiu.
As for your husband and Chi Yang, I already know their whereabouts, and they are now in that demon realm."
"Then, why... why don't you save them too?"

"Why should I save them?" Zhang Fei[5]'s question made Xing Mei look frustrated. "They don't have a problem with me, but they have no relationship with me. I'm not a hero, so it's not my duty to save them. Moreover, I found their location too late, and they had already turned into demons by the time I discovered their location.
Additionally, they are in the hands of a powerful demon cultivator, and I am not his opponent, so I will not throw my life away in vain just to save strangers like them."
"What?" Xing Mei exclaimed in shock as her body trembled. "Has... has my husband really turned into a demon?"

"In fact, my brother-in-law and Yan Zhixiu have also turned into demons like your husband, but they are my family, so I saved them." Zhang Fei [5] immediately stood up and walked out. "Anyway, I might take you to see him one day, but I won't be doing it anytime soon."

After hearing the news about her husband, Xing Mei was completely devastated, and she collapsed on the floor before her heartbroken cries echoed within the Yin-Yang Space. After all, her son was dead, and her husband had also turned into a demon.

After that, Zhang Fei went to the other six women's rooms, and he immediately released them from his dream imprisonment. Before long, Chu Youqian, Wang Xiaoyi, Shen Shixi, Shen Xiwu, Mo Xuanxing, and Gu Jinglin opened their eyes.
However, their expressions looked very confused, especially since he had imprisoned their subconscious for so long, and he also gave them a blissful dream to harvest their Yin Qi.
Gu Jinglin was the first to come back to her senses, and she immediately got out of bed before walking to Zhang Fei [5]. "Why did you wake me up, Master?"

"I needed you guys to do something, so I had to wake you all up." Gu Jinglin let out a heavy sigh in her heart as she thought that Zhang Fei [5] intended to dual cultivate with her, especially since his demon slave mark made it impossible for her to disobey him. "You guys get out now, and I'll teach you something soon."

The five women immediately followed Zhang Fei [5]'s order, but Chu Youqian timidly walked behind her grandmother, Wang Xiaoyi. Mo Xuanxing appeared fearful of him, yet she also felt a sense of helplessness. Unlike them, Shen Shixi and Shen Xiwu had long resigned themselves to their fates, especially after they witnessed him killing all their family members.
Zhang Fei [5] immediately touched the glass tube in the middle of the room. 'Do you think this is enough to help me break through to the 8 Star Soul Realm, Mei?'

[Master, you only need three hundred thousand Qi more to break through to the 8 Star stage, but I'm not sure it will be good for you, especially since your cultivation hasn't broken through to 7 Star for long. Zhang Xiaolong [3] is currently surrounded by too many powerful cultivators, and your rapid cultivation will make them suspicious and jealous of you.
Therefore, I believe it would be better for you to hold back on your cultivation for a few days.]

Zhang Fei [5] let out a heavy sigh, especially since he still hadn't found a way to conceal his cultivation. He then turned to the woman. "Do any of you have any techniques or items to conceal our cultivation?"

"I have one, Master." Zhang Fei [5] turned to Mo Xuanxing, who immediately handed him a necklace. "My ancestor gave me this necklace, which can conceal our cultivation, but I don't know where he got it from."
[Master, this necklace is only an earth-grade artifact, so I'm not sure if it can conceal your cultivation from cultivators in the Wasteland Realm, especially since their senses are very strong.]

Zhang Fei [5] nodded in agreement with Mei, but he still put the artifact into his inventory, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] could take it out after he finished dual soul cultivating with Shang Yingyue. "You guys can sit down in a circle, and I will teach you all about something new."

The six women immediately followed his order, and Zhang Fei [5] then told them about soul cultivation. At first, he didn't want to teach them about it, but his soul power was still too weak, and he also wanted to help all his wives and partners to increase their soul power as soon as possible, so he needed more partners in dual soul cultivation to do so.

All of them looked shocked after he finished explaining everything, but he suddenly changed into his fall-fox form and sat in the middle of them before releasing his soul, so they immediately followed him.

Next, Zhang Fei [5] taught them soul cultivation through direct practice to make it easier for them to learn the soul cultivation path. Unfortunately, their talent in soul cultivation is lower than Shang Yaolin's, so it is not easy for them to learn it. Even so, they eventually managed to learn it after several hours, with Mo Xuanxing the fastest among them and Chu Youqian the slowest.

After they successfully learned it, Zhang Fei [5] decided to bring them to earth, especially since he had to watch over earth and he could use Qi recovery pills to recover their Qi. As soon as they reached Zhang Chen's house, they began to cultivate their souls simultaneously.
Since he had been doing dual soul cultivation with Shang Yingyue for several hours, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] started to slowly draw his Yang Qi back from her soul.

Noticing this, Shang Yingyue also stopped circulating her Yin Qi into Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul. Both of them immediately opened their eyes after their souls returned to their bodies, but she still did not release his hands and looked at him with a curious look.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] deftly activated his demon touch in a split second, but it caught Shang Yingyue by surprise. She immediately released his hands and raised her eyebrows slightly, but her expression soon became calm again. 'Her mental strength is really strong, huh? I've used my demon touch on her twice, and she also peeked at me last night, but she still managed to hold herself back.'
"Yaolin must be waiting for you, so I will take you back now."
"Senior sister, I have a question for you." Zhang Xiaolong [3] promptly handed Shang Yingyue the necklace that Mo Xuanxing had given him.

"This necklace is an earth-grade concealing artifact; it might be useful to cover your cultivation from cultivators in the ten mortal realms, but it won't be useful against cultivators in the seven divine realms like me." Shang Yingyue then took out a ring and gave it to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Instead, you can use this celestial grade concealing ring; it can help you conceal your cultivation from cultivators at my level."

"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was surprised and excited by its effects at the same time. "Is it okay if you give this ring to me, Senior Sister? The price of a celestial-grade artifact must be sky high, right?"

"This celestial-grade artifact is worth fifty million blue jewels, but its price is still not comparable to your Yang Qi." Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s mouth formed a wide O shape after learning the ring's price. "Actually, a medium potion bottle of your Yang Qi might be worth that much, and I've used a lot of it over the past few days, so you don't need to worry about the price."
"Eh? Is my Yang Qi really that expensive, Senior Sister?"
"Long'er, you are a descendant of a mythical beast, the heavenly fox.

Even if you are not a pure heavenly fox, your Yang Qi is still pure, making it truly precious, and people will be willing to pay a lot for it." Shang Yingyue then helped Zhang Xiaolong [3] put the ring on his other ring finger, especially since he was already wearing a storage ring on the other, which he used to cover his inventory.

"This way, people in this realm will never be able to detect your cultivation, but there are some artifacts or techniques that can penetrate the concealment, especially those at divine grade and above, so you still have to be careful."
"So, I need an even higher-level concealment artifact to be able to completely conceal my cultivation, right?"

"Yes." Shang Yingyue then carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] in her arms. "Unfortunately, the price of concealing artifacts at the divine grade is truly expensive, especially since they are made with special materials that are quite rare.

Even a single artifact can cost ten million or even hundreds of millions of purple jewels, depending on the material and quality of the items." (A/N: Jewel grade: Red->Green->Blue->Purple->Gold. 1000 red jewels = 1 green jewels, and so on.)

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was shocked to learn that the price of a concealing artifact at the divine grade was already exorbitant, not to mention the cost of other artifacts at the same grade. "Thank you for this ring, Senior Sister."
"You don't need to think about it, especially since I personally still need your Yang Qi to increase my soul power."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] softly laughed before kissing Shang Yingyue's cheeks, surprising her. "You can ask me whenever you want to dual soul cultivate with me, Senior Sister. Furthermore, if I continue to cultivate with you, my soul power will also continue to increase, and it will soon reach the early stage of the soul core level, so I myself am looking forward to doing it with you."

Moments later, they had arrived at Shang Yaolin's room, and she was already waiting for them there. Shang Yingyue raised her eyebrows slightly at Shang Yumei, who was lying naked on the bed with a cold expression on her face. Despite this, she ignored her, placed Zhang Xiaolong [3] down on the floor, and hurried back to her private quarters.
Wasting no time, Shang Yaolin pulled Zhang Xiaolong [3] into the bathroom before taking off their clothes, but she seemed hesitant and awkward to ask him to change into his adult form.

Realizing her wishes, Zhang Xiaolong [3] changed to his adult form and carried her into the wooden tub directly. However, I hope you will not rush into it, as failing to create your soul mark could potentially damage your soul."

[The Soul Harmonization Method: The body and soul of living beings are made up of Yin and Yang.

However, I have been monitoring you these few days, and I believe you can do it faster than other cultivators with your talent.
However, I hope you will not rush into it, as failing to create your soul mark could potentially damage your soul."
"I understand." Zhang Xiaolong [3] actually wanted to ask Qiao Liangren about the soul sea, soul world, and soul universe.
However, he swallowed his question back, especially since he and Shang Yingyue had not told him about those three things, and they would definitely be suspicious if he asked him now.

Qiao Liangren only nodded and did not bother Zhang Xiaolong [3], who immediately closed his eyes.
His eyes continued to watch his soul, as he began to absorb Yin Qi from the air to balance the Yang Qi within his soul.

Shang Yingyue suddenly landed there and sat beside Qiao Liangren, but she didn't say anything to her senior and watched the rotation of the Yang and Yin Qi within Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, which was gradually accelerating, with a satisfied smile adorning her face.

Qiao Liangren responded to Shang Yingyue by shaking his head. 'Our master forbade me from guiding him directly, so I just explained the general outline, and he could immediately understand everything on his own.'

The look in her purple eyes showed cheerfulness and playfulness; her slender nose kept twitching as if she sniffed something, and her curled lips were wrapped in purple.
Her appearance looks a bit childish and tomboyish, with sleeveless clothes covering her upper body and a short purple skirt covering her lower body.

Miao Miao's words left Shang Yingyue speechless to reply, especially since she herself realized it.

paragraphs: Even though he really wanted the puppet techniques of the Miao Clan, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to hold himself back, especially since he still had a lot of matters on his hands, particularly the matter regarding Shang Yumei. "You are right, Senior Sister. I can't possibly join your clan because I myself like Big Sis Yaolin, and she has done me a great favor by bringing me to this realm.
If it weren't for her, I would never have met all of you, so I won't leave his side or let him down."

"I like your answer, kid." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Miao Miao with confusion. "Even though you are still a kid, you are still a man, so you should know how to be responsible and repay the kindness of your benefactors. If you decide to leave Shang Yaolin for the sake of your own personal ambitions, that means you are an ingrate, and I don't like that kind of person.

For now, you should focus your time on her, but you should also focus on your goal of becoming a body cultivator and a soul cultivator. Your talent is excellent, but trying to learn too much at once will not benefit you, and you may eventually become lost in one of them."
"Thank you for your advice, Senior Sister."

"Anyway, don't feel disappointed because you can't join my clan now; you still have a chance to do so in the future." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding the meaning behind Miao Miao's words. "Since you have done, and it is already dawn, so I will return to my residence now."

After Miao Miao and Lai Minhua left, the three representatives of the Huang, Deng, and Hao clans also rushed down from the mountaintop. Zhang Xiaolong [3] then glanced sideways, but Murong Mengying suddenly disappeared from his sight.

"You don't have to think about Mengying; she has always been like that. Even though she is like that, she is the kindest among us, but she can also be the cruelest." Shang Yingyue then carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] into her embrace. "Senior Brother, I will bring him back to my clan's residence, so you can cultivate your soul."
"All right."

As soon as they entered the room, Shang Yingyue instantly frowned. This was due to the lingering scent of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Shang Yumei's previous sexual activities, which made her face turn embarrassed as she recalled their activities from two days ago.
"Long'er, I don't know why your parents taught you about sex so early, but you're still a child, so you better control yourself or it will harm you."

"Actually, I don't want to do that, Senior Sister." Shang Yingyue looked at him with raised eyebrows, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to her directly about what happened between him and Shang Yumei before, which caused her face to darken.

"Honestly, I myself don't know how the potion's effect didn't work on me, but my father often forced me to swallow various kinds of herbs in the past, and some of them even left me poisoned for quite a long time."

"Your father is truly insane, don't you think?" Shang Yingyue asked that with a shake of her head. "Actually, there are various ways to increase our body's resistance to certain things, but the most extreme way is to swallow poisonous herbs and the like. Actually, many alchemists often use such a method to test their pills or potions, so many of them have high resistance to poison or the like.

However, you were fortunate that your father employed this method on you; otherwise, you might have succumbed to the effects of that potion, and Yaolin would undoubtedly feel sad if you had forgotten about her."
"Would you also feel sad if I forgot about you?"

Shang Yingyue had no intention of answering Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question, and she directly put him on the bed before leaving the room, but she did not return to her private quarter in the fortress. Instead, she went to meet Qiao Liangren to discuss Shang Yumei's actions against him, and he immediately contacted their master to ask for a solution.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled bitterly at Shang Yingyue's departure, but he then released Shang Yaolin's subconscious from his ability. He then turned to Shang Yumei, who was still sleeping soundly. Since she was still at her lowest point, he decided to seal her subconscious before giving her a passionate dream, which even the demon fox was unaware of.

After he had cleaned up the remains of their sexual activity, Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned Shang Yaolin to face him and hugged her. He gently caressed her cheek as he continued to stare at her. 'You are a lovely and kind-hearted woman, and your feelings are gentle. Unfortunately, you are a member of the Shang Clan, and you helped Shang Huaqiang invade the Sky Jade Realm.

Your actions have left Qingyu, Ying'er, Qing'er, and Xing'er grieving over Chu Hong's death. Not only the three of them, but also my brother-in-law and sister-in-law are forced to live separately between two realms. Even Luan'er is still grieving over Yan Zhixiu's transformation into a demon, making it difficult for me to forgive you.'

Early in the morning, Shang Yaolin smiled as he opened his eyes, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face was the first thing she saw. She kissed his forehead instead of his lips, as he was still in his child form. 'After having fun with him last night, my body feels very fresh, and the sensation makes me want to experience it again.'
"Did you dream about me in your sleep again, Big Sis?"
"Yeah." Shang Yaolin admitted with a smile. "Honestly, I still feel that your father is a weirdo for teaching you such things, but thankfully he taught you early, and I enjoyed it so much."

"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed, returned to his adult form, and carried Shang Yaolin to the bathroom. Her heart was pounding as she imagined what would happen next, but she wasn't that crazy to do such a thing with him so early in the morning.

Meanwhile, the demon fox tried to wake up her disciple, but Shang Yumei did not respond to her at all, and she could feel that her body was still hot; even her lust had not subsided since last night. <Tch! That kid fooled us both! I never thought his father would use such a method on him, but I'm at a loss for what to do now. I can only wait for Yumei to wake up before discussing this issue with her.>

After Shang Yaolin left to do her job, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map to look for Shang Xinyu and the other three women. He found them in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, so he decided to cancel his intention of bringing his wives, partners, slaves, and family members there.

Since he had nothing else to do and Hong Xinxin had not yet returned to that realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to go to the eastern rocky beach by himself, and he looked for the bloodstones there, as well as other precious stones. Even though he felt the situation was safe, he didn't stop monitoring his map, and he found a solid red dot there. 'What really happened? Why is that guy hostile to me?
We don't even know each other, so there can't be any problems between us.'

[Master, people may be hostile to you not because there is a problem with you, but they may be jealous of your talent. After all, you're disguising yourself as a ten-year-old kid, so the guy must be jealous that you're too talented for your current age.]

Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with that. 'Sigh! Forget it! If he wants to attack me, I will immediately cancel my clone, and this body will immediately disappear, so he won't be able to do anything to me.'

Imperceptibly, the sun was about to set again, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] was satisfied that he had obtained quite a lot of bloodstones at the east rocky beach. Unfortunately, he saw that Shang Xinyu and both women were still cultivating their bodies in the beast blood pond, so he decided to return to the Shang Clan residence, where Shang Yaolin was already waiting for him.

Shang Yaolin immediately took Zhang Xiaolong [3] away again, and Shang Guangming decided to join them. The Shang siblings then guided him to the western area, an area he had never visited before, and informed him about all the clans residing there.
Unlike the east area, which was noisy due to the presence of the Huo and Tie Clans, the west area was quieter, but they could hear many melodious sounds from several musical instruments.

Even so, they almost never crossed paths with people from those clans, especially since they were all prisoners. Every day, they dedicated their time to carrying out their punishment duties, and at night, they would gather at their respective residences to relax and rest.

After they had enough fun and the moon had risen high in the sky, the Shang siblings brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] back to their residence. However, Shang Yaolin was annoyed that Hao Jianxiu and Huang Qinghua kept watching him from a distance, so she hurriedly brought him back to their room.

Shang Guangming could only shake his head at his sister's behavior. 'Apparently, Yaolin is getting more and more attached to Long'er, and their relationship is also improving day by day. I don't know what will happen to her if our big sister succeeds in snatching him from her, and she might fall into a long period of disappointment.'

Like the previous night, Shang Yaolin was intimate with Zhang Xiaolong [3] in his adult form, and she enjoyed their relationship more and more, which caused the seeds of feelings in her heart to begin to sprout.

After Shang Yaolin was exhausted and fell asleep, Zhang Xiaolong [3] locked up her subconscious again, and he had to do that for at least the next three weeks, especially since the effects of Shang Xiaojuan's pill would only wear off after a month.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Shang Yumei and activated his demon pheromone; he also used his demon touch on her before releasing her subconscious, which caused her to already be lustful when she opened her eyes. In the end, they immediately engage in sexual activities, and their actions make the demon fox feel even more helpless about their situation.

Once he was satisfied with Shang Yumei, Zhang Xiaolong [3] imprisoned her subconscious once more and hurried to meet Shang Yingyue at the top of the mountain to engage in dual soul cultivation with her.

After a week, Hong Xinxin finally returned to the Wasteland Realm, forcing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to halt his actions toward Shang Yumei. Despite this, he found satisfaction in the fact that the seductress had been somewhat lenient toward him, particularly due to the sexual activities they had engaged in over the previous few days, which continued to linger in her memory.
Moreover, nothing happened during the week, so he could spend his days in that realm in a relaxed manner.
In addition to Shang Yumei, Zhang Xiaolong [3] continued to be intimate with Shang Yaolin every night, which further deepened their relationship.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] also never missed cultivating his soul, either manually accompanied by Qiao Liangren or through dual soul cultivation with Shang Yingyue.

Whenever he had the chance, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took all his wives, partners, slaves, and family members to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place to cultivate. Unfortunately, he could only do it once every three days, especially since she and her three friends spent too much time there.

Shang Xinyu also kept her promise to Zhang Xiaolong [3] by giving him a sufficient amount of bloodstones every time she finished cultivating in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place. She also spent time with him whenever her friends and Shang Yaolin were busy with their own affairs, so their relationship also grew better.
Because of all of this, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul power finally broke through to the initial stage of the soul core level, and his cultivation has also broken through to the 8-Star Soul Realm.

Even though his demon rank and beast rank were still far from breaking through, both of them were still improving steadily, especially since his real body and other clones continued to focus on their seclusion.

Despite her growing acclimatization to intimacy with Zhang Xiaolong [3], Shang Yumei remained dissatisfied with their situation. As a result, she reported the incident to Hong Xinxin, leaving her completely perplexed and shocked.
Hong Xinxin herself immediately reported the matter to Shang Yumei's mother, and Murong Qianying was no less shocked after hearing everything.

Murong Qianying even considered asking Ai Weiren for assistance, but the old witch was in a far-off realm with Shang Xiaojuan, and she was unable to assist her. Therefore, she instructed Hong Xinxin to visit Huo Yaoshui once more and request another pill or potion.

Unfortunately, Hong Xinxin couldn't find Huo Yaoshui in the Wasteland Realm anymore, especially since the patriarch of the Huo Clan ordered him to return to their realm. That happened after Qiao Liangren contacted his master a week ago, and Hun Di helped him get rid of the old alchemist.

Hong Xinxin was furious after she learned that from the members of the Huo Clan in the Wasteland Realm, but she couldn't do anything about it either, and she vented her anger by beating Zhang Xiaolong [3] harder than ever.

Shang Yumei made the decision to leave her little sister's room, primarily due to her concern that she might succumb to Zhang Xiaolong [3] if she continued to stay in the same room as him. Even so, she did not stop trying to seduce him, but all her moves were thwarted by him, especially since he himself was far more experienced than her and Hong Xinxin.

Since Hong Xinxin's return, another three weeks had passed, but she and Shang Yumei were completely disappointed because all their attempts to subdue Zhang Xiaolong [3] kept failing. Moreover, he had successfully become a body cultivator two weeks ago, so she no longer had any reason to beat him up. Instead, she began teaching him about the true body cultivation path and its stages.

Although the body cultivation path was simpler than other cultivation paths, it still had its own difficulties, and it was divided into two major stages: The first stage was the body transformation stages, which were divided into seven minor stages. The second stage was the eight body gates, which were divided into eight minor stages.

(A/N: I will make an explanation about each stage in the auxiliary chapter, especially since I haven't found suitable names for them, or you guys can give me some ideas by leaving comments on this paragraph.)

After teaching all the basics of the cultivation path to Zhang Xiaolong [3], Hong Xinxin once again returned to the Red Sun Realm. Her father summoned her back, asking her to accompany her mother to another realm to take care of something.

Shang Yumei, who had continuously failed to subdue Zhang Xiaolong [3], also decided to leave the Wasteland Realm. However, she did not stay in the Red Sun Realm, and she went with her master besides the demon fox to hone her abilities further. 'Tch! I will definitely return to that realm again, and I will succeed in subduing that brat at that time.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself felt relieved with Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei's departure, so he could cultivate and train in peace without having to think about the two women. 'Mei, it's been three weeks since my cultivation broke through, so I think it's time for me to break through again, and the earth realm will be closer to my reach.'

[Master, your cultivation has stabilized after you stabilized it for the past three weeks, so you can directly break through to 9-Star. However, I think it would be better if you met Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue now, especially since you still haven't formed your soul mark, so you can do that now.]
'Oh! That's right!'
