sentences.text: Even though he really wanted the puppet techniques of the Miao Clan, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to hold himself back, especially since he still had a lot of matters on his hands, particularly the matter regarding Shang Yumei.
"You are right, Senior Sister.
I can't possibly join your clan because I myself like Big Sis Yaolin, and she has done me a great favor by bringing me to this realm.
If it weren't for her, I would never have met all of you, so I won't leave his side or let him down."
"I like your answer, kid." Zhang Xiaolong [3] looked at Miao Miao with confusion.
"Even though you are still a kid, you are still a man, so you should know how to be responsible and repay the kindness of your benefactors.
If you decide to leave Shang Yaolin for the sake of your own personal ambitions, that means you are an ingrate, and I don't like that kind of person.
For now, you should focus your time on her, but you should also focus on your goal of becoming a body cultivator and a soul cultivator.
Your talent is excellent, but trying to learn too much at once will not benefit you, and you may eventually become lost in one of them."
"Thank you for your advice, Senior Sister."
"Anyway, don't feel disappointed because you can't join my clan now; you still have a chance to do so in the future." Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in understanding the meaning behind Miao Miao's words.
"Since you have done, and it is already dawn, so I will return to my residence now."
After Miao Miao and Lai Minhua left, the three representatives of the Huang, Deng, and Hao clans also rushed down from the mountaintop.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] then glanced sideways, but Murong Mengying suddenly disappeared from his sight.
"You don't have to think about Mengying; she has always been like that.
Even though she is like that, she is the kindest among us, but she can also be the cruelest." Shang Yingyue then carried Zhang Xiaolong [3] into her embrace.
"Senior Brother, I will bring him back to my clan's residence, so you can cultivate your soul."
"All right."
As soon as they entered the room, Shang Yingyue instantly frowned.
This was due to the lingering scent of Zhang Xiaolong [3] and Shang Yumei's previous sexual activities, which made her face turn embarrassed as she recalled their activities from two days ago.
"Long'er, I don't know why your parents taught you about sex so early, but you're still a child, so you better control yourself or it will harm you."

"Actually, I don't want to do that, Senior Sister." Shang Yingyue looked at him with raised eyebrows, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] explained to her directly about what happened between him and Shang Yumei before, which caused her face to darken.

"Honestly, I myself don't know how the potion's effect didn't work on me, but my father often forced me to swallow various kinds of herbs in the past, and some of them even left me poisoned for quite a long time."
"Your father is truly insane, don't you think?" Shang Yingyue asked that with a shake of her head.
"Actually, there are various ways to increase our body's resistance to certain things, but the most extreme way is to swallow poisonous herbs and the like.
Actually, many alchemists often use such a method to test their pills or potions, so many of them have high resistance to poison or the like.

However, you were fortunate that your father employed this method on you; otherwise, you might have succumbed to the effects of that potion, and Yaolin would undoubtedly feel sad if you had forgotten about her."
"Would you also feel sad if I forgot about you?"
Shang Yingyue had no intention of answering Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s question, and she directly put him on the bed before leaving the room, but she did not return to her private quarter in the fortress.
Instead, she went to meet Qiao Liangren to discuss Shang Yumei's actions against him, and he immediately contacted their master to ask for a solution.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] smiled bitterly at Shang Yingyue's departure, but he then released Shang Yaolin's subconscious from his ability.
He then turned to Shang Yumei, who was still sleeping soundly.
Since she was still at her lowest point, he decided to seal her subconscious before giving her a passionate dream, which even the demon fox was unaware of.
After he had cleaned up the remains of their sexual activity, Zhang Xiaolong [3] turned Shang Yaolin to face him and hugged her.
He gently caressed her cheek as he continued to stare at her. 'You are a lovely and kind-hearted woman, and your feelings are gentle.
Unfortunately, you are a member of the Shang Clan, and you helped Shang Huaqiang invade the Sky Jade Realm.
Your actions have left Qingyu, Ying'er, Qing'er, and Xing'er grieving over Chu Hong's death.
Not only the three of them, but also my brother-in-law and sister-in-law are forced to live separately between two realms.
Even Luan'er is still grieving over Yan Zhixiu's transformation into a demon, making it difficult for me to forgive you.'
Early in the morning, Shang Yaolin smiled as he opened his eyes, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face was the first thing she saw.

She kissed his forehead instead of his lips, as he was still in his child form. 'After having fun with him last night, my body feels very fresh, and the sensation makes me want to experience it again.'
"Did you dream about me in your sleep again, Big Sis?"
"Yeah." Shang Yaolin admitted with a smile.
"Honestly, I still feel that your father is a weirdo for teaching you such things, but thankfully he taught you early, and I enjoyed it so much."
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed, returned to his adult form, and carried Shang Yaolin to the bathroom.
Her heart was pounding as she imagined what would happen next, but she wasn't that crazy to do such a thing with him so early in the morning.
Meanwhile, the demon fox tried to wake up her disciple, but Shang Yumei did not respond to her at all, and she could feel that her body was still hot; even her lust had not subsided since last night.
<Tch!
That kid fooled us both!
I never thought his father would use such a method on him, but I'm at a loss for what to do now.
I can only wait for Yumei to wake up before discussing this issue with her.>
After Shang Yaolin left to do her job, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately opened his map to look for Shang Xinyu and the other three women.
He found them in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place, so he decided to cancel his intention of bringing his wives, partners, slaves, and family members there.

Since he had nothing else to do and Hong Xinxin had not yet returned to that realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to go to the eastern rocky beach by himself, and he looked for the bloodstones there, as well as other precious stones.
Even though he felt the situation was safe, he didn't stop monitoring his map, and he found a solid red dot there. 'What really happened?
Why is that guy hostile to me?
We don't even know each other, so there can't be any problems between us.'
[Master, people may be hostile to you not because there is a problem with you, but they may be jealous of your talent.
After all, you're disguising yourself as a ten-year-old kid, so the guy must be jealous that you're too talented for your current age.]
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with that. 'Sigh!
Forget it!
If he wants to attack me, I will immediately cancel my clone, and this body will immediately disappear, so he won't be able to do anything to me.'
Imperceptibly, the sun was about to set again, and Zhang Xiaolong [3] was satisfied that he had obtained quite a lot of bloodstones at the east rocky beach.

Unfortunately, he saw that Shang Xinyu and both women were still cultivating their bodies in the beast blood pond, so he decided to return to the Shang Clan residence, where Shang Yaolin was already waiting for him.
Shang Yaolin immediately took Zhang Xiaolong [3] away again, and Shang Guangming decided to join them.
The Shang siblings then guided him to the western area, an area he had never visited before, and informed him about all the clans residing there.
Unlike the east area, which was noisy due to the presence of the Huo and Tie Clans, the west area was quieter, but they could hear many melodious sounds from several musical instruments.
Even so, they almost never crossed paths with people from those clans, especially since they were all prisoners.
Every day, they dedicated their time to carrying out their punishment duties, and at night, they would gather at their respective residences to relax and rest.
After they had enough fun and the moon had risen high in the sky, the Shang siblings brought Zhang Xiaolong [3] back to their residence.
However, Shang Yaolin was annoyed that Hao Jianxiu and Huang Qinghua kept watching him from a distance, so she hurriedly brought him back to their room.
Shang Guangming could only shake his head at his sister's behavior. 'Apparently, Yaolin is getting more and more attached to Long'er, and their relationship is also improving day by day.
I don't know what will happen to her if our big sister succeeds in snatching him from her, and she might fall into a long period of disappointment.'

Like the previous night, Shang Yaolin was intimate with Zhang Xiaolong [3] in his adult form, and she enjoyed their relationship more and more, which caused the seeds of feelings in her heart to begin to sprout.

After Shang Yaolin was exhausted and fell asleep, Zhang Xiaolong [3] locked up her subconscious again, and he had to do that for at least the next three weeks, especially since the effects of Shang Xiaojuan's pill would only wear off after a month.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] then turned to Shang Yumei and activated his demon pheromone; he also used his demon touch on her before releasing her subconscious, which caused her to already be lustful when she opened her eyes.
In the end, they immediately engage in sexual activities, and their actions make the demon fox feel even more helpless about their situation.

Once he was satisfied with Shang Yumei, Zhang Xiaolong [3] imprisoned her subconscious once more and hurried to meet Shang Yingyue at the top of the mountain to engage in dual soul cultivation with her.
After a week, Hong Xinxin finally returned to the Wasteland Realm, forcing Zhang Xiaolong [3] to halt his actions toward Shang Yumei.

Despite this, he found satisfaction in the fact that the seductress had been somewhat lenient toward him, particularly due to the sexual activities they had engaged in over the previous few days, which continued to linger in her memory.
Moreover, nothing happened during the week, so he could spend his days in that realm in a relaxed manner.
In addition to Shang Yumei, Zhang Xiaolong [3] continued to be intimate with Shang Yaolin every night, which further deepened their relationship.
Zhang Xiaolong [3] also never missed cultivating his soul, either manually accompanied by Qiao Liangren or through dual soul cultivation with Shang Yingyue.
Whenever he had the chance, Zhang Xiaolong [3] took all his wives, partners, slaves, and family members to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place to cultivate.
Unfortunately, he could only do it once every three days, especially since she and her three friends spent too much time there.
Shang Xinyu also kept her promise to Zhang Xiaolong [3] by giving him a sufficient amount of bloodstones every time she finished cultivating in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place.
She also spent time with him whenever her friends and Shang Yaolin were busy with their own affairs, so their relationship also grew better.
Because of all of this, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul power finally broke through to the initial stage of the soul core level, and his cultivation has also broken through to the 8-Star Soul Realm.

Even though his demon rank and beast rank were still far from breaking through, both of them were still improving steadily, especially since his real body and other clones continued to focus on their seclusion.
Despite her growing acclimatization to intimacy with Zhang Xiaolong [3], Shang Yumei remained dissatisfied with their situation.
As a result, she reported the incident to Hong Xinxin, leaving her completely perplexed and shocked.
Hong Xinxin herself immediately reported the matter to Shang Yumei's mother, and Murong Qianying was no less shocked after hearing everything.
Murong Qianying even considered asking Ai Weiren for assistance, but the old witch was in a far-off realm with Shang Xiaojuan, and she was unable to assist her.
Therefore, she instructed Hong Xinxin to visit Huo Yaoshui once more and request another pill or potion.
Unfortunately, Hong Xinxin couldn't find Huo Yaoshui in the Wasteland Realm anymore, especially since the patriarch of the Huo Clan ordered him to return to their realm.
That happened after Qiao Liangren contacted his master a week ago, and Hun Di helped him get rid of the old alchemist.

Hong Xinxin was furious after she learned that from the members of the Huo Clan in the Wasteland Realm, but she couldn't do anything about it either, and she vented her anger by beating Zhang Xiaolong [3] harder than ever.
Shang Yumei made the decision to leave her little sister's room, primarily due to her concern that she might succumb to Zhang Xiaolong [3] if she continued to stay in the same room as him.
Even so, she did not stop trying to seduce him, but all her moves were thwarted by him, especially since he himself was far more experienced than her and Hong Xinxin.
Since Hong Xinxin's return, another three weeks had passed, but she and Shang Yumei were completely disappointed because all their attempts to subdue Zhang Xiaolong [3] kept failing.
Moreover, he had successfully become a body cultivator two weeks ago, so she no longer had any reason to beat him up.
Instead, she began teaching him about the true body cultivation path and its stages.

Although the body cultivation path was simpler than other cultivation paths, it still had its own difficulties, and it was divided into two major stages: The first stage was the body transformation stages, which were divided into seven minor stages.
The second stage was the eight body gates, which were divided into eight minor stages.

(A/N: I will make an explanation about each stage in the auxiliary chapter, especially since I haven't found suitable names for them, or you guys can give me some ideas by leaving comments on this paragraph.)
After teaching all the basics of the cultivation path to Zhang Xiaolong [3], Hong Xinxin once again returned to the Red Sun Realm.
Her father summoned her back, asking her to accompany her mother to another realm to take care of something.
Shang Yumei, who had continuously failed to subdue Zhang Xiaolong [3], also decided to leave the Wasteland Realm.
However, she did not stay in the Red Sun Realm, and she went with her master besides the demon fox to hone her abilities further. 'Tch!
I will definitely return to that realm again, and I will succeed in subduing that brat at that time.'

Zhang Xiaolong [3] himself felt relieved with Hong Xinxin and Shang Yumei's departure, so he could cultivate and train in peace without having to think about the two women. 'Mei, it's been three weeks since my cultivation broke through, so I think it's time for me to break through again, and the earth realm will be closer to my reach.'
[Master, your cultivation has stabilized after you stabilized it for the past three weeks, so you can directly break through to 9-Star.
However, I think it would be better if you met Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue now, especially since you still haven't formed your soul mark, so you can do that now.]
'Oh!
That's right!'

chapters.title: Chapter 486 Soul Mark
paragraphs: After listening to Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue's instructions, Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately took out his soul and tried to form his soul mark, but he first sealed his senses to make it easier to concentrate.

Following their instructions, Zhang Xiaolong [3] utilized the Yang and Yin Qi within his body, then circulated them into his soul. Additionally, he also absorbed Qi from the air, causing a Yin-Yang diagram to quickly form above him.
"Do you think he'll succeed in one try, Senior Brother?"

Qiao Liangren shook his head in response. "Long'er is indeed talented, but it's not easy to form a soul mark. It took me ten tries before I managed to form one, so I'm not sure if he'll be able to do it in one try."

"I myself failed dozens of times before I managed to form my soul mark." Shang Yingyue then sighed softly and observed Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face. "Look at him; his concentration is deeper than usual, so I think he might succeed in the first try.
If he really succeeds in doing so, he will be the first soul cultivator to do so, and our master will be even more eager to take him as his next direct disciple."
"Yeah."

Murong Mengying unexpectedly arrived and took a seat next to them. Having observed Zhang Xiaolong [3] for over a month, she was eager to witness his next unexpected move. As she repeatedly sipped her wine, her eyes remained glued to his face. A faint smile appeared on her face, but no one knew what was on her mind. 'Show me your miracle, kid.
I know you are not an ordinary kid, and you are a miracle kid who will bring change to this universe.'
One hour.
Two hours.

After five hours had passed, the three people saw Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul shaking quite strongly, and a symbol slowly began to appear in the center of it, which shocked and amazed them at the same time.
"Long'er... He almost succeeded in forming his soul mark, senior brother." Shang Yingyue spoke with a trembling voice, filled with excitement.
"Shang Yaolin hit a jackpot by finding this kid, and he will undoubtedly surpass you, Liangren."

Qiao Liangren shook his head at Murong Mengying. "I am not a genius in the cultivation path, and there are still many soul cultivators who are better than me, so it is useless for Long'er to surpass me. To become the best in the soul cultivation path, he must surpass Senior Sister Jing Qiuyue, Senior Brother Lin Moxian, and Master Hun Di."
"After your master, Jing Qiuyue and Lin Moxian rank second and third, respectively. They are geniuses, but this kid is more genius than them.

I fully believe that this kid will surpass them in the future, and he might even surpass Senior Hun Di." Shang Yingyue turned to Murong Mengying with a slight raise of her eyebrows, especially since she had repeatedly praised Zhang Xiaolong [3] over the past month or so, and she was also so confident in him. "You don't need to look at me like that, Yingyue.

Even though his future is still far ahead, I'm willing to bet that he will stand at the top of the cultivation world one day, and we have to look up to him as the highest standard. That's why it would be good for us if we were always on his side, especially since having an enemy like him would be terrible for anyone."
"I don't know how you can have such high confidence in Long'er, but you might be right about his future." Murong Mengying smiled at Shang Yingyue and sipped her wine.

"However, he still has to go through a tough and steep path to stand at the peak of the cultivation world, and he will also encounter many obstacles on the way there, especially from powerful cultivators who have stood at the peak for a long time like the nameless one."

"Do you think the nameless one is really the strongest in this universe?" Not only Shang Yingyue, but Qiao Liangren also immediately turned to Murong Mengying. "I know that he is the strongest in the upper realms, but I always feel that the seven divine realms are not the final stage of our cultivation, and I think about the possibility of other stages after that.
If my thoughts are correct, he is not the strongest, and there should still be people stronger than him in this universe."
"Where did you get such an idea from?"

"My master." Murong Mengying then took out a parchment and handed it to them. "As you both know, my master is a traveler, and he has explored all the planets in the upper realms. The writings on the parchment are the results of his visits to all the realms, and he suspects that there are other realms above the upper realms.

Unfortunately, a guess is just a guess if it cannot be proven true, but he didn't give up on his conjecture, so he continued to wander in search of solid evidence to prove the truth of his guess. He once discussed this with the nameless one, and he also agreed with him."

After hearing that, Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue immediately read every word on the parchment seriously, especially since they knew Murong Mengying's master very well, and he was not a random thinker.

After reading everything, Qiao Liangren immediately spoke to the two women. "Honestly, Senior Xia Tian may be right about his guess, but I don't want to think too much about it with my cultivation still at the Divine Fusion Realm.
Perhaps I will follow his footsteps to go wandering around this universe after my cultivation reaches the Divine Ascension, but it may take thousands of years for me to reach that stage."

"I agree with you, Senior Brother." Shang Yingyue then returned the parchment to Murong Mengying. "Instead of thinking about that, it would be better if we continued to concentrate on improving our cultivation, so we could go wandering in search of the truth."
"Yeah."
After they waited for another hour, they finally saw a clear symbol inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, indicating that he had successfully formed his soul mark.
"Six hours! He only needed six hours to form his mark! He didn't even fail once!" Shang Yingyue said with a disappointed look, but she was disappointed with herself.

"Hehehe." Murong Mengying chuckled at that. "Do you still need to question my confidence in this kid? Even Senior Hun Di couldn't form his soul mark in one try, but he managed to do it in one try, which already proved his talent."
Shang Yingyue sighed softly and nodded to Murong Mengying. Even though she felt disappointed with herself, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s success actually spurred her enthusiasm to become even better.
"I'll go back now." Murong Mengying quickly vanished without waiting for a response.

A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul had entered his body again, and he immediately opened his eyes before smiling in relief. "Thanks to the guidance from both of you, I finally managed to form my soul mark."

"We guided you, but you succeeded through your own efforts." Qiao Liangren then threw a scroll that he had prepared beforehand to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "Soul mark is the second stage in the soul cultivation path, and there are three other stages.

The third stage is to expand our soul space into a soul sea, but you can only do that when your soul power has reached the heavenly soul level like ours, and it is much harder than forming a soul mark. The fourth stage is to evolve our soul sea into a soul world, and my master said that we must first reach the venerate or divine soul level to be able to do that.
The fifth stage is to form a soul universe, but my master has no information about that."
"Does that mean Senior Hun Di's soul space has turned into a soul world?"
"Not yet." Qiao Liangren shook his head in response. "My master's soul level is still at the saint soul level, so he can't do it yet."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into a daze after hearing that, especially since Hun Di was the best soul cultivator in the upper realms, and many people respected him, yet he still hadn't succeeded in forming his soul world.
"All right, you don't need to think that hard, and you just need to cultivate your soul as usual."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with that. "Senior brother, what exactly is the function of our soul mark other than attacking our enemy's soul?"

"A soul mark still has many other functions, and one of them is that you can sense your partners' situation if you plant your soul mark into their souls. If you do that, you can tell whether they are in danger or not, and you can immediately move to save them if they are."
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was taken aback by this and immediately considered implanting his soul mark into their souls. "I didn't expect that a soul mark would have such a great function."

Qiao Liangren then explained to Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the other uses of the soul mark. "I believe you should return now, particularly since cultivating your soul after forming your soul mark is not beneficial. You can wait three days to begin cultivating your soul again."
"Yes, Senior Brother."
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] came down from the mountaintop, Qiao Liangren asked Shang Yingyue, who looked pensive. "What are you thinking about? Are you feeling pressured by Long'er?"
"Don't you feel pressured by his progress, Senior Brother?" Shang Yingyue asked back.

"No." Qiao Liangren immediately released his soul. "Yingyue, our master has always emphasized that jealousy, envy, and fear will only weigh us down. Long'er has better talent, but the two of us are not bad either. Otherwise, our master wouldn't have accepted us as his disciples, right? That's why we don't need to think about him, and we only need to focus on ourselves."
"Yeah, you're right." Shang Yingyue immediately stood up from her seat. "I won't bother you anymore, Senior Brother."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not immediately return to the Shang Clan residence, especially since Shang Yaolin had not yet completed his task, and he went elsewhere after he found Shang Xinyu alone. "What are you thinking, Big Sis?"

"I don't think about anything, and I just want to enjoy my relaxing time." Shang Xinyu then turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was already sitting beside her. "Did you just come back from the top of the mountain?"

"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Shang Xinyu about his previous activities. "Fortunately, I have Senior Brother Liangren and Senior Sister Yingyue who are willing to guide me patiently, so I managed to do it. However, my journey on the soul cultivation path is still long, and I must strive hard to surpass them."

"Haha." Shang Xinyu laughed and rubbed Zhang Xiaolong's head [3]. "You've already achieved all that despite being so young, so don't be too hard on yourself. Both of them have been cultivating for so long, so it will take a lot of time for you to reach their level, and you have to do it patiently. Otherwise, the results will be bad if you rush things, especially if your body and soul are injured.

Anyway, do you want to go to that place? Xiaoyin and the others are returning to our realm, and they won't be back until a week later. Since you're also a body cultivator like me, the beast blood pond will be beneficial to you, and your body will become stronger if you soak in it often."
"Can I invite Big Sis Yaolin to join us?"
"Sure."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately contacted Shang Yaolin afterward, but she asked him to wait because she was still working on her assignment, so he waited for her while chatting with Shang Xinyu.

An hour later, Shang Yaolin had already arrived there, so Shang Xinyu immediately led them to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place. Even though he had been there many times, Zhang Xiaolong [3] couldn't possibly tell the two women about it.
With the cultivation of the two women, it didn't take long for them to arrive there, and Shang Xinyu immediately led them into the underground area.
As they walked down, Shang Yaolin asked Shang Xinyu. "So you guys kidnapped us and brought us here before?"
"Yes." Shang Xinyu then explained the events of that day to Shang Yaolin. "However, we are still unsure about the identity of the person who saved you two, but we suspect that it was Senior Yingyue."
"I see."

Before long, they had arrived at the bottom, and Shang Yaolin looked jealous when she saw so many resources there, especially since Shang Xiaoyin had only shared them with Shang Xinyu and the other two women.
"Are you really going to take Long'er to soak in that pond?" Shang Yaolin asked as she pointed at the beast blood pond, and she felt horrified at the sight.

"Yaolin, Long'er is a body cultivator, and the blood from the beast in that pond will benefit his body, so you don't need to worry about him." Shang Xinyu promptly removed her dress and asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] to follow suit. "You are not a body cultivator like us, so you cannot soak in there, or you will die."
Shang Yaolin nodded in understanding and took off her clothes too, given that they were already naked. "Long'er, I think it would be better if you used your adult form while you're soaking in there."
"Eh?" Shang Xinyu turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in surprise. "Do you really have an adult form, Long'er?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and nodded to Shang Xinyu. "Actually, Big Sis Yumei taught me the transformation technique, so I can turn myself into a grown man."

Shang Xinyu seemed curious about it, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned to his adult form, which left her dumbfounded. 'Impossible... how could this happen? His face and figure are exactly the same as the man I met in my dream...'

Shang Xinyu's reaction piqued Shang Yaolin's curiosity, especially since she kept staring at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a strange gaze; even her pupils seemed to tremble. "What happened to you? Are you fascinated by his adult form?"

Shang Xinyu did not answer Shang Yaolin's question, and instead, she rushed into the beast blood pond. However, her heart was beating rapidly, and her face flushed red as she remembered her dream from a while ago. 'Ugh! How could Long'er be the man in my dreams? What should I do now? How can I face him?'
Shang Yaolin turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a raised eyebrow, but he responded to her with a shake of his head, and he immediately joined Shang Xinyu in the beast blood pond.

On the other hand, Shang Yaolin was looking for stones that matched her element, and she immediately sat in front of them after she found them. She glanced at Shang Xinyu a few times with suspicious eyes, but she immediately ignored her and began to cultivate.

Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already sitting beside Shang Xinyu in the pond, and he could hear her loud heartbeat, causing him to smile faintly. He then took her hand and gently questioned her. "Are you acting like this because of the man in your dream, Big Sis? Do I look like him?"

Shang Xinyu turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] feeling hesitant to answer him. She attempted to remove her hand from his grasp, but he held it even tighter, making it difficult for her to calm her feelings.

In the end, Shang Xinyu decided to admit the truth to Zhang Xiaolong [3]. "I don't understand how this could happen, but your adult form is really the same as the man in my dream. Even though the dream has long passed, I can never forget his face, and I still remember it to this moment."

I know you are not an ordinary kid, and you are a miracle kid who will bring change to this universe.'
One hour.
Two hours.

After five hours had passed, the three people saw Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul shaking quite strongly, and a symbol slowly began to appear in the center of it, which shocked and amazed them at the same time.
"Long'er...
He almost succeeded in forming his soul mark, senior brother." Shang Yingyue spoke with a trembling voice, filled with excitement.
"Shang Yaolin hit a jackpot by finding this kid, and he will undoubtedly surpass you, Liangren."
Qiao Liangren shook his head at Murong Mengying.
"I am not a genius in the cultivation path, and there are still many soul cultivators who are better than me, so it is useless for Long'er to surpass me.
To become the best in the soul cultivation path, he must surpass Senior Sister Jing Qiuyue, Senior Brother Lin Moxian, and Master Hun Di."
"After your master, Jing Qiuyue and Lin Moxian rank second and third, respectively.
They are geniuses, but this kid is more genius than them.

I fully believe that this kid will surpass them in the future, and he might even surpass Senior Hun Di." Shang Yingyue turned to Murong Mengying with a slight raise of her eyebrows, especially since she had repeatedly praised Zhang Xiaolong [3] over the past month or so, and she was also so confident in him.
"You don't need to look at me like that, Yingyue.
Even though his future is still far ahead, I'm willing to bet that he will stand at the top of the cultivation world one day, and we have to look up to him as the highest standard.
That's why it would be good for us if we were always on his side, especially since having an enemy like him would be terrible for anyone."
"I don't know how you can have such high confidence in Long'er, but you might be right about his future." Murong Mengying smiled at Shang Yingyue and sipped her wine.

"However, he still has to go through a tough and steep path to stand at the peak of the cultivation world, and he will also encounter many obstacles on the way there, especially from powerful cultivators who have stood at the peak for a long time like the nameless one."
"Do you think the nameless one is really the strongest in this universe?" Not only Shang Yingyue, but Qiao Liangren also immediately turned to Murong Mengying.

"I know that he is the strongest in the upper realms, but I always feel that the seven divine realms are not the final stage of our cultivation, and I think about the possibility of other stages after that.
If my thoughts are correct, he is not the strongest, and there should still be people stronger than him in this universe."
"Where did you get such an idea from?"
"My master." Murong Mengying then took out a parchment and handed it to them.
"As you both know, my master is a traveler, and he has explored all the planets in the upper realms.
The writings on the parchment are the results of his visits to all the realms, and he suspects that there are other realms above the upper realms.
Unfortunately, a guess is just a guess if it cannot be proven true, but he didn't give up on his conjecture, so he continued to wander in search of solid evidence to prove the truth of his guess.
He once discussed this with the nameless one, and he also agreed with him."

After hearing that, Qiao Liangren and Shang Yingyue immediately read every word on the parchment seriously, especially since they knew Murong Mengying's master very well, and he was not a random thinker.
After reading everything, Qiao Liangren immediately spoke to the two women.
"Honestly, Senior Xia Tian may be right about his guess, but I don't want to think too much about it with my cultivation still at the Divine Fusion Realm.
Perhaps I will follow his footsteps to go wandering around this universe after my cultivation reaches the Divine Ascension, but it may take thousands of years for me to reach that stage."
"I agree with you, Senior Brother." Shang Yingyue then returned the parchment to Murong Mengying.
"Instead of thinking about that, it would be better if we continued to concentrate on improving our cultivation, so we could go wandering in search of the truth."
"Yeah."
After they waited for another hour, they finally saw a clear symbol inside Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul, indicating that he had successfully formed his soul mark.
"Six hours!
He only needed six hours to form his mark!
He didn't even fail once!" Shang Yingyue said with a disappointed look, but she was disappointed with herself.
"Hehehe." Murong Mengying chuckled at that.
"Do you still need to question my confidence in this kid?
Even Senior Hun Di couldn't form his soul mark in one try, but he managed to do it in one try, which already proved his talent."
Shang Yingyue sighed softly and nodded to Murong Mengying.
Even though she felt disappointed with herself, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s success actually spurred her enthusiasm to become even better.
"I'll go back now." Murong Mengying quickly vanished without waiting for a response.
A while later, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s soul had entered his body again, and he immediately opened his eyes before smiling in relief.
"Thanks to the guidance from both of you, I finally managed to form my soul mark."
"We guided you, but you succeeded through your own efforts." Qiao Liangren then threw a scroll that he had prepared beforehand to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"Soul mark is the second stage in the soul cultivation path, and there are three other stages.

The third stage is to expand our soul space into a soul sea, but you can only do that when your soul power has reached the heavenly soul level like ours, and it is much harder than forming a soul mark.
The fourth stage is to evolve our soul sea into a soul world, and my master said that we must first reach the venerate or divine soul level to be able to do that.
The fifth stage is to form a soul universe, but my master has no information about that."
"Does that mean Senior Hun Di's soul space has turned into a soul world?"
"Not yet." Qiao Liangren shook his head in response.
"My master's soul level is still at the saint soul level, so he can't do it yet."

Zhang Xiaolong [3] fell into a daze after hearing that, especially since Hun Di was the best soul cultivator in the upper realms, and many people respected him, yet he still hadn't succeeded in forming his soul world.
"All right, you don't need to think that hard, and you just need to cultivate your soul as usual."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] nodded in agreement with that.
"Senior brother, what exactly is the function of our soul mark other than attacking our enemy's soul?"
"A soul mark still has many other functions, and one of them is that you can sense your partners' situation if you plant your soul mark into their souls.
If you do that, you can tell whether they are in danger or not, and you can immediately move to save them if they are."
"Oh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3] was taken aback by this and immediately considered implanting his soul mark into their souls.
"I didn't expect that a soul mark would have such a great function."
Qiao Liangren then explained to Zhang Xiaolong [3] about the other uses of the soul mark.
"I believe you should return now, particularly since cultivating your soul after forming your soul mark is not beneficial.
You can wait three days to begin cultivating your soul again."
"Yes, Senior Brother."
After Zhang Xiaolong [3] came down from the mountaintop, Qiao Liangren asked Shang Yingyue, who looked pensive.
"What are you thinking about?
Are you feeling pressured by Long'er?"
"Don't you feel pressured by his progress, Senior Brother?" Shang Yingyue asked back.
"No." Qiao Liangren immediately released his soul.
"Yingyue, our master has always emphasized that jealousy, envy, and fear will only weigh us down.
Long'er has better talent, but the two of us are not bad either.
Otherwise, our master wouldn't have accepted us as his disciples, right?
That's why we don't need to think about him, and we only need to focus on ourselves."
"Yeah, you're right." Shang Yingyue immediately stood up from her seat.
"I won't bother you anymore, Senior Brother."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] did not immediately return to the Shang Clan residence, especially since Shang Yaolin had not yet completed his task, and he went elsewhere after he found Shang Xinyu alone.
"What are you thinking, Big Sis?"
"I don't think about anything, and I just want to enjoy my relaxing time." Shang Xinyu then turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3], who was already sitting beside her.
"Did you just come back from the top of the mountain?"
"Yes." Zhang Xiaolong [3] then told Shang Xinyu about his previous activities.
"Fortunately, I have Senior Brother Liangren and Senior Sister Yingyue who are willing to guide me patiently, so I managed to do it.
However, my journey on the soul cultivation path is still long, and I must strive hard to surpass them."
"Haha." Shang Xinyu laughed and rubbed Zhang Xiaolong's head [3].
"You've already achieved all that despite being so young, so don't be too hard on yourself.
Both of them have been cultivating for so long, so it will take a lot of time for you to reach their level, and you have to do it patiently.
Otherwise, the results will be bad if you rush things, especially if your body and soul are injured.
Anyway, do you want to go to that place?
Xiaoyin and the others are returning to our realm, and they won't be back until a week later.
Since you're also a body cultivator like me, the beast blood pond will be beneficial to you, and your body will become stronger if you soak in it often."
"Can I invite Big Sis Yaolin to join us?"
"Sure."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately contacted Shang Yaolin afterward, but she asked him to wait because she was still working on her assignment, so he waited for her while chatting with Shang Xinyu.
An hour later, Shang Yaolin had already arrived there, so Shang Xinyu immediately led them to Shang Xiaoyin's secret place.
Even though he had been there many times, Zhang Xiaolong [3] couldn't possibly tell the two women about it.
With the cultivation of the two women, it didn't take long for them to arrive there, and Shang Xinyu immediately led them into the underground area.
As they walked down, Shang Yaolin asked Shang Xinyu.
"So you guys kidnapped us and brought us here before?"
"Yes." Shang Xinyu then explained the events of that day to Shang Yaolin.
"However, we are still unsure about the identity of the person who saved you two, but we suspect that it was Senior Yingyue."
"I see."

Before long, they had arrived at the bottom, and Shang Yaolin looked jealous when she saw so many resources there, especially since Shang Xiaoyin had only shared them with Shang Xinyu and the other two women.
"Are you really going to take Long'er to soak in that pond?" Shang Yaolin asked as she pointed at the beast blood pond, and she felt horrified at the sight.

"Yaolin, Long'er is a body cultivator, and the blood from the beast in that pond will benefit his body, so you don't need to worry about him." Shang Xinyu promptly removed her dress and asked Zhang Xiaolong [3] to follow suit.
"You are not a body cultivator like us, so you cannot soak in there, or you will die."
Shang Yaolin nodded in understanding and took off her clothes too, given that they were already naked.
"Long'er, I think it would be better if you used your adult form while you're soaking in there."
"Eh?" Shang Xinyu turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] in surprise.
"Do you really have an adult form, Long'er?"
"Haha." Zhang Xiaolong [3] laughed and nodded to Shang Xinyu.
"Actually, Big Sis Yumei taught me the transformation technique, so I can turn myself into a grown man."
Shang Xinyu seemed curious about it, so Zhang Xiaolong [3] immediately returned to his adult form, which left her dumbfounded. 'Impossible... how could this happen?
His face and figure are exactly the same as the man I met in my dream...'
Shang Xinyu's reaction piqued Shang Yaolin's curiosity, especially since she kept staring at Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a strange gaze; even her pupils seemed to tremble.
"What happened to you?
Are you fascinated by his adult form?"
Shang Xinyu did not answer Shang Yaolin's question, and instead, she rushed into the beast blood pond.
However, her heart was beating rapidly, and her face flushed red as she remembered her dream from a while ago. 'Ugh!
How could Long'er be the man in my dreams?
What should I do now?
How can I face him?'
Shang Yaolin turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] with a raised eyebrow, but he responded to her with a shake of his head, and he immediately joined Shang Xinyu in the beast blood pond.
On the other hand, Shang Yaolin was looking for stones that matched her element, and she immediately sat in front of them after she found them.
She glanced at Shang Xinyu a few times with suspicious eyes, but she immediately ignored her and began to cultivate.
Meanwhile, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was already sitting beside Shang Xinyu in the pond, and he could hear her loud heartbeat, causing him to smile faintly.
He then took her hand and gently questioned her.
"Are you acting like this because of the man in your dream, Big Sis?
Do I look like him?"
Shang Xinyu turned to Zhang Xiaolong [3] feeling hesitant to answer him.
She attempted to remove her hand from his grasp, but he held it even tighter, making it difficult for her to calm her feelings.
In the end, Shang Xinyu decided to admit the truth to Zhang Xiaolong [3].
"I don't understand how this could happen, but your adult form is really the same as the man in my dream.
Even though the dream has long passed, I can never forget his face, and I still remember it to this moment."

chapters.title: Chapter 487 Resting
paragraphs: "It's okay; you still remember that man now, but you will manage to forget him soon." Shang Xinyu seemed unsure that she would be able to forget the man in her dream, especially since Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s face was similar to that man's, and she felt that she would continue to remember him if she saw him more often. "Anyway, Shang Xiaoyin won't be back in this realm until next week, right?"
"Yes."
"How about we spend our time in seclusion in this place for a week?"

"Eh?" Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s desire surprised Shang Xinyu, but he immediately nodded. "It's fine if you want to do that, but Yaolin and I have to carry out our duties, so we have to return to our residence frequently. However, we will return here once our duties are complete, and we will accompany you here. Aren't you going to cultivate your soul?"

Zhang Xiaolong [3] shook his head and proceeded to explain. "Senior Brother Liangren asked me not to cultivate my soul for the next three days, but I was thinking of stopping for a bit longer, especially since my body cultivation path is still in its early stages, so I want to improve it.
Moreover, this place is very good for that, and this kind of opportunity is rare, so I want to make good use of it."

"I see." Shang Xinyu then pulled her hand away from Zhang Xiaolong [3] and straightened her position. "Since you've decided that, then you can do it. I'll contact you immediately when Shang Xiaoyin returns to this realm, so you can hurry up and leave this place. Anyway, we've wasted too much time, so let's begin cultivating our bodies."
Zhang Xiaolong [3] didn't want to rush things with Shang Xinyu, so he closed his eyes and began to cultivate his body using the beast blood in the pond.

On the balcony of the ancient floating castle, Feltia [2] was standing side by side with Morgana, and she asked her about the abilities of the sorcerer demons in her home realm. Although he was surprised by her question, the demon witch immediately told him in as much detail as possible about the abilities of the demon race.

Unfortunately, Feltia [2] was disappointed with the result because the abilities of the sorcerer demons were different from what she had previously expected. "Have you ever heard of other living beings who have the ability to create random portals?"

"Hmm?" Morgana searched her memories first, but she shook her head some time later. "As far as I can remember, only the people from the Xianjin Realm have the ability to create portals to connect two realms that are so far apart, and Shang Huaqiang got his portal from one of those people, though I'm not sure who that person is."
"Have you ever been to the Xianjin Realm before?"

"Yes." Feltia [2] immediately touched Morgana's forehead and shared a picture of the young girl who killed and resurrected him. "The Xianyin realm is not a small realm, and the population in that realm is much larger than in other realms, so I never met her before. Why are you looking for her?"

"She was the one who brought about a big change in my life until I became who I am today." Feltia [2]'s answer surprised Morgana. "Unfortunately, I don't know her name or where she came from, so I wanted to find her to express my gratitude and ask her why she helped me."
Morgana nodded in understanding. "Since that girl can help you, I'm sure that she comes from powerful clans or races out there, and you might meet her someday when you've become fully powerful."
"Yeah, you're right. Anyway, what about the soul and the lock? Has Oz the first started to get his old memories back?"

Morgana sighed in disappointment after Feltia [2] asked that. "I've taken my husband to visit almost all the ancient places in this realm, but he still shows no signs of recovering his memories. That's why I keep delaying to open the lock on the soul, and I will only open it after his memories are restored."

"Actually, I have a bad feeling about that soul, so I think your decision to postpone it is correct. Otherwise, something catastrophic will happen in this realm, and it might spread to the human realm or the other two realms." Feltia [2] then looked into the distance and thought for quite a while, but he didn't tell Morgana about his thoughts.
"I will return to my tower now, and I hope you will tell me if you find any clues about that soul."
"All right, I'll let you know straight away if I get any new leads." After Feltia [2] left, Morgana immediately met her husband, who was talking to Oz the second and Zygoz in another area.

Upon his arrival at the tower, Feltia [2] immediately planted his soul mark into the souls of his partners, including the Amaris Twins and Nadea, even though they were not cultivators like Fyr, Eve, Leora, and Ashreth.

Since there were no problems in the Diyu Realm and his subordinates had completely submitted to him, Feltia [2] decided to bring all his partners to the Netherworld Realm. He brought them to Arbeola's place to increase their demon power and gave them some bloodstones, but he himself didn't relax either, and he accompanied them for that.

Cain suddenly reached out to Zhang Fei [4], informing him that the resources he sought were ready. He immediately went to the northern mansion to meet him, but he was surprised to notice that Lu Xin and Yu Xixiuan had already become his partners. Even so, he did not comment on it and followed him to another room, where all the demon resources were gathered.
"Are you satisfied with all this?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] immediately stored everything in his inventory before handing a bag of bloodstones to Cain. "They are enough for now, but I still need more resources for my subordinates in another realm, and you can get more bloodstones if you continue to help me gather them."

"Haha!" Cain laughed as he threw the bag in the air several times. "Naturally, I will continue to help you, especially since these bloodstones are more useful to me than those resources. However, I'm perplexed as to why you didn't give them the bloodstones directly, especially considering that doing so would enhance their strength faster."

Zhang Fei [4] shook his head at Cain. "The number of my subordinates is quite large, and my supply of bloodstones is not comparable to their numbers, so I have to use other methods to strengthen them."

"All right then, I will contact you again after I prepare the second batch of resources, and you better bring me more bloodstones." After that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately left the mansion, and Cain also took the two women with him.

When Zhang Fei [4] arrived at the succubus tower, he immediately went underground to meet Balena, just as he had done in the past month. From her, he gained more information about the Blue Water Realm, which also made their relationship closer. "Orith and the others haven't returned yet, so I can't talk to her about you yet.
Anyway, I plan to look for them in the dead forest, so I won't be able to visit you during that time."

"That's not a problem for me, especially since I've been cooping up here alone for so long, so I'm used to quiet situations." After they talked for some time, Zhang Fei[4] immediately left the underground, but Balena sighed softly at his departure.

After he implanted his soul mark in the souls of all his partners, Zhang Fei [1] asked them to continue their training using the gravity feature. After all, his partners were different from his wives, and they were more focused on their cultivation and rarely practiced since they entered seclusion. He later met Yan Zhixiu inside the portable mansion.

"Do you really not want to return to the Yin-Yang Pavilion? You are a demon cultivator, so you can use the transformation technique to return to your original form. Moreover, you already know that Shen Xueyi is my partner, and the people there also know about my identity as a demon, so I'm sure they won't have a problem with you returning there."

"No." Yan Zhixiu rejected Zhang Fei [1]'s idea outright. "During these two months, I have understood more about demons thanks to you, so I now know that I also need demon power to strengthen myself. I have decided not to return to the sect, and I want to return to the Netherworld Realm to increase my demon rank so I can become stronger than before I became a demon.

I know that you will always protect Luan'er, but she is still my sister, and she is my last remaining family member, so I want to protect her." (A/N: The time skip is one month, but the flow of time in the training space is two times faster than the outside world.)

Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding. "Since you've made that decision, I'll send you back to the Netherworld Realm, but I won't send you there right now; you should continue your training with them first." Once you've fully adapted to the level three gravity feature, then I'll send you there directly."

Following this, Zhang Fei [1] escorted Yan Zhixiu out of the portable mansion, where she joined the others for training. He himself decided to leave the training space and return to the Sky Jade Realm, especially the southern region, to take care of some matters and meet someone.

When he arrived at the Wei Clan, Zhang Fei [1] couldn't find Yi Na in the clan residence. He was surprised when he heard some maids say that she decided to separate from Wei Jiang about half a month ago.
Zhang Fei [1] then searched for Yi Na's location on his map, and he found that she lived not far from the entrance to the Hidden Sea Palace, especially since Wei Luan was a disciple of the sect.

After a few minutes, Zhang Fei [1] arrived at Yi Na's new residence, where he found her painting his picture. He immediately moved behind her and hugged her from behind, startling her. "Sorry, I've neglected you for quite some time, and I've heard about your relationship with Wei Jiang."

"Do you know that I am so miserable because you ignored me?" Tears began to fall from Yi Na's eyes, and her right hand holding the brush was also shaking violently. "I've been waiting for you for the past two months since our return from the eastern region, but you haven't come to see me even once.

I understand that you have no feelings for me and that you used your demon abilities to seduce me, but I am fully aware that it was entirely my own fault. At first, I didn't enjoy our relationship because I harbored guilt toward my ex-husband. However, the time we spent together in the eastern region strengthened my attachment to you, and I began to enjoy our time together more and more.

I understand that you dislike it when other men touch your woman, which is why I consistently turned down his requests for sex. Honestly, I've tried to forget you because my daughter doesn't want me to be separated from her father, and she tried to help us repair our relationship. Unfortunately, I always felt guilty toward him, so I decided to break up with him two weeks ago."

Zhang Fei [1] sighed softly, lifted Yi Na to her feet, and immediately turned her to face him, wiping away her tears. "You're right, I never had feelings for you before that day, but you should know that I also enjoyed my time with you, and my feelings for you started to grow. I know that I've neglected you in the past two months, but I've decided not to neglect you anymore.
That's why I came here to see you today, and I want you to stay by my side like the others from now on."
"Do you really have feelings for me now?"

"Release your soul first, and I will give you the answer." Yi Na was confused by Zhang Fei[1]'s request, but she did it anyway. When her soul emerged from her body, he immediately implanted his soul mark into her soul, shocking her. "Return your soul to your body again."
After she did that, Yi Na immediately touched her chest and asked Zhang Fei [1]. "What kind of mark is that? Why did you plant it in my soul?"

"I learned it from a cultivator in another realm, and I only gave my soul mark to my wives and partners." Zhang Fei [1] then pressed his palm against the back of Yi Na's palm. "Since I implanted it in your soul, you are my partner now. The mark allows me to know the condition and situation of all of you, so I can immediately move to save you if any of you are in danger."
Zhang Fei [1]'s explanation actually made Yi Na even more confused about his mark, especially since she had never learned the soul cultivation path, so she had no knowledge of it.

"I know you are confused about it, but I will start teaching you many things now, especially about the body cultivation path and the soul cultivation path, so you can catch up with them." Zhang Fei [1] then pulled Yi Na into her residence, where they sat on the floor facing each other, and he patiently explained the two cultivation paths to her.
"Release your soul again, and you just need to follow my guidance to understand it."

After they released their souls, Zhang Fei [1]'s soul immediately held her soul before starting to channel their Yin and Yang Qi into each other's souls, but Yi Na was too quick to channel her Yin Qi into her soul. Even so, it wasn't a problem for him, and he showed her the proper way to do it.

Despite her cultivation not reaching a high level, Yi Na had been cultivating for decades, and she gradually followed Zhang Fei [1]'s guidance, resulting in a more stable and faster circulation of their Yin and Yang Qi.

Zhang Fei himself decided to give his wives, partners, slaves, and family members a few days to rest. After all, they had been in seclusion for quite some time, and some of them seemed bored with it, so he decided that way.

Zhang Fei then sent all of them back to their respective places in the Sky Jade Realm, and he also brought some of them back to earth, including Zhong Yan, who wanted to check on their company progress. Moreover, they need to replenish stock of goods for their company and shop in both realms.
When they arrived at Zhang Chen's house, they saw that Zhang Fei [5] had not stopped doing dual soul cultivation with Wang Xiaoyi and the others.

Zhang Fei then sent the members of the Wang and Ming families back to their respective homes, but he took Zhong Yan to Huang Rong's mansion to see her and Yang Lu'er, especially since they were the ones looking after their company, the Sky Jade Company.

As usual, Huang Rong rushed to hug Zhang Fei as soon as they appeared, and she immediately gave him a slow but passionate kiss, especially considering they hadn't seen each other in two weeks due to his business in the Sky Jade Realm.

Yang Lu'er was annoyed by her mother's childish behavior, but she did not bother them and spoke to Zhong Yan, who explained their situation there. "Fortunately, I am not a cultivator like you all, or I would have died quickly if I had to deal with all that trouble. So how long are you two going to stay here?"

"Although all of you are not cultivators like us, he plans to take you all to the Sky Jade Realm to look around the realm, and you guys can spend more time with him there." Yang Lu'er looked delighted to hear that Zhang Fei wanted to take them to the Sky Jade Realm. "So what about our company?"
