That's why I keep delaying to open the lock on the soul, and I will only open it after his memories are restored."
"Actually, I have a bad feeling about that soul, so I think your decision to postpone it is correct.

Otherwise, something catastrophic will happen in this realm, and it might spread to the human realm or the other two realms." Feltia [2] then looked into the distance and thought for quite a while, but he didn't tell Morgana about his thoughts.
"I will return to my tower now, and I hope you will tell me if you find any clues about that soul."
"All right, I'll let you know straight away if I get any new leads." After Feltia [2] left, Morgana immediately met her husband, who was talking to Oz the second and Zygoz in another area.

Upon his arrival at the tower, Feltia [2] immediately planted his soul mark into the souls of his partners, including the Amaris Twins and Nadea, even though they were not cultivators like Fyr, Eve, Leora, and Ashreth.
Since there were no problems in the Diyu Realm and his subordinates had completely submitted to him, Feltia [2] decided to bring all his partners to the Netherworld Realm.
He brought them to Arbeola's place to increase their demon power and gave them some bloodstones, but he himself didn't relax either, and he accompanied them for that.
Cain suddenly reached out to Zhang Fei [4], informing him that the resources he sought were ready.
He immediately went to the northern mansion to meet him, but he was surprised to notice that Lu Xin and Yu Xixiuan had already become his partners.
Even so, he did not comment on it and followed him to another room, where all the demon resources were gathered.
"Are you satisfied with all this?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei [4] immediately stored everything in his inventory before handing a bag of bloodstones to Cain.
"They are enough for now, but I still need more resources for my subordinates in another realm, and you can get more bloodstones if you continue to help me gather them."
"Haha!" Cain laughed as he threw the bag in the air several times.
"Naturally, I will continue to help you, especially since these bloodstones are more useful to me than those resources.
However, I'm perplexed as to why you didn't give them the bloodstones directly, especially considering that doing so would enhance their strength faster."
Zhang Fei [4] shook his head at Cain.
"The number of my subordinates is quite large, and my supply of bloodstones is not comparable to their numbers, so I have to use other methods to strengthen them."

"All right then, I will contact you again after I prepare the second batch of resources, and you better bring me more bloodstones." After that, Zhang Fei [4] immediately left the mansion, and Cain also took the two women with him.
When Zhang Fei [4] arrived at the succubus tower, he immediately went underground to meet Balena, just as he had done in the past month.
From her, he gained more information about the Blue Water Realm, which also made their relationship closer.
"Orith and the others haven't returned yet, so I can't talk to her about you yet.
Anyway, I plan to look for them in the dead forest, so I won't be able to visit you during that time."

"That's not a problem for me, especially since I've been cooping up here alone for so long, so I'm used to quiet situations." After they talked for some time, Zhang Fei[4] immediately left the underground, but Balena sighed softly at his departure.
After he implanted his soul mark in the souls of all his partners, Zhang Fei [1] asked them to continue their training using the gravity feature.
After all, his partners were different from his wives, and they were more focused on their cultivation and rarely practiced since they entered seclusion.
He later met Yan Zhixiu inside the portable mansion.
"Do you really not want to return to the Yin-Yang Pavilion?
You are a demon cultivator, so you can use the transformation technique to return to your original form.
Moreover, you already know that Shen Xueyi is my partner, and the people there also know about my identity as a demon, so I'm sure they won't have a problem with you returning there."
"No." Yan Zhixiu rejected Zhang Fei [1]'s idea outright.
"During these two months, I have understood more about demons thanks to you, so I now know that I also need demon power to strengthen myself.
I have decided not to return to the sect, and I want to return to the Netherworld Realm to increase my demon rank so I can become stronger than before I became a demon.

I know that you will always protect Luan'er, but she is still my sister, and she is my last remaining family member, so I want to protect her." (A/N: The time skip is one month, but the flow of time in the training space is two times faster than the outside world.)
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding.

"Since you've made that decision, I'll send you back to the Netherworld Realm, but I won't send you there right now; you should continue your training with them first." Once you've fully adapted to the level three gravity feature, then I'll send you there directly."
Following this, Zhang Fei [1] escorted Yan Zhixiu out of the portable mansion, where she joined the others for training.
He himself decided to leave the training space and return to the Sky Jade Realm, especially the southern region, to take care of some matters and meet someone.
When he arrived at the Wei Clan, Zhang Fei [1] couldn't find Yi Na in the clan residence.
He was surprised when he heard some maids say that she decided to separate from Wei Jiang about half a month ago.
Zhang Fei [1] then searched for Yi Na's location on his map, and he found that she lived not far from the entrance to the Hidden Sea Palace, especially since Wei Luan was a disciple of the sect.
After a few minutes, Zhang Fei [1] arrived at Yi Na's new residence, where he found her painting his picture.
He immediately moved behind her and hugged her from behind, startling her.
"Sorry, I've neglected you for quite some time, and I've heard about your relationship with Wei Jiang."
"Do you know that I am so miserable because you ignored me?" Tears began to fall from Yi Na's eyes, and her right hand holding the brush was also shaking violently.
"I've been waiting for you for the past two months since our return from the eastern region, but you haven't come to see me even once.
I understand that you have no feelings for me and that you used your demon abilities to seduce me, but I am fully aware that it was entirely my own fault.
At first, I didn't enjoy our relationship because I harbored guilt toward my ex-husband.
However, the time we spent together in the eastern region strengthened my attachment to you, and I began to enjoy our time together more and more.
I understand that you dislike it when other men touch your woman, which is why I consistently turned down his requests for sex.
Honestly, I've tried to forget you because my daughter doesn't want me to be separated from her father, and she tried to help us repair our relationship.
Unfortunately, I always felt guilty toward him, so I decided to break up with him two weeks ago."
Zhang Fei [1] sighed softly, lifted Yi Na to her feet, and immediately turned her to face him, wiping away her tears.
"You're right, I never had feelings for you before that day, but you should know that I also enjoyed my time with you, and my feelings for you started to grow.
I know that I've neglected you in the past two months, but I've decided not to neglect you anymore.
That's why I came here to see you today, and I want you to stay by my side like the others from now on."
"Do you really have feelings for me now?"
"Release your soul first, and I will give you the answer." Yi Na was confused by Zhang Fei[1]'s request, but she did it anyway.
When her soul emerged from her body, he immediately implanted his soul mark into her soul, shocking her.
"Return your soul to your body again."
After she did that, Yi Na immediately touched her chest and asked Zhang Fei [1].
"What kind of mark is that?
Why did you plant it in my soul?"
"I learned it from a cultivator in another realm, and I only gave my soul mark to my wives and partners." Zhang Fei [1] then pressed his palm against the back of Yi Na's palm.
"Since I implanted it in your soul, you are my partner now.
The mark allows me to know the condition and situation of all of you, so I can immediately move to save you if any of you are in danger."
Zhang Fei [1]'s explanation actually made Yi Na even more confused about his mark, especially since she had never learned the soul cultivation path, so she had no knowledge of it.

"I know you are confused about it, but I will start teaching you many things now, especially about the body cultivation path and the soul cultivation path, so you can catch up with them." Zhang Fei [1] then pulled Yi Na into her residence, where they sat on the floor facing each other, and he patiently explained the two cultivation paths to her.
"Release your soul again, and you just need to follow my guidance to understand it."

After they released their souls, Zhang Fei [1]'s soul immediately held her soul before starting to channel their Yin and Yang Qi into each other's souls, but Yi Na was too quick to channel her Yin Qi into her soul.
Even so, it wasn't a problem for him, and he showed her the proper way to do it.

Despite her cultivation not reaching a high level, Yi Na had been cultivating for decades, and she gradually followed Zhang Fei [1]'s guidance, resulting in a more stable and faster circulation of their Yin and Yang Qi.
Zhang Fei himself decided to give his wives, partners, slaves, and family members a few days to rest.
After all, they had been in seclusion for quite some time, and some of them seemed bored with it, so he decided that way.

Zhang Fei then sent all of them back to their respective places in the Sky Jade Realm, and he also brought some of them back to earth, including Zhong Yan, who wanted to check on their company progress.
Moreover, they need to replenish stock of goods for their company and shop in both realms.
When they arrived at Zhang Chen's house, they saw that Zhang Fei [5] had not stopped doing dual soul cultivation with Wang Xiaoyi and the others.

Zhang Fei then sent the members of the Wang and Ming families back to their respective homes, but he took Zhong Yan to Huang Rong's mansion to see her and Yang Lu'er, especially since they were the ones looking after their company, the Sky Jade Company.

As usual, Huang Rong rushed to hug Zhang Fei as soon as they appeared, and she immediately gave him a slow but passionate kiss, especially considering they hadn't seen each other in two weeks due to his business in the Sky Jade Realm.
Yang Lu'er was annoyed by her mother's childish behavior, but she did not bother them and spoke to Zhong Yan, who explained their situation there.
"Fortunately, I am not a cultivator like you all, or I would have died quickly if I had to deal with all that trouble.
So how long are you two going to stay here?"

"Although all of you are not cultivators like us, he plans to take you all to the Sky Jade Realm to look around the realm, and you guys can spend more time with him there." Yang Lu'er looked delighted to hear that Zhang Fei wanted to take them to the Sky Jade Realm.
"So what about our company?"

chapters.title: Chapter 488 Wei Luan Knows
paragraphs: "Oh?" Zhang Fei and Zhong Yan were quite surprised after Yang Lu'er told them of their plans for the Sky Jade Company.

Huang Rong immediately spoke to them. "Since we extensively advertised our products, our sales in the country have steadily increased, and domestic buyers have flooded our branch stores. Moreover, our items have attracted the interest of overseas buyers, especially after Tang Ziyu's friends in the entertainment industry used some of them.
That's why we are considering opening some branches in other countries, but we won't open too many at once, and we will start with Europe."
"Which country?"
"France!"

Zhang Fei promptly agreed to their proposal. "All right, you can start from that country, and we will focus on one store there. However, you must purchase a space large enough to accommodate buyers from the surrounding countries, and we will open another branch in another country after the new store is successful."
"Who will take care of our shop there?" Zhong Yan asked the two women.

"Haha." Yang Lu'er laughed softly and pointed at Zhang Fei. "Did you forget that he still has a few other women? Zou Ling is a fashion designer, and her name is getting more and more famous, so she often goes back and forth to Europe now. Since Qiu Mei has extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry, which is the focus of most of our products, I plan to dispatch her to handle this task.
In addition to the two of them, I have also discussed this matter with Ren Xia, who has agreed to accompany them there."

Zhong Yan immediately turned to Zhang Fei. "How about you ask Sister Lingxue to concoct some items for us to sell here? After all, you have a large supply of herbs in the valley, and she might be able to concoct some items related to beauty and the like. If necessary, you can sell the beauty retaining pill and the youthful returning pill; I'm sure both will sell at exorbitant prices."

"No." Zhang Fei immediately rejected Zhong Yan's idea. The price of both pills is much higher than you think, and no one on earth could afford them. Second, there were many people who had much higher authority than Huang Rong and Wang Zetian, and the two pills would only bring trouble to them. I'm not afraid of them, but I don't want to look for trouble with them, so we won't sell them here."
"Yeah, you're right about that."

Zhang Fei then spoke to them again. "Actually, I have discussed this matter with Lingxue before, and she has many alchemy recipes that are very easy to concoct, but the effects are very good for ordinary humans like them, such as pills to rejuvenate the body, pills to increase stamina, and many other pills.

Moreover, all the herbs were available in the valley, so she could concoct them whenever she wanted, and she should be able to match them in large quantities. However, we won't sell them all at once; instead, we will sell them in limited quantities, allowing us to charge high prices."
"Do you think people here can imitate those products?"

"Those herbs don't exist on earth, so they won't be able to imitate our products. Even if they want to imitate them using existing ingredients, the effect will never be the same, so you don't need to worry about that." Zhang Fei then lifted the three women to their feet.

"As Yan'er told you before, I will take you all to the Sky Jade Realm to have a look, especially since the situation in that realm is safe now. That way we can spend more time together there, and you guys will definitely be satisfied with that."

After hearing that, Huang Rong immediately contacted her people and told them that she was going on vacation, so she asked them to take care of the company and the shop. Yang Lu'er also contacted Zhang Fei's other women, Hong Yao, Zou Ling, Qiu Mei, Ren Xia, and Fang Chen, to prepare.
After that, Zhang Fei brought the three women to pick them up, and he then took all of them to the Sky Jade Realm afterwards.

When the seven women arrived at Zhang Fei's residence in the Heavenly Sword City, they were completely shocked. The situation in the Sky Jade Realm resembled their country in ancient times, and the buildings there were too traditional compared to the current Earth, not to mention the significant time difference.

The presence of the beasts was quite frightening for them, especially the two python-tailed tigresses. Lan Zhen, the frost lynx, also posed a significant threat to them, but unlike the two tigresses, she remained indifferent to everyone, with the exception of Shen Yu and Zhang Fei.

The women were really surprised when Zhang Fei introduced them to his main harem, especially since their numbers were quite large, and they were also stronger than them because they were cultivators. They were relieved after seeing several familiar women, such as Zhang Chen, Ru Xue, and several others.
Moreover, Liu Hua and the others also welcomed them warmly, even though they were just ordinary humans and not the main members of his harem.

Since it was still not late in the Sky Jade Realm, Zhong Yan and the others brought the seven women from earth to stroll around the Heavenly Sword City, but they first asked them to change out of their clothes from the realm, so their appearance would not be too conspicuous in the eyes of others.

Zhang Fei did not accompany them, but he took Zefyr and the two Dryads to the western forest, especially since Lillea and Janette wanted to check on the members of their race who lived in the fairy forest.

Zhang Fei himself had long decided to include Janette's name in his harem, especially since he was his first man, and he had also always been loyal stay by his side. Even though Lillea wasn't really a member of his harem, he already considered the Dryad queen as one, especially since they had been intimate too many times.

The three women suddenly landed in front of Yi Na's new residence, but they looked confused after seeing the bright lights inside, so they rushed inside. One of the women gasped in shock upon witnessing Zhang Fei [1] engaging in dual soul cultivation with her. The two women behind her briefly exchanged glances before quietly sighing, as they had long suspected a relationship between them.

"Stop it, Luan'er." Wei Luan immediately turned to the two women, who were none other than the Hai Twins. "They are cultivating their souls, so we should wait for them to finish before talking to them."

Wei Luan nodded and turned back to face the front, looking curiously at the souls of Zhang Fei [1] and Yi Na. Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin, who had never heard of such a cultivation method, were also curious about it.

After they waited for some time, the Yin-Yang diagram had disappeared, and their souls had entered their bodies again. However, Yi Na's expression turned shocked and scared at the same time, and her heartbeat became irregular, especially after she saw Wei Luan.
Even cold sweat began to trickle down her forehead, and she clenched both her fists tightly, anticipating her daughter's reaction upon learning about her relationship with Zhang Fei [1].

Zhang Fei [1] immediately grabbed Yi Na's hand, brought her to her feet, and faced Wei Luan before speaking to her. "You must be wondering about our relationship, right? To tell you the truth, your mother is one of my partners now, and I want her to stay by my side."
Zhang Fei[1]'s confession broke Wei Luan's heart, prompting her to ask a cold question. "Since when were you two in a relationship?"

"After we met at the restaurant that day." Wei Luan was completely shocked and looked at her mother with a look of disappointment, especially since Yi Na had cheated on her father before their separation. Zhang Fei [1] immediately spoke again to defend his partner. "You don't need to blame your mother, and you can blame me instead.
You can hate me if you want, but you shouldn't hate her, especially since our relationship was my fault."
"What do you mean by that?"

Zhang Fei [1] instantly transformed into his lust demon form, but Wei Luan and the Hai Twins were no longer surprised to see that. "You already know that I am a demon, and my demon form is a lust demon, so all my abilities are related to lust. You surely still remember how your mother insulted me in the restaurant that day, right?"
Wei Luan did not say anything and nod to Zhang Fei [1], especially since the events of that day were still vivid in her memories, and Yi Na even forbade him from having any relationship with her.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately continued. "Back then, I didn't know you or your mother, yet she insulted and belittled me even after I helped you to cancel your engagement with Ying Xiao, so I used my demon abilities on her. No one, be it men or women, could withstand my abilities. We've been together ever since, and she also followed me to the eastern region for a period of time.

However, I neglected her in the last two months, especially since she always thought about you and your father. Now that they've split up, I've decided to no longer ignore her, and she's now my partner. I sincerely hope you don't harbor resentment toward her after learning the truth."

Wei Luan remained silent in response to Zhang Fei [1] and turned her gaze to Yi Na, who lowered her face in fear and shame. She then stood up from her seat, walked in front of him, and extended her hand to him. "Try using your abilities on me. I want to prove it myself before making a decision."

Yi Na immediately grabbed Zhang Fei [1]'s hand and shook her head, especially since she didn't want her daughter to experience the same thing as her. However, he ignored her and directly grabbed Wei Luan's hand. He used his demon touch on her for a brief moment, which was more than enough to make her moan.

"Ahh!" Wei Luan immediately fell to the floor and gasped heavily after experiencing the sensation, and she could feel her body heating up due to the strange sensation from within; even her lower body felt quite wet because of it, which made her feel a little uncomfortable.

"That's just one of my demon abilities, and you must have realized its effects, right?" Wei Luan nodded slightly to Zhang Fei [1]. "I also used my other abilities on your mother, but the effect was much stronger than that, so I won't use it on you. Otherwise, your lust will spiral out of control, and you will never be able to calm it down without dual cultivating with me."

Red hues suddenly appeared on Wei Luan's cheeks as the thoughts of her dual cultivation with Zhang Fei [1] crossed her mind, but she immediately shook her head to get rid of the feeling. She then tried to stand up, but her legs were still shaking from the previous sensation, so he immediately helped her up.
After experiencing the effects of Zhang Fei's abilities herself, Wei Luan became convinced that her mother had no intention of cheating on her father, and she blamed him for their relationship.

"Do you really want to be with him, Mother?" Yi Na acknowledged that with a slight nod, causing Wei Luan to release a soft sigh. "Honestly, I'm still disappointed with your relationship with him, but I won't blame you for it, especially since his abilities are too terrifying.
Moreover, now that you've separated from my father and become a free woman, I won't stop you from being with him if you truly desire it."
Yi Na immediately looked up at Wei Luan. "Did... did you really not mind if I was with him?"

"No." Wei Luan then said to Zhang Fei [1], who had returned to his human form. "Thanks to you, I was able to escape from a situation that would have definitely caused me suffering, but I also hated you because you snatched my mother from my father. I won't say anything else because my mother has already made the decision to be with you, but I hope you will always take care of her."

"I will definitely always take care of Yi Na." Wei Luan nodded and wanted to move away from him, but Zhang Fei [1] held her back, causing her to frown. "Even if you hate me because of my relationship with your mother, you are still her daughter, so you are also part of my family.

I am someone who always cares for all my family members, so I will also always take care of you, and I want to help you become stronger. Moreover, Xing'er also misses you, and she will definitely be happy if you are by her side, so I will bring you there to meet her."

"Just accept the facts, Luan'er." Hai Dongxin said this as she stood up from her seat, followed by her twin sister, Hai Dongyin. "I know you are disappointed with Zhang Fei [1] because he used such a method against your mother, but he has also helped you get out of your bad relationship with Ying Xiao, and you would definitely suffer if he didn't help you.
That's why I think you can consider everything even, and you two can start a new relationship as a family."

Hai Dongyin rubbed Wei Luan's head. "Moreover, you don't want to be left behind by Xing'er, right? She's been training with Zhang Fei [1] for quite some time now, and she's supposed to be a few steps ahead of you, so your best bet is to train with him to catch up to her."

Wei Luan fell silent after listening to the words of the two female elders, but she seemed hesitant to make a decision. She hated Zhang Fei [1] because of what he did to her mother, but she also didn't want to be left behind by Chu Xing, and she wanted to stay with him to become strong together.

Seeing Wei Luan continue to hesitate, the Hai Twins immediately spoke to her again. "You don't need to hesitate anymore, and we will inform Big Sis Yuzhen about this matter. Once you have become stronger, then you can return to our sect again together with Xing'er and Lin'er, and we will assess the progress of the three of you at that time."
In the end, Wei Luan decides to listen to the Hai Twins. "All right, I will go with them, elders."

After that, Wei Luan immediately assisted her mother in packing up her belongings, particularly since Zhang Fei [1] had made it clear that he would not be returning Yi Na to her residence, but would instead be taking her to his private place.

Wei Luan's decision brought relief to Zhang Fei [1], who proceeded to question the two women. "Do you want to learn about the soul cultivation path? I don't have a special technique to cultivate our souls yet, but you two can cultivate your souls manually, like normal cultivation."
Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin exchanged glances for a moment before agreeing to it. "Is it okay if we teach our sect members to cultivate their souls?"

"No problem, you two can teach all those who have reached the soul realm, and they will be stronger than other cultivators." After that, Zhang Fei [1] sat down again on the floor with the Hai Twins sitting in front of him with their souls outside their bodies, and he guided them to learn the soul cultivation path directly.

Hai Dongxin and Hai Dongyin experienced a strange sensation as Zhang Fei [1]'s Yang Qi began to flow into their souls, particularly since they had never been in a relationship with any man. Despite their discomfort, they made a concerted effort to suppress their feelings and allow him to guide them.

"You must be wondering about our relationship, right?
To tell you the truth, your mother is one of my partners now, and I want her to stay by my side."
Zhang Fei[1]'s confession broke Wei Luan's heart, prompting her to ask a cold question.
"Since when were you two in a relationship?"

"After we met at the restaurant that day." Wei Luan was completely shocked and looked at her mother with a look of disappointment, especially since Yi Na had cheated on her father before their separation.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately spoke again to defend his partner.
"You don't need to blame your mother, and you can blame me instead.
You can hate me if you want, but you shouldn't hate her, especially since our relationship was my fault."
"What do you mean by that?"
Zhang Fei [1] instantly transformed into his lust demon form, but Wei Luan and the Hai Twins were no longer surprised to see that.
"You already know that I am a demon, and my demon form is a lust demon, so all my abilities are related to lust.
You surely still remember how your mother insulted me in the restaurant that day, right?"
Wei Luan did not say anything and nod to Zhang Fei [1], especially since the events of that day were still vivid in her memories, and Yi Na even forbade him from having any relationship with her.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately continued.
"Back then, I didn't know you or your mother, yet she insulted and belittled me even after I helped you to cancel your engagement with Ying Xiao, so I used my demon abilities on her.
No one, be it men or women, could withstand my abilities.
We've been together ever since, and she also followed me to the eastern region for a period of time.
However, I neglected her in the last two months, especially since she always thought about you and your father.
Now that they've split up, I've decided to no longer ignore her, and she's now my partner.
I sincerely hope you don't harbor resentment toward her after learning the truth."
Wei Luan remained silent in response to Zhang Fei [1] and turned her gaze to Yi Na, who lowered her face in fear and shame.
She then stood up from her seat, walked in front of him, and extended her hand to him.
"Try using your abilities on me.
I want to prove it myself before making a decision."
Yi Na immediately grabbed Zhang Fei [1]'s hand and shook her head, especially since she didn't want her daughter to experience the same thing as her.
However, he ignored her and directly grabbed Wei Luan's hand.
He used his demon touch on her for a brief moment, which was more than enough to make her moan.

"Ahh!" Wei Luan immediately fell to the floor and gasped heavily after experiencing the sensation, and she could feel her body heating up due to the strange sensation from within; even her lower body felt quite wet because of it, which made her feel a little uncomfortable.
"That's just one of my demon abilities, and you must have realized its effects, right?" Wei Luan nodded slightly to Zhang Fei [1].
"I also used my other abilities on your mother, but the effect was much stronger than that, so I won't use it on you.
Otherwise, your lust will spiral out of control, and you will never be able to calm it down without dual cultivating with me."
Red hues suddenly appeared on Wei Luan's cheeks as the thoughts of her dual cultivation with Zhang Fei [1] crossed her mind, but she immediately shook her head to get rid of the feeling.
She then tried to stand up, but her legs were still shaking from the previous sensation, so he immediately helped her up.
After experiencing the effects of Zhang Fei's abilities herself, Wei Luan became convinced that her mother had no intention of cheating on her father, and she blamed him for their relationship.
"Do you really want to be with him, Mother?" Yi Na acknowledged that with a slight nod, causing Wei Luan to release a soft sigh.
"Honestly, I'm still disappointed with your relationship with him, but I won't blame you for it, especially since his abilities are too terrifying.
Moreover, now that you've separated from my father and become a free woman, I won't stop you from being with him if you truly desire it."
Yi Na immediately looked up at Wei Luan.
"Did... did you really not mind if I was with him?"
"No." Wei Luan then said to Zhang Fei [1], who had returned to his human form.
"Thanks to you, I was able to escape from a situation that would have definitely caused me suffering, but I also hated you because you snatched my mother from my father.
I won't say anything else because my mother has already made the decision to be with you, but I hope you will always take care of her."
"I will definitely always take care of Yi Na." Wei Luan nodded and wanted to move away from him, but Zhang Fei [1] held her back, causing her to frown.
"Even if you hate me because of my relationship with your mother, you are still her daughter, so you are also part of my family.
I am someone who always cares for all my family members, so I will also always take care of you, and I want to help you become stronger.
Moreover, Xing'er also misses you, and she will definitely be happy if you are by her side, so I will bring you there to meet her."
"Just accept the facts, Luan'er." Hai Dongxin said this as she stood up from her seat, followed by her twin sister, Hai Dongyin.

"I know you are disappointed with Zhang Fei [1] because he used such a method against your mother, but he has also helped you get out of your bad relationship with Ying Xiao, and you would definitely suffer if he didn't help you.
That's why I think you can consider everything even, and you two can start a new relationship as a family."
Hai Dongyin rubbed Wei Luan's head.
"Moreover, you don't want to be left behind by Xing'er, right?
She's been training with Zhang Fei [1] for quite some time now, and she's supposed to be a few steps ahead of you, so your best bet is to train with him to catch up to her."
Wei Luan fell silent after listening to the words of the two female elders, but she seemed hesitant to make a decision.
She hated Zhang Fei [1] because of what he did to her mother, but she also didn't want to be left behind by Chu Xing, and she wanted to stay with him to become strong together.
Seeing Wei Luan continue to hesitate, the Hai Twins immediately spoke to her again.
"You don't need to hesitate anymore, and we will inform Big Sis Yuzhen about this matter.
Once you have become stronger, then you can return to our sect again together with Xing'er and Lin'er, and we will assess the progress of the three of you at that time."
In the end, Wei Luan decides to listen to the Hai Twins.
"All right, I will go with them, elders."

After that, Wei Luan immediately assisted her mother in packing up her belongings, particularly since Zhang Fei [1] had made it clear that he would not be returning Yi Na to her residence, but would instead be taking her to his private place.
Wei Luan's decision brought relief to Zhang Fei [1], who proceeded to question the two women.
"Do you want to learn about the soul cultivation path?
I don't have a special technique to cultivate our souls yet, but you two can cultivate your souls manually, like normal cultivation."
Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin exchanged glances for a moment before agreeing to it.
"Is it okay if we teach our sect members to cultivate their souls?"

"No problem, you two can teach all those who have reached the soul realm, and they will be stronger than other cultivators." After that, Zhang Fei [1] sat down again on the floor with the Hai Twins sitting in front of him with their souls outside their bodies, and he guided them to learn the soul cultivation path directly.
Hai Dongxin and Hai Dongyin experienced a strange sensation as Zhang Fei [1]'s Yang Qi began to flow into their souls, particularly since they had never been in a relationship with any man.
Despite their discomfort, they made a concerted effort to suppress their feelings and allow him to guide them.

chapters.title: Chapter 489 Return To The Sect
paragraphs: After he finished teaching Hai Dongyin and Hai Dongxin to become soul cultivators, Zhang Fei [1] then passed on the Soul Harmonization Method to them, but he forbade them from giving it to anyone else. He then sent Yi Na and Wei Luan into his training space, and he asked Chu Xing, who was unwilling to rest, to teach them.
Despite their disappointment that Zhang Fei [1] forbade them from sharing the method with anyone, the Hai Twins were grateful that he had given them that method.

They hurriedly returned to their sect to tell Hai Yuzhen and the other leaders about how to cultivate their soul, especially since the soul cultivation path would make them much better, even if they did not have a special method to increase their soul power.

Before long, Zhang Fei [1] had arrived above the southern ocean while his gaze was fixed on the sea surface, but Mei suddenly asked him. [Are you going to teach them all to become soul cultivators, Master?]

Zhang Fei [1] nodded slightly in response. "Even though I have taught the Hai Twins how to thread their path on the soul cultivation path, not everyone has the talent for that path. Even if they taught Hai Yuzhen and the others, they wouldn't necessarily become soul cultivators, but some might if they had the talent.
Even so, they would still find it difficult to increase their soul power, especially since it was difficult to do without a proper method."
[Master, I'm curious about your decision, especially since you decided so suddenly.]

"Haha!" Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he enveloped his body with qi and entered the ocean. 'Mei, you should already be familiar with my character, right? The Sky Jade Realm used to be the Heavenly Wilderness Realm, and this realm was the starting point on my path of cultivation.

Although I don't have a deep attachment to this realm, many of my women are attached to this realm, so I want to help the people of this realm a little. However, I will not help them completely, and they will have to make their own efforts to achieve it.'

A while later, Zhang Fei [1] had already reached the seclusion cave of the Shen Ancestor. He hurried off to meet Shen Huang and Shen Xinyia, surprising the two women who were in the midst of cultivation.

Zhang Fei [1] sat directly in front of Shen Huang and passed the Soul Harmonization Method to her, but he did not pass the method to Shen Xinya, primarily because he could see from her eyes that her character had not changed.

Although Zhang Fei [1] had already passed his dual cultivation technique to Shen Xinya, he did so because he needed more help to deal with those heretics before, but he didn't want to help her more than that.

Shen Huang was naturally aware of Zhang Fei's intention, especially since Shen Xueyi had already informed her about his plans for Shen Xinya. Therefore, she remained silent and began studying that method.

Shen Xinya harbored deep anger in her heart due to Zhang Fei [1]'s treatment of her, which differed significantly from his treatment of her mother, daughter, and granddaughter. However, she chose not to comment and kept her anger in her heart, especially since it would make him dislike her even more, and she continued her cultivation.

After Shen Huang finished studying the method, Zhang Fei [1] gave her a bottle of his yang qi, and he immediately asked her to release her soul after she drank it. Once their souls were released from their bodies, he held both of her hands, and his soul also held hers. "Follow my lead."
"Yeah."

Shen Huang immediately closed her eyes and started channeling her Yin Qi into Zhang Fei [1]'s soul, and he also did the same. He channeled his Yang Qi very slowly, especially since she was still not a soul cultivator like him.
With more than a thousand years of experience and quite good talent, coupled with Zhang Fei [1]'s patience, it was not too difficult for Shen Huang to follow his guidance.

An hour later, Shen Huang successfully embarked on the soul cultivation path, prompting Zhang Fei [1] to channel more of his Yang Qi into her soul, resulting in an increasingly rapid circulation of their Yang and Yin Qi.

Sensing the change around the cave area, Shen Xinya opened her eyes and looked up at the Yin-Yang diagram above them, burning her jealousy and envy. 'Tch! This brat! What does he really want from me? I'm still his family, and I have also agreed to give him my body, but he keeps pushing me aside!
If he continues to treat me like this, it will be inevitable for me to fall further behind my mother, Xueyi, and Yu'er!'

Inside the training space, Chu Xing had finished teaching Yi Na and Wei Luan how to train inside, but her best friend didn't want to train right away and pulled her to sit with her on the side, especially since she was still disappointed with the relationship between her mother and Zhang Fei [1].

"Actually, I've heard of Aunt Yi's relationship with my brother-in-law." Wei Luan immediately frowned at Chu Xing. "I know you're disappointed about it, but their relationship is already established, so you have to learn to accept it.

Although their relationship started with hostility because she kept insulting him, I can see that he is starting to care about your mother, or else he wouldn't have brought you two here. You don't know him, but I've gotten to know him better after we spent a lot of time together. He always cares about all his women, so you can rest assured that she will be happy with him."

Wei Luan exhaled deeply, nodded to Chu Xing, and then clasped their hands together. "I have heard about your father from Sect Master Yuzhen, and I have been looking for you for the past month, but no one knows about your whereabouts, so I cannot accompany you to comfort you."

"Haha." Chu Xing giggled and hugged Wei Luan. "You are indeed my best friend, Luan. I know you must want to comfort me because of my father's death, but I am lost in my grief and sadness, so I kept practicing non-stop for the past month to forget about it. You don't need to worry about me now, as I have accepted my father's death, but I will never forget it.
I will continue to forge myself to be even stronger, so I can take revenge on the people who caused his death."
"Who exactly are those people?"

Chu Xing then released her embrace from Wei Luan. "The people behind those demons and heretics are cultivators from the Red Sun Realm, one of the planets in the upper realms. My brother-in-law told us that their cultivation is in the seven divine realms, so they are really powerful, and no one in this realm can match them."
"The seven divine realms?"

"Yes." Chu Xing then told Wei Luan about the seven stages of cultivation above the ten mortal realms, which shocked her. "I know it's not easy to reach those stages, but I will never give up on my goal of taking revenge on those people, and the facilities in this place can help me achieve it.
After I succeed in killing them, I will use their blood as an offering to my late father, so he can rest in peace in the afterlife."

Once again, Wei Luan held Chu Xing's hand as she put on a serious expression. "Currently, I have fallen far behind you, but I will try my best to catch up with you, and we will become strong together. Once we become strong, we will go to that realm together, and I will help you take revenge on the people who killed your father."
"Yeah." Chu Xing then lifted Wei Luan to her feet. "For now, we don't need to think about that, and I will help you with your training, so you won't fall behind me anymore."
"All right."

A few hours later, they had already stopped dual soul cultivation, and Sheng Huang was completely satisfied with the results. However, Zhang Fei [1] suddenly lifted her to her feet. "You too, Shen Xinya."
"Hmm?" Shen Xinya looked at Zhang Fei [1] in confusion.

Zhang Fei [1] immediately asked Mei to open the portal to his training ground. "The cultivation of both of you has indeed reached the sovereign realm, but your fighting abilities are far below Xueyi or my other women now.

That's why you can stop cultivating for the time being, and I want you to focus on training inside with the others, especially since I will be bringing you all to the middle realms not far in the future."

Without saying anything, Shen Xinya immediately entered the portal, causing Shen Huang to shake her head at her rude behavior. She wanted to enter the portal, but Zhang Fei [1] suddenly pulled her into his arms. "Have you thought it over? Are you willing to be my partner?"
"Sorry, I haven't given it much thought yet, and I still don't want to be your partner."

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] immediately released Shen Huang, allowing her to enter the portal, and then hurried back to the surface. Since the location of the deserted valley was not too far away and he had not visited Polypus for a long time, he rushed towards the valley.

"Big brother!" Polypus immediately exclaimed and ran towards Zhang Fei [1] as soon as he landed there. "I thought you had forgotten about me and this place, Big Brother. However, Big Sis Lanxin and Elder Qianyu told me that you were in seclusion with the others, so I kept waiting for you here."

"Haha." Zhang Fei [1] laughed as he ruffled Polypus' hair. "How could I forget about you and this place? I had a lot of trouble before, and I needed strength to be able to solve them, so I focused on my cultivation first.
Anyway, you don't need to guard this place for a while because I will send you to my training ground, so you can improve your strength there, and you can protect this place better in the future."
"But-"

"You don't need to worry about the women from that sect; I'm sure they won't come here anytime soon, especially since I've given them something new, and they'll focus on that now." Polypus didn't argue with Zhang Fei [1] and nodded at him, so he immediately sent him to his training space. "Hmm? What should I do now?"

Zhang Fei [1] then opened his map and checked the Yin-Yang Pavilion; he found that his cousin and the others had already returned to their sect. Furthermore, he was eager to begin his new business as soon as possible, so he hurried there.

Zhang Fei [1] did not immediately teleport into the sect as usual, and instead, he chose to leisurely walk through the sect gate. As he walked through the outer disciple area, he observed the outer disciples cultivating and enjoying themselves with their partners, and he smiled faintly, imagining their reactions once he began to sell those sex items.

Zhang Fei [1] proceeded to the inner disciples area, but the three steles, containing the names of ten disciples from each class, diverted his attention. He immediately checked it, but he no longer paid attention to the outer disciples' stele.
[Inner Disciple - Top 10]
1. Lin Dong'er - Female - 25 Years Old - 8 Star Core Realm - 750,000 points.
2. Mu Lingshu - Female - 22 Years Old - 8 Star Core Realm - 650,000 points.
3. Xia Bing - Male - 25 Years Old - 8 Star Core Realm - 550,000 points.
4. Nanxuan Luoyue - Female - 28 Years Old - 7 Star Core Realm - 500,000 points.
5. Ying Sha - Female - 25 Years Old - 5 Star Core Realm - 430,000 points.
6. Yuan Zheng - Male - 26 Years Old - 8 Star Core Realm - 430,000 points.
7. Wang Jie - Male - 24 Years Old - 8 Star Core Realm - 400,000 points.
5. Sun Bing - Male - 26 Years Old - 5 Star Core Realm - 350,000 points.
6. Zhu Cun - Male - 24 Years Old - 6 Star Core Realm - 320,000 points.
7. Qing Ya - Female - 22 Years Old - 4 Star Core Realm - 300,000 points.
8. Xia Leng - Male - 20 Years Old - 2 Star Core Realm - 300,000 points.
9. Ning Qingxue - Female- 19 Years Old - 1 Star Core Realm - 240,000 points.
10. Yue Qingya - Female - 18 Years Old - 2 Star Core Realm - 220,000 points.

"Oh? Yue Qingya has already broken through to the soul realm and became an inner disciple, huh? I recall that when I last saw her, her cultivation was at the 9-Star Foundation Realm.' Zhang Fei [1] then turned his gaze to the stele, which contained the names of the ten core disciples, especially since he only ever met Fu Lingshan after she became a core disciple.
"Let's take a look at the core disciples."
[Core Disciple - Top 10]
1. Ouyang Feng - Male - 35 Years Old - 9 Star Soul Realm - 1,950,000 points.
2. Ouyang Hong - Male - 35 Years Old - 9 Star Soul Realm - 1,900,000 points.
3. Jiang Guo - Male - 32 Years Old - 9 Star Soul Realm - 1,750,000 points.
4. Bai Chongtian - Male - 31 Years Old - 8 Star Soul Realm - 1,750,000 points.
5. Fu Lingshan - Female - 30 Years Old - 7 Star Soul Realm - 1,550,000 points.
6. Hong Xuan - Female - 29 Years Old - 9 Star Soul Realm - 1,500,000 points.
7. Yuan Fang - Male - 33 Years Old - 8 Star Soul Realm - 1.400,000 points.
5. Su Ying - Female - 27 Years Old - 8 Star Soul Realm - 1,350,000 points.
6. Su Ling - Male - 30 Years Old - 8 Star Soul Realm - 1,320,000 points.
7. Zheng Mo - Male - 32 Years Old - 8 Star Soul Realm - 1,300,000 points.
8. He Feng - Male - 35 Years Old - 8 Star Soul Realm - 1,300,000 points.
9. Yi Peng - Male - 34 Years Old - 7 Star Soul Realm - 1,250,000 points.
10. Li Mengmeng - Female - 30 Years Old - 10 Star Soul Realm - 1,200,000 points.

Zhang Fei [1] rubbed his chin as he looked at the ten names, but he was not interested in the male disciples. He wasn't interested in Fu Lingshan either, because she was Lian Chengyu's partner. He was actually interested in Hong Xuan, especially since she was Ying Sha's partner and both of them were lilies.

"Su Ying? She's only 27 years old, but her cultivation has already reached the 8 Star Soul Realm, which means her talent is really good." Zhang Fei [1] raised his eyebrows slightly when he read the last name. "Li Mengmeng? She's clearly the strongest among them, and she is not inferior to Lian'er, yet her name is at the bottom of the list."

Zhang Fei [1] then opened his map to look for Li Mengmeng, and he found her in the core disciple area, but her room was at the far end of the other disciples' rooms, including his. However, he did not go there immediately, but instead, he first went to the inner disciple area to meet his cousin and the others, who were gathered there.

"You don't need to worry about the women from that sect; I'm sure they won't come here anytime soon, especially since I've given them something new, and they'll focus on that now." Polypus didn't argue with Zhang Fei [1] and nodded at him, so he immediately sent him to his training space.
"Hmm?
What should I do now?"
Zhang Fei [1] then opened his map and checked the Yin-Yang Pavilion; he found that his cousin and the others had already returned to their sect.
Furthermore, he was eager to begin his new business as soon as possible, so he hurried there.
Zhang Fei [1] did not immediately teleport into the sect as usual, and instead, he chose to leisurely walk through the sect gate.

As he walked through the outer disciple area, he observed the outer disciples cultivating and enjoying themselves with their partners, and he smiled faintly, imagining their reactions once he began to sell those sex items.
Zhang Fei [1] proceeded to the inner disciples area, but the three steles, containing the names of ten disciples from each class, diverted his attention.

chapters.title: Chapter 490 Meet Lin Hao
paragraphs: "Eh? Why did you suddenly come back here, Cousin?" Not only was Quan Xun surprised by Zhang Fei[1]'s return, but Xia Bing and the others were also surprised by it.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately sat in front of them as he looked at them one by one. "You all have developed quite well in the past month and a half, especially you, Xun'er."

"Haha." Quan Xun laughed awkwardly at that. "This is all because of Senior Sister Lingshan; she kept pushing me forward in our training last time. In fact, we just came back three days ago, and we were thinking of resting for a few days before going out to take on new missions."

"That's good, but for now, you guys don't need to take on new missions. Instead, I want you all to train at my private training ground alongside the others." Mu Lingshu and the others turned to Zhang Fei [1], who promptly provided them with an explanation. "Actually, I have no interest in bringing outsiders there, but I already consider all of you as my friends, and you guys have helped my cousin.

Moreover, I have prepared some other plans related to the middle realms, so I want you guys to train there, and you all better make good use of it. Otherwise, you won't be able to handle the challenging conditions in the middle realms, especially given the presence of numerous powerful cultivators who are significantly stronger than those in this realm."
"Are you really going to take us to the middle realms?" Fu Lingshan asked in surprise.

"Yes." Zhang Fei [1] nodded at her. "I need people I can trust for my plans, and I trust all of you, so I will bring you guys to the middle realms. However, I will not discuss all of my plans for now, especially since I still have to prepare and finalize everything first. For now, your main task is to practice daily, and once everything is ready, I will immediately take you all there."
"Can you tell us which realm you want to go to?"

Zhang Fei [1] shook his head at Mu Lingshu in response. "I haven't decided which realm will be my next destination, especially since I don't have any definite information about those realms, but I already have a few choices for it. In one of those realms, the situation is extremely harsh and tense, with constant life-and-death battles taking place.
I have heard from someone that we can see corpses every time we take a step forward."
*Gasp*

All of them gasped in shock because of that, especially since the situation in the Sky Jade Realm was relatively safe, even though they had experienced so many great dangers in the past. Moreover, the heretics had disappeared, and the demon portal had also been destroyed, so their realm was much safer.

"Are you afraid of that?" They did not hide their fear from Zhang Fei [1], especially since the situation he described was far more terrifying than what they had faced so far. "Honestly, I myself am afraid of the situation in that realm, but we are cultivators, and we cannot continue to be afraid of facing such a situation.

This realm may be safe now, but it does not rule out the possibility that other great dangers will arise in the future. In fact, cultivators from the upper realms are still targeting this realm because of something, and they will sooner or later attack here again, either directly or indirectly, just like when they take advantage of those demons and heretics in the past.
If we want to protect our loved ones, we must move forward and face whatever danger comes our way; only then will we have the strength."

"Back then, the existence of those heretics always caused us to live in constant anxiety, particularly because we didn't know when they would attack us or what kind of cruel things they would do to us. I didn't want to live in that kind of situation anymore, and I needed strength for that. Moreover, your offer won't come twice, so I accepted it." Fu Lingshan then turned to her partner.
"Do you dare to take risks with me? If you lack the courage, we'll end our relationship today, as I don't want a cowardly partner."
Fu Lingshan's words made Lian Chengyu laugh and cry in his heart, but he immediately put on a determined face. "I am a man, and I will not lose to you, so I accept it."
"That's good."

Xia Bing and Nanxuan Luoyue exchanged glances for a moment before they answered Zhang Fei [1]. "Brother Fei, we will also accept your offer, and we will train harder from now on, so we will be ready when you want to take us to the middle realms."
"What about you, Lingshu?"
"En." Mu Lingshu nodded slightly. "My family no longer wants me, so I have no one else. I only live for myself, and I want to become truly strong to protect myself, so I will join you."
Zhang Fei [1] nodded in satisfaction with their decision. "Anyway, where is Dong'er? Why didn't she join you guys?"

"Cousin, Senior Dong'er has been acting strangely lately and hasn't shown up since we returned to the sect, but it seems to be related to you." Zhang Fei [1] turned to Quan Xun in confusion, especially since he didn't do anything to Lin Dong'er during their last meeting. "I find it difficult to explain it to you, so it would be better if you go see her yourself."

Zhang Fei [1] turned to the others, but they shook their heads, including Mu Lingshu, who was closest to Lin Dong'er. He sighed softly before asking his cousin. "So when do you want to propose to Susu? I've told Aunt Tan about your relationship with her, but she wants you to confirm it with her family first."

At that moment, Tang Susu's face was flushed red as she shily explained to Zhang Fei. "Brother Fei, I've informed my family about our relationship, and they have no objections to my decision, so you are welcome to visit my Tang Clan at any time."

"All right, I will speak with Aunt Tan again later. I will also prepare everything before we go to your clan to formalize your relationship with Xun'er, so you guys can dual cultivate soon." Zhang Fei [1]'s last sentence made Tang Susu's face turn as red as a ripe tomato. "I will send you all there now, so you can start your training, and I will go check on Dong'er."

After he sent them into the training space, Zhang Fei [1] immediately used his invisibility and snuck into Lin Dong'er's room. When he arrived there, he fell dumbfounded at the sight of her punching her pillow in frustration, and there was an ugly painting of someone's face. Moreover, she also repeatedly cursed him in anger, causing him to smile in amusement at her behavior.
*Bam... Bam...*
"Die! You jerk!" Lin Dong'er kept punching and cursing to vent her anger. "You always care about Lingshu, but you never care about me!"

'This girl! She was the one who teased me back then, and I responded to her game right away, but she ran away like a rabbit. Since then, she has been avoiding me and running away whenever she sees me, yet she blames me for not caring about her.' Zhang Fei [1] gave a faint smile before approaching Lin Dong'er. He immediately grabbed both of her hands and pinned her down, shocking her.
"Zhang Fei! Let me go now!" Lin Dong'er immediately screamed in struggle, but Zhang Fei [1] held her hands and feet tightly.

"Hehe." Zhang Fei [1] chuckled as he canceled his invisibility, which simultaneously caused Lin Dong'er to feel irritated, embarrassed, and blush. "I heard you calling me a jerk, and you said I never cared about you."

Lin Dong'er immediately turned her embarrassed face to the side, unable to respond to Zhang Fei [1]. 'Ugh ! This bastard! He already has so many wives, but he still can't understand a woman's feelings!'
"Did you miss me that much, chubby rabbit?"
Lin Dong'er's forehead creased as she glared at Zhang Fei [1]. "I'm not chubby! Don't you dare to call me like that again!"

"Is that so?" Zhang Fei[1] immediately carried Lin Dong'er, further embarrassing her. He then took her to the dressing table in his room and pointed to the mirror. "Am I wrong to call you chubby? Even so, you're not an ugly chubby; rather, you're such a cute chubby."
"Humph!" Lin Dong'er snorted in response. "You are a liar and gibberish! I'm not that cute in your eyes! You care more about Lingshu than me!"

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei[1] laughed, sat Lin Dong'er on the dressing table, and pressed her against the mirror. "Why do you keep blaming me? You were the one who started teasing me, but you immediately ran away after I responded to you, and you kept avoiding me after that, remember? So how can I give you my attention if you keep acting like that?
Furthermore, I've given you my precious pills, so it should be clear to you that I care about you, right? Or do you want something else from me to prove I care about you?"

Lin Dong'er repeatedly blinked her eyes as Zhang Fei [1] took out a bottle. She naturally knew what it contained because her best friend had already consumed it several times, which greatly aided her in catching up to her in their cultivation.
"I don't mind giving it to you, but I can't give it to you now, and I'll give it to you after we meet your father."
"Eh?" Lin Dong'er let out a soft cry immediately. "What... what do you want to do by meeting my father?"

"Isn't that obvious?" Zhang Fei [1] immediately put Lin Dong'er down and pulled her out of his room. "I've known about your feelings for a long time, and you didn't dare to admit your own feelings because your father forbade you from marrying a dual cultivator, right? However, I'm different from other dual cultivators, and I'm sure your father wouldn't refuse if I wanted to take you as my wife."
"No!" Lin Dong'er let out a loud scream as she tried to shake Zhang Fei [1]'s hand off hers. "Stop! Don't meet my father! He will definitely be angry and disappointed with me!"

Zhang Fei [1] naturally did not listen to Lin Dong'er, and she kept screaming all the way to the punishment hall because Lin Hao was in charge of that place, causing the disciples who saw them to wonder for themselves.
Before long, they had arrived at the punishment hall, and Lin Dong'er was forced to follow Zhang Fei [1] inside, but she kept her head lowered in fear.

"Hmm?" Lin Hao immediately turned to them with raised eyebrows, as Zhang Fei [1] was holding his daughter's hand, and Lin Dong'er also appeared frightened. "What are you doing? Why did you make my daughter so scared?"

"Elder Lin, I don't want to mince words with you, and I came here to ask for Dong'er's hand." Lin Dong'er's heart tightened as she glanced at her father, genuinely afraid that Lin Hao would be angry with her. However, her father appeared stunned by Zhang Fei [1]'s words.

"I understand your desire to marry her to a single man who will only be loyal to her, but I can tell you that not all single men are good, and they will not necessarily treat her well. As for me, I do have many wives, but I always treat them fairly and equally, and they also live harmoniously under one roof.

Moreover, your daughter has fallen for me, and she is often jealous of Lingshu, but she doesn't dare to admit her feelings because she doesn't want to disappoint you. That's why I brought her here, and I hope you won't hurt her feelings by forcing her to marry another man."

As soon as Lin Hao glanced at her, Lin Dong'er lowered her head even further and tightly gripped Zhang Fei's [1]'s hand. Even her palms were starting to get cold from sweat, and her body was also trembling in fear.
Lin Hao experienced a conflict in his heart upon witnessing his daughter's actions, which led him to understand that she had indeed developed feelings for him.

On one hand, he was aware that Zhang Fei [1] was the best man he could have chosen to be his daughter's husband, but on the other hand, he had always hoped that his daughter could have a husband who was completely loyal to her, like himself with his late wife. "Do you really like him, Dong'er?"
"Y... yes... father."
"What makes you like him?"
"I... I don't know."
Zhang Fei [1] wanted to laugh hearing Lin Dong'er answer her father like that, but he immediately held himself back. 'This girl! She's too innocent! Even Xu Ling'er is far more mature than her.'

Lin Hao himself massaged his forehead after hearing that, and he also thought the same as Zhang Fei [1] that Lin Dong'er was too innocent to understand her own feelings. "It seems I have to break my promise to your late mother to find you a good single man."
"Eh?" Lin Dong'er immediately looked up at Lin Hao. "Does... does that mean you're not angry and willing to accept my feelings for him, father?"

"What can I do?" Lin Hao asked back with a heavy sigh. "Even though you said you don't know what made you fall for him, I can see that you do like him. Moreover, you are my only daughter, and I cannot bear to see you suffer, which is why I decided for you to be with him."

"Hahahaha!" Lin Dong'er immediately burst out laughing after hearing that, causing Zhang Fei [1] and Lin Hao to facepalm, especially since her character changed instantly. She immediately jumped into her father's lap, hugged his neck, and kissed his cheek repeatedly. "Phew!
I was really afraid that you would be mad at me, so I'm relieved that you're not, and I'm pleased that you can understand my feelings. I... Ouch... Ouch..."

"You spoiled little girl!" Lin Hao pinched Lin Dong'er's chubby cheeks quite forcefully. "You're old now, but your mindset is still too innocent, and your behavior is still childish! If you continue like this, you will never be ready to be a wife. Moreover, you have to remember that Zhang Fei [1] has many wives, and they are much more mature than you in age and mindset!
If you continue like this after marrying him, they will definitely tease you every day!"

"Ouch.. Father, my cheeks are going to stretch if you pinch them this hard!" Lin Hao shook his head and stopped pinching her cheeks, while Lin Dong'er immediately rubbed her own cheeks. "I do like him, but I won't marry him anytime soon, and I will wait for the right time."
Instead, Lin Hao asked Zhang Fei [1]. "Are you okay with that?"

"That's not a problem for me, Elder Lin." Zhang Fei [1] rubbed Lin Dong'er's head. "I know she's not completely sure about her feelings yet, so I'll let her understand them first. Moreover, her character is still too childish, so I'll take her as my wife after she's truly ready to be a wife."
"I'm not childish!" Lin Dong'er complained while puffing her cheeks.

Zhang Fei [1] ignored her and gave his basic pills to Lin Hao. "You don't have to think about it, and they'll help you improve your foundation. Anyway, I'm going to take Dong'er to my private training place, so she probably won't be back anytime soon."
"All right, you can take her with you, and you must train her as hard as you can, so she won't continue to be spoiled."
"Father! I'm not spoiled!"

However, he was even more perplexed when his system failed to display Li Mengmeng's name, leading him to conclude that her current name was a pseudonym.
Liu Mengmeng smiled faintly at Zhang Fei [1]'s reaction.
"I haven't seen you since your marriage to Shen Yu, but your soul and mind are already quite strong compared to before.
Anyway, I would have been disappointed in you if you had fallen into my technique just now, but it turns out you have exceeded my expectations."
"Who are you really?
Why are you disguised as Li Mengmeng?"

"I didn't expect you to see through my disguise, but there are many things that don't need to be discussed, and one of them is my identity." Li Mengmeng suddenly moved right in front of Zhang Fei [1] and pressed her index finger against his chest.
"However, I can tell you that I am not a resident of this realm, and I come from one of the realms outside.
As for the purpose of my coming to this realm, it is because of you, the future ten-tailed fox."
Li Mengmeng's words once again shocked Zhang Fei [1].
"What do you mean by that?"
