paragraphs: Li Mengmeng suddenly patted Zhang Fei [1]'s chest with her palm, and she forced his soul out of his body without him being able to stop it.
"In fact, I have been paying attention to you since you arrived in this realm, but you never noticed it, and no one else noticed my presence in this realm either, including the Phoenix Princess.

I knew about the ten-tailed fox, and I knew that he had already chosen his successor, so I came here specifically to look for his successor." Li Mengmeng then released her own soul and grasped Zhang Fei [1]'s soul. However, the sight of her soul astonished him, particularly because her soul was a dazzling gold, and he had never seen a golden soul before. "You should have guessed my identity, right?"
"You are a member of the natural races, right?"

Li Mengmeng nodded to Zhang Fei [1]. "You are correct; I belong to the natural races, and my ancestors originated from this Heavenly Wilderness Realm. However, they had left this realm long before humans inhabited it, and the nine-tailed fox assisted them in doing so.
Even after they left, they continued to monitor this realm because it was their ancestral land, so they knew everything that happened in it in the past, including his death and predictions."

"I see." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in understanding, as the ten-tailed fox had clearly written that his successor would return to this realm. Therefore, he was not surprised to find Li Mengmeng waiting here. "What is your purpose of searching for me in this realm?"

"I came here to ensure that you do not succumb to your demon bloodline, particularly considering your destiny to bring peace to this universe." Zhang Fei [1] let out a heavy sigh, especially since everyone had always said that his destiny was to be a peacemaker for his universe. He had never thought about becoming one, and he only wanted to have a peaceful life for himself and those closest to him.
"I understand your wish, but you will never be able to find peace as long as this universe is not peaceful, and you will get into even more trouble when you appear in the upper realms."
"Do I look like someone who likes to find trouble with other people?"

"Haha." Li Mengmeng laughed softly in response. "You may not like to find trouble, but your presence is a magnet for trouble, and troubles will continue to come to you endlessly. You are the successor of the ten-tailed fox, and people will find out about it sooner or later.

Even Tian Baitian and Tian Baixing have already become aware of your existence due to your error in sending Pang De to their realm. They may have stopped chasing after you now, but they will chase you again once they learn that you have arrived in the middle or upper realms.

Unlike before, they will no longer send heavenly foxes with cultivation in the ten mortal realms, but they will directly send foxes with cultivation in the seven divine realms, especially since there are no longer any rules that limit them there."

Zhang Fei [1] once again let out a heavy sigh, especially since he felt he had no other choice but to send Pang De to their realm. Unfortunately, his decision at that time caused a chain reaction, and he constantly worried that those heavenly foxes would hunt him down again sooner or later. "Do you really think they will stop chasing me now?"

"Yes." Li Mengmeng gave Zhang Fei [1] an affirmative nod. "You don't know anything about their situation, but I can tell you that many other living beings are eyeing them. Since they are direct descendants of the ten-tailed fox, all living beings, especially the demons from certain realms, desire to subdue them.

That's why you must hide your identity as neatly as possible after you leave this realm, especially when you go to the upper realms in the future. If they discover that you are his successor, they will shift their attention to you, and you will face never-ending problems."
"All right, I will listen to your advice, and I will be more careful in making my decisions or actions." Zhang Fei [1] then questioned her once more. "So what do you want to do with me now?"
"You came looking for me because you wanted to have me as your partner, right?"
"Hahaha!" Zhang Fei[1] laughed before admitting it with a nod.

Li Mengmeng smiled as she shook her head. "My current body is not my real body, and it is also different from your clones. If you want to get me, then you must reach the seven divine realms first and go to my realm to meet me in the future, but you will not necessarily be able to get me."
"What do you mean by that? Which realm do you live in?"

Li Mengmeng first returned their souls to their bodies before she answered Zhang Fei [1]'s questions. "My realm is the Evergreen Spirit Haven, and you will definitely like that place. As for this body, this is just my avatar."
"Avatar?" Zhang Fei [1] was perplexed by that. "I've seen Shang Huaqiang's avatar before, but your body looks different from his avatar, and I can feel that you are a real person."

"Naturally, my avatar is different from Shan Huaqiang's, but I won't explain it to you in detail even if you are the successor of the ten-tailed fox." Zhang Fei [1]'s lips twitched at that as he was curious about Li Mengmeng's abilities. "Anyway, you should leave now, or you'll get into trouble again. I don't want anyone to suffer because of me."

Before Zhang Fei [1] could inquire, Li Mengmeng had already pushed him out of her room, and a barrier immediately surrounded it. This annoyed him, but he quickly walked away to check Hong Xuan's room, which was not far from his own. Unfortunately, he couldn't find her there, so he hurried to the treasure hall.

When Zhang Fei [1] arrived there, Shen Shou, who was one of Shen Xueyi's loyalists, immediately welcomed him. After all, she and Shen Yu were his women, and their status was the highest in the Shen Clan, so her status was no different from theirs. "Are there any items you want?"

"Actually, I've been eyeing some items for some of my wives, but my sect points are still lacking, so I've been delaying buying them." Shen Shou immediately handed over a thick book containing a list of items in the place, and Zhang Fei [1] immediately pointed out several items that he wanted. "Even though Xueyi and Yu'er are my women, I don't want to use their status to get these items.

Instead, I require your assistance in selling certain items, all of which are intended for dual cultivation purposes. However, we should talk in a closed room, or these people will make a scene here."

Shen Shou immediately led Zhang Fei [1] to the back room, where he took out several types of sex tools. The old man seemed confused by all the items, especially since there were no such items in the Sky Jade Realm.
Zhang Fei [1] immediately explained the function of each item to Shen Shou, and he also demonstrated the use of several items such as vibrating dildos and others.

"I know many female disciples are often dissatisfied with their partners, so these items will be useful to satisfy their lust, and they will definitely be willing to pay a high price to buy them." Shen Shou nodded in agreement with Zhang Fei [1] before pointing at a sex doll. "Many male disciples may not be satisfied with their partners, and many of them may have wild imaginations.
Unfortunately, not all of them can get several partners like me, so they can use this doll to satisfy their imaginations."

Shen Shou went into a daze after Zhang Fei [1] explained all that. "Do you really want to sell all these items in this sect? Their existence might alter the relationship between male and female disciples, potentially causing chaos among them."

"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei [1] nodded in agreement with that. Both male and female disciples may be disappointed with their partners if they become addicted to these items, but we know that many of them are always thirsty for sex like Tang Rou, so you can sell them to them, and it shouldn't affect the sect significantly."
"All right, I will sell these items to selective people, so the relationship between disciples will not be chaotic. Then what about their prices?"
Zhang Fei [1] immediately gave more stock of those items to Shen Shou. "I'll leave it to you regarding their prices, and you can sell them through points or jewels."

"Wait here first." Shen Shou immediately left Zhang Fei [1] for a while before returning with the items he wanted. "These items do require a lot of sect points, but your items can sell for a higher price. You can take them, and I will deduct the price from the sale of your items."
[You obtained 1 Frostheart Necklace.]
[You obtained 2 Blazing Lotus Amulet.]
[You obtained 1 Tempest Boot.]
[You obtained 1 Thunderbird Feather Charm.]
[You obtained 1 Celestial Light Orb.]
[You obtained 1 Earthcore Gauntlet.]
[You obtained 1 Riverstone Pendant.]
[You obtained 1 Nightshade Dagger.]
Zhang Fei [1] smiled in satisfaction after storing all the items, and he immediately stood up from his seat. "Thank you, Old Man. Since my business is done, I will enter seclusion again."

"It seems that kid got a really interesting item, especially since I can no longer detect his cultivation, but he has probably reached the 7 or 8 Star Soul Realm by now." Shen Shou immediately left the room and started marketing Zhang Fei [1]'s items in the treasure hall, which attracted the attention of both male and female disciples.
As he had originally planned, he did not sell them to all the disciples, and he selected them based on his knowledge of their characters.

After he accompanied Lillea and Janette in the fairy forest, Zhang Fei immediately brought the two back to his residence in the western region, and he right away distributed the items he got from Shen Shou to some of them, especially since there weren't many of them.

Zhang Fei gave the two Blazing Lotus Amulets to Chu Ying and Chu Qing, especially since they had fire elements, and they were weaker than Zhang Lingxue. Zhang Yue got the Frostheart Necklace, which matched her ice element. Zhang Lin got the Riverstone Pendant, and it could help her have more control over her water element.

Zhang Fei gave the Tempest Boot to his mother, especially since she was too inexperienced compared to Ye Lian. He gave the Celestial Light Orb to Ru Xue to boost her light element. Zhong Yan got the Thunderbird Feather Charm, especially since it could increase her lightning power and speed.

Tang Ziyu got the Earthcore Gauntlet, but she still had to adapt to it and increase her experience first before she could use it. As for the Nightshade Dagger, Zhang Fei gave it to Liu Hua, especially since she was his only woman with poison element.
Although some of them didn't get any items, they didn't look jealous at all, especially since they fully believed that Zhang Fei would never show favoritism among them.

Since his first clone had already confessed his relationship with Yi Na to Wei Luan, and Chu Hong had been dead for more than a month, Zhang Fei decided to reveal his relationship with Liu Qingyu. That way, she could officially become his woman, and he would no longer need to hide his relationship with them.

Zhang Fei immediately informed Liu Qingyu of his plans via telepathy, causing her to become tense, fearing that her three daughters would be disappointed in her. He also instructed his other women, with the exception of Chu Ying and Chu Qing, to leave first.

Before he told them about his relationship with Liu Qingyu, Zhang Fei first asked Chu Xing to stop his training and come out of the training space. Seeing that only his mother and two sisters were there, she had guessed his intention, so she immediately asked him. "Do you want to reveal your relationship with our mother to us?"
"Eh?" Chu Ying and Chu Qing immediately turned to their mother in shock.

Zhang Fei wanted to answer Chu Xing, but Liu Qingyu immediately stopped him and spoke to them herself. "You three might be disappointed in me, but I have indeed had a long-standing relationship with Fei'er, which began after he saved Hua'er."

Chu Ying and Chu Qing were even more shocked after hearing that, especially since they had always lived together with Liu Qingyu, but they never once knew that she had a relationship with their husband. Moreover, their father was still alive at that time, which meant that their mother had betrayed him long before he died.

"I knew it!" Unlike her two sisters, Chu Xing was more relaxed in responding to the matter. "Indeed, I rarely live with you guys, but you are my mother, so I know your character and movements quite well.

I know you are always happy when you are with our father, but I can see your changes since the first time my brother-in-law took me to his training space, and I suspect that it has something to do with him. Moreover, he often spends quite a long time outside, and I think he deliberately spends his time with you, especially since he can't admit the relationship between you two openly to us."
"Mother, why did you do that? Why did you have a relationship with Fei'er when our father was still alive?" Chu Ying finally questioned Liu Qingyu, and her voice was filled with disappointment.
On the other hand, Chu Qing did not say anything and continued to stare at Liu Qingyu, waiting for her response.

"Ying'er and Qing'er, our relationship is not your mother's fault, and it is entirely my fault, so I hope that you two will not be disappointed or hate her." Both sisters immediately turned their faces to Zhang Fei. "When I saved Hua'er, I also used my demon pheromone, and I didn't control it well, so it also affected your mother, who was waiting for us outside the cave.

I myself was too greedy and lustful, and I seduced her after we returned to your clan, so she finally submitted to my abilities. Since then, we've been together, and we've dual cultivated many times."

Chu Ying and Chu Qing were speechless and confused about who to blame for her mother's relationship with Zhang Fei, especially since they themselves were fully aware of their husband's demon abilities, and they had also experienced their effects several times.

Chu Xing immediately walked behind her two sisters and put her arm around their shoulders. "I know you two are confused and disappointed about their relationship, but it has been going on for so long that we won't be able to change the facts. Furthermore, our father has passed away, and our mother is still young, so she deserves to get new happiness.

Since you two are his wives, you both should understand that he can give her that happiness, right? As for the relationship between us, his relationship is already messed up with Aunt Yi and Yue'er, who are already his wives now, so I think you guys don't need to bother about their relationship."

After careful consideration, Chu Ying and Chu Qing decided to agree with their sister, particularly given their mother's current status as a free woman. Although her relationship with her husband started with an affair, their father was dead now, and they realized that she would be happy with him.
"Although your relationship leaves us feeling disappointed and strange, we will try to accept it, but we need time to be able to accept it completely."

chapters.title: Chapter 493 New Plans
paragraphs: "Isn't that easy?" Chu Ying and Chu Qing turned to Chu Xing directly. "Since the three of you are my brother-in-law's wives, all of you just need to dual cultivate with him together. Moreover, you two often dual cultivate with him in front of his other wives, right? Therefore, I believe it's not a significant issue, and both of you can quickly adjust to this situation."

Unlike Liu Qingyu and Chu Ying, who were embarrassed by Chu Xing's idea, Chu Qing immediately agreed with her second sister. "You're right, that is indeed the best solution for us. After all, we are family, and we are also his wives, so it's not a big deal for us."

"Go on! You guys can dual cultivate with him now." Chu Xing chuckled and ushered her two sisters toward Zhang Fei. "Brother-in-law, please send me back now; I will continue my training with Wei Luan."

Chu Xing's attitude made Zhang Fei feel that she was no less mischievous than Zhang Lin, but he immediately sent his sister-in-law back to the training space. "Anyway, I thought of some new plans, but we will discuss this with the others first."
Before long, Liu Hua and the other women had returned to the main hall. Zhang Fei immediately informed them of his new plans, shocking them with his sudden decision.

"I actually decided on this matter after my first clone met someone at the Yin-Yang Pavilion, and their conversation led me to this decision." Zhang Fei then told them about Li Mengmeng, which surprised Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu. "Our cultivation speed is indeed much better compared to other cultivators, but I feel that it is still not enough.

Furthermore, I am eager to rescue Yue'er from Hu Gao's clutches, which is why I am striving to reach the heaven realm as soon as possible. I believe that the middle realm is my best option. As for my future plans, I will reconsider them once we arrive in that realm.
If the situation there is worse than I expected, then we just need to stay in the training space, especially since the quality and quantity of qi inside it depends on the location of my real body."

All the women released a sigh in their hearts, especially since Zhang Fei still had not explained to them about the origins of his training space or other things, which made them continue to wonder about the secrets he was hiding from them.
"Are you thinking of taking us to the Wasteland Realm, Fei'er?" Liu Hua was the first to inquire.

"No." Zhang Fei immediately denied it. "My third clone is in the Wasteland Realm, and we can go to that realm whenever we want, so I won't take you all there. Instead, I want to take you all to the Nine Stars Realm, primarily because I want to search for something important there, and our cultivation will progress more quickly there.
Furthermore, the lightning element in that realm is extremely potent, making it beneficial for those of you who possess it."
Zhang Lingxue immediately asked Zhang Fei. "Do you have definite information about the Nine Stars Realm, husband? How about we ask Big Sis Yao first about that realm?"
"I don't have much information about that realm yet, so you can ask Feng Yao, Lingxue."

"All right, I'll contact her now." Zhang Lingxue didn't have to wait long because Feng Yao immediately replied to her. "Big Sis Yao wants to come here to explain it in person, so you can open the portal there, Husband."

Zhang Fei immediately opened a portal to the Blazing Phoenix Sect, and Feng Yao had already arrived in front of them within seconds. He immediately explained his decision to the Phoenix Princess, who understood his impatience.
"There are many powerful cultivators in the Nine Stars Realm, and quite a few of them have already reached the seven divine realms.

There will always be good and evil people in every realm, and we can't change that fact, so we will always meet many of those evil people wherever we go." Zhang Fei and the others nodded in agreement with Feng Yao, particularly considering that the Earth and the Sky Jade Realms were also filled with such individuals.

"The situation in the Nine Stars Realm is more conducive when compared with the Wasteland Realm, especially since most of the people living there are delinquents from the upper realms. However, the Nine Stars Realm still adheres to the kingdom system, and there are several large kingdoms there, but it shouldn't be a problem for you with your experience so far."
"Kingdoms, huh? Do you have any information about those kingdoms?"

Feng Yao nodded to Zhang Fei before touching his forehead, and she shared some of her memories about the Nine Stars Realm with him, so he could understand the situation in that realm more easily. "That realm is not much different from this Sky Jade Realm, but there are many races living there: the human races, demon races, beast races, and natural races."
"Beast race? Are they demihumans, Big Sis Yao?"

"You have mistaken their identities, Lian'er." Ye Lian looked at Feng Yao in confusion. "Demihumans are the offspring of humans and beasts, so their appearance is half human and half beast, and many of them live in the western island of the Wasteland Realm. On the other hand, the beast race are beasts who can transform into humans like me, Shen Xueyi, and Shen Yu."
"Oh." Ye Lian nodded her head in understanding.

Feng Yao then spoke to Zhang Fei again. "Of the five human emperors, you should be careful of Emperor Huangfu Shou, and you should not stay in Huangfu Kingdom. That guy is the most cruel among them, and he is also famous for his degeneracy, so you will put them in danger if you take them there.
Instead, you can take them to live in the Xian Kingdom, especially since Xian Feng is the best among them, making his kingdom truly prosperous and safe under his leadership."

"Actually, I haven't thought about starting a new life in that realm, and I only need the Qi there to strengthen ourselves, so we'll probably stay in seclusion after we get there." Zhang Fei then asked Feng Yao. "What about the demons, beasts, and natural races in that realm?"

"Unlike humans, beasts value strength highly, so there is only one beast kingdom in that realm. Moreover, Long Huang is a mythical beast, so he stands the highest among all the beast races in that realm." Zhang Fei could immediately guess the person's beast form from his name. "You are right, he is a dragon, but he is not as strong as the dragons from the upper realms.

Actually, you don't need to worry about him, especially since he is a wise man who treats all the beasts under him as equals, ensuring a truly peaceful situation in his kingdom. For the natural races, there is only one kingdom, and Xian Lianghua, an elf, is their emperor."

After Feng Yao mentioned this, a strange smile instantly appeared on Zhang Fei's face, causing all his women to shake their heads helplessly as they understood the meaning behind his smile. He then turned to them. "Why are you all looking at me like that?"

Neither of them answered Zhang Fei's question, and their behavior made Feng Yao laugh. "Anyway, the Cyanwood Mountain belongs to the kingdom of the natural races, and that place is one of their sacred places, so you have no choice but to go there to obtain permission."
"Hmm?"

"I know you have your invisibility ability, but it won't be of any use there, and Xian Lianghua can detect your presence using his eye abilities." Zhang Fei nodded in understanding and immediately thought about his plan to go to the Cyanwood Mountain. "As for the demon race, there are two demon kingdoms there.

In fact, both are led by two siblings, but they have different opinions and ideologies about their goals, so their race is split into two now. Ximen Changtian, the oldest, leads the original Ximen demon kingdom. Ximen Gongfu, the youngest, leads the Dark Demon Kingdom."
"So the name nine stars symbolizes the nine kingdoms, huh?"

"Yes." Feng Yao replied with a nod. "So, when are you going to that realm? How can I contact you later? My parents have already sent someone to this realm to teach your big sister about the ice phoenix, and her speed is one of the fastest in our race, so she will probably arrive in about three months."

"Three months is still quite a long time, and I will use one of my clones to contact you around that time." Zhang Fei contemplated their departure plan while observing his women, all of whom appeared eager to go to the Nine Stars Realm. "I think I will leave for the Nine Stars Realm in a week, and I will leave from the Wasteland Realm.

As for all my business in this realm, I will hand them over to the people of the Chu, Liu, and Shen Clans during my absence. Once my cultivation breaks through to the heaven realm, I will bring them back to this realm, and I will settle my affairs with the Moon Fox Race at that time."

"In that case, I will wait for you to return to this realm, and I will personally witness your progress at that time." Feng Yao suddenly had an idea and conveyed it to Zhang Fei directly. Could you bring the leaders of the natural races from this realm with you? They have already recognized you as their leader, and they are sincerely willing to help you.
That's why I think you can help them improve themselves, and they will be useful to you in the future."

"Actually, I have already talked to them about this matter, especially since I still have some other plans for the future, and most of them agreed to it. However, I don't want to dwell on it too much at the moment, and I will prioritize our cultivation first." Feng Yao looked at Zhang Fei with a curious expression, so he immediately told her some of his other plans.
"What do you think about my plans?"

"Your plans are quite good, and they are indeed important for you guys to face the situation in the upper realms, especially since you are not natives there." Feng Yao then looked at Liu Hua. "She used to manage her assassin group, so I think she is your best choice for now.

You can initiate them early and further develop them once your cultivation reaches the seven divine realms, which will provide you with a more mature preparation and foundation for exploring the upper realms."

Zhang Fei immediately agreed with Feng Yao. "Yeah, I also think that Hua'er is the best choice for that, and the Wen Twins will help her as usual. Beside them, I have also started preparing some other people, but they still need a long time to be fully prepared, so I postpone my other plans and wait for them to be ready."
"You can decide your own plans, and I will wait for your good news."

Following this, Zhang Fei sent Feng Yao back to the central region while also instructing his women to prepare for the lengthy journey from the Wasteland Realm to the Nine Stars Realm, which took approximately three weeks. Additionally, he asked Liu Qingyu, Ye Lian, and Zhang Linguxe to inform their families about his new plans.
Zhang Fei asked Liu Hua to select some of the best individuals from the demon fox group, as he wanted them to start their preparations early for his other plans.
The four women immediately left their residence to carry out their husband's requests, and the other women hurried back to their respective rooms to rest.

On the other hand, Zhang Fei rushed into the Yin-Yang Space and absorbed the Qi of his female prisoners, especially since the yin qi he had harvested from them was already quite a lot, and it was far more than what he needed to break through to the next minor stage.
[Congratulations! Your cultivation broke through to 9 Star Soul Realm.]

Zhang Fei smiled with satisfaction when the notification appeared. "This way, I can stabilize my cultivation while I'm on my way to the Nine Stars Realm, and I'll speed up my cultivation after I arrive at that realm."

[Three weeks of travel is more than enough to stabilize your cultivation, master. When you arrive at that realm, not only will your cultivation advance by leaps and bounds, but the cultivation of your wives and partners will also be the same, and the heaven realm will not be far from your reach.

However, after successfully rescuing Hu Yue from Hu Gao's hands, it would be better to fully focus on the middle realms. This is because the amount of Qi required to break through will be even greater once you reach that stage. Therefore, you cannot relax in this realm and focus on reaching the quasi-divine realm.]

"Yeah, you're right about that." At first, Zhang Fei still wanted to enjoy his time in the Sky Jade Realm while continuing to improve his cultivation, but his mistake led the Heavenly Fox Race to chase him, and his conversation with Li Mengmeng made him change his mind. "How long do you think it will take for me to reach the quasi-divine realm?"

[I can't confirm that yet, master. As long as your original body continues to stay in the middle realms, and the number of your partners also continues to increase, then you will probably reach that stage in two or three years.]

"Two to three years, huh?" Although he was quite satisfied with that, Zhang Fei still felt that it was too long, and he desired to reach the quasi-divine realm even faster than that. "I think I should add more partners, but I can't keep looking for women from this realm, and I have to look for new partners from the Nine Stars Realm."

[That's for sure! The women in this realm won't be of much help to you once you reach the heaven realm, so your best option is to find new partners from the Nine Stars Realm, especially female beasts to help you evolve faster. As for your demon ranks, that realm is also in the middle realm, so the strength of the demons in that realm will not be too different from the Netherworld Realm.]
"All right, I will reassess everything once we reach the Nine Stars Realm, and I hope the situation there aligns with what Feng Yao previously stated.

That way, we don't need to live in hiding, and we can start my other plans." Zhang Fei then left the Yin-Yang Space and went to find the seven women from earth to accompany them, especially since they were his right-hand men in taking care of his affairs on earth, and he had left them aside for quite some time.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 Depart
paragraphs: In the Wasteland Realm, Zhang Xiaolong [3] was completely satisfied after spending quite a lot of time in Shang Xiaoyin's secret place. Unfortunately, Shang Xiaoyin and his two friends returned earlier than he expected, which made it difficult for him to go there again.

Zhang Xiaolong [3] was also disappointed that he couldn't bring all his wives, partners, and family members to cultivate there, especially since Shang Yaolin and Shang Xinyu were always with him during those days. However, he wasn't too bothered about it, especially since both women always helped him dig for precious stones in that place, so he had a large supply of precious resources for them.

Furthermore, Zhang Xiaolong [3]'s relationship with both women, particularly Shang Yaolin, was improving and becoming closer. Shang Xinyu was also getting acccustomed to his presence by her side, but she continued to feel curious about him, whether he will remain the same as the man figure in his dreams or not when he grows up.

Therefore, Zhang Xiaolong [3] decided to deepen his knowledge in the soul cultivation path under the guidance of the two senior cultivators. Unlike the other Shang Clan members, he is quite respectful of Shang Yingyue, especially since she has helped him so much, and she is his first partner in dual soul cultivation.

Moreover, her mental strength is so strong, and she continues to manage to hold herself back, even though he often teases her by using his demon abilities. In the end, he stopped teasing her and treated her as his senior.
Like Shang Yingyue, Zhang Xiaolong [3] also respected Qiao Liangren, especially since he was the one who introduced him to the soul cultivation path, and he was always sincere in guiding him.

In addition to them, Tie Xuan frequently visited the mountaintop to persuade Zhang Xiaolong [3] to join his Tie Clan, but he consistently declined his invitation. Two senior female cultivators, Miao Miao and Lai Minhua, also frequently visited to observe his progress, but he showed little interest in them, particularly in the second woman.
Instead, he was more interested in waiting for Murong Mengying, but she never came and only watched him from afar.

Day after day quickly passed, and a week had passed in all cultivation realms. Over the past week, Zhang Fei spent most of his time accompanying the seven women from Earth as he stabilized his cultivation, while his few women were occupied with carrying out his plans.

Shen Xueyi and Shen Yu opened Zhang Fei's new shop in the southern river city, and his new shop was not much different from the one in the heavenly sword city. At first, both shops only sold ordinary supplies from earth, such as mattresses, coats, and so on.

However, he decided to add various types of sex equipment to both shops, and their sales proved to be good, especially since there were too many couples who were dissatisfied with their partners, plus many of them had wild imaginations when it came to sex.

Since Zhang Fei was going to take them all to the Nine Stars Realm, Shen Xueyi handed over the shop in the southern river city to the members of the Shen Clan, and Liu Qingyu handed over the show in the heavenly sword city to the members of the Chu Clan.
Zhang Fei did not bother to travel back and forth between the two realms, as his fifth clone stayed on earth, and he managed everything with the assistance of Zhong Yan and Huang Rong's subordinates.

Zhang Lingxue was always occupied with alchemy in the deserted valley, creating various types of pills and potions related to sex and beauty. Zhang Fei chose not to sell all of them in the Sky Jade Realm, preferring to ask Huang Rong and Yang Lu'er to sell them on Earth.
He made this decision due to the higher value of cultivator items there, which allowed him to earn more money for purchasing items in the modern system shop.

According to Zhang Fei's orders, Liu Hua and the Wen Twins had already selected five women with the best cultivation and abilities of the demon fox group, and he sent them to his training space to prepare them for his future plans.

For Zhang Fei, the five women were just his subordinates, and he had no intention of dual cultivating with them. Even so, he still shared the dual cultivation technique he got from Shang Yaolin with them, and he also gave them his Yang Qi. He also gave the dual cultivation technique to all his family members and friends, so they would be more useful to him in the higher realms.

Zhang Fei did not forget to go to the Di Clan in the central region, especially since he needed better formation arrays for them in the middle realms. Initially, Di Xiong extended an invitation to become his disciple, but he declined as he had already made the decision to focus more on the middle realms.

Although Di Xiong was disappointed with Zhang Fei's decision, he still respected it, and he gladly gave him five high-grade intermediate formation arrays as a reward for his help in the demon cave. The five formations were the Eight Trigrams Spirit Array, the Five Elements Convergence Array, the Thousand Sword Array, the Frozen Heaven Array, and the Misty Phantom Array.
(A/N: I will put the explanation of these formations in the auxiliary abilities chapter.)

Zhang Fei naturally did not forget his cousin's relationship with Tang Susu, so he also brought Qing Tan to the Tang clan to propose to their daughter. His reputation and relationship with several large clans had already spread widely in the realm, so the people of the clan immediately agreed to his marriage with Quan Xun.

Early in the morning, people from the Liu, Zhang, and Ye Clans had gathered at Zhang Fei's residence as they were leaving for the Nine Stars Realm today. He also invited Chu Liuxiang and Yuan Manqiu to join them, but they refused his offer, and they wanted to spend the rest of their lives in the Sky Jade Realm.

Zhang Fei naturally did not forget the members of the Ming and Wang families who had stayed on earth for the past week, and his fifth clone immediately picked them up and sent them into the training space.

At first, Zhang Lingxue considered bringing members of the Di and Chang clans with them. However, Zhang Fei rejected her idea, as he didn't have a close relationship with either clan and didn't want them to know about his secrets, such as his training space.

Several leaders from the natural races were also there, such as Oliver the fairy race leader, Gravir the dwarf race leader, Persix the centaur race leader, Tanbar the gnome race leader, Sabina the Dryad race leader, Elmyra the elf race leader, and Yuhe the undine race leader.

Zhang Fei was most pleased with Elmyra's presence, especially since his main destination in the Nine Stars Realm was located in the natural races kingdom, and he hoped she could help him to get in touch with them more easily. After all, their emperor, Xian Lianghua, was an elf like her.

After they were all gathered, Zhang Fei immediately sent Huang Rong and the other six women back to Earth, and he asked the others to enter the training space, so it would be easier for him to bring them all to the Wasteland Realm before heading to the Nine Stars Realm.

Meanwhile, Zhang Wuji and Yan Zhixiu decided to go to the Netherworld Realm, especially since they needed the demon energy from that realm, and Zhang Fei himself still didn't know whether there was demon energy in the Nine Stars Realm or not.

Since there were no problems in the Diyu Realm and the situation in the realm was relatively safe with Morgana and the others there, Zhang Fei decided to bring Feltia [2]'s partners with them, such as Fyr, Eve, Leora, and Ashreth since they were demon cultivators.
He did not bring the Amaris Twins, Nadea, and Tessa, but his second clone sent them away to the Netherworld Realm along with Zhang Wuji and Yan Zhixiu.

Zhang Fei immediately used his invisibility before he entered the gate to the Wasteland Realm, and upon arriving there, he right away looked for an empty place before taking out the Pandora Odyssey. Once Mei activated the stealth feature and barrier on his flying artifact, he swiftly flew it out of the Wasteland Realm.

Even so, Zhang Fei's actions did not go unnoticed by Tianguo, but the divine beast still did not do anything, especially since he was still in his black dog form, which had a better character than his black fox form. "That brat certainly piques my interest, and I can't discern any distinction between his real body and his clone.
I don't know about his plans, but he seems to intend to go to other realms, and his clone continues to have fun with that human woman in this realm."

Zhang Fei immediately took all of them out of the training space after he left the Wasteland Realm. Since they had never left the Sky Jade Realm in their entire lives, they were curious about the journey they would take to reach the Nine Stars Realm.

Those people were immediately amazed to see the outer space, whether they were seniors like Zhang Long and the others or juniors like Zhang Fei [1]'s partners. They immediately spread out to each side of his flying artifact to admire their new experience, including the leaders of the natural races and female demons such as Ursula, Angela, Virgil, and others.

Although the people of the Sky Jade Realm hated demons very much, they did not mind the presence of demons from the Diyu Realm among them, and their relationship was actually good because they were members of Zhang Fei's extended family.

As usual, Xu Ling'er immediately asked Zhang Fei to carry her, and her eyes scanned the surrounding area in space, which was mostly filled with darkness. "Big brother, the people on earth will definitely be jealous if they know that we can go to space this freely, and we don't even need to spend money to build rockets and the like."

"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed upon hearing that. "After all, they are ordinary humans, and we are cultivators, so they can't possibly be our match. Moreover, the cultivation world still holds many mysteries that powerful cultivators have yet to solve, and many of those mysteries contain dangers."
"En." Xu Ling'er then turned to those people. "Big Brother, our family is really big now; even though many of them are your clones' partners, they are still our family, right?"

"You're right, Ling'er." Zhang Fei looked at each of them with a smile. The three of them are my clones, but they are still me, so they are part of our big family. Even so, they will never become the main members of my family, and they will continue to live with my clones in the future."
"Does that mean you will send all your clones to other realms in the future, Big Brother?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei then told Xu Ling'er about his plans for all his clones and their partners, causing the little girl to laugh out loud. "Aren't my plans good?"

Xu Ling'er nodded to Zhang Fei. "Your plans are indeed good, but I find it difficult to imagine the number of your descendants in the future, especially since their number is not small, and your family will definitely be the largest in this universe."
"Well, that's true." Zhang Fei's smile widened at the thought. "As the old saying goes, more children means more fortune, so I want to have many descendants from them."
Xu Ling'er immediately put her arms around Zhang Fei's neck. "Do you also want to have children with me in the future, Big Brother?"

Zhang Fei was stunned for a while by Xu Ling'er's question, but then he kissed the little girl's forehead. "Back then, I have always regarded you as my little sister, but I have promised to marry you when you grow up, and Xue'er has also agreed to it, so I also want to have children with you in the future.
However, you still have to wait another seven years to become my wife, so you must continue to focus on your cultivation and training while waiting for that day to come."

"Hehehe." Xu Ling'er giggled and hugged Zhang Fei tightly. "Seven years is not a long time for cultivators like us, especially if we continue to focus on our cultivation. I will undoubtedly mature into a stunning adult woman without our knowledge, and you must accept me as your wife by that time, okay?"
"Sure, I will take you as my wife in seven years." Zhang Fei then brought the little girl to join the others.
Since it was their first time leaving the Sky Jade Realm, Zhang Fei let them enjoy their new experience first, and he would send them back to the training space after they were satisfied.

In the Netherworld Realm. Zhang Fei [4] decided to go to the dead forest after he sent Zhang Wuji and the other three female demons to Arbeola's place, especially since Orith had been gone for so long, but she still hadn't returned.

Moreover, Zhang Fei [4] also had a pending quest to explore the forest, so he wanted to complete it at once. However, he was not confident in completing the second quest to free the prisoner in the ancient sub-realm, who he believed was the true demon emperor of the Netherworld Realm.

Since he wasn't in too much of a rush with it, Zhang Fei [4] chose to fly normally to the Dead Forest, so he could complete the daily quest to kill the demons or demon beasts, which were increasing in number.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei's two other clones, Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2], stayed inside the training space to cultivate and study the five new formation arrays he got from Di Xiong. Zhang Fei [5] remained on Earth, persistently cultivating his soul alongside Wang Xiaoyi and the remaining five women.

In the moon fox's sub-realm, Hu Gao stood in front of a young man with white hair and four tails behind him, but his expression looked annoyed as he watched his son, Hu Dong. Even though he had provided his son with many precious resources, and he had also been in seclusion for quite some time, he still had not succeeded in breaking through to the sovereign realm. 'This brat!
How could I have a useless son like him? If he wasn't my only son, I would have killed him for his uselessness!'
Hu Dong suddenly let out a heavy sigh and opened his eyes, but he was shocked by the presence of his father. "Why did you suddenly come here, Father?"

"You really are a useless son!" Hu Gao scolded him instead. "Despite all the efforts I've made for you, you still haven't succeeded in breaking through. How can you marry Hu Yue if you continue like this?"
"Hmm? What do you mean by that? Mine and Yue'er's cultivation are on par, and I'm sure she hasn't broken through to that stage yet."

"What a fool!" Hu Gao immediately kicked his son, causing Hu Dong to fly and slam into the wall behind him. "Hu Yue is much better than you! She has already broken through to the sovereign realm three months ago!"
As he held his painful chest, Hu Dong stared at his father in disbelief. "How is that possible? You have limited all the resources for Yue'er, right?"

"That's why you are a fool!" Once again, Hu Gao cursed at his son. "I have given you all the best resources in our sub-realm, but you can't make good use of them, and Hu Yue has surpassed you now! If you don't break through or surpass her soon, you will never be able to subdue her to become your wife.
Even if I force her to marry you, you will never be able to do anything to her, and she will dominate you."
"I'm going to see Yue'er now, Father!" Hu Dong immediately stood up and ran out of his cultivation cave, causing Hu Gao to let out a heavy sigh at his behavior.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 Hu Dong's Anger
paragraphs: "What are you doing here, Hu Dong? Why aren't you focusing on your cultivation?"

Hu Dong looked surprised by the two women who had also just arrived in front of Hu Yue's seclusion cave, and they seemed close to each other. 'Hmm? What is Hu Qiaomu doing here? Did something happen while I was in isolation? As far as I can remember, she had always been hostile to Hu Lili, but they seem to be close friends now.'

Hu Lili briefly looked at Hu Dong before ignoring him, and she immediately opened the stone door in front of her daughter's cultivation cave. "You are indeed my daughter's future husband, but Yue'er is currently focusing on her cultivation, so I hope you don't make any noise."

"I know." Hu Dong immediately followed Hu Lili inside, followed by Hu Qiaomu, whose expression was a little strange as she looked at his back. He immediately frowned as soon as they arrived inside, especially since he could no longer sense Hu Yue's cultivation, and he could also feel that her aura was stronger than when they last met.
"How could Yue'er break through to the sovereign realm before me?"

"Yue'er found a stroke of luck when she went to the outside world to calm her mind, and that helped her break through to the sovereign realm." Hu Dong raised his eyebrows at Hu Lili, but she had no intention of telling him anything, which left him looking annoyed. "If you are still interested in marrying my daughter, please return now and concentrate on your cultivation.

If you don't focus on your cultivation, you won't be able to defeat her on the day of the battle to choose your partners; instead, she will defeat you. Even if your father forces her to marry you, she will never accept you, and your marriage to her will only be a status."

Hu Dong's two fists clenched tightly after Hu Lili mentioned the matter, but he himself was fully aware that he would never be able to defeat Hu Yue as long as he still hadn't broken through to the sovereign realm by that day. "Heh! No matter whether she accepts me or not, she will eventually become my wife, and I will force her to serve me."

Hu Lili frowned for a moment but didn't say anything to refute Hu Dong, especially since she already knew about Zhang Fei's demon partner mark on her daughter's body, so he would never be able to force her to serve him.

Hu Qiaomu wanted to say something to Hu Dong, but Hu Lili immediately shook her head, signaling her to keep quiet. 'This foolish and ignorant brat! He has spent the past year in isolation, so he knew nothing about the happenings in the outside world.

If he knew about Zhang Fei and his abilities, he would definitely think twice about saying such a thing; even Hu Gao would not be able to protect him from him with the natural races standing behind him. Furthermore, he is the savior of this realm, and the people of this realm will undoubtedly fully support him.'
Hu Dong then crouched down in front of Hu Yue and wanted to touch her face, but a small wave of qi suddenly came out of her body, blowing him out of the cave before crashing onto the ground.

"Fuck!" Hu Dong immediately stood up and wanted to run into the cave, but Hu Yue suddenly opened her eyes and released her aura to deter him, causing his body to shiver and stop in his tracks. 'What the hell! How can he be this scary?'

"Our agreement is five years, and there are still four and a half years left, so you better go back to your cave and don't bother me." Without waiting for Hu Dong's response, Hu Yue waved her hand, causing the rock in front of her cave to immediately close on its own.
*Boom*

Hu Dong's aura exploded because of this, especially since he was the young master of the moon fox race, and no one dared to treat him like that, including elders like Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu. "That bitch! No matter the means and the price, I will subdue you, and you will serve me like a slave at that time."
After that, Hu Dong rushed back to his isolation cave, and Hu Gao, who watched that from a distance, just shook his head.

"Nearly two months have passed since the destruction of the demon portal, and the situation outside ought to have calmed down by now. Those people should no longer be around that heavenly fox brat, so it's time for me to take action against him.

If I let him continue to grow stronger, he might come here sooner or later, and he will definitely suppress me." Hu Gao immediately flew toward the exit portal of the Moon Fox sub-realm, but he also contacted two elders to accompany him, as he still clearly remembered Zhang Fei's connection with those people, particularly the natural races.
Unfortunately, Hu Gao was too late because Zhang Fei had already taken all his closest people to leave the Sky Jade Realm, and no one knew when they would return to the realm again.

Inside the cave, Hu Yue surprised the two senior women by informing them that Zhang Fei was on his way to the middle realms. However, Hu Qiaomu was particularly surprised, as she shouldn't have been able to communicate with him while she was in their sub-realm. "How can you communicate with him, Yue'er?"

"I am his woman, and he possesses a unique method to communicate with all his women, transcending the boundaries of space and distance." Hu Yue didn't conceal it from Hu Qiaomu, as she was aware that her soul had already fused with Zhang Fei's, preventing her from disclosing any information to anyone else.
"One of his clones was in the Wasteland Realm, and his body went to the Nine Stars Realm together with his other women, friends, and family."
"Did he tell you when he would return to this realm, Yue'er?"

Hu Yue shook her head at her mother. "Fei'er still doesn't know when he will return to this realm again, but he promised me that he will come back as soon as his cultivation reaches the 10-Star Heaven Realm.

Currently, his cultivation has reached the 9-Star Soul Realm, and he will break through to the Earth Realm soon, so I'm confident that he can reach the Heaven Realm in one to two years, or maybe less."

"You're right." Hu Lili acknowledged this with a confident nod. "Almost half a year since Zhang Fei started his path of cultivation, but his cultivation speed has already surpassed everyone in this realm, and he has even reached that stage now. Furthermore, he possesses numerous connections, and he is also regarded as the savior of this realm."

"Haha." Hu Yue laughed softly in response to her mother. "Honestly, I still felt strange about our meeting at that time, and I immediately fell in love with him during our first accidental meeting. However, I didn't expect that the man I fell in love with would be such an amazing man, and he would bring about a big change to this realm.

Since then, I've constantly thought about him, missed him, and longed to be by his side like his other women. However, the mark of Hu Gao in my soul prevents me from seeing him. That's why I can only wait for him to save me, and I'm confident that the time won't be long."

"Actually, Zhang Fei can save you from this place at any time, especially if he makes use of his connections with the leaders of the natural races. After all, some of them are stronger than Hu Gao, so he won't be able to fight all of them at once."

Hu Yue did not deny Hu Qiaomu's words. "However, you forgot that Zhang Fei is a mythical beast, the heavenly fox. Not to mention a mythical beast like him; even divine beasts like us have high self-esteem, right? We never want to rely on others, so I can understand his desire to become strong and save me with his own abilities, and I will wait for him while improving my own cultivation."
"Yeah, you're right." Hu Qiaomu then thought for a while. "I hope Zhang Fei will not slaughter our race members when he comes here to save Yue'er."

Hu Lili and Hu Yue naturally didn't want that kind of thing to happen, especially since their race didn't have many members. However, they had heard a lot about Zhang Fei, and they doubted he would hold himself back if they opposed and fought him. "The outcome will depend on our members, and I hope they will realize that siding with Hu Gao is the worst choice.
Otherwise, he will not spare them just like he did not spare the heretics, and he will slaughter them."
"Are you enjoying the view in this outer space?"

Guo Lan, who was standing alone at the stern, immediately turned to Zhang Fei. "If it weren't for you, I would still be living as an ordinary woman on earth, and I would never know anything. Since you brought me to the Sky Jade Realm almost four months ago, I've learned many intriguing things about cultivators, but I still feel that everything is bizarre."

"All this could happen because of that mysterious young girl." Zhang Fei then hugged Guo Lan from behind before giving her a gentle kiss on the lips. "Even though I don't know her, and she also caused me to die for a while, I am truly grateful to her for the opportunity she gave me.
Otherwise, I wouldn't have gotten so many good wives, and I would never have known that you have liked me for so long, especially since you never showed your feelings clearly."

Guo Lan smiled bitterly, remembering their relationship since Zhang Fei joined Zhong Yan's factory, which made her regret never showing her true feelings to him. If only she hadn't kept her feelings for herself back then, she might have become her first woman, and she might never have become a cultivator with many wives.

"Lan, I know that you still haven't fully accepted my relationship with them, but I'm grateful that you keep trying to get used to our relationship." Guo Lan said nothing and leaned her body against Zhang Fei's chest. "Honestly, I hope that you can get used to our relationship as soon as possible, and you will be a part of them by then."
Guo Lan immediately turned to face Zhang Fei and hugged him. "I will definitely be able to accept everything soon, and I will be yours at that time."
"Yeah."
After he talked and accompanied Guo Lan for some time, Zhang Fei immediately went to another area to meet the other woman, who also still couldn't accept his relationship.

Angela, who was enjoying the view of outer space with Ursula and Virgil, was startled when Zhang Fei suddenly hugged her from behind. Despite this, she accepted his embrace, leaning against his chest and grasping his hands, which were already encircling her waist.
Since they knew Angela's feelings, Ursula and Virgil chose to leave the two of them and go to another area to join the other female demons.
"Why don't you accompany your other women?"
"Even though you are still unwilling to accept my relationship with them, I already consider you my woman, so it's natural for me to want to accompany you, right?"
Angela neither agrees nor disagrees with that. "Are we really going to spend three weeks in this outer space?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded slightly as he responded to Angela. "Since I have never been to the Nine Stars Realm before, I cannot open the gate to that realm, so we have to go through this tedious journey to get there. Once we arrive in that realm, I can bring you all back whenever you want, but we won't be returning to the lower realms that quickly.

Currently, your cultivation is still in the body realm, but the quality of Qi there will accelerate your cultivation even if you don't want to use my Yang Qi to cultivate. Moreover, I need to reach the 10-Star Heavenly Realm as soon as possible, which means we will spend a significant amount of time there. By the time we return, you will be stronger than Zygoz or Oz the second."

"Haha." Angela laughed softly at the thought of surpassing her two seniors. "Oz the second and Zygoz have lived for tens of thousands of years, so I never imagined that I would be able to reach their level, let alone surpass them. However, the opportunity is wide open in front of me, and it happened because of you.
Therefore, I will make good use of my time to increase my strength as high as possible, and I will surprise them when we return later."
"They will definitely be surprised when they meet you later."
Angela then looked up at Zhang Fei. "Anyway, can we stay in an area near the sea when we arrive at the Nine Stars Realm? I'm a demon fish, and I've lived too long on land, so I miss the sea."

"Sure." Zhang Fei himself really liked sea views, so he immediately agreed to Angela's wishes. "However, I still don't have clear information about the terrain or areas in that realm, so I have to find a suitable place first. Since there are many powerful cultivators in that realm, I must ensure our safety when living there.
If the area is far from danger, I will arrange for you all to live near the sea."
Angela nodded in understanding to Zhang Fei. "It's just my wish, and our safety comes first, so you don't have to bring us to live by the sea if that area is dangerous."
"Don't worry, I'll check the situation first."

After that, Zhang Fei went to another area and met two women who appeared to be happily chatting and joking with each other, and they immediately turned to him with looks of joy. "You two are getting along well, huh?"

"Hahaha!" Ming Yanyu laughed before jumping up to hug Zhang Fei. "Big Sis Zhuxian is very kind, and we have the same hobbies. Moreover, we often spend time together, so we were able to get along quickly."

Zhang Fei briefly glanced at Wang Zhuxian, who was smiling at him. Despite being half cousins, they didn't have a close relationship, primarily because he rarely spoke to her and was always absorbed in his cultivation and training. "Are you enjoying your life as a cultivator now?"

"Yes." Wang Zhuxian responded with a nod. "Even though I've only been a cultivator for less than three months, I really enjoy my life as a cultivator, so I feel reluctant to return to earth. Unfortunately, my parents still live there, so I still have to go back to visit them."
"I see." Zhang Fei chose not to comment on Wang Zhuxian's parents, especially since he disliked her father.
"Cousin, where are we going to live in the Nine Stars Realm? Are we going to continue living in your training space?"

"I haven't decided on that yet, Yanyu." Zhang Fei then told Ming Yanyu and Wang Zhuxian a little about his plans for them in the realm. "Anyway, Angela hopes that we will live near the sea since she is a demon fish, so I will look for a suitable sea, and we will live there if I find one."

The two women's eyes lit up upon hearing that. "Actually, living near the sea is really nice, Cousin. We can watch the sunrise and sunset every day, and we can play around there if we are bored of cultivating."
"Haha." Zhang Fei laughed while rubbing Ming Yanyu's head. "I myself like the idea of living near the sea, so my first priority when we arrive in that realm is to see all the sea there."

Hu Dong looked surprised by the two women who had also just arrived in front of Hu Yue's seclusion cave, and they seemed close to each other. 'Hmm?
What is Hu Qiaomu doing here?

As far as I can remember, she had always been hostile to Hu Lili, but they seem to be close friends now.'
Hu Lili briefly looked at Hu Dong before ignoring him, and she immediately opened the stone door in front of her daughter's cultivation cave.
"You are indeed my daughter's future husband, but Yue'er is currently focusing on her cultivation, so I hope you don't make any noise."

Hu Dong's two fists clenched tightly after Hu Lili mentioned the matter, but he himself was fully aware that he would never be able to defeat Hu Yue as long as he still hadn't broken through to the sovereign realm by that day.

Hu Dong's aura exploded because of this, especially since he was the young master of the moon fox race, and no one dared to treat him like that, including elders like Hu Lili and Hu Qiaomu.
"That bitch!

After that, Hu Dong rushed back to his isolation cave, and Hu Gao, who watched that from a distance, just shook his head.
"Nearly two months have passed since the destruction of the demon portal, and the situation outside ought to have calmed down by now.

Hu Gao immediately flew toward the exit portal of the Moon Fox sub-realm, but he also contacted two elders to accompany him, as he still clearly remembered Zhang Fei's connection with those people, particularly the natural races.
Unfortunately, Hu Gao was too late because Zhang Fei had already taken all his closest people to leave the Sky Jade Realm, and no one knew when they would return to the realm again.

"How can you communicate with him, Yue'er?"

"I am his woman, and he possesses a unique method to communicate with all his women, transcending the boundaries of space and distance." Hu Yue didn't conceal it from Hu Qiaomu, as she was aware that her soul had already fused with Zhang Fei's, preventing her from disclosing any information to anyone else.
"One of his clones was in the Wasteland Realm, and his body went to the Nine Stars Realm together with his other women, friends, and family."
"Did he tell you when he would return to this realm, Yue'er?"
Hu Yue shook her head at her mother.
"Fei'er still doesn't know when he will return to this realm again, but he promised me that he will come back as soon as his cultivation reaches the 10-Star Heaven Realm.

Currently, his cultivation has reached the 9-Star Soul Realm, and he will break through to the Earth Realm soon, so I'm confident that he can reach the Heaven Realm in one to two years, or maybe less."
"You're right." Hu Lili acknowledged this with a confident nod.
"Almost half a year since Zhang Fei started his path of cultivation, but his cultivation speed has already surpassed everyone in this realm, and he has even reached that stage now.
Furthermore, he possesses numerous connections, and he is also regarded as the savior of this realm."
"Haha." Hu Yue laughed softly in response to her mother.
"Honestly, I still felt strange about our meeting at that time, and I immediately fell in love with him during our first accidental meeting.
However, I didn't expect that the man I fell in love with would be such an amazing man, and he would bring about a big change to this realm.
Since then, I've constantly thought about him, missed him, and longed to be by his side like his other women.
However, the mark of Hu Gao in my soul prevents me from seeing him.
That's why I can only wait for him to save me, and I'm confident that the time won't be long."
"Actually, Zhang Fei can save you from this place at any time, especially if he makes use of his connections with the leaders of the natural races.
After all, some of them are stronger than Hu Gao, so he won't be able to fight all of them at once."
Hu Yue did not deny Hu Qiaomu's words.
"However, you forgot that Zhang Fei is a mythical beast, the heavenly fox.
Not to mention a mythical beast like him; even divine beasts like us have high self-esteem, right?
We never want to rely on others, so I can understand his desire to become strong and save me with his own abilities, and I will wait for him while improving my own cultivation."
"Yeah, you're right." Hu Qiaomu then thought for a while.
"I hope Zhang Fei will not slaughter our race members when he comes here to save Yue'er."
Hu Lili and Hu Yue naturally didn't want that kind of thing to happen, especially since their race didn't have many members.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 A Week Later
paragraphs: "How do you two feel? Are you enjoying your first experience leaving your home realm?" Wen Yuan and Wen Xuan turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately embraced their shoulders. "Even though we only departed today, you must have missed the Sky Jade Realm, right?

Actually, I also experienced that kind of feeling when I first left earth, but I slowly got used to the situation, especially since you all helped me through my time there. Both of you are more experienced than me, so you'll adapt faster and be eager to explore the Nine Stars Realm."

Wen Xuan was the first to answer Zhang Fei. "Before your arrival in our realm, we didn't even know that other realms existed, so we never imagined leaving it, yet here we are now on our way to a new and unfamiliar realm. Even though we still feel strange about leaving our realm, I can't wait to arrive there, and we're already thinking about exploring it once we get there."

"We are aware that the realm is full of strong cultivators; but as experienced assassins, we want to explore that realm as quickly as possible, even if our cultivation is still in the earth realm." Wen Yuan then posed a curious question. "Why are you considering forming a new organization in the Middle Realm?"

Zhang Fei first gave each of the Wen twins a kiss before giving them an explanation. "Whether in the lower, middle, or upper realms, strength is everything in the world of cultivation. In addition to our personal strength, we also need a supporting force, so I plan to form a new organization.

Since we are still unfamiliar with the situation in the Nine Stars Realm, I cannot bring too many people there immediately. Therefore, our new organization will begin with us, and I will gradually bring members of the demon fox group there. The new organization will not only focus on assassination like before, but it will be active in broader fields such as trading, alchemy, and healing.
Hua'er and you two will focus on assassination, Lingxue will focus on alchemy, Ru Xue will focus on healing, and the others will focus on trading."
"So, you're also going to open a new shop in that realm?"

"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to them. "In the Sky Jade Realm, you use Hua Luo as a facade, but I dislike prostitution even though I am a dual cultivator. That's why I want to open a shop that is not much different from my shops in our realm, but I will not sell items from my home realm, and the new shop will specifically sell cultivator items, especially those related to alchemy."
"Is that because the realm still adheres to the kingdom system?"

"The imperial system is different from the system in the Sky Jade Realm, where each clan and sect has their own role." The Wen twins themselves were unfamiliar with such a system, as their realm lacked a monarchy. Each kingdom's emperor or empress controls everything, limiting our freedom of movement.

If I sell items from my home realm in my new shop, it would be too conspicuous, and they will do everything they can to suppress us. Moreover, we don't have any connections there yet, so it would be better if we kept it low-key by selling common items to avoid such a thing."
"Are there also sects in that realm?"
Zhang Fei nodded to them. "Like other cultivation worlds, there are several sects in the Nine Stars Realm.

Based on the information I got from Feng Yao, all the major sects in that realm are under the influence of those imperial families, and they require younger cultivators with the best talents to join their sects, so the power of the sects there is not balanced because the minor sects only get disciples with ordinary talents."

"Wouldn't that be detrimental to them?" Wen Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow. "They may be strong, but I'm sure they still need other people's help, especially when the other kingdoms attack their kingdom. If the minor sects are too weak and no one can help them, then their kingdom will fall apart if the enemies succeed in destroying their major sects."

"You're not wrong about that." Zhang Fei then proceeded to explain to the Wen Twins the circumstances of the kingdom era on earth. "Even though I still don't know for sure what the situation is in that realm, I'm sure it's not too different from the situation in my home realm in the past.

Those emperors or empresses will probably use the people from those minor sects as cannon fodder, so their main force will have plenty of time to strategize to stop their enemy. However, the war between mortal kingdoms and cultivator kingdoms is definitely different, so I can't guess about the intensity of their war if that happens."
The Wen Twins released heavy sighs after hearing all that, especially since the mortal world was never peaceful, let alone the cultivation world, which was much harsher.

Zhang Fei hugged the Wen Twins even tighter. "You two don't think about such things because I will take you all to live in a place far away from their conflicts, and I will build up our strength gradually while we focus on increasing our individual strength."
Wen Xuan then asked him. "Hey, Fei, are we going to stay in the middle realms forever? Are we never going back to the Sky Jade Realm again?"

"Why do you have to think about that, Xuan? If you and Yuan want to go back there, I can send you two there whenever you want to, remember?" The Wen Twins laughed as they nodded to Zhang Fei. "I myself will miss the Sky Jade Realm, but I want to focus more on building up our strength in the middle realms, so I might not go back there often after I save Hu Yue.

Moreover, the middle realms are not our last stop, and there are countless realms in the upper realms waiting for us, so we cannot continue to be distracted by matters in the lower realms. Once our cultivation breaks through to the seven divine realms, we will probably go directly to one of the planets in the upper realms.
However, the upper realms are still far from our reach, so I don't want to think about it now, and we should focus on the road ahead of us."

A while later, Zhang Fei was already sitting beside Zhang Chen, who was talking with Wang Zetian and Dou Luotian about the earth. "What about your father? Did he succeed in persuading the winged race higher-ups?"

"Not yet." Dou Luotian replied with a disappointed sigh. "My father has successfully persuaded some of them, but the majority, particularly the Throne, are overly ambitious to become the sole ruler of the four realms.

Micah informed me that they are considering the possibility of invading the Xian Realm before launching an attack on the other two, given that the people from that realm present the greatest challenge for them. However, I am confident that such an invasion is unlikely, given their superior strength over our race."

Zhang Fei nodded in understanding. "I hope that those birds will attack the Xian Realm, thereby significantly decreasing the strength of the Tian and Xian realms, and making them reconsider attacking the other two realms."
"What if they attack the earth, Fei'er?"

"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled as he hugged Zhang Chen. "Grandma, my fifth clone is staying on earth, so you don't have to worry about that. The Throne might be strong by the standards of the four realms, but he won't be stronger than the cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm.
I will ask Boitata to slaughter them if they dare to attack there, and I will ask our acquaintances in that realm to help her if she has trouble fighting them alone."
The three people frowned at Zhang Fei's answer. "Are you really going to slaughter them, Fei'er?"

Zhang Fei answered Wang Zetian with a determined nod. "Old man, our enemies will never be merciful towards us, so we don't need to be merciful towards them either. If they choose to be my enemies, I will use all means to eliminate them, even if it means destroying the balance between the four realms. However, I will only kill those who are my enemies, and I will spare those who are on my side.

As for the Diyu Realm, I don't think much about that realm anymore, especially since Morgana and Oz the first were able to wipe out the people from both realms, so I leave the affairs of that realm to them."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately left them because he could see that they wanted to persuade him not to do such a thing, and he himself would never change his decision about his enemies.

Zhang Chen let out a heavy sigh because of her grandson's departure, and she then spoke to Dou Luotian. "Sister Dou, I hope your father can persuade those higher-ups, or else they will all die in vain if they try to invade Earth."
"Yeah, I myself don't want my race members to die stupidly at the hands of Zhang Fei and his friends, so I hope my father can convince them, even though it won't be easy."

After that day, Zhang Fei let them all relax for three days, so he sent them all back to the training space to practice and cultivate after three days. He himself also went inside to dual cultivate with all his wives and slaves, so Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] took turns to control the Pandora Odyssey.

After three days, Hu Gao and the two moon fox race's elders arrived at the heavenly sword city, and they immediately checked the Chu Clan. Naturally, they couldn't find Zhang Fei and his family there, and they couldn't find them in the Ye Clan either.
Before they went to the western region, they had already checked the Zhang Clan, but they couldn't find Zhang Long and the others there.

Hu Gao's face darkened as he was unable to locate Zhang Fei anywhere. "Where is that brat? Why isn't he in this city? I remember clearly that he stayed in this city most of the time, but I can't find any trace of him at all, and the main members of those two clans aren't here either."

"Do you think he's in the southern region, leader?" Hu Gao immediately turned to Hu Peiwu. "Zhang Fei is the son-in-law of the Shen and Liu clans, and he's also a disciple of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, right? Since we can't find him in this region, I think he might be there now."

"I agree with Peiwu, Leader." Hu Dahai said as he nodded. "The two Shen ancestors have indeed broken through to the sovereign realm, but they are just ordinary beasts, and our cultivation is also higher than theirs, so they are not an obstacle for us to capture that brat."
"All right, we're going to the southern region now to check on that brat there."

Immediately, the three of them took off toward the southern region, only to abruptly halt when Feng Yao suddenly appeared before them. Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu stiffened because of his sudden appearance, especially since it was still fresh in their memories when he beat up Hu Gao in the past, and it even took him several years to recover.

"He's not in this realm anymore, and he's on his way to another realm now, so you don't need to bother looking for him." Hu Gao frowned after hearing Feng Yao's words, but he remembered that Zhang Fei had the ability to switch realms easily. "Peace has just returned to this realm, so I don't want you to disturb it again.
If you won't listen to me, then I will beat you even harder than before, and I will cripple your cultivation if necessary."
"You-"

"You what?" Feng Yao immediately interrupted Hu Gao, enveloping the three of them with her aura and causing cold sweat to quickly trickle down their foreheads. "I can't do anything to these humans, but you are divine beasts, and I am the protector of this realm, so I can punish you accordingly. Since my patience is limited, you should return to your sub-realm now or face the consequences."

'Leader, I think we should go back right now, or this woman will really cripple our cultivation, and we will be the ones to suffer.' Hu Peiwu spoke to Hu Gao through voice transmission, but his tone was filled with fear.

Hu Dahai was also frightened by Feng Yao's threat, and he was really afraid of becoming crippled, so he also persuaded Hu Gao, who was still hesitating. 'Leader, we will never win against her, so we should leave now.'

'This bitch! She repeatedly interferes in my affairs and pressures me! Damn it! I will definitely teach her a harsh lesson one day.' With a heavy heart, Hu Gao immediately led the two old men to leave the western region, but his expression turned ugly as soon as Feng Yao said something in his mind. 'Heh! This bitch thinks too highly of that brat!
I will kill him if he dares to return to this realm again.'

Feng Yao shook her head as she watched them fly away. "He has lived for more than two thousand years, but he is just an ignorant old man. When Zhang Fei returns to this realm again, it means that he is ready to face them. If he still has such thoughts about him at that time, then he and his race will be doomed, and they will be wiped out from this realm."
