[Master, I don't know what awaits you in there, so you increase your vigilance once you enter that area. Back then, Tian Jiyuan managed to escape from that place using his gate ability, so you should be able to do the same if you encounter powerful demons inside.]
Zhang Fei [4] nodded slightly and landed right on the edge of the area that was not detected by his map, and a notification immediately appeared in his mind.
[Quest: Explore the dead forest]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: Hard Gift Pack x 1 sent to the inventory]

Zhang Fei [4] immediately summoned the demon extermination sword out of his body and entered the area afterward, but his expression became serious as the map turned completely black, and he could not detect anything inside the place.

"I had expected this formation to be very powerful, especially since Morgana said that Shang Huaqiang got it from someone in the Xianjin Realm, but it is much more powerful than I had previously imagined."

[Master, although the map can't show anything, I can still detect a lot of movement around this area, and the portal should be in the middle of this area. However, I advise you not to get too close to that area, especially since Shang Huaqiang placed a powerful guardian there.]
*Rustling... Rustling...*
Zhang Fei [4] immediately went on alert as soon as he heard the voices, but to his surprise, a demon tree approached him. "Oh? Was Arbeola the one who gave the order to see me?"

"Yes." The demon tree then pointed one of its trunks toward the center. "Those demon kings and queens are in that area, and most of them were heavily injured after being attacked by the guardian. Some others managed to escape, but they were lost in there and couldn't find their way out."
"Do you know where the three succubi duchesses are located?"

sentences.text: "How do you two feel?
Are you enjoying your first experience leaving your home realm?" Wen Yuan and Wen Xuan turned to Zhang Fei, who immediately embraced their shoulders.
"Even though we only departed today, you must have missed the Sky Jade Realm, right?
Actually, I also experienced that kind of feeling when I first left earth, but I slowly got used to the situation, especially since you all helped me through my time there.
Both of you are more experienced than me, so you'll adapt faster and be eager to explore the Nine Stars Realm."
Wen Xuan was the first to answer Zhang Fei.
"Before your arrival in our realm, we didn't even know that other realms existed, so we never imagined leaving it, yet here we are now on our way to a new and unfamiliar realm.
Even though we still feel strange about leaving our realm, I can't wait to arrive there, and we're already thinking about exploring it once we get there."

"We are aware that the realm is full of strong cultivators; but as experienced assassins, we want to explore that realm as quickly as possible, even if our cultivation is still in the earth realm." Wen Yuan then posed a curious question.
"Why are you considering forming a new organization in the Middle Realm?"
Zhang Fei first gave each of the Wen twins a kiss before giving them an explanation.
"Whether in the lower, middle, or upper realms, strength is everything in the world of cultivation.
In addition to our personal strength, we also need a supporting force, so I plan to form a new organization.
Since we are still unfamiliar with the situation in the Nine Stars Realm, I cannot bring too many people there immediately.
Therefore, our new organization will begin with us, and I will gradually bring members of the demon fox group there.
The new organization will not only focus on assassination like before, but it will be active in broader fields such as trading, alchemy, and healing.
Hua'er and you two will focus on assassination, Lingxue will focus on alchemy, Ru Xue will focus on healing, and the others will focus on trading."
"So, you're also going to open a new shop in that realm?"
"Yes." Zhang Fei nodded to them.
"In the Sky Jade Realm, you use Hua Luo as a facade, but I dislike prostitution even though I am a dual cultivator.

That's why I want to open a shop that is not much different from my shops in our realm, but I will not sell items from my home realm, and the new shop will specifically sell cultivator items, especially those related to alchemy."
"Is that because the realm still adheres to the kingdom system?"

"The imperial system is different from the system in the Sky Jade Realm, where each clan and sect has their own role." The Wen twins themselves were unfamiliar with such a system, as their realm lacked a monarchy.
Each kingdom's emperor or empress controls everything, limiting our freedom of movement.
If I sell items from my home realm in my new shop, it would be too conspicuous, and they will do everything they can to suppress us.
Moreover, we don't have any connections there yet, so it would be better if we kept it low-key by selling common items to avoid such a thing."
"Are there also sects in that realm?"
Zhang Fei nodded to them.
"Like other cultivation worlds, there are several sects in the Nine Stars Realm.

Based on the information I got from Feng Yao, all the major sects in that realm are under the influence of those imperial families, and they require younger cultivators with the best talents to join their sects, so the power of the sects there is not balanced because the minor sects only get disciples with ordinary talents."
"Wouldn't that be detrimental to them?" Wen Yuan asked with a raised eyebrow.
"They may be strong, but I'm sure they still need other people's help, especially when the other kingdoms attack their kingdom.
If the minor sects are too weak and no one can help them, then their kingdom will fall apart if the enemies succeed in destroying their major sects."
"You're not wrong about that." Zhang Fei then proceeded to explain to the Wen Twins the circumstances of the kingdom era on earth.
"Even though I still don't know for sure what the situation is in that realm, I'm sure it's not too different from the situation in my home realm in the past.
Those emperors or empresses will probably use the people from those minor sects as cannon fodder, so their main force will have plenty of time to strategize to stop their enemy.
However, the war between mortal kingdoms and cultivator kingdoms is definitely different, so I can't guess about the intensity of their war if that happens."
The Wen Twins released heavy sighs after hearing all that, especially since the mortal world was never peaceful, let alone the cultivation world, which was much harsher.
Zhang Fei hugged the Wen Twins even tighter.

"You two don't think about such things because I will take you all to live in a place far away from their conflicts, and I will build up our strength gradually while we focus on increasing our individual strength."
Wen Xuan then asked him.
"Hey, Fei, are we going to stay in the middle realms forever?
Are we never going back to the Sky Jade Realm again?"
"Why do you have to think about that, Xuan?
If you and Yuan want to go back there, I can send you two there whenever you want to, remember?" The Wen Twins laughed as they nodded to Zhang Fei.
"I myself will miss the Sky Jade Realm, but I want to focus more on building up our strength in the middle realms, so I might not go back there often after I save Hu Yue.
Moreover, the middle realms are not our last stop, and there are countless realms in the upper realms waiting for us, so we cannot continue to be distracted by matters in the lower realms.
Once our cultivation breaks through to the seven divine realms, we will probably go directly to one of the planets in the upper realms.
However, the upper realms are still far from our reach, so I don't want to think about it now, and we should focus on the road ahead of us."
A while later, Zhang Fei was already sitting beside Zhang Chen, who was talking with Wang Zetian and Dou Luotian about the earth.
"What about your father?
Did he succeed in persuading the winged race higher-ups?"
"Not yet." Dou Luotian replied with a disappointed sigh.
"My father has successfully persuaded some of them, but the majority, particularly the Throne, are overly ambitious to become the sole ruler of the four realms.

Micah informed me that they are considering the possibility of invading the Xian Realm before launching an attack on the other two, given that the people from that realm present the greatest challenge for them.
However, I am confident that such an invasion is unlikely, given their superior strength over our race."
Zhang Fei nodded in understanding.
"I hope that those birds will attack the Xian Realm, thereby significantly decreasing the strength of the Tian and Xian realms, and making them reconsider attacking the other two realms."
"What if they attack the earth, Fei'er?"
"Haha." Zhang Fei chuckled as he hugged Zhang Chen.
"Grandma, my fifth clone is staying on earth, so you don't have to worry about that.
The Throne might be strong by the standards of the four realms, but he won't be stronger than the cultivators in the Sky Jade Realm.
I will ask Boitata to slaughter them if they dare to attack there, and I will ask our acquaintances in that realm to help her if she has trouble fighting them alone."
The three people frowned at Zhang Fei's answer.
"Are you really going to slaughter them, Fei'er?"
Zhang Fei answered Wang Zetian with a determined nod.
"Old man, our enemies will never be merciful towards us, so we don't need to be merciful towards them either.
If they choose to be my enemies, I will use all means to eliminate them, even if it means destroying the balance between the four realms.
However, I will only kill those who are my enemies, and I will spare those who are on my side.

As for the Diyu Realm, I don't think much about that realm anymore, especially since Morgana and Oz the first were able to wipe out the people from both realms, so I leave the affairs of that realm to them."
After he said that, Zhang Fei immediately left them because he could see that they wanted to persuade him not to do such a thing, and he himself would never change his decision about his enemies.
Zhang Chen let out a heavy sigh because of her grandson's departure, and she then spoke to Dou Luotian.
"Sister Dou, I hope your father can persuade those higher-ups, or else they will all die in vain if they try to invade Earth."
"Yeah, I myself don't want my race members to die stupidly at the hands of Zhang Fei and his friends, so I hope my father can convince them, even though it won't be easy."
After that day, Zhang Fei let them all relax for three days, so he sent them all back to the training space to practice and cultivate after three days.
He himself also went inside to dual cultivate with all his wives and slaves, so Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] took turns to control the Pandora Odyssey.
After three days, Hu Gao and the two moon fox race's elders arrived at the heavenly sword city, and they immediately checked the Chu Clan.
Naturally, they couldn't find Zhang Fei and his family there, and they couldn't find them in the Ye Clan either.
Before they went to the western region, they had already checked the Zhang Clan, but they couldn't find Zhang Long and the others there.
Hu Gao's face darkened as he was unable to locate Zhang Fei anywhere.
"Where is that brat?
Why isn't he in this city?
I remember clearly that he stayed in this city most of the time, but I can't find any trace of him at all, and the main members of those two clans aren't here either."
"Do you think he's in the southern region, leader?" Hu Gao immediately turned to Hu Peiwu.
"Zhang Fei is the son-in-law of the Shen and Liu clans, and he's also a disciple of the Yin-Yang Pavilion, right?
Since we can't find him in this region, I think he might be there now."
"I agree with Peiwu, Leader." Hu Dahai said as he nodded.

"The two Shen ancestors have indeed broken through to the sovereign realm, but they are just ordinary beasts, and our cultivation is also higher than theirs, so they are not an obstacle for us to capture that brat."
"All right, we're going to the southern region now to check on that brat there."
Immediately, the three of them took off toward the southern region, only to abruptly halt when Feng Yao suddenly appeared before them.

Hu Dahai and Hu Peiwu stiffened because of his sudden appearance, especially since it was still fresh in their memories when he beat up Hu Gao in the past, and it even took him several years to recover.

"He's not in this realm anymore, and he's on his way to another realm now, so you don't need to bother looking for him." Hu Gao frowned after hearing Feng Yao's words, but he remembered that Zhang Fei had the ability to switch realms easily.
"Peace has just returned to this realm, so I don't want you to disturb it again.
If you won't listen to me, then I will beat you even harder than before, and I will cripple your cultivation if necessary."
"You-"
"You what?" Feng Yao immediately interrupted Hu Gao, enveloping the three of them with her aura and causing cold sweat to quickly trickle down their foreheads.
"I can't do anything to these humans, but you are divine beasts, and I am the protector of this realm, so I can punish you accordingly.
Since my patience is limited, you should return to your sub-realm now or face the consequences."

'Leader, I think we should go back right now, or this woman will really cripple our cultivation, and we will be the ones to suffer.' Hu Peiwu spoke to Hu Gao through voice transmission, but his tone was filled with fear.

Hu Dahai was also frightened by Feng Yao's threat, and he was really afraid of becoming crippled, so he also persuaded Hu Gao, who was still hesitating. 'Leader, we will never win against her, so we should leave now.'
'This bitch!
She repeatedly interferes in my affairs and pressures me!
Damn it!

I will definitely teach her a harsh lesson one day.' With a heavy heart, Hu Gao immediately led the two old men to leave the western region, but his expression turned ugly as soon as Feng Yao said something in his mind. 'Heh!
This bitch thinks too highly of that brat!
I will kill him if he dares to return to this realm again.'
Feng Yao shook her head as she watched them fly away.
"He has lived for more than two thousand years, but he is just an ignorant old man.
When Zhang Fei returns to this realm again, it means that he is ready to face them.
If he still has such thoughts about him at that time, then he and his race will be doomed, and they will be wiped out from this realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 497 Saving Orith
paragraphs: "Lady Ilsath was thrown into the portal after King Bapho used her as a shield to block the guardian's attack, so I didn't know about her situation."

Hearing the news about Ilsath, Zhang Fei [4] frowned, especially since he needed her to help him increase his demon rank. However, the portal ended up throwing her into another realm. Unfortunately, he himself didn't know the destination of the portal, and the guardian protecting it should be powerful if it could injure so many demons in the king and queen ranks at once.

"Lady Thish is a little far to the east, and her condition is really bad." Zhang Fei [4] was naturally happy to hear that, and he immediately looked towards the east. "As for Lady Orith, she was taken into hiding by Queen Zilvora a little further north, and both of them only suffered minor injuries."
The demon tree then told Zhang Fei [4] about the condition of the demons; some of them died at the hands of the guardian, and the majority of them suffered serious injuries.

Zhang Fei [4] naturally couldn't care less about the condition of the demons, and he was more concerned about the two succubi duchesses. "Show me the location of Thish first, and we'll go to Orith's place after that."

Zhang Fei [4] followed the demon tree directly to Thish's location, but it took a detour due to the guardian's position in the center of the area, which could attack them if they approached it too closely.
Since the demon tree had lived in that area for a long time, and it could also communicate with other demon trees in other areas, it wasn't difficult for it to lead Zhang Fei [4] to Thish's location.

However, the heart of the dead forest was very wide, and it took them approximately one hour to arrive at Thish's location. Zhang Fei [4] smiled with satisfaction as he discovered the unconscious succubus duchess on the ground, with several parts of her body suffering from burns. Her blood continued to flow, soaking the ground beneath her.

"Don't say anything to the other demons, understand?" The demon tree nodded to Zhang Fei [4], who was already squatting beside Thish. He then took out two demon-sealing power artifacts, one collar and one bracelet, and then put them on her neck and right hand. "Heh!
This way, Luan'er can vent her frustration and anger on you, and you will experience more painful pain than you did to Yan Zhixiu before."
Wasting no time, Zhang Fei [4] sent Thish into the training space, and the demon tree immediately led him north to Orith and Zilvora's location.
About two hours later, they had arrived there, but they couldn't see any sign of them, and Zhang Fei [4] also couldn't find them because the map was still dark. "Orith! Are you here? It's me, Elion!"
"Elion? Is that really you?"

Zhang Fei [4] immediately looked up and saw a large spider web on the tree, but it wasn't an ordinary spider web because it was extremely thick and its pitch-black color blended in with the darkness of the forest. "It's me; I came here to look for you because you hadn't returned in a long time, and I was really worried about you."

Hearing that, Zilvora immediately pulled her spider web and brought Orith down from up there, but the succubus duchess immediately jumped up and hugged her. "Sob... Sob... The guardian is really scary and powerful, and it is more powerful than the fake demon emperor, Elion! It killed many demon kings and queens, and Ilsath was also thrown into the portal because of King Bapho's actions."

Zhang Fei [4] raised his eyebrows slightly after hearing that the guardian's strength exceeded Oz the first, which meant its strength was equivalent to that of a cultivator in the seven divine realms. He then hugged Orith and rubbed her back. "It's okay; the guardian is far from this place, and it never leaves its spot, so you're safe now."
"How did a marquis lust demon like you get into this forest?" Zhang Fei [4] was suddenly asked by Queen Zilvora [4], and he could hear the doubt in her tone.
Zhang Fei [4] pointed to the demon tree behind him. "Lord Arbeola ordered him to guide me, and he was the one who brought me here through a safe route."

Zilvora appeared surprised when she heard the name Arbeola from Zhang Fei [4]. She then glanced at the demon tree, which trembled in fear at her sight. "This demon lives here, so it should know this forest route. In that case, we have to find the surviving demon kings and queens, and we have to bring them back to the demon emperor city."

"No." Zhang Fei [4] immediately refused Zilvora. "You all are incapable of fighting against that guardian, let alone a weak demon like me. I'm still young, so I won't throw my life away in vain. If you want to save them, this demon tree can lead you to their places, but I will take Lady Orith away from this place."

"You-" Zilvora didn't have time to scold Zhang Fei [4], and he had already taken Orith away using his teleportation, causing her to stomp her feet in anger. "That cowardly demon! I'll chop him to pieces using my spider web after I get out of this place! Hey! Take me to the nearest demon kings or queens!
Otherwise, I'll pluck all your leaves, and I'll chop your body into pieces before using them as firewood!"

The demon tree hurriedly guided Zilvora to the location of several nearby demon kings and queens, but the spider queen was still irritated because of Zhang Fei [4], and she was also irritated after remembering King Bapho's cowardly actions. 'Tch! If I ever meet that damn goat again, I'll roast him alive and feed his roasted meat to my babies.'

Zhang Fei [4] had already brought Orith to the border of the formation array, but the succubus duchess continued to stare at him in shock, especially since no lust demon had such a teleportation ability. "How could you do such a thing?"

"Didn't you already know my other abilities before?" Zhang Fei [4] then rubbed Orith's cheek. "You don't have to think too much about my abilities, okay? The important thing is that you're safe now, and I'll take you back to the tower soon."
After staring at Zhang Fei [4] for some time and nodding at him, Orith turned her head towards the central area. "What do you think will happen to Ilsath? Will she die?"

"I don't have an answer for that myself. However, he should be fine since Lord Arbeola told me that the real demon emperor was locked up behind that portal, and she probably met him by now." Zhang Fei [4] then hugged Orith's waist as he looked in that direction. "Honestly, I want to try to meet that guardian, but I hesitate because it's too powerful to be able to kill many demon kings and queens.
Anyway, do you see the figure of that guardian?"

"The guardian is a lion, but its body is similar to lava, and it can spray scorching lava." Zhang Fei [4] nodded in understanding to Orith after remembering Thish's wound. "Anyway, did you find Thish?"

"No." Zhang Fei [4] immediately turned to Orith. "Forgive me, but I don't care about Lady Thish, especially since she always tortures other demons. I came here specifically to save you and Lady Ilsath, but unfortunately, she is stranded in another realm now."

"Haha." Orith laughed happily and gave Zhang Fei [4] a deep kiss. "I am ecstatic that you are so concerned about me, but I am really concerned about Ilsath. Do you have any other abilities that you can use to trick the guardian? As for Thish, just leave her be since I never liked her anyway, and the tower will be more peaceful without her around."

"Actually, I still possess some other abilities, but I'm uncertain if they can deceive the guardian. If it notices our presence, it will immediately attack us, and both of us will definitely die." Orith seemed disappointed with Zhang Fei[4]'s answer. "I myself really want to save Lady Ilsath, but we will only be throwing our lives away if we go there now, so I think we should go back now.
Once my demon rank rises to the duke rank, we will return to try to save her."

Orith released a heavy sigh while shaking her head. "Even if your demon rank rises to the duke rank, we still won't be able to defeat that guardian. It's truly powerful, and it can even kill King Groth and Queen Drudna with just one attack.
Anyway, Queen Zilvora must be angry because of your previous actions, and she will undoubtedly look for you in the tower after she leaves this place, so you'd better hide in my private cave."
"No need." Zhang Fei [4] refused. "I know Queen Zilvora is strong, but I'm not too afraid of her, so I won't hide from her. Anyway, we should go back now, so you can rest later."
"All right, let's go back now."

After that, the two of them rushed out of the formation array and immediately flew away from the Dead Forest, but their speed was too slow because Orith was completely exhausted, and Zhang Fei [4] also didn't want to show his movement technique to her.

Meanwhile, Zhang Fei had already taken Thish into one of the rooms in the portable mansion, where he hung her upside down with her feet chained to the ceiling, causing her blood to saturate the floor.

Since Thish's condition was really bad, Zhang Fei forced her to swallow two pills to stop her bleeding and heal her wounds. He then turned to Yan Luan'er, who was eager to torture the succubus duchess. "You should restrain yourself for the time being and let her recover first, then you can do whatever you want to her after that, so she can feel the pain when you torture her."

"I agree with him, Luan'er." Xi Zihua said with a nod. "Sister Zhixiu has suffered so much because of this female demon, so it would be too good for her if you tortured her while she was unconscious. After she recovers and wakes up, you can start torturing her in the most cruel way, and I will help you with that."

Yan Luan'er nodded in agreement to the two of them and immediately suppressed her anger. "All right, I will wait for her to recover first, and I will make her taste hell, so she will never forget it for the rest of her life."
"Don't you want to use her to increase your demon power?"

Zhang Fei immediately shook his head at Xi Zihua as a sign of rejection. "I do need a lot of female essence, but I have no interest in this female demon. Moreover, there are still so many succubi in the succubi tower, and I can use them all as I please, so Luan'er can satisfy her anger towards him."

Hearing that, Yan Luan'er immediately hugged Zhang Fei's arm. "Fei, how about you take my big sister as your partner? She is a demon cultivator, so you can get female essence and yin qi from her, right? That way, he doesn't need to continue living in the Netherworld Realm, and he can live with me in this mansion."

Zhang Fei himself did not deny that Yan Zhixiu was lovely and attractive, and her body was also very tempting to him. Moreover, he himself had heard that she had only ever dual cultivated with one man, but her partner died at the hands of the Pang Clan, and she never looked for a new partner after that. "Let's talk about this matter again later, and I will talk to him first."
Yan Luan'er pouted her lips as she watched Zhang Fei walk out of the room. "Do you think Big Sis will agree to be his partner?"

"Don't you already know the answer?" Yan Luan'er nodded with a soft sigh. "Even though her partner has been dead for a long time, Sister Zhixiu is still loyal to him even now, so I'm not sure if she will be willing to accept Zhang Fei as her new partner. The situation will be different if he uses his lust demon abilities on her, and I'm sure she will submit to their effects.

However, she will never really like him, and she will probably hate him if he uses such methods to get her. Therefore, we have to think of other ways to bring her closer to him, and he may be able to subdue her heart gradually."
"Yeah, you're right." Yan Luan'er then pulled Xi Zihua out of the room. "I'll try to talk to Big Sis about this when Zhang Fei brings her here again, and I hope I can persuade her to accept him."
"Did you manage to save them, Big Brother?"

Zhang Fei immediately sat down in the middle of his little sister and big sister. "I managed to save Orith, but I couldn't save Ilsath because she was thrown into the portal, and she's probably with the real demon emperor of the Netherworld right now."
"Are you planning to save Ilsath, Fei'er?" This time, it was Qing Yi who asked him.

"No." Zhang Fei then told them about the guardian's form and its power. "Since the guardian is a cultivation beast and its cultivation is at the seven divine realms, my current bloodline power probably can't suppress it for too long, and I'll definitely die if it manages to escape my suppression.
That's why I decided to postpone saving Ilsath, but I'll try to meet it after my demon rank rises to the duke rank and my beast form evolves to the six tails."
"Why don't you use your invisibility to infiltrate the portal, husband?"
"Hey, my invisibility is not omnipotent. There are cultivators or artifacts that might be able to detect me, even if I am in an invisible state.

Therefore, I refuse to take such a risk, knowing that my death at the hands of the guardian would leave all of you miserable and heartbroken." Boitata and the others laughed upon hearing that, and they naturally did not want Zhang Fei to die, so they were relieved by his decision.

"All right, you guys don't need to think about the guardian and Ilsath, but instead, you should focus on our cultivation. Our journey to the Nine Stars Realm still takes two weeks, so I want to break through to the 10-Star Soul Realm before we get there.
However, I will first help those of you who are still in the core realm to break through to the soul realm, so you won't feel pressured when we get there."

Liu Qingyu directly spoke to Zhang Fei. "In that case, you should focus on Sister Yi, Zhang Yue, Zhang Lin, Zhong Yan, Ru Xue, Tang Ziyu, and Janette for their time being, especially since they have yet to break through to the soul realm. As for us, we will release our Yin Qi by force, so you can still improve your cultivation while helping them."
"I agree with Big Sis, Fei'er."
"Me too."
After that, Liu Hua and the others returned to their respective rooms to prepare their Yin Qi for their husbands, and Zhang Fei took the seven women into his room, which excited them.

Upon arrival, Janette immediately asked Zhang Fei. "Why didn't you invite my mother to join us? She has long been ready to dual cultivate with you, and her cultivation is still in the core realm, so I think you can do it now."

Zhang Fei himself was eager to engage in dual cultivation with Lillea, but she had previously been preoccupied with the affairs of her race members, so he didn't have time to do it with her. "All right, I will call her now."

paragraphs: [Ding]
[The system has already recorded the Nine Stars Realm, and the host can access it through Gate in the future.]
[The system upgrade process to level 5 begins.]
[Starts mapping the entire area of the Nine Stars Realm.]
"Extremely vast and huge!" All of them, including Zhang Fei, were shocked when the Pandora Odyssey started to enter the Nine Stars Realm.
The Nine Stars Realm was simply too vast, with four islands spread across several areas, but they were separated by a vast ocean. Even the smallest island, located in the south, was larger than Asia.

The atmosphere on the smallest island looked eerie, with black fog enveloping the entire area of the island, blocking their view. They could immediately conclude that the island belonged to the demon races, given their affiliation with the darkness element.
In the north, there were two islands next to each other that were one and a half to two times the size of the smallest island, and dense green forests covered both islands from end to end.

On one of the islands, a mountain towered high into the sky, with lightning constantly flashing at its peak. This mountain, known as the Cyanwood Mountain, was the main reason Zhang Fei had come to the Nine Stars Realm. The mountain itself is in the Natural Races Kingdom area, which means the island is the home of the Natural Races.

On another island, they could hear various loud sounds from various kinds of beasts, and they could also see so many giant flying beasts flying above it, indicating that it was the home of the beast races.

To the east lay a vast archipelago that was several times larger than the combined size of the two northern islands. However, they could see five barriers encircling various areas of the island, which were the capitals of the five human kingdoms.

Numerous towns and villages were scattered throughout the area of the five kingdoms, but one of them erected a high and thick wall that rivaled the great wall surrounding its entire border with the other four kingdoms. Forests, rivers, valleys, and mountains separate the borders of the other four kingdoms.

In the western area, all they could see was the ocean and numerous small islands scattered across it. Mei told Zhang Fei that there were no living creatures on those islands, except for plants and trees.

Their attention was suddenly diverted by a tall tower located in the middle of the realm; the tower area was also surrounded by a barrier that was much stronger than the five barriers that protected those five human kingdoms. Judging from its size, the tower was not that tall, and it seemed to only have about ten floors.
"Do you have any information about that tower, Fei'er?"

Zhang Fei shook his head at Zhang Yue. "Feng Yao gave me a lot of information about those nine kingdoms and their emperors, but she didn't give any information about that tower. Since we don't have any information about it, I'll go there and check it out later.
For now, we'll look for the most suitable area to be our residence first, especially since our numbers are quite large, so we can't be too obvious, or they'll bother us and pressure us."
[Ding]
[Generating new quests]
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the soul realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack X1.]
[Quest: Find a new place to live.]
[Quest rank: Easy]
[Reward: Easy gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Open a shop in one of the human kingdoms.]
[Quest rank: Medium]
[Reward: Medium gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Build a good relationship with a member of the royal families of one of the kingdoms.]
[Quest rank: Hard]
[Reward: Hard gift pack x 1]
[Quest: Obtain lightning element.]
[Quest rank: Abyss]
[Reward: Abyss Gift Pack x 1]
[Quest: Clear the first floor of the Star Tower.]
[Quest rank: Special]
[Reward: Special gift pack x 1]

The appearance of the seven quests shocked Zhang Fei, especially since he had only ever gotten daily quests in the Sky Jade Realm and the Wasteland Realm, yet the system suddenly gave him seven of them at once, and two of them were daily quests. Moreover, the first daily quest to absorb Qi no longer gave him jewels but coins, and he never got coins other than demon coins.

Meanwhile, the second daily quest was not too different from the old quest because he only needed to kill beasts or demon beasts, but the reward was no longer female essence, and it was replaced with a daily gift pack.
[Master, you don't need to ask me because I don't control the system, and it runs automatically.]
Zhang Fei let out a heavy sigh. 'Do you believe the young girl is in control of the system, Mei?'
[That possibility does exist, master. Unfortunately, I still don't have access to the creator's information, so I don't have a definite answer for that.]

'Bronze coins? Why did the system give me such a reward? Jewels should be worth more than bronze coins.' Zhang Fei suddenly remembered the information from Feng Yao that the five human kingdoms used bronze, silver, and gold coins as their currency. As for the jewels, not all of their citizens could have them, and only people of high class could have them.

'Even though it's a loss for me, I don't think it's too big of a deal, especially since my two shops in the Sky Jade Realms will continue to receive jewels. The change in the second daily quest is also a huge loss for me, but fortunately, I have Orith, the Amaris Twins, Nadea, and the other succubi.
Moreover, the female essence of Eve, Fyr, Ashreth, and Leora continues to increase, or else the increase in my demon rank would slow down.'

[Hehe! Isn't that easy, Master? You just need to go to the demon island, and you can find new female demon partners there. Unlike Orith, the Amaris Twins, and Nadea, who can only provide you with female essences, the female demons in this realm can also provide you with Yin Qi.]

'Yeah.' Zhang Fei then read the other five quests, but only the abyss and special quests were intriguing to him. He already knew how to get the lightning element, but the quest rank made him realize that it wouldn't be easy.

Firstly, he needed to travel to the Natural Races Kingdom to obtain permission to enter Cyanwood Mountain, and he was skeptical that the elf king would grant it, particularly considering he was a foreigner with low cultivation. Second, there were only low-rank lightning seeds in the mountain, and his chances of getting the lightning element were very small.

'The star tower?' Zhang Fei then looked towards the tower located in the middle of the realm, but Mei immediately told him that she and the system could not detect it. 'Sigh! I have to go to one of those kingdoms to find out about the star tower, and I will go there if my current strength is sufficient to challenge it.
If my current strength is still insufficient, then I will enter seclusion again until it is sufficient.'
"What are you thinking, Big Brother? Why does your expression look strange?" Zhang Lin suddenly questioned Zhang Fei.
"Nothing; I just suddenly remembered something." Zhang Fei then turned to them one by one. "Which island besides the demon island should we choose for our new residence in this realm?"

"Zhang Fei, most of us are humans, so you should find a place to live near the human kingdom." All of them nodded in agreement with Oliver, acknowledging that living on the demon or beast islands was not feasible for them. Regarding the natural races, most of them have a strong dislike for humans. "However, you can drop us off at the natural races' island, and we will stay there."
"Eh? Grandpa, why did you suddenly decide such a thing without telling me?" Zefyr protested as she floated in front of her grandfather with her two small hands on her waist.

"Hahaha!" Oliver laughed and stroked Zefyr's head. "We've been residing in the fairy forest for an extended period and haven't embarked on any adventures for the past thousand years, so we've made the decision to journey together to discover new adventures in this realm.
Moreover, we've been training hard in his training space for the past six weeks, and our cultivation is not bad either, so the best choice is to go to that island."
"Moreover, Zhang Fei wants to go to that island in the future, so we decided to go there to prepare the way for him." Persix added.
Gravir also spoke to Zefyr. "Little girl, we are all natural races, and our races are peaceful races. That's why you don't need to worry about us; we will definitely be fine on the island."
"Well, that's true." Zefyr then turned to the other leaders of the natural races, especially the female ones. "Are the three of you also heading to that island?"

"No." Elmyra answered Zefyr directly. "Sabina and Yuhe will join them, but I will stay with you all, and I will teach Ru Xue more about healing, so she will be the best support for you in the future."
"I see." Zefyr then turned to Zhang Fei. "Are you okay with their decision?"

"Why should I object to their decision?" Zhang Fei responded with a shake of his head. "All of us are cultivators, and we can only improve ourselves by facing unexpected situations. Moreover, all of them are experienced seniors, so I believe they can take care of themselves well on the island."
Zefyr released a soft sigh before nodding. "So where are we going to stay?"
[Ding]
[Mapping of the area of the Nine Stars Realm has been completed; the host can check the entire area via the map.]

Zhang Fei immediately opened his map and checked every area of the human island, where he found that the Xian Kingdom was located in the south of the island. Moreover, there was a large area quite far from the twons and villages around there, and it was close to the sea.

"We will stay in the south near the sea, especially since Feng Yao said that the kingdom in that area is the safest and most peaceful compared to the other four, so we shouldn't encounter many problems if we stay there."
"Yay!" Most of them cheered with joy after Zhang Fei said that, especially since they were eager to live near the sea, particularly Angela, the demon fish.

Zhang Fei smiled seeing them in such excitement, and he immediately flew the Pandora Odyssey to the natural races' island first to drop Oliver and the others on the island. After some time, they reached the island's edge, but Yuhe, the undine leader, abruptly decided to jump into the sea below them, causing confusion among the others.

"You don't need to worry about Yuhe, especially since she is an Undine and her habitat is the sea." After Oliver and the others landed on the island, Zhang Fei immediately flew the Pandora Odyssey to the south of the human island. "So what are we going to do now? Are we going to look for the nearest city right away?"

"Yes." Sabina immediately pointed toward the forest in front of them. "I have communicated with the trees in the forest, and they will guide us to the nearest city, which is about 1500 miles from here. We should move now, as it will take a few days on foot."

They all promptly trailed behind Sabina, but Gravir abruptly spoke to them. "Hey! We have been training in Zhang Fei's training space for a considerable amount of time, and since the beasts in this realm are expected to be much stronger than those in the Sky Jade Realm, I wanted to test my fighting skills."

"Hahaha!" Persix laughed hearing that. "You're right, we can't lose to our leader, so we also need to hone our fighting skills even more, especially since he will take us to the upper realms in the future. Otherwise, we won't be able to help him deal with the enemies that might appear there, and we will only be a burden to him."

Gravir and the others agreed with Persix, so they leisurely walked through the forest while fighting the beasts that blocked their way. However, they did not kill them and used them as training opponents, but they fled when faced with stronger opponents.

Yuhe, the undine leader, kept diving towards the bottom of the sea, especially since she felt something from there. Although the current in the sea was strong, it was not a big problem for her because her race was related to water, and she could transform her body into water.
Something unexpected happened when she was just halfway to the bottom of the sea; a whirlpool suddenly appeared in front of her and sucked her into it.

Yuhe emerged from the whirlpool in a matter of seconds, only to find herself in an underwater city. Despite its small size, the underwater city was surprisingly spacious, with a huge bubble covering the entire area.

Yuhe immediately looked around the area around the underwater city, and she found many members of the undine race. She could also see many other aquatic living beings living in it from both natural races and beast races, but the situation there is really safe and peaceful. "Apparently, Feng Yao doesn't know the existence of this city, or else she has already told Zhang Fei about it. Hmm?
Since this city is specifically for aquatic living beings like me, I will stay here for the time being, so I can increase my strength faster."

After they flew for a few hours due to the vastness of the planet, they finally arrived at the southern part of the human island, and Zhang Fei immediately landed the Pandora Odyssey in an empty place.

Once they disembarked from the flying artifact, Zhang Fei's wives, partners, female family members, and female disciples from the Yin-Yang Pavilion immediately ran towards the sea, which was slightly distant from their location. All of them, especially Angela, who had missed the sea for a long time, were ecstatic.

Zhang Fei let them enjoy themselves first, especially since they had been living in his training space and outer space for so long. He immediately summoned Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] out of the training space, mainly because he couldn't use the portable mansion or the cloud mansion for their residence, so he wanted to build some houses for them to live in.

Zhang Fei then conveyed his idea to the other men, and they immediately agreed with it. They immediately divided the task of looking for wood in the forest and rocks for the foundation of their houses, especially since they had to build several houses for all of them. Additionally, he also wanted to build a wall to protect their houses from beasts or others.

Fortunately, all of them were cultivators, and their cultivations were not bad either, so they didn't need heavy equipment for that. Instead, they used their qi and weapons to cut down trees and split rocks, which was much easier and faster for them to do so.
When the sun had set, Zhang Fei and the men had gathered large quantity logs and rocks, but they still weren't enough to build many houses at once, so they decided to continue the next day.

Unlike Zhang Long and the other men, Zhang Fei did not rest, and his two clones, Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2], went hunting beasts with Feltia [2] to complete the second daily quest. Meanwhile, he immersed himself in his cultivation to complete the first daily quest, especially since there was not much time left.

"Zhang Fei, most of us are humans, so you should find a place to live near the human kingdom." All of them nodded in agreement with Oliver, acknowledging that living on the demon or beast islands was not feasible for them.
Regarding the natural races, most of them have a strong dislike for humans.
"However, you can drop us off at the natural races' island, and we will stay there."
"Eh?
Grandpa, why did you suddenly decide such a thing without telling me?" Zefyr protested as she floated in front of her grandfather with her two small hands on her waist.
"Hahaha!" Oliver laughed and stroked Zefyr's head.

"We've been residing in the fairy forest for an extended period and haven't embarked on any adventures for the past thousand years, so we've made the decision to journey together to discover new adventures in this realm.
Moreover, we've been training hard in his training space for the past six weeks, and our cultivation is not bad either, so the best choice is to go to that island."
"Moreover, Zhang Fei wants to go to that island in the future, so we decided to go there to prepare the way for him." Persix added.
Gravir also spoke to Zefyr.
"Little girl, we are all natural races, and our races are peaceful races.
That's why you don't need to worry about us; we will definitely be fine on the island."
"Well, that's true." Zefyr then turned to the other leaders of the natural races, especially the female ones.
"Are the three of you also heading to that island?"
"No." Elmyra answered Zefyr directly.
"Sabina and Yuhe will join them, but I will stay with you all, and I will teach Ru Xue more about healing, so she will be the best support for you in the future."
"I see." Zefyr then turned to Zhang Fei.
"Are you okay with their decision?"
"Why should I object to their decision?" Zhang Fei responded with a shake of his head.
"All of us are cultivators, and we can only improve ourselves by facing unexpected situations.
Moreover, all of them are experienced seniors, so I believe they can take care of themselves well on the island."
Zefyr released a soft sigh before nodding.
"So where are we going to stay?"
[Ding]
[Mapping of the area of the Nine Stars Realm has been completed; the host can check the entire area via the map.]
Zhang Fei immediately opened his map and checked every area of the human island, where he found that the Xian Kingdom was located in the south of the island.
Moreover, there was a large area quite far from the twons and villages around there, and it was close to the sea.

"We will stay in the south near the sea, especially since Feng Yao said that the kingdom in that area is the safest and most peaceful compared to the other four, so we shouldn't encounter many problems if we stay there."
"Yay!" Most of them cheered with joy after Zhang Fei said that, especially since they were eager to live near the sea, particularly Angela, the demon fish.
Zhang Fei smiled seeing them in such excitement, and he immediately flew the Pandora Odyssey to the natural races' island first to drop Oliver and the others on the island.
After some time, they reached the island's edge, but Yuhe, the undine leader, abruptly decided to jump into the sea below them, causing confusion among the others.

"You don't need to worry about Yuhe, especially since she is an Undine and her habitat is the sea." After Oliver and the others landed on the island, Zhang Fei immediately flew the Pandora Odyssey to the south of the human island.
"So what are we going to do now?
Are we going to look for the nearest city right away?"
"Yes." Sabina immediately pointed toward the forest in front of them.
"I have communicated with the trees in the forest, and they will guide us to the nearest city, which is about 1500 miles from here.
We should move now, as it will take a few days on foot."
They all promptly trailed behind Sabina, but Gravir abruptly spoke to them.
"Hey!

We have been training in Zhang Fei's training space for a considerable amount of time, and since the beasts in this realm are expected to be much stronger than those in the Sky Jade Realm, I wanted to test my fighting skills."
"Hahaha!" Persix laughed hearing that.
"You're right, we can't lose to our leader, so we also need to hone our fighting skills even more, especially since he will take us to the upper realms in the future.
Otherwise, we won't be able to help him deal with the enemies that might appear there, and we will only be a burden to him."
Gravir and the others agreed with Persix, so they leisurely walked through the forest while fighting the beasts that blocked their way.
However, they did not kill them and used them as training opponents, but they fled when faced with stronger opponents.
Yuhe, the undine leader, kept diving towards the bottom of the sea, especially since she felt something from there.
Although the current in the sea was strong, it was not a big problem for her because her race was related to water, and she could transform her body into water.
Something unexpected happened when she was just halfway to the bottom of the sea; a whirlpool suddenly appeared in front of her and sucked her into it.
Yuhe emerged from the whirlpool in a matter of seconds, only to find herself in an underwater city.
Despite its small size, the underwater city was surprisingly spacious, with a huge bubble covering the entire area.
Yuhe immediately looked around the area around the underwater city, and she found many members of the undine race.
She could also see many other aquatic living beings living in it from both natural races and beast races, but the situation there is really safe and peaceful.
"Apparently, Feng Yao doesn't know the existence of this city, or else she has already told Zhang Fei about it.
Hmm?
Since this city is specifically for aquatic living beings like me, I will stay here for the time being, so I can increase my strength faster."

After they flew for a few hours due to the vastness of the planet, they finally arrived at the southern part of the human island, and Zhang Fei immediately landed the Pandora Odyssey in an empty place.

Once they disembarked from the flying artifact, Zhang Fei's wives, partners, female family members, and female disciples from the Yin-Yang Pavilion immediately ran towards the sea, which was slightly distant from their location.
All of them, especially Angela, who had missed the sea for a long time, were ecstatic.
Zhang Fei let them enjoy themselves first, especially since they had been living in his training space and outer space for so long.

He immediately summoned Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2] out of the training space, mainly because he couldn't use the portable mansion or the cloud mansion for their residence, so he wanted to build some houses for them to live in.
Zhang Fei then conveyed his idea to the other men, and they immediately agreed with it.
They immediately divided the task of looking for wood in the forest and rocks for the foundation of their houses, especially since they had to build several houses for all of them.
Additionally, he also wanted to build a wall to protect their houses from beasts or others.
Fortunately, all of them were cultivators, and their cultivations were not bad either, so they didn't need heavy equipment for that.
Instead, they used their qi and weapons to cut down trees and split rocks, which was much easier and faster for them to do so.
When the sun had set, Zhang Fei and the men had gathered large quantity logs and rocks, but they still weren't enough to build many houses at once, so they decided to continue the next day.
Unlike Zhang Long and the other men, Zhang Fei did not rest, and his two clones, Zhang Fei [1] and Feltia [2], went hunting beasts with Feltia [2] to complete the second daily quest.
Meanwhile, he immersed himself in his cultivation to complete the first daily quest, especially since there was not much time left.

chapters.title: Chapter 500 Azaroth
paragraphs: [Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins sent to the inventory.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the soul realm or above.]
[Status: Done]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1 sent to the inventory.]

Zhang Fei, who had previously been focusing on cultivating, immediately opened his eyes when both notifications appeared. He was curious about the reward from the daily gift pack, but he remembered that the reward from the quest to meet Cain and go to the dead forest had not been opened, so he asked Mei to open them.
[You obtained 1 Abyssal Heart Pendant.]
[You obtained 1 Bloodmoon Devouring Array.]
[Abyssal Heart Pendant: A pendant that is imbued with demon energy, it can enhance the wielder's cultivation while corrupting their mind. Grade: Earth.]
[Bloodmoon Devouring Array: A dark formation that channels the power of a blood moon, draining the life force of those trapped within it. Grade: Intermediate-High. Limited: one-time use.]

Zhang Fei immediately took the two new items, but he frowned when he read the description of the Abyssal Heart Pendant. 'Corrupts the user's mind? Does that mean I will become berserk if I use this pendant?'

[There is a possibility of that happening, master. You should not use it unless you are in a truly desperate situation, or the pendant will affect you, and the people around you will have a hard time stopping you.]

'Yeah, you're right.' Zhang Fei immediately read the description of the Bloodmoon Devouring Array. 'Even though I can only use it once, I believe its effects are quite strong, and I might be able to use it if I encounter opponents stronger than me.'

[Master, the gift box is not bad, and you can get a random reward from it, such as Qi, female essence, beast essence, jewels, and usable items. However, the description doesn't mention anything about the usable items, but all the items from the system quests are valuable.]
'Open it, Mei.'
[You gained 50.000 beast essence.]

As soon as the notification appeared, Zhang Fei felt a surge of energy coursing through his body, which was undoubtedly the beast essence. Although the amount was not too much for his current level, he was still satisfied with it, but he hoped that he would get better rewards later, especially the usable items.

Zhang Fei's two clones immediately entered the training space to practice using the battle simulation feature by fighting his old enemies, especially since he was sure that sooner or later he would meet stronger enemies in the Nine Stars Realm.

Zhang Fei felt that he could no longer rely on the hit-and-run strategy he used when fighting his enemies in the Sky Jade Realm, especially since the people around him lacked the strength to take on strong cultivators from their current realm. Therefore, he needed to continue enhancing his combat experience, particularly in hand-to-hand combat.
"Fei."
Zhang Fei smiled when he saw Mu Lingshu and Lin Dong'er walking towards him, and he asked them to sit on either side of him. "Why don't you two go to sleep? It's almost midnight, you know?"

"I'm homesick." Lin Dong'er was the first to answer him. "I'm accustomed to living in the sect with my father, and this is my first time visiting another realm." Furthermore, we have spent a significant amount of time traveling to this realm, so I missed our home realm and my father so much."

"We just arrived in this realm today, so it's natural that you feel homsick, but you'll get used to this new environment after a few days, especially since I myself was like that when I first came to our realm." Lin Dong'er nodded and laid her head on Zhang Fei's right shoulder. "What about you, Lingshu? Are you feeling homesick too?"

"No." Mu Lingshu shook her before explaining. "Having lived alone for a long time, I'm accustomed to this type of situation. However, I usually need a few days to adapt to my new environment, and I always have trouble sleeping when I move to a new place."

Zhang Fei immediately pulled Mu Lingshu's head to his left shoulder before hugging their waists. "Back then, you lived alone because your family didn't want you, but you are no longer alone because you have all of us by your side, and we will all help you get used to everything."

Listening to Zhang Fei, a sweet smile appeared on Mu Lingshu's face, but she then looked at the crowd of women, who were mostly sleeping in the distance. "Anyway, I feel weird seeing all of them gathered together in one place, especially since you and your clones are essentially the same person, but you divided them into different groups.

Mistress Shen, Senior Shen Yu, and several others are your official wives. Your first clone has Du Yuan, Ning Xiang, and the others as his partners. Your second clone has Fyr, Eve, Leora, and Ashreth as his partners. Your third clone has Ba Shuxiang and Xie Jingxian as his partners. If my guess is correct, your other clones also have their own partners, right?"
"My fourth clone has several female demon partners now, but they are not official partners, and I only use them to increase my demon rank.

My fifth clone has no partner at the moment, and he only focuses on dual soul cultivating with my seven female prisoners." Mu Lingshu and Lin Dong'er immediately looked up at him with frowns, and Zhang Fei then told them about his original plans for the female disciples of the Yin-Yang Pavilion and the demons of the Diyu Realm.
"However, I changed my mind about them, and I wanted them to continue staying by my clones' side, so I took them with us now."

"Then, what about me? Are you also going to give me to one of them?" Lin Dong'er asked in an irritated tone, as she did not want to be the wife of Zhang Fei's clones, and she wanted to be his official wife in the future.

Mu Lingshu didn't ask anything, but she was also curiously waiting for Zhang Fei's answer, especially since she herself only wanted to be his official wife if their relationship had deepened and her body had become normal.

"Hahaha." Zhang Fei laughed at her question and pulled his left hand from Mu Lingshu's waist. He then cupped Lin Dong'er's face, but the timid rabbit's cheeks blushed as soon as he kissed her, which was their first kiss. "Do you know the answer now? If I wanted to give you to my clone, I would have eaten you long ago using my first clone."
Lin Dong'er immediately laid her head on Zhang Fei's right shoulder again, rubbed her lips, and smiled to herself as her cheeks became even redder.

Zhang Fei then turned to the other woman and lifted her chin, causing Mu Lingshu's heart to pound as his face moved closer to hers. She immediately closed her eyes as soon as their lips touched each other, but he didn't kiss her for too long and separated their lips again.

Mu Lingshu immediately laid her head on Zhang Fei's left shoulder again and hugged his waist. "I've never liked a man before, but your sincerity in wanting to heal my body touched my feelings, and I unknowingly started to like you. Unfortunately, due to your busy schedule over the past few months, I haven't had much opportunity to meet you, which has left me feeling deeply saddened.

Honestly, I thought that you had forgotten about me because of your business, but you suddenly appeared that day with a new technique. Even though it failed to cure my body, I am still happy that you have never forgotten about me."

"I'm sorry for making you sad before, but the situation is different now, and we will be together for a long time in this realm, so we have plenty of time to deepen our relationship." Mu Lingshu herself was happy with Zhang Fei's decision to take her away with him, so there was no need for them to be separated by distance and time.
"As for your body abnormalities, I will definitely fulfill my promise to you, and I will take you as my wife after your body becomes normal."
"I believe in you."
After they talked for some time, Mu Lingshu and Lin Dong'er joined the other women again and slept with them.

Zhang Fei himself did not go to sleep right away, but he jumped onto the tallest tree in the area. For quite some time, he looked at the star tower while thinking about his plans regarding the tower. He then turned his gaze towards the location of the Cyanwood Mountain, and he was truly impatient to go there to take the low-rank lightning elemental seed.
"Mei, those lightnings are definitely not ordinary ones, and they seem to be strengthened by the lightning law."

[Hehehe! Your guess is right, master. Those lightnings are indeed strengthened by the lightning law, so they are suitable for improving your lightning body cultivation technique, and your body will become even stronger if you continue to forge it using them.

It would be even more beneficial if you were able to obtain the lightning element, as it is considered one of the strongest among the basic elements. Unlike the fire element, which focuses more on single attacks because of its strong explosive power, you can use the lightning element for AOE attack and defense, which will make it easier for you to fight and defend against group enemies.]

"Mei, I certainly want to obtain the lightning element, but it won't be as easy as turning over my palm." Zhang Fei then pointed in that direction. "Look at them; the flashes of those lightnings can be seen from this distance, so they are truly powerful.
Since I don't yet possess the lightning element, my current body won't be able to withstand their attacks, and they will likely reduce me to ashes as soon as they strike."

[Anyway, master, you forgot about something. Actually, I wanted to remind you about it, but you were too focused on your cultivation and soul cultivation, so I waited for your situation to relax first.]
"What do you mean by that?"

[Master, you still haven't met the last beast on Earth, remember? The thunderbird lives in the Amazon forest, and it must have the lightning element. I'm sure its lightning element won't be inferior to Hong Xinxin, even if its cultivation is still far below hers, so I think you can use the fifth clone to meet the beast.

If you can convince it, it can help you to practice your lightning body cultivation technique, and your body will probably become accustomed to lightning attacks, so you will be more prepared to face those lightnings in the Cyanwood Mountain in the future.]
"Oh! That's right! I forgot about that beast!" Zhang Fei immediately used his fifth clone to go there, but two notifications suddenly appeared in his mind.
[Daily Quest: Absorb 100,000 Qi.]
[Reward: 1,000 bronze coins.]
[Daily Quest: Killing 500 beasts or demon beasts at the soul realm or above.]
[Reward: Daily gift pack x1.]

"The amount of Qi I have to absorb and the beasts I have to kill to complete the two daily quests didn't increase, huh? I think this is very good, so I don't have to waste too much time completing them." Zhang Fei immediately jumped down from the tree to cultivate again, and Mei, as usual, was in charge of keeping an eye on the area around them.

In a distant realm, a middle-aged man leisurely strolls among the town crowd, carrying a large package in his hand. However, the town's population is relatively small compared to its size, giving it a deserted appearance. Dense forests that are not too large surround the entire town, and many beasts roam there, both land beasts and flying beasts.
On the other side of the forest, there is a high mountain, but its peak cannot be seen by the eye because it penetrates the clouds in the sky.

Arriving outside the city, the middle-aged man hurriedly headed east and entered the forest, and he moved very carefully so as not to provoke the beasts that lived in it. Fortunately, he was familiar with every area of the forest, so he could find the safest route to return to his place.
After walking for quite a while, the middle-aged man arrived at the other side of the forest. He hurriedly climbed up the mountain until he reached a fairly flat area, where there was a small hut.

As he entered the hut, the middle-aged man let out a soft sigh as he looked at a female demon with long white hair who was still unconscious on the bamboo bed, especially since her body was covered in many deep wounds.

The middle-aged man quickly unwrapped the package, selected the herbs he had bought in the town earlier, and ground them by mixing them with a little water until they became a thick liquid. He also prepared several other herbs by boiling them in water, making the water turn dark green.

Once everything was ready, the middle-aged man took the two to bed and lifted the female demon to assist her in drinking the liquid. After that, he carefully applied the thick liquid to her wounds, covering them completely. "What actually happened there?
This woman was supposed to be a descendant of Zethia, but she ended up stranded in this realm through that portal, so I'm sure something bad happened there."
"Ugh." The female demon suddenly groaned softly as she slowly opened her eyes, but the middle-aged man could see that her eyes were unfocused, especially since he had been unconscious for so long.

"Finally awake?" The female demon was surprised to hear the middle-aged man's question, so she immediately turned to him. However, her expression turned to shock once she recognized his face, and she tried to get up, but he immediately stopped her. "Your injuries haven't fully healed yet, so you'd better not move for the time being.
Otherwise, they'll get worse again, and the treatment I've given you for the past month and a half will be in vain."
The female demon nodded slightly and lay down again. "Demon Emperor Azaroth, you are still alive."

"Hahaha!" Azaroth laughed upon hearing that. "Despite spending thousands of years stranded in this realm and having my demon power sealed by the man who sent me here, I remain alive and well to this day. Anyway, what is your name? How did you end up entering that portal?
As far as I remember, that man placed a lion guardian in front of the portal, and he also used a special formation to prevent other demons from finding it."

"My name is Ilsath, the daughter of Zethia." Ilsath then provided Azaroth with an explanation of all the events that transpired in the Netherworld Realm, which included the fake demon emperor, the Shang Clan's cultivators, and their invasion of various realms.

"Honestly, we never knew that the man was an impostor, and we only found out about it after a beast woman confronted those human cultivators. After that, the demon kings and queens decided to look for that portal to free you, but we were attacked by the guardian.
As for me, King Bapho used me as a shield, and the guardian's attack sent me flying into the portal, but I didn't expect that you would be the one to save me."

"Bapho, huh?" Azaroth muttered to himself. "That brat is indeed a coward and scaredy cat, but I didn't expect him to use a demon weaker than him as a shield. If only I could return to our realm, I would definitely capture him and allow the demon beasts to eat him alive."
Ilsath smiled when she heard that, especially since Azaroth was much different from Oz the first, who ruled them with an iron fist.
"All right, you don't need to think about anything for now, and you should focus on healing your wounds first."
"Thank you, Emperor."

In a distant realm, a middle-aged man leisurely strolls among the town crowd, carrying a large package in his hand.
However, the town's population is relatively small compared to its size, giving it a deserted appearance.
Dense forests that are not too large surround the entire town, and many beasts roam there, both land beasts and flying beasts.
On the other side of the forest, there is a high mountain, but its peak cannot be seen by the eye because it penetrates the clouds in the sky.
Arriving outside the city, the middle-aged man hurriedly headed east and entered the forest, and he moved very carefully so as not to provoke the beasts that lived in it.
Fortunately, he was familiar with every area of the forest, so he could find the safest route to return to his place.
After walking for quite a while, the middle-aged man arrived at the other side of the forest.
He hurriedly climbed up the mountain until he reached a fairly flat area, where there was a small hut.

As he entered the hut, the middle-aged man let out a soft sigh as he looked at a female demon with long white hair who was still unconscious on the bamboo bed, especially since her body was covered in many deep wounds.
The middle-aged man quickly unwrapped the package, selected the herbs he had bought in the town earlier, and ground them by mixing them with a little water until they became a thick liquid.
He also prepared several other herbs by boiling them in water, making the water turn dark green.
Once everything was ready, the middle-aged man took the two to bed and lifted the female demon to assist her in drinking the liquid.
After that, he carefully applied the thick liquid to her wounds, covering them completely.
"What actually happened there?
This woman was supposed to be a descendant of Zethia, but she ended up stranded in this realm through that portal, so I'm sure something bad happened there."
"Ugh." The female demon suddenly groaned softly as she slowly opened her eyes, but the middle-aged man could see that her eyes were unfocused, especially since he had been unconscious for so long.
"Finally awake?" The female demon was surprised to hear the middle-aged man's question, so she immediately turned to him.
However, her expression turned to shock once she recognized his face, and she tried to get up, but he immediately stopped her.
"Your injuries haven't fully healed yet, so you'd better not move for the time being.
Otherwise, they'll get worse again, and the treatment I've given you for the past month and a half will be in vain."
The female demon nodded slightly and lay down again.
"Demon Emperor Azaroth, you are still alive."
"Hahaha!" Azaroth laughed upon hearing that.
"Despite spending thousands of years stranded in this realm and having my demon power sealed by the man who sent me here, I remain alive and well to this day.
Anyway, what is your name?
How did you end up entering that portal?
As far as I remember, that man placed a lion guardian in front of the portal, and he also used a special formation to prevent other demons from finding it."

"My name is Ilsath, the daughter of Zethia." Ilsath then provided Azaroth with an explanation of all the events that transpired in the Netherworld Realm, which included the fake demon emperor, the Shang Clan's cultivators, and their invasion of various realms.
"Honestly, we never knew that the man was an impostor, and we only found out about it after a beast woman confronted those human cultivators.
After that, the demon kings and queens decided to look for that portal to free you, but we were attacked by the guardian.
As for me, King Bapho used me as a shield, and the guardian's attack sent me flying into the portal, but I didn't expect that you would be the one to save me."
"Bapho, huh?" Azaroth muttered to himself.
"That brat is indeed a coward and scaredy cat, but I didn't expect him to use a demon weaker than him as a shield.
If only I could return to our realm, I would definitely capture him and allow the demon beasts to eat him alive."
Ilsath smiled when she heard that, especially since Azaroth was much different from Oz the first, who ruled them with an iron fist.
"All right, you don't need to think about anything for now, and you should focus on healing your wounds first."
"Thank you, Emperor."
